in ruins.cn: 毁坏；严重受损；破败不堪

in the clear.cn: 不再有危险；不再被认为有罪

in time.cn: 经过一段时间之后；迟早；最后；终于

in truth.en: (formal) used to emphasize the true facts about a situation

in your own time.en: in your free time and not when you usually work or study

stick up.en: to point upwards or be above a surface

third time lucky.en: (US also third time is the charm) used when you have failed to do sth twice and hope that you will succeed the third time

with a flea in your ear.cn: 以气愤的言语,以责难(把人轰走)
with a flea in your ear.en: if sb sends a person away with a flea in their ear, they tell them angrily to go away

with a human face.cn: 考虑老百姓需要的；有人情味的；有人性的
with a human face.en: that considers the needs of ordinary people

with a vengeance.cn: 程度更深地；出乎意料地
with a vengeance.en: (informal) to a greater degree than is expected or usual

with a will.en: in a willing and enthusiastic way

with all due respect.cn: (通常在表示强烈不同意之前说)恕我直言
with all due respect.en: (formal) used when you are going to disagree, usually quite strongly, with sb

with gay abandon.en: without thinking about the results or effects of a particular action

with half an ear.en: without giving your full attention to what is being said, etc.

with knobs on.cn: 有过之而无不及；更是如此；尤其突出
with knobs on.en: (BrE, slang) used to say that sth is a more complicated version of what you mention

with pleasure.cn: (客气地接受或同意)当然了,很愿意
with pleasure.en: used as a polite way of accepting or agreeing to sth

with the sun.en: when the sun rises or sets

with tongue in cheek.en: if you say sth with your tongue in your cheek, you are not being serious and mean it as a joke

with your eyes open.cn: 明知后果如何；明知有问题；心中有数
with your eyes open.en: fully aware of the possible problems or results of a particular course of action

with your nose in the air.cn: 傲慢；看不起人；鼻孔朝天,自高自大
with your nose in the air.en: (informal) in a way that is unfriendly and suggests that you think that you are better than other people

with your tail between your legs.cn: 无地自容；垂头丧气；灰溜溜
with your tail between your legs.en: (informal) feeling ashamed or unhappy because you have been defeated or punished

within limits.cn: 在某种程度上；有一定限制
within limits.en: to some extent; with some restrictions

without a second thought.en: immediately; without stopping to think about sth further

without ceremony.cn: 粗鲁无礼；不拘礼节；随便
without ceremony.en: in a very rough or informal way

without exception.en: used to emphasize that the statement you are making is always true and everyone or everything is included

woe to sb.cn: (用以警告某人会有麻烦)…就要倒霉,…将会遭殃
woe to sb.en: (formal or humorous) a phrase that is used to warn sb that there will be trouble for them if they do sth or do not do sth

wonders will never cease.cn: (表示惊喜)真是无奇不有,怪事何其多
wonders will never cease.en: (informal, usually ironic) a phrase used to express surprise and pleasure at sth

word for word.cn: 一字不差地；(翻译时)逐字地
word for word.en: in exactly the same words or (when translated) exactly equivalent words

words to that effect.cn: 诸如此类的话；大致是这个意思的话
words to that effect.en: used to show that you are giving the general meaning of what sb has said rather than the exact words

work at sth.en: to make great efforts to achieve sth or do sth well

work like a charm.en: to be immediately and completely successful

work on sb.cn: 努力说服(使某人答应或做某事)
work on sb.en: to try to persuade sb to agree to sth or to do sth

work on sth.en: to try hard to improve or achieve sth

work sth up into sth.en: to bring sth to a more complete or more acceptable state

work to rule.en: to follow the rules of your job in a very strict way in order to cause delay, as a form of protest against your employer or your working conditions

work to sth.cn: 按照(计划、时间表等)；根据…行事
work to sth.en: to follow a plan, schedule, etc.

work towards sth.cn: 努力达到,设法完成(目标)
work towards sth.en: to try to reach or achieve a goal

work up to sth.cn: 逐步发展到,逐渐达到(更高或更深的程度)
work up to sth.en: to develop or move gradually towards sth, usually sth more exciting or extreme

work wonders.cn: 创造奇迹；取得优良的成绩；产生良好的效果

work your way through sth.cn: 自始至终做(尤指耗费时间或力量的事)
work your way through sth.en: to do sth from beginning to end, especially when it takes a lot of time or effort

work your way up.cn: 逐步升职；按部就班晋升
work your way up.en: to move regularly to a more senior position in a company

worth sb's while.en: interesting or useful for sb to do

wring sb's hand.en: to squeeze sb's hand very tightly when you shake hands

wring sb's neck.cn: (表示愤怒或气恼)拧断…的脖子,非掐死…不可
wring sb's neck.en: (informal) when you say that you will wring sb's neck, you mean that you are very angry or annoyed with them

wring your hands.cn: (尤指出于焦急或烦恼)扭绞双手
wring your hands.en: to hold your hands together, and twist and squeeze them in a way that shows you are anxious or upset, especially when you cannot change the situation

write sth into sth.en: to include a rule or condition in a contract or an agreement when it is made

year by year.cn: 一年一年地；每年；年复一年
year by year.en: as the years pass; each year

yes and no.en: used when you cannot give a clear answer to a question

you can say that again.cn: 让你说对了；一点没错；正是这样

you can't be too careful.cn: 无论怎样小心也不会过分；越小心越好
you can't be too careful.en: used to warn sb that they should take care to avoid danger or problems

you can't get away from sth.cn: 不容否认,只好承认(不愉快的事实)
you can't get away from sth.en: you have to admit that sth unpleasant is true

you can't keep a good man down.cn: 有志者事竟成；决心大的人终有出头之日
you can't keep a good man down.en: (saying) a person who is determined or wants sth very much will succeed

you had me worried.en: (informal) used to tell sb that you were worried because you had not understood what they had said correctly

you haven't lived.cn: (表示若没有某种经历生活便不完整)你白活了
you haven't lived.en: used to tell sb that if they have not had a particular experience their life is not complete

you live and learn.cn: (对得知的事物感到惊讶或意外)真是得活到老学到老,真想不到
you live and learn.en: used to express surprise at sth new or unexpected you have been told

you never can tell.cn: 谁也拿不准；谁也说不清；很难说
you never can tell.en: (saying) you can never be sure, for example because things are not always what they appear to be

you never know.cn: (尤指可能会发生好事)很难说,很难预料
you never know.en: (informal) used to say that you can never be certain about what will happen in the future, especially when you are suggesting that sth good might happen

you see.cn: (作解释时说)你看,你知道,要知道
you see.en: (informal) used when you are explaining sth

you win.cn: (被迫表示同意时说)你赢了,我服输了
you win.en: (informal) used to agree to what sb wants after you have failed to persuade them to do or let you do sth else

you'll be lucky.cn: (告诉某人所期盼的事很可能不会发生)但愿你会走运
you'll be lucky.en: (informal) used to tell sb that sth that they are expecting probably will not happen

you're a fine one to talk.cn: (用以表示自己同样不对时不要批评别人)还有脸说别人
you're a fine one to talk.en: (informal) used to tell sb that they should not criticize sb else for sth because they do the same things too

you're on.en: (informal) used when you are accepting a bet

you're welcome.en: (especially NAmE) used as a polite reply when sb thanks you for sth

young at heart.en: thinking and behaving like a young person even when you are old

your best bib and tucker.en: (humorous) your best clothes that you only wear on special occasions

your conscience pricks you.cn: 唤醒良心；受到良心谴责
your conscience pricks you.en: to make you feel guilty about sth; to feel guilty about sth

your daily bread.en: the basic things that you need to live, especially food

your good deed for the day.en: a helpful, kind thing that you do

your heart goes out to sb.en: used to say that you feel a lot of sympathy for sb

your heart is not in sth.cn: 对某事不很感兴趣(或不热衷)
your heart is not in sth.en: used to say that you are not very interested in or enthusiastic about sth

your number is up.en: (informal) the time has come when you will die or lose everything

your obedient servant.cn: (用作正式信函的结束语)您恭顺的仆人
your obedient servant.en: (old use) used to end a formal letter

your salad days.cn: 年少不谙世事的岁月；涉世未深的青少年时代
your salad days.en: (old-fashioned) the time when you are young and do not have much experience of life

your thick head.cn: (认为某人理解慢而恼火)笨脑瓜,木头脑瓜
your thick head.en: (informal) used to show that you are annoyed that sb does not understand sth

your true colours.en: (often disapproving) your real character, rather than the six that you usually allow other people to see

a bad lot.en: He is truly a bad lot who betrayed his friends for money.
a bad lot.cn: 他是个为了钱出卖朋友的坏人。

a barrel of laughs.en: The comedian's jokes were absolutely a barrel of laughs, making everyone in the room burst with laughter.
a barrel of laughs.cn: 这位喜剧演员的笑话妙趣横生，引得在场所有人捧腹大笑。

a bit much.en: The noise from the construction site is a bit much for me to handle at this hour.
a bit much.cn: 此刻工地上的噪音对我来说实在难以忍受。

a blessing in disguise.en: What seemed like a terrible accident turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
a blessing in disguise.cn: 那看似可怕的事故，结果却是个不幸中的万幸。

a bone of contention.en: The specific allocation of funds remains a bone of contention between the two departments.
a bone of contention.cn: 两部门在资金具体分配问题上仍存在分歧。

a break in a bone in one place.en: The fracture occurred at a single point, causing a break in the bone in just one place.
a break in a bone in one place.cn: 骨折仅发生于一点，导致骨骼仅在单一位置断裂。

a breath of fresh air.en: After years of stagnation, her new ideas were truly a breath of fresh air for the team.
a breath of fresh air.cn: 经历多年停滞不前后，她的新点子为团队带来了清新之风。

a bull in a china shop.en: He acted like a bull in a china shop, breaking everything he touched.
a bull in a china shop.cn: 他像个闯进瓷器店的公牛，所触之物尽碎。

a can of worms.en: We opened a can of worms by discussing the budget deficit.
a can of worms.cn: 讨论预算赤字无异于打开了潘多拉的魔盒。

a case in point.en: The recent surge in inflation serves as a case in point for our economic forecast.
a case in point.cn: 近期通胀飙升印证了我们的经济预测。

a chink in sb's armour.en: We found a chink in his armor when we discovered he was afraid of public speaking.
a chink in sb's armour.cn: 我们在他害怕公开演讲这一弱点中发现了一个破绽。

a clean bill of health.en: The doctor gave him a clean bill of health after his thorough medical examination.
a clean bill of health.cn: 经过全面体检后，医生确认他身体健康。

a close run thing.en: The election was a close run thing, with the margin of victory barely exceeding one percent.
a close run thing.cn: 此次选举胜负之局毫厘必争，胜选幅度仅超过百分之一。

a close thing.en: The outcome remains a close thing, with both sides equally poised to win.
a close thing.cn: 局势胶着，双方均有机会获胜。

a cold fish.en: He was described as a cold fish who never showed any empathy for his suffering friends.
a cold fish.cn: 他被描述为一个冷酷的人，从不表现出对受苦朋友的同情。

a counsel of despair.en: The committee offered a counsel of despair, suggesting they abandon the impossible project immediately.
a counsel of despair.cn: 委员会提出了绝望的建议，建议他们立即放弃这个不可能完成的项目。

a counsel of perfection.en: The proposal was a counsel of perfection, sounding flawless yet impossible to implement in reality.
a counsel of perfection.cn: 该提议堪称完美无瑕，听起来无可挑剔，却难以在现实中实施。

a crashing bore.en: He is such a crashing bore that I can't bear listening to his endless complaints.
a crashing bore.cn: 他是个令人极度厌烦的无聊鬼，我实在无法忍受听他那些无休止的牢骚。

a day of reckoning.en: The company's financial collapse marked a day of reckoning for all its employees.
a day of reckoning.cn: 该公司的财务崩溃使全体员工面临清算时刻。

a different kettle of fish.en: That situation is a different kettle of fish from the one we discussed yesterday.
a different kettle of fish.cn: 那件事与我们昨天讨论的情况大相径庭。

a dog's life.en: His daily existence is truly a dog's life, filled with relentless hardship and despair.
a dog's life.cn: 他的日常生活简直如狗一般，充满了无尽的艰辛与绝望。

a fast talker.en: He is a fast talker, but his promises are often unreliable.
a fast talker.cn: 他话多，但承诺往往不可靠。

a fast worker.en: He is a fast worker who quickly secured her affection.
a fast worker.cn: 他是个勤快的人，很快便赢得了她的芳心。

a fate worse than death.en: He faced a fate worse than death, losing his family and home in the war.
a fate worse than death.cn: 他遭遇了比死亡更悲惨的命运，在战争中失去了家人和家园。

a feather in your cap.en: Winning this competition is truly a feather in your cap, given your impressive track record.
a feather in your cap.cn: 鉴于您出色的履历，赢得此次比赛实属锦上添花。

a figment of sb's imagination.en: The alleged evidence was merely a figment of the detective's imagination, with no factual basis.
a figment of sb's imagination.cn: 所谓证据不过是侦探的臆想，毫无事实依据。

a firm hand.en: The new leader will exercise a firm hand to restore order in the chaotic region.
a firm hand.cn: 新领导人将铁腕治理，以恢复混乱地区的秩序。

a good egg.en: He is a good egg who always stands up for the truth.
a good egg.cn: 他是个正直的人，总是维护真理。

a good few.en: A good few students have already submitted their essays by now.
a good few.cn: 已有不少学生交上了论文。

a good job.en: It's a good job that the storm cleared before our flight was delayed.
a good job.cn: 好在风暴在我们航班延误前就散了。

a guilt trip.en: Don't make me feel guilty by constantly reminding me of my mistakes.
a guilt trip.cn: 别总提醒我的错误让我感到内疚。

a guilty secret.en: He kept the a guilty secret buried deep within his heart for years.
a guilty secret.cn: 他将那份有罪的秘密深埋心底多年。

a heavy heart.en: She stood alone with a heavy heart, unable to bear the weight of her loss.
a heavy heart.cn: 她独自伫立，心绪沉重，难以承受失去亲人的痛苦。

a hornets nest.en: The scandal has turned the company into a real hornet's nest, causing outrage among shareholders.
a hornets nest.cn: 该丑闻使公司陷入极度混乱，引发股东强烈愤慨。

a jack of all trades.en: He is a jack of all trades, yet he lacks true expertise in any specific field.
a jack of all trades.cn: 他无所不能，但在任何特定领域却缺乏真正的专长。

a kind of.en: It's a kind of music that blends traditional rhythms with modern beats.
a kind of.cn: 这是一种将传统节奏与现代节拍融合的音乐。

a knight in shining armour.en: He finally arrived as the knight in shining armour to save her from danger.
a knight in shining armour.cn: 他终于如骑士般身披铠甲前来拯救她脱离险境。

a leopard cannot change its spots.en: Just as a leopard cannot change its spots, he will never abandon his reckless nature.
a leopard cannot change its spots.cn: 正如豹子无法改变其斑点，他也将永远无法放弃其鲁莽的本性。

a licence to print money.en: The central bank issued a licence to print money, causing inflation to skyrocket across the nation.
a licence to print money.cn: 央行发行了印钞令，导致全国物价飞涨。

a likely story.en: That's a likely story; he claims to have flown to Mars yesterday.
a likely story.cn: 这简直是天方夜谭；他声称昨天飞到了火星。

a link in the chain.en: Every individual is merely a link in the chain of events that ultimately determines our collective future.
a link in the chain.cn: 每个人不过是决定我们共同命运的那条因果链条中的一环。

a live wire.en: He is a real live wire, always buzzing with energy and ideas.
a live wire.cn: 他是个精力充沛、点子不断的人。

a long shot.en: Winning the lottery is a long shot, but I'll take my chances anyway.
a long shot.cn: 中彩票几率渺茫，但我还是试一试。

a man's man.en: He is truly a man's man, possessing the strength and courage that only men admire.
a man's man.cn: 他确实是个真正的男子汉，拥有唯有男子才钦佩的力量与勇气。

a meeting of minds.en: The two strangers achieved a meeting of minds instantly, agreeing on the project's core vision.
a meeting of minds.cn: 这两位陌生人瞬间心意相通，一致认同项目的核心愿景。

a mug's game.en: It is a fool's errand, not a mug's game that will ever yield any profit.
a mug's game.cn: 这是一项徒劳无功的差事，绝非能带来任何利润的投机。

a needle in a haystack.en: Finding a specific document among millions of files is like searching for a needle in a haystack.
a needle in a haystack.cn: 在数百万份文件中查找特定文件，犹如大海捞针。

a new one on me.en: I haven't encountered a new one on me regarding this specific regulatory framework.
a new one on me.cn: 就这一特定监管框架而言，我尚未遇到新的情况。

a night out.en: They decided to celebrate their anniversary with a night out at the jazz club.
a night out.cn: 他们决定去爵士俱乐部度个夜，以此庆祝他们的周年纪念。

a pair of hands.en: We need a pair of hands to help us finish the project before tomorrow.
a pair of hands.cn: 我们需要帮手在明天之前完成这个项目。

a peg to hang sth on.en: Without a peg to hang his excuses on, he finally admitted the truth.
a peg to hang sth on.cn: 因无处挂起借口，他终于承认了事实。

a penny for them.en: A penny for your thoughts? You seem to be pondering something deeply.
a penny for them.cn: 在想什么？你似乎在深思熟虑。

a place in the sun.en: The new startup has finally secured a place in the sun with major investors.
a place in the sun.cn: 这家新创业公司终于获得了主要投资者的青睐。

a price on sb's head.en: A bounty was placed on his head, making him the primary target for all law enforcement agencies.
a price on sb's head.cn: 悬赏令悬于其首，使他成为所有执法机构的首要目标。

a raw deal.en: He received a raw deal because his hard work was ignored by the management team.
a raw deal.cn: 他遭遇不公，因为管理层无视了他的辛勤工作。

a rotten apple.en: That one bad employee is ruining the whole team's performance.
a rotten apple.cn: 那名表现不佳的员工正在毁掉整个团队的业绩。

a rough deal.en: It feels like a rough deal when the company takes all the profits while workers earn so little.
a rough deal.cn: 当公司攫取全部利润而工人所得微薄时，这感觉很不公平。

a rule of thumb.en: We can use a rule of thumb to estimate the project's cost quickly.
a rule of thumb.cn: 我们可以用经验法则快速估算项目成本。

a sense of occasion.en: The gala dinner created a special atmosphere that truly reflected the importance of the event.
a sense of occasion.cn: 晚宴营造了独特的氛围，充分体现了活动的重要性。

a shot in the arm.en: The unexpected victory was a real shot in the arm for our team's morale.
a shot in the arm.cn: 这场意外的胜利极大地鼓舞了我们的士气。

a slap in the face.en: The harsh criticism felt like a slap in the face to his hard work and dedication.
a slap in the face.cn: 严厉的批评仿佛是对他辛勤付出与奉献的一记耳光。

a slap on the wrist.en: The fine was just a slap on the wrist that failed to deter his repeated violations.
a slap on the wrist.cn: 罚款只是对他屡犯不改的一种轻微惩戒。

a smoke-filled room.en: They sat in a smoke-filled room, sharing stories that had long since faded from memory.
a smoke-filled room.cn: 他们坐在烟雾缭绕的房间里，讲述那些早已淡出记忆的故事。

a sort of sth.en: It's a sort of modern art that confuses everyone.
a sort of sth.cn: 这是一种让所有人感到困惑的现代艺术。

a square meal.en: The generous donation provided a square meal for the homeless family.
a square meal.cn: 这笔慷慨捐款为无家可归的家庭提供了一顿丰盛的饭菜。

a state of affairs.en: The current state of affairs demands immediate and decisive action from the government.
a state of affairs.cn: 当前局势要求政府立即采取果断行动。

a stone's throw.en: The nearest supermarket is just a stone's throw from our apartment.
a stone's throw.cn: 最近的超市就在我们公寓附近。

a thick head.en: After drinking too much wine, he walked with a thick head and stumbled home.
a thick head.cn: 他喝醉后，头重脚轻地踉踉跄跄地走回家。

a train of thought.en: The speaker lost his train of thought and stumbled over his words.
a train of thought.cn: 说话人思绪中断，言语也磕绊起来。

a very complicated situation.en: They are struggling to navigate this very complicated situation.
a very complicated situation.cn: 他们正努力应对这一极其复杂的局面。

a whole lot.en: I have a whole lot of work to finish before the deadline.
a whole lot.cn: 截止日期前我还有大量工作要完成。

a wolf in sheep's clothing.en: He appeared harmless but was actually a wolf in sheep's clothing.
a wolf in sheep's clothing.cn: 他看似无害，实则披着羊皮的狼。

above all.en: Above all, we must prioritize safety over speed in our daily operations.
above all.cn: 最重要的是，我们在日常运营中必须将安全置于速度之前。

above yourself.en: He is above himself, believing his own importance too much.
above yourself.cn: 他自视过高，过分看重自己的重要性。

absence makes the heart grow fonder.en: Her prolonged absence has only made me miss her even more deeply.
absence makes the heart grow fonder.cn: 她久未露面，反而让我思念更深。

accidents will happen.en: Accidents will happen, so we must always remain vigilant.
accidents will happen.cn: 事故难免，因此我们必须时刻保持警惕。

across country.en: We chose to cross the fields directly, avoiding all main roads.
across country.cn: 我们选择直接穿越田野，避开所有主干道。

across the pond.en: The company is expanding its operations across the pond to capture new markets.
across the pond.cn: 该公司正拓展海外业务以开拓新市场。

actions speak louder than words.en: His generous donations proved that his actions speak louder than his empty promises.
actions speak louder than words.cn: 他慷慨的捐赠证明了他的行动胜过空洞的承诺。

add to sth.en: The new policy will add to the company's annual revenue significantly.
add to sth.cn: 新政策将显著增加公司年收入。

after a fashion.en: The new design is after a fashion, though it lacks originality.
after a fashion.cn: 该设计虽具时尚感，但缺乏原创性。

after everything has been considered.en: After everything has been considered, the committee will make a final decision.
after everything has been considered.cn: 经全面考虑后，委员会将作出最终决定。

after the fact.en: The police found evidence after the fact that proved his innocence.
after the fact.cn: 警方事后发现了证明其无辜的证据。

against nature.en: It is completely against nature to deny the truth when you have seen it.
against nature.cn: 眼见为实，却故意否认真相，这完全违背常理。

against the clock.en: The team raced against the clock to finish the project before midnight.
against the clock.cn: 团队争分夺秒，力求在午夜前完成项目。

against time.en: We must finish the project against time to meet the client's deadline.
against time.cn: 我们必须按时完工，以满足客户的截止日期要求。

against your will.en: He signed the contract against his will, though he regretted it immediately.
against your will.cn: 他违背本意签署了合同，尽管随即感到后悔。

ahead of your time.en: Her vision was truly ahead of her time, predicting trends others missed.
ahead of your time.cn: 她的远见卓识超前于时代，预见了他人所忽略的趋势。

all and sundry.en: The new regulations apply to all and sundry, regardless of their background or status.
all and sundry.cn: 新法规适用于所有人，不论其背景或地位如何。

all at the same time.en: The team executed all tasks simultaneously to maximize efficiency.
all at the same time.cn: 团队同时执行所有任务，以最大化效率。

all found.en: The package includes all found, such as free accommodation and meals.
all found.cn: 该套餐包含所有已列明的项目，如免费住宿和餐饮。

all hell broke loose.en: Suddenly, all hell broke loose when the fire alarm went off in the crowded theater.
all hell broke loose.cn: 突然，拥挤的剧院响起警报，全场顿时乱作一团。

all hours.en: He was found at the scene all hours of the night, long after everyone else had gone home.
all hours.cn: 他整夜都在现场被发现，此时其他人早已回家。

all in a day's work.en: It is all in a day's work for an experienced professional to handle such complex cases efficiently.
all in a day's work.cn: 对经验丰富的专业人士而言，高效处理此类复杂案件是日常工作的一部分。

all in all.en: All in all, the project was a success despite numerous unexpected challenges.
all in all.cn: 总体而言，该项目尽管面临诸多意外挑战，但仍告成功。

all in one.en: The new tablet combines a laptop, phone, and camera all in one.
all in one.cn: 这款新平板电脑将笔记本电脑、手机和相机功能合为一体。

all is not lost.en: Though the project failed, all is not lost if we start fresh.
all is not lost.cn: 尽管项目失败，但若从头开始，一切并非无望。

all of a sudden.en: All of a sudden, the power went out and we were left in total darkness.
all of a sudden.cn: 突然停电，我们置身于完全的黑暗中。

all things considered.en: All things considered, the project's benefits outweigh its significant costs.
all things considered.cn: 综合来看，该项目的收益超过了其显著的成本。

all through a period of time.en: The project spanned all through a period of time marked by severe economic instability.
all through a period of time.cn: 该项目贯穿了一段经济动荡剧烈的时期。

all told.en: All told, the project cost over two million dollars in total expenses.
all told.cn: 总计，该项目总费用超过两百万美元。

allow me.en: Allow me to assist you with this complex task immediately.
allow me.cn: 请允许我立即协助您完成这项复杂任务。

along or further along a road or street.en: We walked along the winding coastal road for miles.
along or further along a road or street.cn: 我们沿着蜿蜒的海岸公路走了数英里。

an acquired taste.en: Some people find the spicy food an acquired taste that takes time to appreciate.
an acquired taste.cn: 有些人觉得辛辣食物是一种需要时间才能欣赏的口味。

an early bird.en: As an early bird, I always arrive at the meeting before everyone else.
an early bird.cn: 我向来是个早到者，总是比其他人提前到达会议现场。

an embarrassment of riches.en: The new collection is an embarrassment of riches, offering too many exquisite options to choose from easily.
an embarrassment of riches.cn: 新系列琳琅满目，过于精美以至于难以挑选。

an old wives tale.en: Many health remedies are just an old wives' tale with no scientific basis.
an old wives tale.cn: 许多所谓的健康疗法不过是毫无科学依据的老话。

and a half.en: The results were nothing short of extraordinary, truly and a half impressive.
and a half.cn: 结果简直非凡，令人叹为观止。

and all that jazz.en: He mentioned the project briefly and all that jazz, leaving us guessing about the details.
and all that jazz.cn: 他仅略提了该项目及相关事宜，让我们对细节一无所知。

and everything.en: The project included data analysis, team meetings, and everything else required for success.
and everything.cn: 该项目包含数据分析、团队会议以及所有成功所需的其他内容。

and no mistake.en: The results are accurate, and no mistake has been made in the entire process.
and no mistake.cn: 结果准确，整个过程中未出错。

and the rest.en: The budget was already tight, and the rest of the costs were even higher.
and the rest.cn: 预算本就紧张，其余费用更高。

and what have you.en: He mentioned a few potential clients, and what have you.
and what have you.cn: 他提到了一些潜在客户，以及其他一些内容。

any amount of sth.en: The project required any amount of patience from the entire team.
any amount of sth.cn: 该项目需要团队付出极大的耐心。

any old how.en: The room was left in any old how after the party ended.
any old how.cn: 派对结束后，房间乱得像什么样子。

any other business.en: Before the meeting concludes, there is no other business to discuss today.
any other business.cn: 会议结束前，今日无其他议题。

any port in a storm.en: When panic strikes, I feel like any port in a storm and make hasty decisions.
any port in a storm.cn: 遇险时，我如风暴中的任何港口般无所适从，仓促做决定。

anything but.en: The project is anything but a success, given all the delays.
anything but.cn: 考虑到种种延误，该项目远非成功。

anything goes.en: In this chaotic market, anything goes, so no one knows what to expect next.
anything goes.cn: 在这个混乱的市场中，一切皆有可能，无人能预知下一刻会发生什么。

anytime soon.en: I won't see you anytime soon because I'm busy with work.
anytime soon.cn: 我工作很忙，短时间内见不到你。

apples and oranges.en: Comparing a car's fuel efficiency to a bicycle is like comparing apples and oranges, as they serve entirely different purposes.
apples and oranges.cn: 将汽车的燃油效率与自行车进行比较，无异于比较苹果和橙子，因为它们的服务目的截然不同。

armed to the teeth.en: The soldiers were armed to the teeth, ready for any potential conflict in the region.
armed to the teeth.cn: 士兵们武装到牙齿，随时准备应对该地区可能发生的冲突。

arrive at sth.en: After hours of debate, the committee finally arrived at a consensus on the new policy.
arrive at sth.cn: 经过数小时的辩论，委员会最终就新政策达成了一致意见。

as a response or reaction to sth.en: As a response to the sudden policy change, many businesses immediately adjusted their strategies.
as a response or reaction to sth.cn: 面对突如其来的政策变化，许多企业立即调整了策略。

as a result of sth.en: As a result of the sudden power outage, the entire office remained dark until morning.
as a result of sth.cn: 因突发的停电，整个办公室直到清晨仍一片漆黑。

as a whole.en: As a whole, the project's success outweighs its minor setbacks.
as a whole.cn: 总体而言，该项目的成功超过了其微小的挫折。

as against sth.en: As against the rising costs, our profits have remained remarkably stable this year.
as against sth.cn: 与成本上涨相比，我司今年利润仍异常稳定。

as always.en: As always, he arrives at the office exactly on time.
as always.cn: 他一如往常，准时到达办公室。

as and when.en: We will visit you as and when your schedule permits.
as and when.cn: 我们将视您的时间安排而定进行拜访。

as busy as a bee.en: She is as busy as a bee, working on her project until late at night.
as busy as a bee.cn: 她忙得像个蜜蜂，工作到深夜。

as clean as a whistle.en: The room was swept and dusted until it was as clean as a whistle.
as clean as a whistle.cn: 房间被打扫得干干净净，一尘不染。

as good as.en: The new model is as good as the one we used last year.
as good as.cn: 新模型与去年使用的效果相当。

as high or as good as sth.en: The results are as high or as good as anyone could have expected.
as high or as good as sth.cn: 结果之好，正如任何人所能预期的那样。

as it is.en: We must accept the situation as it is, rather than trying to change what we cannot control.
as it is.cn: 我们必须接受现状，而不是试图改变我们无法控制的事物。

as it were.en: As it were, the project is progressing smoothly despite minor delays.
as it were.cn: 总体而言，该项目进展顺利，虽有轻微延误。

as long as your arm.en: The distance between the two cities is as long as your arm, making a direct flight unnecessary.
as long as your arm.cn: 两城相距不过臂长，无需直飞。

as luck would have it.en: As luck would have it, the meeting was rescheduled to tomorrow morning.
as luck would have it.cn: 巧的是，会议改期至明天上午。

as much.en: She deserves as much credit for the project's success as her team did.
as much.cn: 她应与其团队一样获得该项目成功的同等赞誉。

as much as sb can do.en: He tried his best, but he could not achieve as much as he could do.
as much as sb can do.cn: 他尽了最大努力，但未能达到他所能够做到的程度。

as old as the hills.en: This tradition is as old as the hills, dating back centuries.
as old as the hills.cn: 此传统源远流长，可追溯至数百年前。

as one.en: As one, the team unanimously agreed to support the new proposal immediately.
as one.cn: 作为一个人，团队一致同意立即支持新提议。

as opposed to.en: We should focus on renewable energy, as opposed to relying on fossil fuels.
as opposed to.cn: 我们应关注可再生能源，而非依赖化石燃料。

as per sth.en: Please submit your report as per the guidelines provided in the handbook.
as per sth.cn: 请按照手册中规定的指南提交报告。

as regards sth.en: As regards the budget, we must prioritize essential expenses first.
as regards sth.cn: 至于预算，我们必须优先保障基本开支。

as six man.en: The team worked as one, moving in perfect unison to achieve their goal.
as six man.cn: 全队齐心协力，动作完美同步，共同达成目标。

as such.en: As such, the policy applies strictly to all employees regardless of rank.
as such.cn: 因此，该政策对所有员工均严格适用，不论其职位高低。

as the crow flies.en: The hotel is only five miles away, as the crow flies.
as the crow flies.cn: 该酒店直线距离仅五英里。

as usual.en: As usual, the team arrived at the stadium just before kickoff.
as usual.cn: 一如往常，球队在开赛前一刻抵达了体育场。

as yet.en: As yet, no concrete evidence has emerged to support the initial hypothesis.
as yet.cn: 目前尚无确凿证据支持初始假设。

as you do.en: As you do, he often makes the same mistake in his reports.
as you do.cn: 正如你所做的那样，他在报告中常犯同样的错误。

ask around.en: Before making a decision, I need to ask around to ensure we have all the necessary information.
ask around.cn: 做决定前，我需要多方询问，以确保掌握所有必要信息。

ask for it.en: He tried to cheat the system, so he deserves to ask for it.
ask for it.cn: 他试图欺骗系统，因此有理由接受其后果。

ask sb out.en: He finally asked her out, and she accepted his invitation to dinner.
ask sb out.cn: 他终于鼓起勇气向她表白，她欣然答应共进晚餐。

at a higher than normal price.en: The company decided to sell the equipment at a higher than normal price due to rising demand.
at a higher than normal price.cn: 公司因需求上涨，决定以高于正常水平的价格出售设备。

at a loss.en: She was at a loss when she couldn't find her keys anywhere.
at a loss.cn: 她四处翻找却找不到钥匙时不知所措。

at a low ebb.en: The company is at a low ebb, facing severe financial difficulties and declining sales.
at a low ebb.cn: 该公司陷入低谷，面临严峻的财务困境和销量下滑。

at a moment's notice.en: The hotel offers rooms at a moment's notice, so you can book instantly without prior arrangements.
at a moment's notice.cn: 该酒店可应要求即刻安排客房，无需预先预约即可立即预订。

at a snail's pace.en: The project is moving at a snail's pace, causing significant delays.
at a snail's pace.cn: 该项目进展缓慢，导致严重延误。

at a time.en: The committee will review each proposal at a time to ensure thorough evaluation.
at a time.cn: 委员会将逐一审查每项提案，以确保全面评估。

at all events.en: At all events, we must finish the project before the deadline.
at all events.cn: 无论如何，我们必须在截止日期前完成项目。

at all times.en: You must follow the rules at all times, no matter where you are.
at all times.cn: 无论身在何处，都必须始终遵守规则。

at an unearthly hour.en: We arrived at an unearthly hour, having missed the last bus entirely.
at an unearthly hour.cn: 我们抵达时已是异乎寻常的时刻，因为完全错过了末班车。

at an ungodly hour.en: He arrived at the office at an ungodly hour, disrupting everyone's morning routine.
at an ungodly hour.cn: 他在一个不吉利的时刻到达办公室，打乱了每个人的晨间惯例。

at any cost.en: She insisted on finishing the project at any cost, regardless of her health.
at any cost.cn: 她不顾健康，坚持要完成该项目。

at any price.en: She will accept the job at any price, regardless of how low the salary is.
at any price.cn: 她愿意以任何价格接受这份工作，无论薪水多低。

at bay.en: The predator finally cornered the prey, forcing it into a desperate fight at bay.
at bay.cn: 捕食者终于将猎物逼入绝境，迫使它殊死搏斗。

at bottom.en: At bottom, the project's failure stems from a lack of adequate funding.
at bottom.cn: 究其根本，该项目的失败源于资金不足。

at cost.en: The company decided to sell the old warehouse at cost rather than for a profit.
at cost.cn: 公司决定以成本价出售旧仓库，而非获利。

at death's door.en: The patient is at death's door, so the doctors are working tirelessly to save him.
at death's door.cn: 病人命悬一线，医生正全力以赴抢救他。

at first glance.en: At first glance, the painting's vibrant colors immediately captivated me.
at first glance.cn: 乍看之下，画作鲜艳的色彩便立刻吸引了我。

at gunpoint.en: The hostages were held at gunpoint until the police arrived to negotiate.
at gunpoint.cn: 人质被持枪者挟持，直到警察到达进行谈判。

at heart.en: At heart, she is a kind person who always helps others.
at heart.cn: 她本质上是个心地善良、总是乐于助人的人。

at knifepoint.en: The negotiations reached a critical stage where the deal hung at knifepoint.
at knifepoint.cn: 谈判进入关键阶段，交易岌岌可危。

at liberty.en: The prisoner was granted his freedom and declared at liberty.
at liberty.cn: 该囚犯获准释放，并被宣布自由。

at liberty to do sth.en: The government is at liberty to impose stricter regulations if necessary.
at liberty to do sth.cn: 必要时，政府有权实施更严格的监管。

at long last.en: At long last, the project was completed after years of hard work.
at long last.cn: 经过多年的辛勤努力，该项目终于完工了。

at one stroke.en: He managed to solve the complex problem at one stroke.
at one stroke.cn: 他一举解决了这个复杂问题。

at random.en: The committee selected candidates at random to ensure fairness in the process.
at random.cn: 委员会随机选拔候选人，以确保过程的公平性。

at sb's behest.en: The new policy was implemented at the CEO's behest after a board meeting.
at sb's behest.cn: 新政策经董事会会议后由首席执行官下令实施。

at sb's convenience.en: Please contact me at your convenience, whenever it suits you best.
at sb's convenience.cn: 请随时联系我，在您最方便的时候。

at sb's discretion.en: The final decision rests entirely at the manager's discretion.
at sb's discretion.cn: 最终决定权完全由经理自行裁量。

at sb's hands.en: The project failed at the team leader's hands due to poor planning.
at sb's hands.cn: 该项目因规划不善而未能由团队负责人成功完成。

at sb's service.en: I am at your service if you need any assistance with the project.
at sb's service.cn: 如需项目协助，我随时为您服务。

at source.en: We must address the root causes at source to prevent future environmental disasters.
at source.cn: 必须从源头解决根本原因，以防止未来的环境灾难。

at stake.en: The future of the project remains at stake due to recent budget cuts.
at stake.cn: 该项目的前景因近期预算削减而岌岌可危。

at that.en: At that, the committee also approved the additional funding request.
at that.cn: 此时，委员会还批准了额外的资金请求。

at the actual place where sth is happeni.en: We need to verify the data at the actual place where the incident occurred.
at the actual place where sth is happeni.cn: 我们需要在事故发生地核实数据。

at the beginning.en: At the beginning of the semester, we focused on basic grammar before moving to complex sentences.
at the beginning.cn: 学期初，我们先学习基础语法，再过渡到复杂句式。

at the best of times.en: Even at the best of times, his financial situation remains precarious.
at the best of times.cn: 即便在最好的时候，他的财务状况依然岌岌可危。

at the latest.en: You must submit your application by Friday at the latest.
at the latest.cn: 最迟须于本周五提交申请。

at the longest.en: It will take at the longest two weeks to finish this project.
at the longest.cn: 完成该项目最长需要两周时间。

at the outside.en: At the outside, only three people attended the meeting.
at the outside.cn: 门外只有三人参加了会议。

at the risk of doing sth.en: At the risk of sounding foolish, I think we should reconsider our entire strategy.
at the risk of doing sth.cn: 冒昧之见，我认为我们应重新审视整个战略。

at the same time.en: While we must address the immediate crisis, we should also plan for long-term recovery.
at the same time.cn: 在应对眼前危机的同时，我们也应规划长期复苏。

at the top of the tree.en: She has reached the top of the tree in her career, leading the industry.
at the top of the tree.cn: 她已升至职业生涯巅峰，引领行业。

at the top of your voice.en: She sang at the top of her voice to make the entire audience feel the emotion.
at the top of your voice.cn: 她声嘶力竭地歌唱，让全场观众都感受到了那份情感。

at this moment in time.en: At this moment in time, the city is experiencing its most chaotic traffic conditions ever recorded.
at this moment in time.cn: 此刻，该市正经历着有史以来最混乱的交通状况。

at times.en: At times, the unexpected weather disrupts our carefully planned outdoor activities.
at times.cn: 有时，突如其来的天气会打乱我们精心安排的户外活动。

at will.en: He has the freedom to work at his own pace and at his own will.
at will.cn: 他可按自己的节奏和意愿工作。

at your command.en: The company grants you full authority at your command over all project resources.
at your command.cn: 公司赋予您全权指挥所有项目资源。

at your leisure.en: You may review the contract at your leisure whenever you have time.
at your leisure.cn: 您随时有空时均可审阅合同。

away from a price.en: The market is moving away from a price that reflects the true value of these goods.
away from a price.cn: 市场正转向不再反映这些商品真实价值的价格。

away from work or duty.en: He decided to stay away from work or duty to rest after the long shift.
away from work or duty.cn: 他决定在长时间工作后休息，暂不处理工作或公务。

back on track.en: After the setback, she managed to get back on track with her studies.
back on track.cn: 受挫后，她设法重新投入学业。

bag and baggage.en: He left the office bag and baggage, taking everything with him in a hurry.
bag and baggage.cn: 他匆忙地离开办公室，带走了所有的包和行李。

bang into sth.en: He accidentally banged into the doorframe while rushing to catch the bus.
bang into sth.cn: 他赶去抓公交车时不小心撞到了门框。

be a bit strong.en: I think you're being a bit strong about that point.
be a bit strong.cn: 我认为你对这一点有些过分了。

be a crying shame.en: The project's failure is truly a crying shame given all the resources invested.
be a crying shame.cn: 鉴于投入的资源之多，该项目的失败实在令人痛心。

be a dead ringer for sb.en: Her new hairstyle is a dead ringer for the famous actress's.
be a dead ringer for sb.cn: 她的新发型与那位著名女演员的一模一样。

be a dirty word.en: It is considered a dirty word to discuss the scandal in that specific circle.
be a dirty word.cn: 在该特定圈子内讨论丑闻被视为不光彩之事。

be a game.en: You should take this matter seriously; it is not just a game.
be a game.cn: 此事应认真对待，绝非儿戏。

be a law unto yourself.en: He insists on being a law unto himself, ignoring all rules and regulations.
be a law unto yourself.cn: 他坚持我行我素，无视一切规章条例。

be a mass of.en: The room was a mass of clutter, making it impossible to find anything.
be a mass of.cn: 房间杂乱不堪，什么都找不到。

be all ears.en: She sat with her eyes wide, completely be all ears to listen to his exciting story.
be all ears.cn: 她睁大眼睛，全神贯注地倾听着他激动人心的故事。

be all eyes.en: The whole team was all eyes on the captain as he made his crucial decision.
be all eyes.cn: 全队目光都聚焦在队长身上，因为他正做出关键决定。

be all mouth.en: He is all mouth, boasting about his plans while doing absolutely nothing.
be all mouth.cn: 他只会夸夸其谈，空谈计划却一事无成。

be all the rage.en: Smartphones are currently all the rage among teenagers everywhere.
be all the rage.cn: 如今，智能手机在各地青少年中极为流行。

be all the same to sb.en: It really doesn't matter to me, so it is all the same to me.
be all the same to sb.cn: 于我而言，这真的无关紧要，一切对我来说都一样。

be an item.en: They decided to be an item and move in together immediately.
be an item.cn: 他们决定成为情侣并立即同居。

be asking for it.en: He ignored the warning and now he is truly asking for it.
be asking for it.cn: 他无视警告，如今自讨苦吃。

be at issue.en: The question of funding remains the primary issue at hand.
be at issue.cn: 资金问题仍是当前首要难题。

be at it again.en: Don't be at it again, or the police will have you in no time.
be at it again.cn: 别再这样了，否则警察很快就会把你抓起来。

be at pains to do sth.en: She is at pains to ensure that her children receive the best possible education.
be at pains to do sth.cn: 她费尽心机确保子女接受最好的教育。

be at sb's command.en: The army is entirely at the general's command, ready to execute any order.
be at sb's command.cn: 全军完全听命于将军，随时准备执行任何命令。

be at the end of sth.en: The supply of fresh water is now at the end of our ability to cope with the drought.
be at the end of sth.cn: 淡水供应现已达到我们应对干旱能力的极限。

be at your wits end.en: When the crisis hit, I was truly at my wits' end with no clear solution in sight.
be at your wits end.cn: 危机爆发时，我束手无策，眼前并无明解之法。

be beside the point.en: His complaint about the price is beside the point; we must address the quality issues first.
be beside the point.cn: 他对价格的抱怨无关紧要；我们应先解决质量问题。

be beyond sb.en: The complexity of this problem is truly beyond my understanding.
be beyond sb.cn: 此问题的复杂性确实超出了我的理解范围。

be bitten by sth.en: She is completely bitten by the habit of reading every night before sleep.
be bitten by sth.cn: 她养成了每晚睡前阅读的习惯。

be borne in on sb.en: It took her years to be borne in on the reality of his situation.
be borne in on sb.cn: 她花了多年时间才真正了解他的处境。

be bouncing off the walls.en: The children were so excited they couldn't stop bouncing off the walls.
be bouncing off the walls.cn: 孩子们兴奋极了，在屋里蹦来蹦去停不下来。

be bound up in sth.en: He is completely bound up in his latest research project, leaving no time for family.
be bound up in sth.cn: 他完全沉浸在最新的研究项目中，无暇顾及家庭。

be brought low.en: The scandal ultimately brought the wealthy family down, stripping them of their social standing and fortune.
be brought low.cn: 该丑闻最终使这个富裕家庭身败名裂，失去了社会地位和财富。

be bursting to do sth.en: She was bursting to tell everyone about her amazing new discovery.
be bursting to do sth.cn: 她迫不及待地想告诉所有人她惊人的新发现。

be calculated to do sth.en: The plan was calculated to confuse the opposition and gain time.
be calculated to do sth.cn: 该计划旨在迷惑对手并争取时间。

be child's play.en: Learning to code has become nothing but a child's play for me now.
be child's play.cn: 如今，学编程对我来说简直易如反掌。

be coming up roses.en: The new startup is thriving, with rapid growth and success be coming up roses.
be coming up roses.cn: 这家新创业公司蓬勃发展，增长迅速，前景一片光明。

be dead and gone.en: The old factory is dead and gone, replaced by a gleaming glass tower.
be dead and gone.cn: 那座旧工厂已荡然无存，取而代之的是座熠熠生辉的玻璃塔楼。

be devoured by sth.en: She was completely devoured by the thrill of winning the competition.
be devoured by sth.cn: 她完全被赢得比赛的兴奋所吞噬。

be doing well.en: She is doing well after her surgery and has returned to work.
be doing well.cn: 她术后恢复良好，已重返工作岗位。

be done for.en: The project is completely off track and we are truly done for.
be done for.cn: 该项目已彻底偏离轨道，我们确实已无力回天。

be done in.en: After running the marathon, she was absolutely done in and couldn't walk straight.
be done in.cn: 跑完马拉松后，她累得精疲力竭，无法直着走。

be down on your luck.en: He is down on his luck and can't afford a new car.
be down on your luck.cn: 他运气不好，买不起新车。

be down to sb.en: The final decision is entirely down to the manager's judgment.
be down to sb.cn: 最终决定完全取决于经理的判断。

be down to sth.en: After the lavish party, we were left down to just a few dollars.
be down to sth.cn: 宴会结束后，我们仅剩几美元了。

be drugged up to the eyeballs.en: He was so heavily drugged up to the eyeballs that he barely recognized his own mother.
be drugged up to the eyeballs.cn: 他醉得连自己的母亲都几乎认不出来了。

be employed in doing sth.en: He was found to be employed in doing illegal activities last night.
be employed in doing sth.cn: 昨晚发现他从事非法活动。

be getting younger.en: He looks so energetic that he seems to be getting younger every day.
be getting younger.cn: 他看起来精力充沛，仿佛每天都在返老还童。

be glued to sth.en: She was glued to her phone, completely absorbed in the latest video game.
be glued to sth.cn: 她全神贯注地盯着手机，完全沉浸在最新的游戏里。

be going places.en: She is on the right track and is definitely going places in her career.
be going places.cn: 她方向正确，事业前途无量。

be good with your hands.en: She is truly good with her hands, crafting intricate wooden furniture with remarkable skill.
be good with your hands.cn: 她手艺精湛，能巧妙制作出精美的木制家具。

be guaranteed to do sth.en: It is guaranteed that the new policy will significantly boost local employment rates.
be guaranteed to do sth.cn: 新政策将显著提升当地就业率。

be history.en: The scandal is now just a distant memory, completely out of date and irrelevant to our current reality.
be history.cn: 这起丑闻如今已成遥远的往事，完全过时且与我们当下的现实无关。

be implicated in sth.en: He was implicated in the fraud, which caused significant financial loss to the company.
be implicated in sth.cn: 他卷入欺诈案，给公司造成重大经济损失。

be in a jam.en: The company is in a jam due to the sudden supply chain disruption.
be in a jam.cn: 该公司因供应链突然中断而陷入困境。

be in a minority of one.en: He was the only one to disagree, making him a minority of one against the majority.
be in a minority of one.cn: 他是唯一持异议的人，成为少数派中的孤军。

be in attendance.en: The CEO was in attendance to sign the crucial merger agreement.
be in attendance.cn: 首席执行官出席签署关键并购协议。

be in business.en: The team is finally in business and ready to launch the new product.
be in business.cn: 团队终于投入运营，准备推出新产品。

be in doubt.en: I am still in doubt about whether the project will be completed on time.
be in doubt.cn: 我仍不确定项目能否按时完成。

be in sb's confidence.en: He is the only one truly in the CEO's confidence and holds her deepest secrets.
be in sb's confidence.cn: 他是唯一真正获得首席执行官信任的人，也知晓她最深处的秘密。

be in sb's debt.en: I am deeply in your debt for the invaluable support you provided during my research.
be in sb's debt.cn: 承蒙您在研究期间给予的宝贵支持，我深感感激。

be in sb's good graces.en: He finally managed to be in the manager's good graces after apologizing for his mistake.
be in sb's good graces.cn: 他最终因道歉而消除了经理的不满。

be in sb's light.en: The tall building blocked the sun, leaving our office in darkness.
be in sb's light.cn: 高楼挡住了阳光，使办公室陷入黑暗。

be in sb's pocket.en: The government is clearly in the hands of a corrupt faction.
be in sb's pocket.cn: 政府显然已被腐败派系把持。

be in the bag.en: The project is finally in the bag, so we can celebrate our hard work.
be in the bag.cn: 项目终于敲定，我们可以庆祝辛勤工作了。

be in the can.en: The documentary crew is finally in the can, ready for editing.
be in the can.cn: 纪录片团队终于完成了拍摄，准备进入后期编辑阶段。

be in the doghouse.en: She was left out of the party and is now in the doghouse.
be in the doghouse.cn: 她被排除在聚会之外，现在正被众人冷落。

be in the genes.en: It's not just bad luck; it is clearly written in his genes.
be in the genes.cn: 这并非单纯的运气不好，而是明确写在他基因里的。

be in the money.en: The stock market finally broke through, putting our portfolio firmly in the money.
be in the money.cn: 股市终于突破，使我们的投资组合稳稳盈利。

be in the same boat.en: We are all in the same boat and must face this challenge together.
be in the same boat.cn: 我们同乘一条船，必须共同面对这一挑战。

be in your dotage.en: Critics accused the aging leader of being in his dotage when he made such a foolish decision.
be in your dotage.cn: 批评家指责这位年迈的领导人处于暮年之际时做出了如此愚蠢的决定。

be into sth.en: He is completely into the latest trends in modern street fashion.
be into sth.cn: 他完全热衷于现代街头时尚的流行趋势。

be jumping up and down.en: She was absolutely thrilled, be jumping up and down with joy.
be jumping up and down.cn: 她欣喜若狂，高兴得跳上跳下。

be just looking.en: I'm just looking, not buying anything right now.
be just looking.cn: 我只是看看，暂时不买任何东西。

be looking over your shoulder.en: She kept her eyes fixed on the road, always be looking over her shoulder for any hidden dangers.
be looking over your shoulder.cn: 她目光紧锁前方道路，时刻警惕身后是否有隐藏的危险。

be looking to do sth.en: She is looking to find a better job that matches her skills.
be looking to do sth.cn: 她在寻找一份能发挥她技能的更好工作。

be lost for words.en: He was so shocked by the sudden news that he was completely lost for words.
be lost for words.cn: 突如其来的消息令他震惊得无言以对。

be lost in sth.en: She was completely lost in the book, ignoring everything around her.
be lost in sth.cn: 她完全沉浸在书中，忽略了周围的一切。

be lost on sb.en: The complex theory remained completely lost on the students, who struggled to grasp its nuances.
be lost on sb.cn: 该理论对学生而言完全难以理解，他们苦于把握其细微之处。

be lost to the world.en: She was so engrossed in her novel that she seemed completely lost to the world.
be lost to the world.cn: 她全神贯注于小说创作，仿佛与世隔绝。

be made of sterner stuff.en: He is truly made of sterner stuff, having endured years of relentless hardship without breaking.
be made of sterner stuff.cn: 他确实由更坚韧的材质铸成，历经多年艰苦磨难而未曾折断。

be meant to be sth.en: It is generally believed that the project was meant to be a complete failure.
be meant to be sth.cn: 人们普遍认为该项目注定要彻底失败。

be miles away.en: She was so lost in her thoughts that she seemed to be miles away from the present moment.
be miles away.cn: 她沉浸于思绪之中，仿佛与当下相隔千里。

be my guest.en: You may take the seat if you wish; be my guest.
be my guest.cn: 如您愿意，请就座；您自便。

be no joke.en: It is absolutely not a joke to fix this complex system in such a short time.
be no joke.cn: 在如此短的时间内修复如此复杂的系统绝非儿戏。

be no laughing matter.en: It is absolutely not a laughing matter, given the serious consequences involved.
be no laughing matter.cn: 鉴于后果严重，这绝非儿戏。

be no oil painting.en: She is not an oil painting; her features are quite ordinary.
be no oil painting.cn: 她并非油画；其容貌颇为普通。

be no picnic.en: It is certainly not a picnic to manage such complex logistics alone.
be no picnic.cn: 独自管理如此复杂的物流绝非易事。

be no respecter of persons.en: The law must be applied equally to everyone, with no one receiving special treatment or privilege.
be no respecter of persons.cn: 法律必须平等适用于所有人，不得给予任何人特殊待遇或特权。

be no slouch.en: He is absolutely no slouch at coding, finishing complex projects with ease.
be no slouch.cn: 他编程能力极强，能轻松完成复杂项目。

be not to know.en: I am not to know what happened until the police arrive.
be not to know.cn: 直到警察到达，我才得知发生了什么。

be nothing to sb.en: To him, the entire scandal was nothing to him.
be nothing to sb.cn: 对他而言，整个丑闻与他无关。

be on a razor edge.en: The company is on a razor's edge, facing potential bankruptcy if sales don't improve.
be on a razor edge.cn: 该公司处于破产边缘，若销售不改善则面临倒闭风险。

be on a roll.en: The team is on a roll, winning every game in their recent championship run.
be on a roll.cn: 该队势头正盛，近期冠军赛段连胜多场。

be on about sth.en: They were constantly on about the upcoming budget meeting.
be on about sth.cn: 他们一直喋喋不休地谈论即将召开的预算会议。

be on edge.en: The unexpected announcement left the entire team on edge, causing everyone to feel anxious and restless.
be on edge.cn: 突如其来的消息令全队如坐针毡，人人感到焦虑不安。

be on firm ground.en: He is on firm ground regarding the evidence, so his argument holds significant weight.
be on firm ground.cn: 他在证据方面立场坚定，因此其论点颇具分量。

be on for sth.en: She is on for a promotion, so she's working extra hours this week.
be on for sth.cn: 她正在争取晋升，所以本周加班。

be on sb's back.en: The constant pressure from his parents made it hard for him to focus on his studies.
be on sb's back.cn: 父母持续的施压使他难以专心学习。

be on sb's case.en: The coach is constantly on the player's case about his lack of effort.
be on sb's case.cn: 教练不断指责他缺乏努力。

be on sb's side.en: The judge finally ruled in favor of the defendant, showing he was truly on their side.
be on sb's side.cn: 法官最终判决被告胜诉，表明他真正站在他们这一边。

be on sb's wavelength.en: They finally found a way to be on the same wavelength and collaborate effectively.
be on sb's wavelength.cn: 他们最终找到了同频协作的有效方法。

be on the case.en: The detective is finally on the case and has made significant progress.
be on the case.cn: 侦探终于着手调查，已取得重大进展。

be on the door.en: The usher was busy standing on the door, checking tickets for every patron entering.
be on the door.cn: 售票员正站在门口，为每位入场者检票。

be on the offensive.en: The company decided to be on the offensive by launching a bold new marketing campaign.
be on the offensive.cn: 该公司决定采取攻势，推出了一项大胆的新的营销活动。

be on the skids.en: The company is currently on the skids due to a severe decline in sales figures.
be on the skids.cn: 该公司因销售额大幅下滑而陷入困境。

be on your best behaviour.en: You must be on your best behaviour during the formal dinner tonight.
be on your best behaviour.cn: 今晚正式晚宴上，你必须举止得体。

be on your guard.en: You should be on your guard against anyone trying to manipulate you.
be on your guard.cn: 你应警惕任何试图操纵你的人。

be oneself.en: She finally felt at ease and decided to be herself instead of pretending.
be oneself.cn: 她终于感到自在，决定做真实的自己，不再伪装。

be onto a good thing.en: He finally landed his dream job and is truly living on top of things.
be onto a good thing.cn: 他终于获得了梦寐以求的工作，正真真切切地过上理想生活。

be out of your tree.en: The drug made him act so strangely that he seemed completely out of his tree.
be out of your tree.cn: 药物使他举止怪异，仿佛完全失去了常态。

be out on your ear.en: He was finally made to leave his job after years of incompetence and poor performance.
be out on your ear.cn: 他在多年不胜任和表现不佳后，终于被解雇。

be over the hump.en: After months of struggle, we are finally over the hump and things are looking up.
be over the hump.cn: 历经数月艰难挣扎，我们终于翻过难关，形势日渐好转。

be poles apart.en: Their opinions on this controversial issue are completely poles apart.
be poles apart.cn: 他们对这一争议问题的看法截然相反。

be possessed of sth.en: She is truly possessed of an innate talent for mathematics.
be possessed of sth.cn: 她天生便具有数学方面的天赋。

be remembered as sth.en: He will be remembered as the greatest innovator in modern history.
be remembered as sth.cn: 他将被铭记为现代史上最伟大的创新者。

be riddled with sth.en: The old factory was riddled with structural issues that made it unsafe for workers.
be riddled with sth.cn: 这座旧工厂存在大量结构问题，导致工人无法安全作业。

be riding for a fall.en: He was so reckless that he was literally riding for a fall.
be riding for a fall.cn: 他鲁莽至极，简直是在自取灭亡。

be riding high.en: The team is still riding high after their unexpected victory last night.
be riding high.cn: 这支球队昨晚意外获胜后士气正旺。

be sb's department.en: This complex issue falls squarely within the director's department, so only he can address it.
be sb's department.cn: 这一复杂问题完全属于导演部门管辖，唯有他才能处理。

be sb's life.en: He is truly my life, the one person who matters most to me in this chaotic world.
be sb's life.cn: 他确实是我的一切，在这个混乱的世界里，他是唯一对我至关重要的人。

be sb's lookout.en: It is your own responsibility to be someone's lookout for their questionable behavior.
be sb's lookout.cn: 你应负责留意他人的可疑行为。

be sb's man.en: He is the only one who can truly lead our team through this crisis.
be sb's man.cn: 唯有他能带领我们的团队度过这场危机。

be sb's middle name.en: His unyielding honesty is truly his middle name, defining who he is.
be sb's middle name.cn: 他坚贞不欺的诚实，恰如其中名一般，定义了他是谁。

be sb's pigeon.en: It is my job to handle these sensitive client files every day.
be sb's pigeon.cn: 我每天都要处理这些敏感的客户文件。

be sb's strong suit.en: Her ability to negotiate complex deals is truly her strongest professional asset.
be sb's strong suit.cn: 她谈判复杂交易的能力，确实是其最突出的专业优势。

be sold on sth.en: She is completely sold on the new startup's innovative business model.
be sold on sth.cn: 她完全看好这家新创业公司的创新商业模式。

be spoiling for a fight.en: The two rivals were clearly spoiling for a fight, ready to clash immediately.
be spoiling for a fight.cn: 这两名对手显然急于开战，随时准备立即交锋。

be staring sth in the face.en: The consequences of our negligence are staring us right in the face.
be staring sth in the face.cn: 我们过失的后果正赤裸裸地摆在眼前。

be sunk in sth.en: She was completely sunk in her own thoughts, ignoring everyone around her.
be sunk in sth.cn: 她完全沉浸在自己的思绪中，忽略了周围的一切。

be sure to do sth.en: You must be sure to submit your report before the deadline.
be sure to do sth.cn: 务必在截止日期前提交报告。

be sweet on sb.en: He has been sweet on her for months, constantly sending flowers and gifts.
be sweet on sb.cn: 他追求她数月之久，不断送花和礼物。

be that as it may.en: Be that as it may, the project deadline remains unchanged despite recent delays.
be that as it may.cn: 尽管如此，项目截止日期仍不受近期延误影响。

be the biz.en: That presentation was absolutely brilliant and truly the biz.
be the biz.cn: 那次演示堪称完美，确实展现了行业水准。

be the business.en: That's exactly what I needed; it is truly the business.
be the business.cn: 这正是我所需要的；它确实就是生意本身。

be the butt of sth.en: He became the butt of jokes whenever he forgot his lines during the play.
be the butt of sth.cn: 他在演出中忘词时总成为众人取笑的对象。

be the death of sb.en: The constant uncertainty about his safety is slowly becoming the death of him.
be the death of sb.cn: 对他安危的持续担忧正逐渐夺去他的生命。

be the despair of sb.en: The constant delays have become the despair of our entire project team.
be the despair of sb.cn: 这些持续的延误已使我们整个项目团队陷入绝望。

be the limit.en: It's absolutely unbearable; it truly is the limit of what I can tolerate.
be the limit.cn: 这实在无法忍受，已达我所能容忍的极限。

be the making of sb.en: He is truly the making of his supportive mother and hard work.
be the making of sb.cn: 他确实是他母亲的悉心支持与自身努力共同造就的。

be the pits.en: This terrible performance was truly the pits, leaving everyone in despair.
be the pits.cn: 这次糟糕至极的表现真是令人绝望，让所有人陷入困境。

be the spitting image of sb.en: She is absolutely the spitting image of her mother, with identical features and a matching smile.
be the spitting image of sb.cn: 她简直是她母亲的翻版，五官完全相同，笑容也一模一样。

be there for sb.en: She is always be there for her friends whenever they face difficulties.
be there for sb.cn: 她总是在朋友遇到困难时挺身而出。

be tickled pink.en: She was absolutely tickled pink after receiving the unexpected birthday gift from her best friend.
be tickled pink.cn: 收到挚友突如其来的生日礼物后，她欣喜若狂。

be toast.en: The company is toast after the scandal exposed their financial mismanagement.
be toast.cn: 丑闻曝光其财务混乱后，该公司已陷入绝境。

be too late.en: It is simply too late to regret your mistakes now.

be touched with sth.en: The sunset was slightly tinged with a faint golden hue.

be under arms.en: The army has been placed on high alert, fully prepared to respond to any sudden threat.
be under arms.cn: 军队已进入最高戒备状态，随时应对突发威胁。

be under control.en: The situation is finally under control thanks to the emergency team's swift action.
be under control.cn: 多亏应急小组迅速采取行动，局势终于得到控制。

be up against a brick wall.en: The project failed because we were up against a brick wall of funding cuts.
be up against a brick wall.cn: 该项目因资金削减如临绝壁而失败。

be up to sb.en: It is entirely up to you whether we proceed with the project today.
be up to sb.cn: 是否今日推进该项目，全由您决定。

be up to your ears in sth.en: She is completely up to her ears in paperwork and barely has time for anything else.
be up to your ears in sth.cn: 她完全被文件工作缠住，几乎没有时间做其他任何事。

be up to your eyeballs in sth.en: She has been up to her eyeballs in research for the project.
be up to your eyeballs in sth.cn: 她为该项目忙得不可开交。

be up to your eyebrows in sth.en: She was completely absorbed in her research, buried up to her eyebrows in data analysis.
be up to your eyebrows in sth.cn: 她全神贯注于研究，埋头于数据分析之中。

be up to your eyes in sth.en: She was completely absorbed in her research, spending hours buried up to her eyes in data analysis.
be up to your eyes in sth.cn: 她全神贯注于研究，数小时埋头于数据分析之中。

be up to your neck in sth.en: He is completely up to his neck in debt from gambling.
be up to your neck in sth.cn: 他因赌博欠债累累，几乎负债一身。

be upstanding.en: Please be upstanding, as the assembly is now ready to begin.
be upstanding.cn: 请起立，因为会议现已准备就绪。

be with child.en: She is with child, so she has been granted a six-month leave of absence.
be with child.cn: 她已怀有身孕，因此获准休假六个月。

be working overtime.en: The team has been working overtime to ensure the project is completed on time.
be working overtime.cn: 该团队加班以确保项目按时完成。

be worlds apart.en: Their views on this issue are truly worlds apart.
be worlds apart.cn: 他们对这一问题的看法截然不同。

be yourself.en: You should stop pretending and just be yourself in this challenging situation.
be yourself.cn: 你应该停止伪装，在这艰难处境中做真实的自己。

bear arms.en: The soldiers were ordered to bear arms against the invading troops immediately.
bear arms.cn: 士兵们被命令立即武装起来对抗入侵部队。

bear fruit.en: The new policy has finally borne fruit by boosting local employment rates significantly.
bear fruit.cn: 新政策通过显著提升当地就业率，终于取得了成效。

beat a path to sb's door.en: The celebrity beat a path to the fans' doors, drawing immediate attention.
beat a path to sb's door.cn: 这位名人一路受到粉丝欢迎，立刻吸引了众人的目光。

beat it.en: The security guard ordered the intruder to beat it immediately.
beat it.cn: 保安命令入侵者立即滚蛋。

beat sb at their own game.en: The team beat the champions by exploiting their own greatest strength.
beat sb at their own game.cn: 该队利用自身最强优势击败冠军。

beat sb to the punch.en: He beat his rivals to the punch by securing the contract first.
beat sb to the punch.cn: 他抢先与对手签约，抢占了先机。

beat the clock.en: She beat the clock by ten minutes to arrive at the airport.
beat the clock.cn: 她提前十分钟到达机场。

beat your brains out.en: We spent hours beating our brains out to solve this complex puzzle.
beat your brains out.cn: 我们花了数小时绞尽脑汁才解开这个复杂的谜题。

beat your breast.en: He beat his breast, feigning deep remorse for the mistake he had made.
beat your breast.cn: 他捶胸顿足，假装对自己所犯的错误深感懊悔。

beauty is in the eye of the beholder.en: Whether something counts as beautiful ultimately depends on each individual's personal perspective.
beauty is in the eye of the beholder.cn: 某物是否算作美丽，最终取决于每个人的个人视角。

beauty is only skin-'deep.en: True beauty lies within, not merely in the superficial allure of one's appearance.
beauty is only skin-'deep.cn: 真正的美在于内心，而不只是外表的浅层魅力。

before you know where you are.en: Before you realize where you are, the situation has already changed completely.
before you know where you are.cn: 在你意识到身处何地之前，局势早已彻底改变。

beg leave to do sth.en: I beg your leave to submit my proposal for immediate consideration.
beg leave to do sth.cn: 请允许我提交提案供立即审议。

beg off.en: He tried to beg off the meeting he had already promised to attend.
beg off.cn: 他试图推脱一个他已经答应参加的会议。

beg sb's pardon.en: I beg your pardon, but could you repeat that sentence for me?
beg sb's pardon.cn: 请您重复一遍刚才那句话好吗？

beggars can't be choosers.en: Beggars can't be choosers, so we must accept whatever offer is available right now.
beggars can't be choosers.cn: 穷人才不能挑剔，所以我们必须接受当下能得到的任何提议。

behind closed doors.en: The company's merger was finalized behind closed doors to avoid public scrutiny.
behind closed doors.cn: 该公司在闭门状态下完成合并，以避免公众监督。

behind sb's back.en: She made a false accusation about him behind his back, which caused significant damage to their friendship.
behind sb's back.cn: 她背着他对他进行了虚假指控，严重损害了他们的友谊。

behind the times.en: His outdated approach is clearly behind the times and no longer fits modern needs.
behind the times.cn: 他的方法显然过时，已不再符合现代需求。

being forced to do sth.en: She was forced to resign when her company faced severe financial losses.
being forced to do sth.cn: 她因公司面临严重财务亏损而被迫辞职。

belabour the point.en: He keeps belabouring the point that safety protocols must be strictly enforced.
belabour the point.cn: 他反复强调必须严格执行安全规程。

believe in sb.en: I truly believe in her ability to overcome this challenge and succeed.
believe in sb.cn: 我深信她有能力克服这一挑战并取得成功。

believe in sth.en: I don't believe in that theory because it lacks scientific evidence.
believe in sth.cn: 我不相信那个理论，因为它缺乏科学证据。

believe it or not.en: Believe it or not, the project deadline has been moved up by two weeks.
believe it or not.cn: 信不信由你，项目截止日期提前了两周。

believe sth of sb.en: I can't believe he could do such a terrible thing to his own family.
believe sth of sb.cn: 我无法相信他会对自己家人做出如此可怕的事。

below stairs.en: The butler served the guests in the dining room while the staff worked below stairs.
below stairs.cn: 管家在餐厅为客人服务，而工作人员则在楼下工作。

belt and braces.en: We need to implement belt and braces measures to ensure the project's success.
belt and braces.cn: 需采取多重保障措施以确保项目成功。

bend the truth.en: He tried to bend the truth by claiming he didn't know anything about the incident.
bend the truth.cn: 他声称对这件事一无所知，试图歪曲真相。

better luck next time.en: I know you'll do better luck next time, so don't be discouraged.
better luck next time.cn: 我知道你下次会好运，所以别气馁。

between midnight and midday.en: The power outage lasted between midnight and midday, leaving us in total darkness for twelve hours.
between midnight and midday.cn: 停电持续了从午夜到正午的十二个小时，使我们陷入完全黑暗之中。

beyond belief.en: The speed of the rocket was beyond belief, leaving us all in awe.
beyond belief.cn: 火箭的速度令人难以置信，让我们无不惊叹。

beyond measure.en: The view from the mountain top was beyond measure, breathtakingly beautiful.
beyond measure.cn: 山顶景色壮丽无比，美得令人屏息。

beyond recall.en: The details of that conversation are now beyond my recall.
beyond recall.cn: 那番对话的细节我已无法回忆起来。

beyond sb's wildest dreams.en: The sudden success was beyond her wildest dreams, leaving her speechless.
beyond sb's wildest dreams.cn: 突如其来的成功超出了她最狂野的梦想，让她无言以对。

bide your time.en: Patience is key; you must bide your time until the perfect moment arrives.
bide your time.cn: 耐心是关键；你必须耐心等待完美时刻的到来。

bit by bit.en: We will tackle this complex problem bit by bit until we find a lasting solution.
bit by bit.cn: 我们将逐步解决这一复杂问题，直至找到长效方案。

bite into sth.en: He hesitated before biting into the juicy, fresh strawberry.
bite into sth.cn: 他犹豫了一下才咬下那颗多汁鲜红的草莓。

bite off more than you can chew.en: He tried to launch a startup alone, but he was biting off more than he could chew.
bite off more than you can chew.cn: 他试图独自创办一家初创公司，但贪多嚼不烂。

bite the bullet.en: She decided to bite the bullet and accept the job despite her fears.
bite the bullet.cn: 她决定咬紧牙关，尽管心存恐惧也接受了这份工作。

bite the hand that feeds you.en: She decided to bite the hand that feeds her by stealing from her employer's account.
bite the hand that feeds you.cn: 她决定通过挪用雇主的账户来报复养家糊口的人。

bite your lip.en: She bit her lip to keep her frustration from spilling over during the heated argument.
bite your lip.cn: 她紧咬嘴唇，以免在激烈的争吵中显露出内心的烦躁。

bite your tongue.en: He bit his tongue to keep silent, fearing that speaking would only make things worse.
bite your tongue.cn: 他咬住舌头保持沉默，生怕开口只会让事态更糟。

blaze a trail.en: She decided to blaze a trail in the tech industry by launching her own startup.
blaze a trail.cn: 她决定在科技行业开辟新途，创办了自己的初创公司。

bleed sb dry.en: The company's aggressive tactics eventually bled the investors dry.
bleed sb dry.cn: 该公司咄咄逼人的手段最终耗尽投资者资金。

blend into sth.en: The green foliage blends into the surrounding forest, creating a seamless natural landscape.
blend into sth.cn: 翠绿的枝叶与周遭森林融为一体，构成无缝的自然景观。

bless you.en: When someone sneezes, people often say 'bless you' to wish them well.
bless you.cn: 有人打喷嚏时，人们常说‘祝你健康’以示祝福。

blood is thicker than water.en: Family bonds often prove stronger than friendships, as blood is thicker than water.
blood is thicker than water.cn: 家庭纽带往往比友谊更牢固，因为血浓于水。

bloody well.en: You bloody well better finish this report by noon.
bloody well.cn: 你必须在今日中午前完成这份报告。

blot your copybook.en: He was accused of blotting his copybook by leaking confidential company secrets.
blot your copybook.cn: 他因泄露公司机密而受到指责抄写错误。

blow a fuse.en: The sudden argument made him blow his fuse and shout at everyone.
blow a fuse.cn: 突如其来的争吵让他火冒三丈，对众人大声吼叫。

blow itself out.en: The storm finally blew itself out after three days of relentless rain.
blow itself out.cn: 三天倾盆大雨后，风暴终于消散了。

blow over.en: The storm finally blew over, leaving the city quiet and safe.
blow over.cn: 风暴终于过去，城市恢复了宁静与安全。

blow up in sb's face.en: The project blew up in the investors' face when the budget exploded.
blow up in sb's face.cn: 项目因预算失控而令投资者颜面扫地。

blow your mind.en: The stunning view will absolutely blow your mind with its breathtaking beauty.
blow your mind.cn: 这令人惊叹的美景定会让你叹为观止。

body and soul.en: She approached the challenge with body and soul, leaving nothing to chance.
body and soul.cn: 她全身心投入应对挑战，不留任何侥幸。

boil up.en: The political situation is boiling up, causing deep concern among experts.
boil up.cn: 政治局势日益紧张，令专家深感忧虑。

bored out of your mind.en: The endless meetings had bored me out of my mind, leaving me with nothing but exhaustion.
bored out of your mind.cn: 无尽的会议让我精疲力竭，只剩疲惫。

born and bred.en: He is truly born and bred, having spent his entire youth in this coastal town.
born and bred.cn: 他确是土生土长，自幼便生活在这个海滨小镇。

born with a silver spoon in your mouth.en: He was born with a silver spoon in his mouth, so he never knew the struggle of poverty.
born with a silver spoon in your mouth.cn: 他含着银汤匙出生，从未体验过贫穷的艰辛。

bounce back.en: After the setback, she managed to bounce back and regain her confidence quickly.
bounce back.cn: 受挫后，她很快振作起来，重拾信心。

bound up with sth.en: The project's success remains inextricably bound up with the team's collective effort.
bound up with sth.cn: 该项目的成功始终与团队的共同努力密不可分。

bow and scrape.en: He would bow and scrape to please the powerful, earning his reputation for excessive flattery.
bow and scrape.cn: 他阿谀奉承以取悦权贵，以此博得过度逢迎的恶名。

bow to sth.en: He finally bowed to the evidence and admitted his mistake.
bow to sth.cn: 他最终向证据低头，承认了自己的错误。

brass monkey weather.en: The brass monkey weather has frozen the pipes in our garage.
brass monkey weather.cn: 极寒天气导致车库里的管道冻裂。

break for sth.en: The thief broke for the window to escape through it.

break in.en: The thieves managed to break into the bank vault during the night.
break in.cn: 窃贼趁夜潜入银行金库。

break new ground.en: The team broke new ground by developing an AI system that diagnoses diseases with unprecedented accuracy.

break out in sth.en: Suddenly, a cold sweat broke out all over his face when he heard the bad news.
break out in sth.cn: 听到这个坏消息时，他突然浑身冷汗直流。

break sb's heart.en: The sudden news completely broke her heart, leaving her unable to function.

break step.en: The marching band broke step, causing a chaotic ripple through the crowd.
break step.cn: 行进乐队乱了步伐，在人群中激起一阵混乱的涟漪。

break the back of sth.en: We finally broke the back of the project by finishing the core design.
break the back of sth.cn: 我们最终通过完成核心设计打破了项目的瓶颈。

break the ice.en: The host broke the ice by telling a funny joke to get everyone talking.
break the ice.cn: 主人讲了一个笑话来打破僵局，让大家开始交谈。

break through.en: The team finally broke through the barrier to discover a new cure for the disease.
break through.cn: 团队最终突破障碍，发现了该病的新型疗法。

break through sth.en: The team finally broke through the opponent's defense to score the winning goal.
break through sth.cn: 球队终于攻破对方防线，攻入制胜一球。

break wind.en: He suddenly had to break wind in the middle of our important meeting.
break wind.cn: 他突然在我们重要的会议中途放了个屁。

break with sth.en: The company decided to break with its outdated policies immediately.
break with sth.cn: 该公司立即决定摒弃其过时的政策。

breathe down sb's neck.en: The security guard was breathing down the suspect's neck, making him tremble with fear.
breathe down sb's neck.cn: 保安紧贴着嫌疑人，让他因恐惧而颤抖。

breathe out.en: She slowly breathed out, letting the tension leave her body completely.
breathe out.cn: 她缓缓吐气，让紧绷感彻底从体内消散。

breathe your last.en: The old man finally breathed his last after a long and painful illness.
breathe your last.cn: 这位老人最终在长期痛苦的病痛中离世。

bricks and mortar.en: The company's real estate portfolio consists mainly of office buildings and retail spaces.
bricks and mortar.cn: 该公司的房地产组合主要由办公楼和零售空间组成。

bright and early.en: We usually leave the house bright and early to catch the morning train.
bright and early.cn: 我们通常天刚亮就出门赶早班火车。

bring sb to justice.en: The police finally brought the corrupt official to justice after months of investigation.
bring sb to justice.cn: 经过数月调查，警方终于将这名腐败官员绳之以法。

bring sb to their knees.en: The relentless bombardment finally brought the enemy commander to his knees.
bring sb to their knees.cn: 无情的轰炸终于迫使敌军指挥官投降。

bring sb up against sth.en: The new regulations will bring many small businesses up against severe financial challenges.
bring sb up against sth.cn: 新规将使许多小企业面临严峻的财务挑战。

bring sth alive.en: The comedian brought the dry lecture to life with his witty jokes.
bring sth alive.cn: 这位喜剧演员用机智的笑话让枯燥的讲座变得生动起来。

bring sth in its train.en: His careless remark brought serious consequences in its train.
bring sth in its train.cn: 他随口说出的轻率话语引发了严重后果。

bring sth into force.en: The new regulations will bring stricter safety standards into force next month.
bring sth into force.cn: 新法规将于下月实施更严格的安全标准。

bring sth out in sth.en: The harsh sun brought freckles out on her pale skin.
bring sth out in sth.cn: 刺眼的阳光使她白皙的皮肤上浮现出雀斑。

bring sth to a grinding halt.en: The sudden strike brought production to a grinding halt, leaving workers idle.
bring sth to a grinding halt.cn: 突如其来的罢工使生产陷入停滞，工人无所事事。

bring sth to its knees.en: The relentless attacks finally brought the enemy's defensive line to its knees.
bring sth to its knees.cn: 无情的攻势终于使敌人的防线崩溃。

bring sth to light.en: The journalist managed to bring the corruption scandal to light through her investigation.
bring sth to light.cn: 该记者通过调查揭露了腐败丑闻。

bring sth to the fore.en: The new policy aims to bring renewable energy sources to the forefront of national strategy.
bring sth to the fore.cn: 新政策旨在将可再生能源置于国家战略的核心地位。

bring the curtain down on sth.en: The final report brought the curtain down on years of frantic research.
bring the curtain down on sth.cn: 最终报告揭开了多年疯狂研究的帷幕。

bring the house down.en: The comedian's hilarious routine brought the entire audience to its feet in applause.
bring the house down.cn: 这位喜剧演员滑稽的表演引得全场起立鼓掌。

bring up the rear.en: The new team will bring up the rear to protect our veterans during the retreat.
bring up the rear.cn: 新部队将在撤退时殿后，保护我们的老兵。

build on sth.en: We should build on their initial success to launch the next phase.
build on sth.cn: 应依托其初步成功，启动下一阶段。

bums on seats.en: The theater desperately needs more bums on seats to justify the high ticket prices.
bums on seats.cn: 剧院亟需更多观众以匹配高昂的票价。

burn a hole in your pocket.en: He constantly burns a hole in his pocket, spending money on impulse buys without a second thought.
burn a hole in your pocket.cn: 他总是一掷千金，对冲动消费从不考虑后果。

burn down.en: The fire finally burned down to a smoldering heap of ash.
burn down.cn: 大火终于烧成一堆冒着余烬的灰烬。

burn rubber.en: The driver accelerated hard, burning rubber as the car surged forward.
burn rubber.cn: 司机猛踩油门加速，轮胎摩擦地面发出刺耳声响，汽车猛然向前冲去。

burn the candle at both ends.en: She burned the candle at both ends, working tirelessly until dawn.
burn the candle at both ends.cn: 她昼夜不停地工作，直到黎明。

burn the midnight oil.en: She decided to burn the midnight oil to finish her thesis before graduation.
burn the midnight oil.cn: 她决定熬夜赶在毕业前完成论文。

burst into sth.en: The crowd burst into spontaneous applause when the final note rang out.
burst into sth.cn: 当最后一个音符响起时，人群爆发出自发的掌声。

burst sb's bubble.en: The unexpected failure finally burst his bubble, leaving him feeling utterly defeated and hopeless.
burst sb's bubble.cn: 这次意外的失败终于戳破了他的幻想，使他感到彻底挫败和绝望。

bury your differences.en: We should bury our differences and focus on the common goal ahead.
bury your differences.cn: 我们要搁置分歧，共同致力于前方的目标。

business as usual.en: Despite the crisis, the company insists on maintaining business as usual to keep operations running smoothly.
business as usual.cn: 尽管面临危机，该公司仍坚持维持业务如常，以确保运营顺畅。

business is business.en: Let's not let personal feelings interfere; the business is business.
business is business.cn: 不要让个人情感干扰；公事公办。

but then again.en: But then again, the initial budget cuts might have long-term benefits.
but then again.cn: 但另一方面，最初的预算削减或许能带来长远的好处。

buy time.en: The lawyer argued to buy time for his client to gather more evidence.
buy time.cn: 律师请求延期，以便其客户收集更多证据。

by a long way.en: The new policy is more effective by a long way compared to the old one.
by a long way.cn: 新政策比旧政策有效得多。

by a neck.en: The home team won by a neck, securing their spot in the finals.
by a neck.cn: 主队险胜，锁定决赛席位。

by a whisker.en: The team won by a whisker, leaving fans breathless with excitement.
by a whisker.cn: 球队险胜，令球迷兴奋不已。

by accident.en: He found the old photo by accident while cleaning his grandmother's attic.
by accident.cn: 他在打扫祖母阁楼时偶然发现了一张旧照片。

by all means.en: By all means, you should take this opportunity to improve your skills.
by all means.cn: 务必抓住这次机会提升你的技能。

by and large.en: By and large, the new policy has improved overall efficiency in our organization.
by and large.cn: 总体而言，新政策提高了我们组织的整体效率。

by any chance.en: By any chance, did you manage to find that rare book in the library?
by any chance.cn: 顺便问一下，你在图书馆找到那本罕见的书了吗？

by choice.en: She decided to pursue art by choice rather than following her family's expectations.
by choice.cn: 她选择追随艺术，而非顺从家人的期望。

by comparison.en: By comparison, the new model is significantly more efficient than its predecessor.
by comparison.cn: 相比之下，新模型比其前代效率显著提高。

by degrees.en: The house was renovated by degrees, with each room updated over several months.
by degrees.cn: 该房屋分阶段进行翻修，每间房历时数月才完成更新。

by extension.en: By extension, the company's new policy applies to all its international subsidiaries.
by extension.cn: 依此推论，该公司的新政策适用于其所有国际子公司。

by fair means or foul.en: He will achieve his goal by fair means or foul, regardless of the cost.
by fair means or foul.cn: 无论代价如何，他都将不择手段实现目标。

by jingo.en: By jingo, I finally realized the truth about my life.
by jingo.cn: 就这样，我终于看清了生活的真相。

by lot.en: The winning team was decided by lot, not by any prior agreement.
by lot.cn: 获胜队伍由抽签决定，而非事先约定。

by marriage.en: She is not his wife by blood, but by marriage.
by marriage.cn: 她非他血亲之妻，乃婚配之妻。

by means of sth.en: We can solve this complex problem by means of advanced statistical analysis.
by means of sth.cn: 我们可通过高级统计分析解决这一复杂问题。

by mistake.en: I accidentally left my passport at home by mistake.
by mistake.cn: 我因疏忽将护照忘在家里了。

by name.en: The suspects were identified by name during the police investigation.
by name.cn: 警方在调查期间已查明嫌疑人的姓名。

by numbers.en: The robot moved by numbers, executing each command precisely without deviation.
by numbers.cn: 机器人按指令顺序行动，执行每个命令精确无误。

by popular demand.en: The sequel was released by popular demand, becoming an instant bestseller.
by popular demand.cn: 续集应大众要求推出，旋即成为畅销书。

by the book.en: He always follows the rules by the book, never taking any risks.
by the book.cn: 他始终按部就班行事，从不冒险。

by the same token.en: By the same token, your dedication to this project is equally commendable.
by the same token.cn: 同样，你对本项目的奉献也值得称赞。

by the way.en: By the way, did you manage to finish that project we discussed yesterday?
by the way.cn: 顺便问一下，昨天我们讨论的那个项目你完成了吗？

by water.en: The cargo was transported by water from the port to the inland city.
by water.cn: 货物由水路从港口运至内陆城市。

by way of sth.en: We can reach the city center by way of the old railway station.
by way of sth.cn: 我们可经由旧火车站抵达市中心。

by your own account.en: Please tell us the truth by your own account, without any outside influence.
by your own account.cn: 请凭您的亲身经历如实告知我们，不受任何外界影响。

call a spade a spade.en: We must call a spade a spade and admit the project is failing.
call a spade a spade.cn: 我们必须直言不讳地承认该项目已失败。

call in.en: He called in early to discuss the urgent project updates with his supervisor.
call in.cn: 他提前来与主管讨论紧急项目进展。

call it a day.en: Let's call it a day and head home before the storm arrives.
call it a day.cn: 天色已晚，我们该回家，以免暴风雨来临。

call sb away.en: The sudden noise called the baby away from its nap, leaving it crying.
call sb away.cn: 突如其来的声响惊醒了熟睡中的婴儿，使其啼哭起来。

call sb names.en: He called her names in anger, which was completely unacceptable behavior.
call sb names.cn: 他愤怒地辱骂她，这是完全不可接受的行为。

call sb's bluff.en: She called his bluff by revealing the evidence he had been hiding.
call sb's bluff.cn: 她揭出他藏匿的证据，戳破了他的虚张声势。

call sth into play.en: The committee called new funding into play to rescue the struggling school.
call sth into play.cn: 委员会动用新资金救助陷入困境的学校。

call sth into question.en: The new data calls the company's previous claims into serious question.
call sth into question.cn: 新数据使公司此前的说法受到严重质疑。

can't be bad.en: I can't be bad, but I'll try to do better next time.
can't be bad.cn: 我本不想做坏事，但下次我会努力做得更好。

can't be doing with sth.en: I can't be doing with this terrible noise all night long.
can't be doing with sth.cn: 我受不了整晚这可怕的噪音。

can't do sth for toffee.en: He can't do this job for toffee; he lacks the necessary patience and focus.
can't do sth for toffee.cn: 他无法胜任这份工作，缺乏必要的耐心与专注。

can't get over sth.en: I still can't get over how incredibly talented she is.
can't get over sth.cn: 我仍无法完全接受她如此惊人的才华。

can't make head nor tail of sth.en: I still can't make head or tail of this complex legal document.
can't make head nor tail of sth.cn: 我仍无法弄懂这份复杂的法律文件。

care of sb.en: Please leave this package with the post office for delivery to Mr. Smith.
care of sb.cn: 请将此包裹交由邮局转交史密斯先生。

careful with money.en: You should be careful with money and avoid unnecessary spending.
careful with money.cn: 应谨慎理财，避免不必要的开支。

carry a torch for sb.en: He still carries a torch for her, despite their breakup last year.
carry a torch for sb.cn: 尽管去年分手，他仍对她念念不忘。

carry over.en: The team's momentum carried over to their next match without any loss of confidence.
carry over.cn: 球队士气未减，顺利进入下一场比赛。

carry sth through.en: The team worked tirelessly to carry the project through before the deadline.
carry sth through.cn: 该团队不遗余力地推进项目，赶在截止日期前完成。

cast your net wide.en: You should cast your net wide to find the perfect candidate for this role.
cast your net wide.cn: 应广撒网以寻觅此职位的完美人选。

catch on.en: The new fashion trend caught on quickly among young people in the city.
catch on.cn: 这种新时尚在城里年轻人中迅速流行起来。

catch sb on the hop.en: The detective managed to catch the thief on the hop before he could escape.
catch sb on the hop.cn: 侦探在小偷逃脱前便将其抓获。

catch sb red-'handed.en: The inspector caught the thief red-handed while he was stealing from the shop.
