catch sb red-'handed.cn: 检查员在窃贼从商店行窃时当场将其抓获。

catch sb's eye.en: The vibrant colors immediately caught the crowd's eye at the exhibition.
catch sb's eye.cn: 鲜艳的色彩立刻吸引了观众的目光。

champing at the bit.en: The students were champing at the bit to start their new project immediately.
champing at the bit.cn: 学生们迫不及待地想立刻开始新项目。

change hands.en: The company's assets will change hands when the new investors take over.
change hands.cn: 新投资者接手后，该公司的资产将易主。

change horses in midstream.en: The politician changed his stance on the issue, effectively changing horses in midstream.
change horses in midstream.cn: 该政治家在议题上改变立场，无异于中途换马。

change your tune.en: He changed his tune completely after hearing the opposing arguments.
change your tune.cn: 他听完对方的论点后，完全改变了主意。

change your ways.en: You must change your ways if you want to truly improve your life.
change your ways.cn: 若想真正改善生活，你必须改变行事方式。

chapter and verse.en: We must quote chapter and verse to prove our argument is entirely accurate.
chapter and verse.cn: 我们必须引经据典，以证明我们的论点完全准确。

charity begins at home.en: True charity starts at home, so we should help our neighbors first.
charity begins at home.cn: 慈善始于家庭，因此我们应先帮助邻居。

chew the fat.en: We should stop wasting time and start discussing the real issues instead of just chewing the fat.
chew the fat.cn: 我们应停止浪费时间，转而讨论实际问题，而非闲聊。

chuck sb under the chin.en: He didn't chuck her under the chin, but simply offered a warm smile instead.
chuck sb under the chin.cn: 他并未捏她的下巴，而是只是报以温暖的微笑。

claim to fame.en: She claimed to fame by winning the national poetry contest last year.
claim to fame.cn: 她去年赢得全国诗歌大赛而一举成名。

close at hand.en: With all the resources we need close at hand, our project is moving forward smoothly.
close at hand.cn: 所需资源近在咫尺，项目正顺利推进。

close the book on sth.en: They decided to close the book on their failed business venture after losing all their savings.
close the book on sth.cn: 他们在耗尽所有积蓄后，决定放弃这项失败的商业计划。

close to.en: The project is close to completion, with only a few days remaining.
close to.cn: 该项目即将完工，仅剩数日。

close to home.en: The question about his divorce was uncomfortably close to home for the audience.
close to home.cn: 关于他离婚的问题让听众感到十分尴尬。

close up.en: The camera was positioned close up to capture the intricate details of the flower.
close up.cn: 相机近距离拍摄，以捕捉花朵的精细细节。

close your mind to sth.en: She refused to close her mind to the new evidence presented by the lawyer.
close your mind to sth.cn: 她拒绝关闭心扉，不再听取律师提出的新证据。

come a gutser.en: The project came to a gusher after the team faced unexpected budget cuts.
come a gutser.cn: 该项目在团队遭遇意外预算削减后迎来爆发式增长。

come apart.en: The old vase finally came apart when I dropped it on the floor.
come apart.cn: 那只旧花瓶落地时终于碎裂了。

come at sth.en: We must come at the problem from a completely different angle.
come at sth.cn: 我们必须从完全不同的角度来审视这个问题。

come forward.en: The witness decided to come forward and testify against the accused.
come forward.cn: 证人决定出面作证，指控被告。

come in handy.en: When the power went out, my flashlight finally came in handy.
come in handy.cn: 停电后，我的手电筒终于派上了用场。

come into effect.en: The new environmental regulations will come into effect next month.
come into effect.cn: 新的环保法规将于下月生效。

come into operation.en: The new safety regulations will come into operation next Monday.
come into operation.cn: 新安全法规将于下周一生效。

come into question.en: The new policy is now coming into question due to its high cost.
come into question.cn: 新政策因其高昂的成本而受到质疑。

come into the world.en: He finally came into the world after a long and difficult labor.
come into the world.cn: 他历经漫长而艰难的产程后终于降生。

come off worse.en: The underdog managed to come off worse after the intense match.
come off worse.cn: 尽管比赛激烈，弱势一方却最终落了下风。

come off worst.en: The underdog team managed to come off worst against the champions last night.
come off worst.cn: 昨晚，这支弱队在与冠军队的比赛中表现不佳。

come on strong.en: He came on strong at the party, flirting with everyone he met.
come on strong.cn: 他在聚会上表现活跃，与遇到的每个人都调情。

come out of the closet.en: After years of hiding his sexuality, he finally came out of the closet to face his family's judgment.
come out of the closet.cn: 在多年隐藏性取向后，他终于走出衣橱，面对家人的评判。

come out of your shell.en: She finally came out of her shell and shared her deepest fears with us.
come out of your shell.cn: 她终于敞开心扉，向我们倾诉了最深的恐惧。

come out of yourself.en: She finally came out of herself, greeting everyone with genuine warmth and confidence.
come out of yourself.cn: 她终于走出自我，以真诚的热情和自信迎接众人。

come out on top.en: After years of fierce competition, she finally came out on top with her groundbreaking research.
come out on top.cn: 历经多年激烈竞争，她凭借开创性研究最终脱颖而出。

come running.en: He came running the moment I asked him to help with the project.
come running.cn: 我一叫他帮忙处理项目，他就跑过来。

come to a full stop.en: The car came to a full stop just before the red light turned on.
come to a full stop.cn: 汽车在红灯亮起前完全停下。

come to a grinding halt.en: The traffic came to a grinding halt as the heavy rain began to pour down.
come to a grinding halt.cn: 随着大雨倾盆而下，交通陷入瘫痪。

come to a head.en: The situation has finally come to a head, demanding an immediate and decisive action.
come to a head.cn: 局势已至关键时刻，亟需立即采取果断行动。

come to light.en: The truth about the scandal finally came to light after months of investigation.
come to light.cn: 经过数月调查，该丑闻真相终于大白于天下。

come to pass.en: It took years for the scandal to come to pass in our industry.
come to pass.cn: 这起丑闻在我们行业的发生耗费了数年时间。

come to rest.en: The pendulum finally came to rest after swinging for hours.
come to rest.cn: 钟摆摆动数小时后终于静止。

come to sb's knowledge.en: It took years for the public to come to his knowledge of the scandal.
come to sb's knowledge.cn: 公众花了数年才得知他卷入丑闻一事。

come to terms with sth.en: It took her years to come to terms with the sudden loss of her husband.
come to terms with sth.cn: 她花了数年才接受丈夫突然去世的事实。

come to think of it.en: Come to think of it, we might just skip the meeting today.
come to think of it.cn: 再想想，今天或许可以跳过会议。

come together.en: The diverse teams finally came together to form a unified strategy for the project.
come together.cn: 各支多元团队最终汇聚，为项目制定了统一战略。

come up with the goods.en: She finally came up with the goods and delivered her project on time.
come up with the goods.cn: 她终于拿出了成果，按时完成了项目。

come what may.en: We will face any challenge that comes what may, without hesitation.
come what may.cn: 我们将无所畏惧地应对任何挑战。

come your way.en: It's hard to predict when a sudden storm will come your way.
come your way.cn: 难以预测突如其来的风暴何时会降临。

comfortable and relaxed.en: The spacious room provided a comfortable and relaxed atmosphere for our team meeting.
comfortable and relaxed.cn: 宽敞的房间为团队会议营造了舒适放松的氛围。

comfortably off.en: Thanks to her inheritance, she is comfortably off and enjoys a luxurious lifestyle.
comfortably off.cn: 得益于遗产，她生活无忧，享受着奢华的生活。

comings and goings.en: The comings and goings of guests often disrupt our quiet evenings at home.
comings and goings.cn: 客人的来来往往常打扰我们在家安静的夜晚。

confused and not knowing what to do.en: She looked confused and didn't know what to do next.
confused and not knowing what to do.cn: 她一脸困惑，不知接下来该做什么。

cook sb's goose.en: The scandal completely cooked the politician's goose, ending his promising career.
cook sb's goose.cn: 该丑闻彻底毁掉了这位政客的事业，终结了他充满希望的职业生涯。

cook the books.en: They tried to cook the books by falsifying the sales records.
cook the books.cn: 他们试图通过篡改销售记录来伪造账目。

could do with sth.en: I could do with a quiet evening to unwind after work.
could do with sth.cn: 工作后想找个安静的晚上放松一下。

count sb in.en: The committee decided to count every new applicant in the upcoming budget.
count sb in.cn: 委员会决定将每位新申请者计入即将批准的预算。

count sb out.en: She decided to count him out of the final team selection entirely.
count sb out.cn: 她决定将他完全排除在最终选拔名单之外。

count sheep.en: To count imaginary sheep is a common habit people use to fall asleep quickly.
count sheep.cn: 数着绵羊入睡是许多人常用的快速助眠习惯。

count your blessings.en: You should count your blessings instead of constantly complaining about what you lack.
count your blessings.cn: 应感恩拥有的，而非不断抱怨所缺。

cover all the bases.en: To cover all the bases, he prepared detailed plans for every possible scenario.
cover all the bases.cn: 为应对各种可能情况，他制定了详尽的计划。

cover your back.en: He tried to cover his back by blaming the new policy for the recent budget cuts.
cover your back.cn: 他试图通过指责新政策导致近期预算削减来推卸责任。

cover your tracks.en: He tried to cover his tracks by planting false evidence against the real culprit.
cover your tracks.cn: 他试图栽赃真凶以掩盖自己的行踪。

crack the whip.en: The coach cracked the whip to force the team to run faster during the race.
crack the whip.cn: 教练挥动皮鞭迫使队伍在比赛中跑得更快。

cramp sb's style.en: The strict regulations often cramp the artist's creative style.
cramp sb's style.cn: 严格的规范往往束缚了艺术家的创作风格。

creak under the strain.en: The old engine began to creak under the strain of heavy loads.
creak under the strain.cn: 老旧的引擎在重载下开始发出吱嘎声。

creep up.en: The price of housing has been creeping up steadily over the past year.
creep up.cn: 过去一年房价稳步上涨。

crocodile tears.en: He offered crocodile tears, yet his actions proved he cared nothing for her plight.
crocodile tears.cn: 他流下了鳄鱼的眼泪，但他的行为却证明他对她的困境漠不关心。

cry foul.en: The team decided to cry foul when the referee missed a clear penalty kick.
cry foul.cn: 球队在裁判漏判明显点球时决定抗议。

cry out.en: The sudden noise made the baby cry out in fear.
cry out.cn: 突如其来的噪音吓得婴儿大哭。

cry wolf.en: The security team was alerted when the system falsely signaled a fire, effectively crying wolf.
cry wolf.cn: 当系统误报火灾时，安保团队被通知，这无异于狼来了。

curiosity killed the cat.en: His curiosity led him to ask questions that ultimately ruined his chances.
curiosity killed the cat.cn: 他的好奇心使他提出了问题，最终毁掉了他的机会。

cut corners.en: The company was accused of cutting corners to reduce production costs.
cut corners.cn: 该公司被指控偷工减料以降低生产成本。

cut off your nose to spite your face.en: He cut off his own career prospects just to spite his boss's authority.
cut off your nose to spite your face.cn: 他为了报复上司的权威，主动断送了自己的前程。

cut out.en: The engine suddenly cut out while we were driving down the mountain road.
cut out.cn: 我们下山时，发动机突然熄火。

cut sb down to size.en: The coach cut him down to size during the team meeting.
cut sb down to size.cn: 教练在队会上让他认清自己的位置。

cut sb some slack.en: We should cut him some slack since he is still learning the ropes.
cut sb some slack.cn: 鉴于他尚在摸索入门之道，我们应对他稍加宽容。

cut the ground from under sb's feet.en: The new policy effectively cut the ground from under the company's expansion plans.
cut the ground from under sb's feet.cn: 新政策使公司扩张计划落空。

cut your losses.en: You should cut your losses and stop investing in that failing project immediately.
cut your losses.cn: 你应立即止损，停止对该失败项目的投资。

cut your own throat.en: He tried to destroy the company, only to cut his own throat and face ruin.
cut your own throat.cn: 他试图摧毁公司，结果却自取灭亡，面临破产。

cut your teeth on sth.en: He cut his teeth on coding complex algorithms during his internship.
cut your teeth on sth.cn: 他在实习期间通过编写复杂算法练成了编程本领。

dangerous ground.en: We should avoid discussing this topic, as it is truly dangerous ground for us all.
dangerous ground.cn: 我们应避免讨论此话题，因为对我们所有人来说，这真是危险之地。

day after day.en: He stared at the blank wall, feeling the same boredom day after day.
day after day.cn: 他盯着空白的墙壁，日复一日地感到同样的无聊。

day and night.en: The project team worked day and night to finish the challenging task before the deadline.
day and night.cn: 项目组昼夜奋战，赶在截止日期前完成了这项艰巨任务。

day by day.en: The company's profits have grown steadily day by day.

daylight robbery.en: The price they quoted was nothing short of a daylight robbery.
daylight robbery.cn: 他们报出的价格简直是天价。

dead in the water.en: The project is dead in the water due to funding cuts.
dead in the water.cn: 该项目因资金削减而夭折。

dead meat.en: The company is in dead meat, facing severe financial losses and potential bankruptcy.
dead meat.cn: 该公司已陷入绝境，面临严重财务亏损和破产风险。

dead to the world.en: He was dead to the world, sleeping so deeply that no noise could wake him up.
dead to the world.cn: 他已对世界浑然不觉，睡得太沉，任何声响都唤不醒他。

deal with sb.en: The manager insisted on dealing with the issue personally rather than delegating it to others.
deal with sb.cn: 经理坚持亲自处理此事，而非委托他人。

depart from sth.en: The new policy departs from established norms by prioritizing speed over safety.
depart from sth.cn: 新政策以牺牲安全为代价优先追求速度，背离了既定的规范。

depart this life.en: It is a gentle way to say that someone has departed this life and passed away.
depart this life.cn: 这是一种委婉的说法，意指某人离世去世。

depending on.en: The outcome depends entirely on how effectively we manage the crisis.
depending on.cn: 结果完全取决于我们如何有效应对危机。

die back.en: The maple leaves began to die back as the first frost hit the ground.
die back.cn: 初霜降地，枫叶开始凋零。

die down.en: The storm's fury began to die down as the clouds parted, revealing a clear sky.
die down.cn: 风暴的肆虐随着云层散去而渐渐平息，露出了晴朗的天空。

die in your bed.en: He finally died in his bed after a long battle with cancer.
die in your bed.cn: 他在与癌症长期抗争后，最终死于病榻。

die laughing.en: The comedian's jokes were so absurd that the entire audience died laughing.
die laughing.cn: 这位喜剧演员的段子荒谬至极，引得全场捧腹大笑。

die off.en: The rare species began to die off rapidly due to habitat destruction.
die off.cn: 该稀有物种因栖息地破坏而迅速死亡。

die out.en: Many rare species are facing the risk of dying out due to habitat loss.
die out.cn: 许多珍稀物种正面临因栖息地丧失而灭绝的风险。

different from sth.en: The proposed plan is fundamentally different from the one we previously discussed.
different from sth.cn: 该提议方案与我们此前讨论的方案有根本不同。

dig a grave for yourself.en: You are digging your own grave by spreading such false rumors about the company.
dig a grave for yourself.cn: 散布关于该公司的此类虚假谣言，无异于自掘坟墓。

dig sb in the ribs.en: He poked me in the ribs to get my attention during the meeting.
dig sb in the ribs.cn: 他在会议上捅我肋骨以引起我的注意。

dig yourself into a hole.en: He made a hasty decision that only dug himself deeper into a financial hole.
dig yourself into a hole.cn: 他草率做出的决定，反而让自己陷入了更深的财务困境。

dip into your pocket.en: She decided to dip into her savings to cover the unexpected travel costs.
dip into your pocket.cn: 她决定动用积蓄支付突发的旅行费用。

dish it out.en: He decided to dish it out to the team for their recent poor performance.
dish it out.cn: 他决定对球队进行严厉批评，以回应他们近期的糟糕表现。

dish up sth.en: The government is trying to dish up a new economic plan.
dish up sth.cn: 政府正试图推出新的经济计划。

do as you please.en: You have full freedom to do as you please with your own time.
do as you please.cn: 您对自己的时间拥有完全的自由支配权。

do sb a disservice.en: His constant complaining does his friends a real disservice by making them avoid him.
do sb a disservice.cn: 他不断抱怨，反而让朋友们避之不及。

do sb a power of good.en: This morning's walk did me a world of good by clearing my mind and boosting my energy levels.
do sb a power of good.cn: 今晨的散步让我身心舒畅，清除了杂念并提升了精力。

do sb no favours.en: His constant complaining does us all no favours in the eyes of our colleagues.
do sb no favours.cn: 他不断抱怨，在同事眼中对我们都不利。

do sb the courtesy of doing sth.en: The company did us the courtesy of informing us weeks before the deadline.
do sb the courtesy of doing sth.cn: 该公司在截止日期前几周便告知了我们此事。

do sth on the off chance.en: I'll try it on the off chance that it might actually work for you.
do sth on the off chance.cn: 万一它能对你起作用，我会试一下。

do sth standing on your head.en: He managed to solve the complex puzzle effortlessly, doing it as if he were standing on his head.
do sth standing on your head.cn: 他轻而易举地解开了那道复杂的谜题，仿佛倒立着一般。

do sth till you are blue in the face.en: He kept trying to convince her until he was blue in the face, but it was all in vain.
do sth till you are blue in the face.cn: 他费尽口舌试图说服她，却毫无成效。

do sth to death.en: I've heard this song so many times it drives me absolutely crazy.
do sth to death.cn: 我听过这首歌太多次了，简直让我发疯。

do the honours.en: The eldest son will do the honours by cutting the ribbon at the opening ceremony.
do the honours.cn: 大儿子将在开幕式上剪彩以示祝贺。

do the job.en: The new policy finally did the job to improve safety standards.
do the job.cn: 新政策终于改善了安全标准。

do the trick.en: The new study method finally did the trick, helping me pass the exam with flying colors.
do the trick.cn: 这种新的学习方法终于奏效了，助我顺利通过考试。

do things to sb.en: The shocking news did terrible things to her, leaving her completely stunned and unable to speak.
do things to sb.cn: 这惊人的消息对她造成了极大的冲击，让她完全震惊得说不出话来。

do time.en: He was sentenced to do time for the serious crimes he committed.
do time.cn: 他因所犯重罪被判入狱服刑。

do up.en: He quickly did up his jacket before stepping out into the cold wind.
do up.cn: 他迅速穿好夹克，走进寒风之中。

do well.en: She did well in the final exam, scoring higher than expected.
do well.cn: 她在期末考试中表现优异，成绩超出预期。

do well by sb.en: We must do well by our elderly parents, treating them with kindness and generosity.
do well by sb.cn: 我们要善待年迈的父母，以仁慈和慷慨之心对待他们。

do well for yourself.en: You should focus on doing well for yourself before worrying about others.
do well for yourself.cn: 应先顾好自己，再为他人操心。

do well to do sth.en: It is wise to do well to save money for your future retirement.
do well to do sth.cn: 为未来的退休生活存钱是明智之举。

do your bit.en: Everyone must do their bit to ensure the community remains safe and secure.
do your bit.cn: 人人必须尽己所能，确保社区安全无忧。

do your own thing.en: She decided to do her own thing and quit her stable job.
do your own thing.cn: 她决定做自己的事，辞去了那份稳定的工作。

do your stuff.en: You should do your stuff and show everyone what you can really do.
do your stuff.cn: 你应该专注于自己的任务，向所有人展示你真正的能力。

do yourself justice.en: You must do yourself justice by working hard to achieve your goals.
do yourself justice.cn: 你必须通过努力争取实现目标来对自己负责。

don't ask.en: It's better not to ask, as the answer might only make things worse.
don't ask.cn: 不问为妙，因为答案只会让事情变得更糟。

don't ask me.en: I'm not aware of the details, so don't ask me.
don't ask me.cn: 我不了解具体情况，所以请不要问我。

don't bet on it.en: You can't count on him to arrive on time, don't bet on it.
don't bet on it.cn: 别指望他能准时到达，别打这个主意。

don't blame me.en: Don't blame me for my past mistakes, I've learned a lot since then.
don't blame me.cn: 过去的错误不必归咎于我，此后我已获益良多。

don't give me that.en: Don't give me that; I know you're lying about the deadline.
don't give me that.cn: 别这样；我知道你在拖延期限。

don't give up the day job.en: Don't abandon your stable career to chase uncertain dreams.
don't give up the day job.cn: 切勿为了追逐不确定的梦想而放弃稳定的职业。

don't go doing sth.en: Don't go doing that, or you'll end up in serious trouble.
don't go doing sth.cn: 别做那事，否则你会陷入严重麻烦。

don't make me laugh.en: That proposal is so absurd it genuinely makes me laugh.
don't make me laugh.cn: 那个提议荒谬至极，令人捧腹大笑。

don't mention it.en: Don't mention it, I'd be delighted to assist you with your project.
don't mention it.cn: 不客气，我很乐意协助您完成项目。

don't tell me.en: Don't tell me you've already decided to quit your job today.
don't tell me.cn: 别告诉我你今天已经决定辞职了。

doom merchant.en: The doom merchant's latest predictions have fueled public anxiety about the impending climate crisis.
doom merchant.cn: 末日商人的最新预测加剧了公众对迫在眉睫的气候危机的焦虑。

down in the dumps.en: The sudden job loss left her down in the dumps, unable to enjoy anything.
down in the dumps.cn: 突如其来的失业让她情绪低落，无法享受任何事物。

down in the mouth.en: The disappointing results left her feeling down in the mouth about her performance.
down in the mouth.cn: 令人失望的结果让她对自己的表现感到沮丧。

down south.en: We should head down south to find warmer weather this summer.
down south.cn: 今年夏天我们应南下寻找更温暖的气候。

down through sth.en: It took us down through the entire winter to finish the project.
down through sth.cn: 该项目直到整个冬天结束才完成。

down under.en: We are planning a trip down under to explore the Australian outback.
down under.cn: 我们计划前往澳大利亚内陆探险。

drag sth out of sb.en: The detective dragged the suspect out of his story to reveal the truth.
drag sth out of sb.cn: 侦探揭穿了嫌疑人的谎言，揭示了真相。

draw a blank.en: After hours of searching, the detective drew a blank when trying to identify the suspect.
draw a blank.cn: 经过数小时的搜寻，侦探在辨认嫌疑人时一无所获。

draw blood.en: The doctor will draw blood from her arm to check for anemia.
draw blood.cn: 医生将抽取她手臂的血以检查是否贫血。

draw in.en: As autumn approaches, the days draw in and nights grow longer.

draw on.en: Time has drawn on, and the old memories are fading away.
draw on.cn: 时光荏苒，旧日回忆渐行渐远。

draw out.en: As the sun sets, the daylight slowly draws out into the evening.
draw out.cn: 夕阳西下，白昼渐次过渡为傍晚。

draw sb's fire.en: He threw a rock to draw the enemy's fire away from his injured friend.
draw sb's fire.cn: 他扔出一块石头，将敌人的火力引离受伤的朋友。

draw up.en: The taxi finally drew up beside the curb after a long journey.
draw up.cn: 出租车在长途跋涉后终于停在路边。

dress sb down.en: The teacher decided to dress the student down for his repeated tardiness.
dress sb down.cn: 老师因该学生屡次迟到而对他进行了严厉训斥。

dress sth up.en: The politician tried to dress up the scandal as a minor administrative error.
dress sth up.cn: 该政客试图将丑闻包装成一起轻微的行政失误。

dress up.en: She decided to dress up in her finest gown for the gala dinner.

dressed to kill.en: She was dressed to kill, wearing a stunning red gown that commanded attention at the gala.
dressed to kill.cn: 她盛装出席，一袭惊艳的红裙令全场瞩目。

drive a coach and horses through sth.en: They tried to drive a coach and horses through our carefully planned project.
drive a coach and horses through sth.cn: 他们试图用尽一切办法破坏我们精心规划的项目。

drive on.en: He decided to drive on, ignoring the heavy traffic ahead.
drive on.cn: 他决定继续驾车前行，无视前方的拥堵。

drive sb away.en: The constant noise and chaos truly drove everyone away from the festival.
drive sb away.cn: 持续的噪音与混乱确实让所有人都离开了节日。

drop names.en: He dropped names to impress the investors with his exclusive connections.
drop names.cn: 他列举名人以向投资者展示其独家人脉。

drunk or fast asleep.en: He was either drunk or fast asleep, making it impossible to tell which state he was in.
drunk or fast asleep.cn: 他要么醉倒，要么熟睡，让人无法分辨其究竟处于何种状态。

during sth.en: During the entire project, we maintained strict communication protocols to ensure timely delivery.
during sth.cn: 项目全程严格执行沟通协议，确保按时交付。

during the journey.en: During the journey, we encountered unexpected delays that disrupted our schedule.
during the journey.cn: 旅途中我们遇到了意外延误，打乱了行程。

during this present period.en: During this present period, the market has shown remarkable resilience despite global uncertainties.
during this present period.cn: 本时期尽管面临全球不确定性，市场仍表现出显著韧性。

easy money.en: He claimed he could make easy money, but his promises never came true.
easy money.cn: 他声称能轻松赚钱，但承诺从未兑现。

eat like a horse.en: He eats like a horse, consuming three substantial meals daily.
eat like a horse.cn: 他食量极大，每日三餐都很丰盛。

eat out.en: Instead of cooking at home, we decided to eat out for a change.
eat out.cn: 为了换换口味，我们决定外出就餐，而不是在家做饭。

eat your words.en: After the evidence surfaced, she finally ate her words and admitted her mistake.
eat your words.cn: 证据曝光后，她终于承认错误，收回了前言。

economical with the truth.en: He was economical with the truth, omitting key details to protect his reputation.
economical with the truth.cn: 他言过其实，为护名节而删去关键细节。

end of story.en: That's the end of the story, and we'll handle it exactly as discussed.
end of story.cn: 故事至此告一段落，我们将按既定方案处理。

end to end.en: The soldiers stood end to end, forming an unbroken line across the field.
end to end.cn: 士兵们肩并肩站立，在田野上形成了一道连绵不断的防线。

enough already.en: Enough already, we've discussed this topic enough for today.
enough already.cn: 够了，我们今天讨论这个话题已经足够了。

err on the side of sth.en: When in doubt, we should err on the side of caution to avoid potential risks.
err on the side of sth.cn: 存疑时，应谨慎行事以规避潜在风险。

even as.en: Even as the sun set, we were still discussing our future plans.
even as.cn: 夕阳西下时，我们仍在讨论未来的计划。

even so.en: Even so, the project's success remains uncertain given the recent delays.
even so.cn: 尽管如此，鉴于近期的延误，该项目的成功仍存不确定性。

every cloud has a silver lining.en: Though the project faced numerous setbacks, every cloud had its silver lining.
every cloud has a silver lining.cn: 尽管项目遭遇重重挫折，但每朵乌云背后都有阳光。

every man for himself.en: In this chaotic market, every man for himself has become the only survival strategy.
every man for himself.cn: 在这混乱的市场中，自私自利已成为唯一的生存之道。

every other.en: We visited every other museum in the city to see the exhibits.
every other.cn: 我们参观了市内每隔一家的一家博物馆，以观展。

every penny.en: We spent every penny on the project, leaving us with no savings.
every penny.cn: 我们在项目上花光了每一分钱，导致没有积蓄。

every so often.en: Every so often, she visits her grandmother in the countryside.
every so often.cn: 她时常去乡下看望祖母。

every time.en: Every time I see her, she looks so incredibly happy and radiant.
every time.cn: 每次见到她，她都显得无比快乐和光彩照人。

every trick in the book.en: He used every trick in the book to convince the investors.
every trick in the book.cn: 他使出浑身解数说服投资者。

every which way.en: The rescue team searched every which way to find the missing hikers in the dense forest.
every which way.cn: 救援队在茂密的森林中四处搜寻失踪的徒步者。

everyone has their price.en: Everyone has their price, so the highest bidder will eventually win.
everyone has their price.cn: 物有所值，最终出价最高者将获胜。

everything but the kitchen sink.en: The box was overflowing with everything but the kitchen sink.
everything but the kitchen sink.cn: 箱子里塞满了各种东西，除了厨房水槽里的垃圾都装进去了。

exactly right.en: The solution to this complex problem is exactly right.
exactly right.cn: 该复杂问题的解决方案完全正确。

except for.en: The room was empty except for a single chair in the corner.
except for.cn: 房间里空无一人，只有角落里的一把椅子。

face to face with sth.en: He finally faced the music, confronting his mistakes face to face with the truth.
face to face with sth.cn: 他终于直面现实，正视了自己的错误。

facts and figures.en: The report relies on facts and figures to prove the company's growth.
facts and figures.cn: 该报告依据事实和数据证明公司的增长。

fair enough.en: That's fair enough; your proposal makes logical sense to me.
fair enough.cn: 很合理；你的提议合乎逻辑。

fair play to sb.en: It's fair play to let the team rest before the final match.
fair play to sb.cn: 赛前让球队休息是公平的做法。

fair to middling.en: The new restaurant offers fair to middling food at reasonable prices, making it a solid choice for casual dining.
fair to middling.cn: 这家新餐厅提供价格适中的普通美食，是休闲用餐的可靠选择。

fair's fair.en: It's fair's fair; if he gets a raise, she should too.
fair's fair.cn: 公平就是公平；他加薪了，她也该加。

fall away.en: The interest rates are expected to fall away gradually over the next quarter.
fall away.cn: 预计未来一个季度利率将逐步下降。

fall behind with sth.en: Don't fall behind with your tuition payments, or you'll face penalties.
fall behind with sth.cn: 切勿拖欠学费，否则将面临罚款。

fall by the wayside.en: Many promising students fell by the wayside due to a lack of financial support.
fall by the wayside.cn: 许多有前途的学生因缺乏经济支持而未能成才。

fall down.en: The new policy has fallen down, failing to meet the community's high expectations.
fall down.cn: 新政策已落空，未能满足社区的高期望。

fall from grace.en: After the scandal, he was quickly forced to fall from grace and resign.
fall from grace.cn: 丑闻爆发后，他很快失宠并辞职。

fall in.en: The students fell in quickly, forming an orderly line to enter the hall.
fall in.cn: 学生们迅速排成一列，有序地进入大厅。

fall into sth.en: The complex data can be divided into three distinct categories.

fall off.en: The company's profits fell off sharply due to the recent economic downturn.
fall off.cn: 公司利润因近期经济衰退而急剧下滑。

fall on deaf ears.en: His plea for reform fell on deaf ears from the skeptical committee members.
fall on deaf ears.cn: 他要求改革的呼吁遭到持怀疑态度的委员会成员充耳不闻。

fall on stony ground.en: The new policy fell on stony ground, failing to gain public support or achieve its intended goals.
fall on stony ground.cn: 新政策石沉大海，既未获得公众支持，也未达成预期目标。

fall through.en: The plan to relocate fell through due to unexpected budget cuts.
fall through.cn: 因预算意外削减，搬迁计划未能实施。

fall to sb.en: The responsibility for this critical error ultimately falls on the project manager.
fall to sb.cn: 这一关键错误的最终责任在于项目经理。

falling from or down from a place.en: The package fell from the truck, scattering debris across the street.
falling from or down from a place.cn: 货物从卡车上跌落，碎片散落街道。

familiarity breeds contempt.en: Too much familiarity with his new colleague eventually bred a sense of contempt in her.
familiarity breeds contempt.cn: 对她新同事的过分熟悉最终在她心中滋生了一种蔑视感。

far and wide.en: We searched far and wide but found no trace of the missing child.
far and wide.cn: 我们四处搜寻，却未发现失踪儿童的任何踪迹。

far from it.en: He claims to be perfect, but he is far from it.
far from it.cn: 他自称完美无缺，实则相去甚远。

far from the madding crowd.en: He lives far from the madding crowd, seeking peace in his quiet garden.
far from the madding crowd.cn: 他远离喧嚣的人群，在宁静的花园中寻求安宁。

feed into sth.en: The new policy will feed into the broader economic recovery strategy.
feed into sth.cn: 新政策将纳入更广泛的经济复苏战略。

feed your face.en: After the marathon, she decided to feed her face at the local diner.
feed your face.cn: 马拉松结束后，她决定去当地餐馆补妆。

feel good.en: The team feels good about their chances of winning the championship.
feel good.cn: 球队对赢得冠军充满信心。

feel sorry for yourself.en: He spent hours feeling sorry for himself instead of working on his project.
feel sorry for yourself.cn: 他花了好几个小时自怨自艾，而不是专注于项目。

feel strange.en: I feel strangely uneasy whenever I walk through that abandoned house alone.
feel strange.cn: 每当我独自穿过那座废弃的房子时，总会感到一种莫名的不安。

feel the pinch.en: The company is feeling the pinch as sales drop and costs rise.
feel the pinch.cn: 公司因销量下滑和成本上升而倍感压力。

feel up to sth.en: I don't feel up to dealing with all these complex problems right now.
feel up to sth.cn: 我现在没精力处理这些复杂问题。

feel your age.en: She felt her age when she realized everyone else was still young and energetic.
feel your age.cn: 当她意识到其他人依然年轻充满精力时，她感到了岁月的流逝。

feel your ears burning.en: I felt my ears burning when I realized everyone was whispering about me.
feel your ears burning.cn: 当我意识到大家都在窃窃私说我时，感到耳朵发烫。

fewer not as many as.en: Fewer people attended the conference than we had anticipated last month.
fewer not as many as.cn: 上个月出席该会议的人数少于我们的预期。

fight your own battles.en: You must fight your own battles rather than relying on others.
fight your own battles.cn: 你必须亲自应对自己的挑战，而非依赖他人。

fighting fit.en: He remains fighting fit despite his age and the demanding schedule.
fighting fit.cn: 尽管年事已高且日程繁忙，他依然保持充沛精力。

fighting spirit.en: The team's fighting spirit kept them winning despite the heavy odds.
fighting spirit.cn: 尽管赔率悬殊，但球队的斗志使他们屡战屡胜。

fighting talk.en: The coach's fighting talk was meant to boost the team's morale before the crucial match.
fighting talk.cn: 教练在关键比赛前发表激昂的讲话，旨在提振全队士气。

fill out.en: The economy is filling out, with more people joining the workforce.
fill out.cn: 经济日益完善，更多人加入劳动力市场。

find sb out.en: The detective finally managed to find the culprit out by analyzing the crime scene evidence.
find sb out.cn: 侦探通过分析犯罪现场证据，终于查明了真凶。

find your feet.en: After months of training, she finally found her feet and confidently led the team.
find your feet.cn: 经过数月训练，她终于站稳脚跟，自信地带领团队。

finders keepers.en: The lost wallet was found, and as the old saying goes, finders keepers.
finders keepers.cn: 失物招领箱里的钱包找到了，正如那句老话所说：拾金不昧。

first things first.en: Before tackling complex problems, we must address the most urgent issues first things first.
first things first.cn: 在着手解决复杂问题之前，我们必须先处理最紧迫的事项。

flatter to deceive.en: The company's glossy report flattered to deceive, hiding its true financial decline.
flatter to deceive.cn: 该公司光鲜的报告意在粉饰太平，掩盖其真实的财务下滑。

flesh and blood.en: We shouldn't judge him by his flesh and blood, for he has a heart of gold.
flesh and blood.cn: 我们不应以他的外表来评判他，因为他有一颗金子般的心。

flex your muscles.en: The company threatened to flex its muscles if the government didn't pass the new bill.
flex your muscles.cn: 该公司威胁称，若政府不通过新法案，将采取强硬措施。

flip over.en: The heavy table suddenly flipped over, scattering papers everywhere.
flip over.cn: 那张沉重的桌子突然翻倒，纸张散落一地。

flip through sth.en: She quickly flipped through the magazine to find the specific article she needed.
flip through sth.cn: 她迅速翻阅杂志，找到所需的那篇文章。

flip your lid.en: The sudden noise made her flip her lid, causing her to scream at the intruder.
flip your lid.cn: 突如其来的噪音让她掀开盖子，吓得尖叫起来。

float sb's boat.en: The company floated the new product to appeal to young consumers' interests.
float sb's boat.cn: 该公司推出新产品以迎合年轻消费者的兴趣。

fly high.en: She hopes to fly high in her next project and achieve great success.
fly high.cn: 她希望下一个项目能飞得更高，取得巨大成功。

fly in the face of sth.en: His sudden resignation flies in the face of the company's official policy.
fly in the face of sth.cn: 他的突然辞职公然违背了公司的官方政策。

fly off the handle.en: He flew off the handle when he realized his car had been stolen.
fly off the handle.cn: 他得知汽车被盗后勃然大怒。

fly the coop.en: The parrot decided to fly the coop and escaped through the open window.
fly the coop.cn: 鹦鹉决定飞走，从敞开的窗户逃了出去。

fold sb in your arms.en: He folded me in his arms, and I felt completely safe from the storm outside.
fold sb in your arms.cn: 他拥抱着我，让我感到完全免受外界风暴的侵扰。

fold your arms.en: He folded his arms, signaling a clear lack of interest in the discussion.
fold your arms.cn: 他双臂交叉，表示对讨论毫无兴趣。

fold your hands.en: She folded her hands in anticipation of the manager's announcement.
fold your hands.cn: 她双手合十，期待经理宣布消息。

follow in sb's footsteps.en: Many young entrepreneurs aim to follow in their father's footsteps by launching similar businesses.
follow in sb's footsteps.cn: 许多年轻企业家通过创办类似企业来效仿父亲的足迹。

follow on.en: The new policy will follow on from the previous one to ensure continuity.
follow on.cn: 新政策将延续前一项政策，以确保连续性。

food for thought.en: Let me share some food for thought regarding our upcoming project strategy.
food for thought.cn: 我想就我们即将开展的项目战略分享一些思考。

for a song.en: We managed to buy that vintage car for a song.
for a song.cn: 我们花小钱买到了那辆老爷车。

for certain.en: It is for certain that the project will be completed before summer.
for certain.cn: 该项目肯定能在夏季前完工。

for example.en: For example, renewable energy sources like solar and wind power are increasingly vital.
for example.cn: 例如，太阳能和风能等可再生能源日益重要。

for good measure.en: We ordered three pizzas, but we'll add a dessert for good measure.
for good measure.cn: 我们点了三份披萨，但为了保险起见，还加了一份甜点。

for information only.en: This document is for information only and does not constitute an offer or commitment.
for information only.cn: 本文件仅供信息参考，不构成要约或承诺。

for instance.en: For instance, renewable energy sources like solar power are crucial for a sustainable future.
for instance.cn: 例如，太阳能等可再生能源对可持续未来至关重要。

for my money.en: For my money, this new policy is far superior to the old one.
for my money.cn: 在我看来，这项新政策远优于旧政策。

for no particular reason.en: He suddenly quit his job for no particular reason, leaving everyone confused.
for no particular reason.cn: 他无缘无故突然辞职，弄得大家都很困惑。

for old times sake.en: For the sake of our old friendship, let's not argue about this minor point.
for old times sake.cn: 看在我们多年老朋友的份上，就别为这点小事争辩了。

for one.en: For one thing, the cost is simply prohibitive for most families.
for one.cn: 首先，对大多数家庭而言，费用高得令人望而却步。

for one thing.en: For one thing, the cost is prohibitive; for another, the quality is subpar.
for one thing.cn: 一来成本高昂，二来质量欠佳。

for openers.en: For openers, I'd suggest we address the budget issue first.
for openers.cn: 对于开场白，我建议先解决预算问题。

for real.en: The team's victory was for real, not just a lucky fluke.
for real.cn: 这支队伍的胜利是实至名归，绝非侥幸。

for sale.en: The antique furniture is currently for sale in the living room.
for sale.cn: 这套古董家具现正供客厅出售。

for sb's benefit.en: The new policy was designed specifically for the employees' benefit.
for sb's benefit.cn: 这项新政策专为员工利益而设计。

for sb's eyes only.en: This confidential report is for the CEO's eyes only and must remain strictly private.
for sb's eyes only.cn: 此机密报告仅供首席执行官阅知，必须严格保密。

for starters.en: For starters, we need to address the budget before discussing the timeline.
for starters.cn: 首先，我们需要先讨论预算问题。

for sth's sake.en: We must save the forest for its own sake, not just for timber.
for sth's sake.cn: 我们必须为了森林本身而保护它，而不仅仅是为了木材。

for sure.en: I am absolutely certain that she will succeed in her new project.
for sure.cn: 我完全确信她在新项目中会成功。

for ten pins.en: He was so eager to start the project that he seemed ready for ten pins.
for ten pins.cn: 他急于开始这个项目，仿佛随时准备投掷十枚保龄球瓶。

for that matter.en: For that matter, did you ever consider taking up a new hobby?
for that matter.cn: 话说回来，你曾考虑过培养一个新爱好吗？

for the asking.en: The rare manuscript is available for the asking from our specialized archive.
for the asking.cn: 该稀有手稿可由我们专门档案馆应需提供。

for the duration.en: The project will remain on hold for the duration of the legal dispute.
for the duration.cn: 该项目将因法律纠纷而暂停。

for the heck of it.en: He did it for the heck of it, just to see how he would react.
for the heck of it.cn: 他只是为了好玩，想看看自己会怎么反应。

for the life of you.en: I tried for the life of me to remember his name, but it slipped my mind immediately.
for the life of you.cn: 我拼尽全力也想不起他的名字，但它却立刻从脑海中溜走了。

for the most part.en: For the most part, the project went smoothly without any major setbacks.
for the most part.cn: 总体而言，项目进展顺利，未遇重大挫折。

for the time being.en: We will resolve this issue for the time being and revisit it later.
for the time being.cn: 暂且解决此问题，稍后再作回顾。

for your life.en: Do it for your life, meaning to make every effort and finish it as soon as possible.
for your life.cn: 为生命而做，意指竭尽全力并尽快完成。

for your liking.en: The cake is baked to perfection, exactly for your liking.
for your liking.cn: 蛋糕烤得恰到好处，正合您的口味。

force of habit.en: He kept doing it because the force of habit was too strong to ignore.
force of habit.cn: 他坚持这样做，因为习惯的力量太过强大，无法忽视。

free and easy.en: He moved around the room free and easy, laughing at his own jokes.
free and easy.cn: 他在房间里自在地走动，不时自嘲一笑。

freeze over.en: The lake froze over overnight, trapping the ducks inside.
freeze over.cn: 一夜之间湖面结冰，将鸭子困在其中。

from afar.en: The lighthouse beam cut through the fog, visible from afar.
from afar.cn: 灯塔的光束穿透迷雾，在远处清晰可见。

from day one.en: She has been working on this project from day one until now.
from day one.cn: 她自项目伊始便一直工作至今。

from hell.en: This situation is absolutely from hell, and I can't believe it happened.
from hell.cn: 这种情况简直惨不忍睹，我难以置信竟发生了。

from the sublime to the ridiculous.en: The performance ranged from the sublime to the ridiculous, leaving critics baffled.
from the sublime to the ridiculous.cn: 演出从崇高到荒诞不一，令评论家们无所适从。

fuck me.en: I fuck me, I can't believe the unexpected twist in our story.
fuck me.cn: 我简直不敢相信我们故事中的意外转折。

fuck up.en: I completely fucked up the presentation and ruined everything.
fuck up.cn: 我彻底搞砸了演示，毁了所有东西。

fuck with sb.en: He really tried to fuck with me by hiding all the important documents.
fuck with sb.cn: 他故意藏起所有重要文件来捉弄我。

fucking well.en: Stop talking to me like that, you fucking well know I hate it.
fucking well.cn: 别跟我用那种语气说话，你明明知道我很讨厌。

full of the joys of spring.en: The children ran through the meadow, full of the joys of spring.
full of the joys of spring.cn: 孩子们欢笑着穿过草地，充满了春天的喜悦。

full of yourself.en: He is so full of himself that he refuses to admit his mistakes.
full of yourself.cn: 他自以为是，拒绝承认自己的错误。

fun and games.en: The children spent the whole afternoon playing fun and games in the park.
fun and games.cn: 孩子们整个下午都在公园里嬉戏玩耍。

funnily enough.en: Funnily enough, the weather turned out to be perfect for our picnic.
funnily enough.cn: 有趣的是，天气竟非常适合我们野餐。

funny ha-'ha.en: The clown's ridiculous antics made the whole audience burst out laughing.
funny ha-'ha.cn: 小丑滑稽的表演引得全场捧腹大笑。

funny peculiar.en: The scientist found the strange, peculiar behavior of the alien species truly funny.
funny peculiar.cn: 这位科学家发现外星物种那种奇怪而怪诞的行为真是有趣。

gain ground.en: The new policy has finally gained ground by reducing unemployment rates significantly.
gain ground.cn: 新政策通过大幅降低失业率终于取得了成效。

gain time.en: He kept delaying the meeting to gain more time for his research project.
gain time.cn: 他推迟会议，以便为他的研究项目争取更多时间。

game on.en: With the score tied and time running out, it's truly game on.
game on.cn: 比分持平且时间所剩无几，比赛真正进入白热化阶段。

get a life.en: Stop complaining and get a real life instead of this boring routine.
get a life.cn: 停止抱怨，去体验真实的生活，而不是这种无聊的日常。

get a rise out of sb.en: The politician managed to get a rise out of the crowd by exaggerating their fears.
get a rise out of sb.cn: 该政客通过夸大民众的恐惧成功激起了他们的愤怒。

get at sth.en: It took us weeks to get at the truth behind his sudden disappearance.
get at sth.cn: 我们花了数周时间才查清他突然失踪背后的真相。

get away from it all.en: They decided to get away from it all by renting a cabin in the mountains.
get away from it all.cn: 他们决定租下山里的一座小屋，远离尘嚣。

get away with murder.en: He tried to steal the car but managed to get away with murder.
get away with murder.cn: 他试图偷车，却因杀人未遂而逃脱。

get back.en: After the long meeting, she finally managed to get back home before dark.
get back.cn: 会议结束后，她终于在天黑前赶回了家。

get back on the rails.en: After months of chaos, the company finally got back on its rails.
get back on the rails.cn: 历经数月混乱，该公司终于重回正轨。

get back to sb.en: I'll get back to you once I have all the necessary details.
get back to sb.cn: 待备齐所需详情后，我将回复您。

get back to sth.en: Let's get back to the project and finish the report by Friday.
get back to sth.cn: 让我们回到项目上，周五前完成报告。

get cracking.en: Let's get cracking on the project before the deadline approaches.
get cracking.cn: 在截止日期临近前，我们立即着手推进项目。

get down to business.en: Let's stop chatting and get down to the real work at hand.
get down to business.cn: 让我们停止闲聊，着手处理手头的工作。

get down to sth.en: Let's stop chatting and get down to the real work.
get down to sth.cn: 让我们停止闲聊，开始真正的工作。

get heavy.en: The conflict has escalated to the point where violence is getting heavy.
get heavy.cn: 冲突已升级至暴力程度加剧的地步。

get hitched.en: After years of dating, they finally decided to get hitched last summer.
get hitched.cn: 交往多年后，他们终于在去年夏天决定结婚。

get in on sth.en: I hope you can get in on the project before it's too late.
get in on sth.cn: 希望你在为时已晚之前加入该项目。

get in sb's hair.en: The constant questions are finally getting in my hair.
get in sb's hair.cn: 那些反复的问题终于让我心烦了。

get in the way of.en: The new regulations are getting in the way of our project's progress.

get it up.en: He tried to get it up but the medication failed to work.
get it up.cn: 他试图站起来，但药物未能奏效。

get lost.en: Don't get lost in your thoughts; focus on the task at hand.
get lost.cn: 切勿沉溺于思绪，应专注于手头的工作。

get moving.en: We need to get moving if we want to catch the early train.
get moving.cn: 若想赶早班车，我们必须立即出发。

get off my case.en: Please stop criticizing me; I've already explained myself.
get off my case.cn: 请不要再批评我了，我已经解释清楚了。

get off sb's back.en: Finally, the relentless criticism stopped, and he could get off my back.
get off sb's back.cn: 最后，无情的批评停止了，他终于不再纠缠我。

get off to a flyer.en: The team managed to get off to a flying start with their first victory.
get off to a flyer.cn: 球队凭借首胜便取得了势如破竹的开局。

get on sb's nerves.en: The constant noise from the construction site is really getting on my nerves.
get on sb's nerves.cn: 施工现场的持续噪音真让我心烦。

get on to sth.en: After finishing the report, let's get on to the budget discussion.
get on to sth.cn: 报告结束后，我们转入预算讨论。

get on top of sb.en: The sudden influx of complaints made it impossible for her to get on top of the staff.
get on top of sb.cn: 突增的投诉使她无法掌控局面。

get on top of sth.en: We need to get on top of these urgent issues before the deadline.
get on top of sth.cn: 我们必须在截止日期前解决这些紧迫问题。

get out.en: The company's financial secrets were leaked and got out to the public.
get out.cn: 该公司的财务机密被泄露并公之于众。

get over sth.en: It took her months to get over the devastating loss of her beloved pet.
get over sth.cn: 她花了数月时间才从失去心爱宠物的巨大悲痛中走出来。

get religion.en: After years of doubt, he suddenly got religion and started attending church every Sunday.
get religion.cn: 多年怀疑之后，他突然改信宗教，开始每逢周日去教堂。

get sb into trouble.en: He got her into trouble by encouraging their secret relationship.
get sb into trouble.cn: 他因鼓励他们的秘密恋情而让她陷入麻烦。

get sb nowhere.en: The endless arguments only served to get us nowhere regarding the project's future.
get sb nowhere.cn: 无尽的争论使我们无法就项目的未来达成共识。

get sb through sth.en: The tutor helped me get through the final exam with flying colors.
get sb through sth.cn: 导师助我顺利通过期末考试。

get sb's goat.en: Don't get your boss's goat by making that stupid mistake at the meeting.
get sb's goat.cn: 不要在会议上犯那个愚蠢的错误，以免惹恼你的老板。

get somewhere.en: It's been years since I finally managed to get somewhere in my career.
get somewhere.cn: 我终于在事业上有所进展，已是多年前的事情了。

get spliced.en: After years of dating, they finally got spliced in a quiet ceremony.
get spliced.cn: 历经多年交往，他们最终在一个宁静的仪式上完婚。

get started.en: We need to get started on the project immediately to meet the deadline.
get started.cn: 我们必须立即着手该项目，以确保按时完工。

get sth down to a fine art.en: He has mastered the craft of negotiation, getting it down to a fine art.
get sth down to a fine art.cn: 他精通谈判之道，将其化为精湛的艺术。

get sth in one.en: I didn't get it in one go, so I asked for more explanation.
get sth in one.cn: 我没一次听懂，所以请求进一步解释。

get sth into gear.en: The team finally got the project back into gear after weeks of delays.
get sth into gear.cn: 经过数周的延误，团队终于让项目重新运转起来。

get sth moving.en: We need to get the project moving before the deadline arrives tomorrow.
get sth moving.cn: 我们必须在明天截止日期到来之前推动项目进展。

get sth off.en: I need to get the documents off to the post office immediately.
get sth off.cn: 我得立刻把文件送到邮局去。

get sth off your chest.en: It's time to get the truth off your chest before it ruins everything.
get sth off your chest.cn: 趁一切毁于一旦之前，把真相说出来吧。

get sth out of sb.en: The detective managed to get the crucial evidence out of the suspect.
get sth out of sb.cn: 侦探设法从嫌疑人那里取得了关键证据。

get sth out of your system.en: He went to the gym to get his anger out of his system.
get sth out of your system.cn: 他去了健身房发泄怒气。

get the bit between your teeth.en: She decided to get the bit between her teeth and quit her job immediately.
get the bit between your teeth.cn: 她决定咬紧牙关，立即辞职。

get the boot.en: After years of loyalty, he was finally forced to get the boot by his company.
get the boot.cn: 历经多年忠诚后，他终于被公司解雇。

get the message.en: He finally got the message that his behavior was unacceptable to everyone.
get the message.cn: 他终于明白自己的行为已不被任何人所接受。

get the picture.en: Could you get the picture of what's happening in this crisis?
get the picture.cn: 你能看清这场危机中的局势吗？

get there.en: It took her years to finally get there in her career.
get there.cn: 她花了多年时间才在事业上达到这一境界。

get through to sb.en: It took me hours to get through to her about the terrible news.
get through to sb.cn: 我花了几个小时才向她传达这个噩耗。

get through with sth.en: It took her months to get through with the complex project alone.
get through with sth.cn: 她独自完成那个复杂项目花了数月时间。

get to the bottom of sth.en: We must get to the bottom of this mystery before the investigation ends.
get to the bottom of sth.cn: 必须在调查结束前查清这个谜团。

get under sb's skin.en: The constant delays are starting to get under my skin, making me extremely frustrated.
get under sb's skin.cn: 这些持续的延误开始让我感到烦躁，使我极度不满。

get wind of sth.en: She managed to get wind of the scandal before anyone else did.
get wind of sth.cn: 她比其他人更早得知了丑闻。

get with the programme.en: You need to get with the programme and stop making excuses for your poor performance.
get with the programme.cn: 你必须跟上形势，停止为你的糟糕表现找借口。

get your act together.en: You need to get your act together if you want to finish the project on time.
get your act together.cn: 若想按时完成项目，你必须振作起来。

get your fingers burnt.en: He got his fingers burnt by investing in that failing startup without doing proper research.
get your fingers burnt.cn: 他因未做充分调研便投资那家失败初创公司而遭受损失。

get your hands dirty.en: He decided to get his hands dirty by fixing the broken fence himself.
get your hands dirty.cn: 他决定自己动手修好破损的篱笆。

get your money's worth.en: You should negotiate a better deal to ensure you get your money's worth.
get your money's worth.cn: 您应争取更优的交易条件，以确保物有所值。

get your name on the score sheet.en: He managed to get his name on the score sheet with a stunning goal.
get your name on the score sheet.cn: 他凭借一个惊人的进球成功将自己的名字记入记分表。

get your teeth into sth.en: She finally got her teeth into the complex project and worked tirelessly.
get your teeth into sth.cn: 她终于着手处理这个复杂的项目，并不知疲倦地工作。

get your wings.en: After months of rigorous training, she finally got her wings and earned her pilot's license.
get your wings.cn: 经过数月严格的训练，她终于展翅翱翔，考取了飞行员执照。

get your wires crossed.en: Don't get your wires crossed; I meant to say we should meet tomorrow.
get your wires crossed.cn: 请勿弄错；我的意思是，我们明天见面。

gild the lily.en: Adding more decoration to an already perfect painting is truly gilding the lily.
gild the lily.cn: 给一幅完美的画作增添更多装饰，无异于锦上添花。

give a dog a bad name.en: Once you give someone a bad name, it is incredibly difficult to erase that reputation completely.
give a dog a bad name.cn: 一旦给某人贴上坏名声的标签，便极难彻底抹去那声誉。

give and take.en: Successful negotiations often require a healthy give and take between both parties.
give and take.cn: 成功的谈判往往需要双方相互让步与妥协。

give as good as you get.en: He decided to give her as good as she gave him in return.
give as good as you get.cn: 他决定给予她同她对他的回报一样多的东西。

give it a rest.en: Let's give this annoying topic a rest and move on to something else.
give it a rest.cn: 暂且搁置这个令人厌烦的话题，转向其他内容。

give off sth.en: The old lamp began to give off a faint, warm light in the dark room.
give off sth.cn: 那盏旧灯在昏暗的房间里发出微弱而温暖的光。

give rise to sth.en: The prolonged economic downturn has given rise to widespread social unrest across the region.
give rise to sth.cn: 该地区的经济长期低迷引发了广泛的社会动荡。

give sb a box on the ears.en: The coach gave him a box on the ears for missing the practice.
give sb a box on the ears.cn: 教练因他缺席训练而在他耳朵上拍了一下。

give sb a buzz.en: He decided to give his friend a buzz to confirm the meeting time.
give sb a buzz.cn: 他决定给朋友打个电话确认会议时间。

give sb a dirty look.en: She gave him a dirty look when he interrupted her during the meeting.
give sb a dirty look.cn: 他会议中打断她时，她瞥了他一眼。

give sb a hard time.en: The new manager decided to give the staff a hard time by cutting their budget.
give sb a hard time.cn: 新经理通过削减预算为难员工。

give sb a mouthful.en: The politician gave the reporter such a mouthful that she had to leave the interview immediately.
give sb a mouthful.cn: 该政客对记者说了太多话，导致她不得不立即结束采访。

give sb a piece of your mind.en: I can't take it anymore; I must give him a piece of my mind about his rudeness.
give sb a piece of your mind.cn: 我忍无可忍了，必须对他无礼的行为表示抗议。

give sb a shout.en: Don't forget to give your parents a shout when you visit them next week.
give sb a shout.cn: 下周去看望他们时，别忘了给他们打个电话。

give sb enough rope.en: Don't give him enough rope to hang himself; let him make his own mistakes.
give sb enough rope.cn: 别给他足够的绳子让他自缢；让他自己犯错。

give sb five.en: They gave each other a high-five to celebrate their victory.

give sb the cold shoulder.en: He gave her the cold shoulder to show he didn't care about her feelings.
give sb the cold shoulder.cn: 他故意对她不理不睬，以表明不在乎她的感受。

give sb the eye.en: She gave him the eye, clearly trying to flirt across the crowded room.
give sb the eye.cn: 她瞥了他一眼，显然想在那拥挤的房间里向他示好。

give sb the runaround.en: The manager tried to give us the runaround about our delayed project.
give sb the runaround.cn: 经理试图就我们延误的项目敷衍我们。

give sb their head.en: The manager decided to give the team their head, allowing them to experiment freely with new strategies.
give sb their head.cn: 经理决定放手让团队自由尝试新策略。

give sb their marching orders.en: The board gave the manager his marching orders to step down immediately.
give sb their marching orders.cn: 董事会命令经理立即辞职。

give sb up for lost.en: They gave him up for lost after the car crash left him trapped in the burning vehicle.
give sb up for lost.cn: 车祸将他困在燃烧的轿车内后，人们便认为他已无力回天。

give shape to sth.en: Her passionate speech gave new shape to the community's long-held vision.
give shape to sth.cn: 她激情洋溢的演讲赋予了社区长久以来的愿景新的形态。

give sth a rest.en: You should give your tired eyes a rest instead of staring at the screen all day.
give sth a rest.cn: 你应该让疲劳的眼睛休息，而不是整天盯着屏幕看。

give sth a whirl.en: You should give the new recipe a whirl before committing to making it for dinner.
give sth a whirl.cn: 在决定为晚餐制作这道新食谱之前，不妨先尝试一下。

give the game away.en: He accidentally gave away his secret plan during the meeting.
give the game away.cn: 他在会议上不慎泄露了秘密计划。

give the lie to sth.en: The evidence gave the lie to his claim that he had never been there.
give the lie to sth.cn: 证据证明他从未去过那里的说法是谎言。

give up.en: She decided to give up her dream job after years of relentless rejection.
give up.cn: 她在多年屡遭拒绝后，决定放弃梦想中的工作。

give voice to sth.en: She finally gave voice to her long-suppressed fears in a powerful speech.
give voice to sth.cn: 她最终在一次强有力的演讲中表达了自己长期压抑的恐惧。

give way.en: The old bridge suddenly gave way under the heavy traffic load.
give way.cn: 这座古桥在重载交通下突然坍塌。

give your heart to sb.en: She finally gave her heart to him after years of hesitation.
give your heart to sb.cn: 多年犹豫后，她终于将心交付于他。

give your name to sth.en: He decided to give his new invention a name that reflects its unique purpose.
give your name to sth.cn: 他决定给他的新发明起一个能体现其独特用途的名字。

gloom and doom.en: The gloom and doom about the economy's collapse has left many citizens feeling utterly hopeless.
gloom and doom.cn: 关于经济崩溃的悲观论调让许多市民感到彻底绝望。

glued to the spot.en: She was glued to the spot, frozen by the terrifying news she just heard.
glued to the spot.cn: 她吓得动弹不得，因刚刚听到的可怕消息而僵在原地。

gnash your teeth.en: She gnashed her teeth in fury when she realized the plan had failed.
gnash your teeth.cn: 当她意识到计划失败时，她气得咬牙切齿。

go about sth.en: We must go about our daily tasks without any further delay.
go about sth.cn: 我们必须立即着手处理日常事务。

go about your business.en: You should go about your business and ignore the distractions around you.
go about your business.cn: 专心于你的事务，忽略周围的干扰。

go after sb.en: He decided to go after her despite the risks involved in following her.
go after sb.cn: 尽管追随她存在风险，他还是决定去追求她。

go against sb.en: The new policy goes against the workers' interests and could cause unrest.
go against sb.cn: 这项新政策违背了工人利益，可能引发骚乱。

go against sth.en: The new policy goes against the company's long-term growth strategy.
go against sth.cn: 新政策违背了公司的长期增长战略。

go all out to do sth.en: The team went all out to secure the championship title.
go all out to do sth.cn: 全队全力以赴争夺冠军头衔。

go and do sth.en: He went ahead with the plan despite our warnings, which is absolutely ridiculous.
go and do sth.cn: 尽管我们发出警告，他还是执意推进该计划，这简直荒谬至极。

go at sb.en: They decided to go at the corrupt official during the town hall meeting.
go at sb.cn: 他们决定在市政厅会议上向那位腐败官员发起攻击。

go at sth.en: They decided to go at the project with full energy and dedication.
go at sth.cn: 他们决定全力以赴投入该项目。

go back.en: They went back to knowing each other after years apart.
go back.cn: 多年未见后，他们重新相识。

go back on sth.en: He went back on his promise to help us with the project last week.
go back on sth.cn: 他上周违背了帮助我们要项目的承诺。

go back to sth.en: After the long break, she decided to go back to her old passion for painting.
go back to sth.cn: 休息许久后，她决定重拾绘画这一旧爱。

go ballistic.en: The coach went ballistic when the referee made a controversial call during the match.
go ballistic.cn: 比赛期间，裁判做出争议判罚后，教练勃然大怒。

go bananas.en: The sudden noise made the cat go bananas, jumping everywhere.
go bananas.cn: 突如其来的噪音让这只猫疯了起来，到处乱跳。

go before.en: The new policy must go before any other legislative changes are implemented.
go before.cn: 新政策必须在实施任何其他立法变更之前生效。

go belly up.en: The company went belly up after losing its biggest client last month.
go belly up.cn: 该公司上月失去最大客户后破产。

go beyond sth.en: We must go beyond our current limitations to achieve true innovation.
go beyond sth.cn: 我们必须突破现有局限，方能实现真正的创新。

go by sth.en: We must judge his character not by his words but by his actions.
go by sth.cn: 我们应透过他的行动而非言语来评判其品格。

go commando.en: They decided to go commando for the weekend, wearing only jackets and no undergarments.
go commando.cn: 他们决定本周末穿夹克不穿内衣去野外。

go down in history.en: Her groundbreaking discovery will go down in history as a turning point for science.
go down in history.cn: 她这一开创性的发现将被载入史册，成为科学发展的转折点。

go downhill.en: His health has been going downhill since the flu last winter.
go downhill.cn: 自去年流感以来，他的健康状况每况愈下。

go for broke.en: After months of saving, she decided to go for broke and buy the house.
go for broke.cn: 经过数月积蓄，她决定放手一搏买下这所房子。

go for sb.en: The media went for the politician, spreading false rumors about his integrity.
go for sb.cn: 媒体转而攻击该政客，散布关于其诚信的虚假谣言。

go for the jugular.en: The debate turned toxic when opponents went for the jugular by attacking his financial record.
go for the jugular.cn: 当对手攻击其财务记录时，辩论变得极具毒性。

go haywire.en: The automated system suddenly went haywire, causing the entire factory to shut down immediately.
go haywire.cn: 自动化系统突然失控，导致整个工厂立即停机。

go hot and cold.en: The sudden news made her go hot and cold with fear.
go hot and cold.cn: 突如其来的消息令她惊恐得浑身发抖。

go in one ear and out the other.en: The news went in one ear and out the other, so I didn't take it seriously.
go in one ear and out the other.cn: 这消息左耳进右耳出，我没当回事。

go in with sb.en: He decided to go in with his brother to launch a new tech startup.
go in with sb.cn: 他决定和弟弟一起创办一家新的科技公司。

go into overdrive.en: The team went into overdrive to catch up with the leader in the final race.
go into overdrive.cn: 队伍在最后冲刺中全力追赶领先者。

go it alone.en: She decided to go it alone and launch her own startup without any partners.
go it alone.cn: 她决定独自创业，不找任何合伙人。

go native.en: After living there for years, he went native and speaks the local dialect perfectly.
go native.cn: 居住多年后，他变得入乡随俗，能完美使用当地方言。

go off on one.en: He went off on me when I mentioned the budget cuts.
go off on one.cn: 我一提削减预算，他就对我大发雷霆。

go off the deep end.en: When the argument escalated, he finally went off the deep end and screamed at everyone.
go off the deep end.cn: 随着事态升级，他终于彻底失控，对众人大喊大叫。

go off with sb.en: After years of marriage, he decided to go off with a younger woman.
go off with sb.cn: 结婚多年后，他决定与一位年轻女子私奔。

go off with sth.en: He went off with the designer's latest creation without asking for permission.
go off with sth.cn: 他未经同意便带走了设计师的最新作品。

go on doing sth.en: He went on talking about his childhood for hours without stopping.
go on doing sth.cn: 他不停地谈论童年往事，整整几个小时都没停过。

go on the block.en: The seized goods will be taken to the auction house and put on the block for sale.
go on the block.cn: 扣押物品将被送往拍卖行并上架出售。

go on to do sth.en: After finishing his thesis, he went on to become a renowned professor.
go on to do sth.cn: 完成论文后，他成为了一位著名的教授。

go on to sth.en: After finishing the report, she went on to discuss the upcoming budget.
go on to sth.cn: 写完报告后，她继续讨论了即将到来的预算。

go out to sb.en: I went out to my friend after hearing about her difficult situation.
go out to sb.cn: 得知她处境艰难后，我去探望了朋友。

go over to sth.en: We must go over to the opposing view before we can truly understand their argument.
go over to sth.cn: 唯有先了解对方的观点，才能真正理解其论点。

go overboard.en: Don't go overboard with your enthusiasm; a little is enough.
go overboard.cn: 热情不必过火，适度即可。

go postal.en: The crowd went postal when the police tried to arrest their leader.
go postal.cn: 当警方试图逮捕他们的领袖时，人群暴发了。

go round in circles.en: The debate keeps going round in circles without reaching any real solution.
go round in circles.cn: 这场争论仍在原地打转，未能得出任何实质性解决方案。

go straight.en: He finally decided to go straight and build a new life for himself.
go straight.cn: 他最终决定直走，为自己开启新生活。

go the way of all flesh.en: The old man finally went the way of all flesh after a long battle with cancer.
go the way of all flesh.cn: 这位老人在与癌症的长期抗争后，最终离世。

go the whole hog.en: We decided to go the whole hog and launch our new product immediately.
go the whole hog.cn: 我们决定一鼓作气，立即推出新产品。

go through.en: The board finally went through the controversial merger proposal after weeks of debate.
go through.cn: 董事会在数周的辩论后，最终通过了有争议的合并提案。

go through the wringer.en: She went through the wringer during her first year of medical school.
go through the wringer.cn: 她在医学院第一年经历了磨难。

go through with sth.en: She finally decided to go through with the difficult surgery despite her fears.
go through with sth.cn: 尽管心存恐惧，她最终决定接受这项艰难的手术。

go to bed with sb.en: They decided to go to bed with her after the long night of drinking.
go to bed with sb.cn: 他们决定在她喝完长夜酒后陪她睡觉。

go to pieces.en: The constant pressure finally made her go to pieces, causing a complete breakdown.
go to pieces.cn: 巨大的压力最终使她精神崩溃。

go to pot.en: The neglected garden has completely gone to pot due to lack of care.
go to pot.cn: 因缺乏照料，这处被忽视的花园已彻底荒废。

go to sea.en: He decided to go to sea after graduating from the maritime academy.

go to the wall.en: The startup went to the wall after investors pulled out their funding.
go to the wall.cn: 投资者撤资后，这家初创公司难以为继。

go towards sth.en: He decided to go towards the bill by paying half of the total cost.
go towards sth.cn: 他决定通过支付总费用的一半来结账。

go with the flow.en: You should learn to go with the flow and adapt easily to any new situation.
go with the flow.cn: 你要学会顺势而为，并轻松适应任何新情况。

go without saying.en: It goes without saying that honesty is the most important quality in a leader.
go without saying.cn: 不言而喻，诚实是领导者最重要的品质。

go your own way.en: She decided to go her own way, ignoring his advice completely.
go your own way.cn: 她决定另辟蹊径，完全无视他的建议。

going out of fashion.en: This vintage style is quickly going out of fashion among young people.
going out of fashion.cn: 这种复古风格正迅速在年轻人中过时。

going strong.en: The company has been going strong for over fifty years, expanding into new markets every year.
going strong.cn: 该公司已稳健经营五十余年，每年拓展新市场。

gone for a burton.en: The old car is gone, having been completely destroyed in the recent storm.
gone for a burton.cn: 旧车已在近期风暴中彻底损毁。

good for the soul.en: This quiet walk is good for the soul, offering a peaceful respite from our hectic daily lives.
good for the soul.cn: 这宁静的漫步有益于心灵，为我们喧嚣的日常生活提供片刻安宁。

good luck to sb.en: I wish you good luck with your new project, as it's not my concern.
good luck to sb.cn: 祝你的新项目好运，这与我无关。

good money.en: She spent good money on that vintage car, which was a wise investment.
good money.cn: 她花了不少钱买了那辆老式汽车，这是一笔明智的投资。

grease sb's palm.en: The corrupt official took bribes to grease the palms of his associates.
grease sb's palm.cn: 该腐败官员向同伙行贿以疏通关系。

green with envy.en: She was green with envy when she saw her colleague's new car.
green with envy.cn: 见她同事的新车时，她妒火中烧。

grind on.en: The relentless rain kept grinding on, making the outdoor event impossible to continue.
grind on.cn: 连绵不断的雨水持续倾泻，致使户外活动无法继续。

groan under the weight of sth.en: The team groaned under the weight of their crushing financial debt.
groan under the weight of sth.cn: 团队在沉重的财务债务下呻吟。

grow back.en: The trees will grow back quickly after the storm destroyed them.
grow back.cn: 风暴过后，树木将迅速重新生长。

half the battle.en: You've only half the battle done; the final challenge remains ahead.
half the battle.cn: 你才完成了一半的战斗，最后的挑战仍在前方。

ham it up.en: Don't ham it up during the interview; keep your expressions natural and sincere.
ham it up.cn: 面试时切勿做作，保持表情自然真诚。

hammer and tongs.en: The couple's heated argument escalated into a physical fight with hammer and tongs.
hammer and tongs.cn: 这对夫妇激烈的争吵升级为使用铁锤和钳子的肢体冲突。

hang back.en: The team decided to hang back and wait for further instructions from headquarters.
hang back.cn: 该队决定按兵不动，等待总部的进一步指令。

hang on sth.en: The project's success hangs on the team's unwavering dedication and hard work.
hang on sth.cn: 项目的成功取决于团队坚定不移的奉献与辛勤工作。

hang over sb.en: A looming deadline hangs over the team, causing constant anxiety about their upcoming presentation.
hang over sb.cn: 团队笼罩在迫在眉睫的截止日期之下，对即将到来的演示感到持续焦虑。

hang sth.en: He decided to hang the meeting until we had a clear answer.
hang sth.cn: 他决定推迟会议，直到我们得到明确答复。

hang up.en: After the long discussion, she finally decided to hang up on him.
hang up.cn: 经过长时间的讨论，她终于决定挂断电话。

hard cheese.en: It's hard cheese that he got rejected from his dream job today.
hard cheese.cn: 他今天被心仪的工作拒之门外，心里苦得像硬奶酪。

hard going.en: The initial phase of the project proved hard going due to unexpected technical challenges.
hard going.cn: 项目初期因遇到预料之外的技术难题而进展艰难。

hate sb's guts.en: I absolutely hate my boss's guts for ruining our entire project.
hate sb's guts.cn: 我恨透了老板毁了我们整个项目。

hats off to sb.en: We should hats off to her for her remarkable achievements in the field.
hats off to sb.cn: 我们应向她致以敬意，表彰她在该领域的杰出成就。

have a ball.en: The kids had so much fun at the party that they really had a ball all night long.
have a ball.cn: 孩子们玩得太开心了，整夜都乐此不疲。

have a bone to pick with sb.en: I have a bone to pick with him regarding the project's delays.
have a bone to pick with sb.cn: 我对他因项目延误一事颇有微词。

have a bun in the oven.en: She has a bun in the oven, so she'll be having a baby soon.
have a bun in the oven.cn: 她肚子里已有宝宝了，所以很快就要生小孩了。

have a card up your sleeve.en: She has a card up her sleeve to turn the tables on him.
have a card up your sleeve.cn: 她有一张王牌可以扭转局势对付他。

have a claim on sb.en: The company has a legitimate claim on the investors' funds for their promised returns.
have a claim on sb.cn: 该公司对投资者的资金拥有合法索赔权，以获取其承诺的回报。

have a finger in every pie.en: He has a finger in every pie, meddling in business that isn't his.
have a finger in every pie.cn: 他插手每件事，干涉本不属于自己的事务。

have a good head on your shoulders.en: You need to have a good head on your shoulders to make such a difficult decision.
have a good head on your shoulders.cn: 做出如此艰难的决定，你需要有清晰的头脑。

have a heart of gold.en: She has a heart of gold and always helps those in need without expecting anything in return.
have a heart of gold.cn: 她心地善良，总是无私地帮助有需要的人。

have a heart of stone.en: He showed no mercy when he had a heart of stone against his own family.
have a heart of stone.cn: 他对家人毫不留情，心如铁石。

have a high old time.en: They had an absolutely high old time at the party last night.
have a high old time.cn: 昨晚他们在聚会上度过了非常愉快的时光。

have a long way to go.en: Achieving this goal requires us to have a long way to go before we succeed.
have a long way to go.cn: 实现这一目标，我们仍需付出长期努力方能成功。

have a loose tongue.en: She has a loose tongue and often shares others' private secrets without thinking.
have a loose tongue.cn: 她口无遮拦，常不经思考便泄露他人的隐私。

have a mind of your own.en: She has a mind of her own and often makes decisions without consulting anyone.
have a mind of your own.cn: 她有自己的主见，常不经商量便做决定。

have a problem with sth.en: I have a problem with your proposal because it lacks sufficient data.
have a problem with sth.cn: 我对您的提议有疑虑，因为缺乏足够的数据。

have a roof over your head.en: He finally has a roof over his head after years of homelessness.
have a roof over your head.cn: 多年流离失所后，他终于有了栖身之所。

have a roving eye.en: He has a roving eye and often seeks out new romantic interests whenever he gets the chance.
have a roving eye.cn: 他目光游移，一有机会便四处寻觅新的浪漫对象。

have a screw loose.en: He has a screw loose, judging by his erratic behavior at the party.
have a screw loose.cn: 据他在派对上的举止失常判断，他脑子有点不对劲。

have a sweet tooth.en: She has a sweet tooth and always asks for chocolate dessert.
have a sweet tooth.cn: 她爱吃甜食，总要点巧克力甜点。

have a way of doing sth.en: It's not uncommon for the project to have a way of going off track unexpectedly.
have a way of doing sth.cn: 项目意外偏离轨道并不罕见。

have a whale of a time.en: They had a whale of a time at the party and laughed until dawn.
have a whale of a time.cn: 他们在聚会上玩得非常开心，笑到黎明。

have an axe to grind.en: He has an axe to grind, so he's biased against the new policy.
have an axe to grind.cn: 他心存偏见，对新政策颇有微词。

have an eye for sth.en: She has a keen eye for detail that impresses everyone.
have an eye for sth.cn: 她眼光敏锐，注重细节，令众人赞叹。

have ants in your pants.en: The waiting for the verdict made him have ants in his pants, pacing back and forth.
have ants in your pants.cn: 等待判决让他坐立不安，来回踱步。

have been around.en: Having been around for decades, he knows how the world truly works.
have been around.cn: 他历经数十载风雨，深知世界运行的真谛。

have been in the wars.en: He has been in the wars, so he's surprisingly resilient when things go wrong.
have been in the wars.cn: 他经历过战火，因此遭遇变故时表现出惊人的韧性。

have been there before.en: I've heard this story so many times I've had it before.
have been there before.cn: 这个故事我听过太多次了，以前就听过了。

have come a long way.en: The company has come a long way since its humble beginnings in the 1990s.
have come a long way.cn: 该公司自 20 世纪 90 年代起步以来已发展甚远。

have come to stay.en: The new policy has come to stay, gaining widespread acceptance among the public.
have come to stay.cn: 这项新政策已深入人心，广受公众支持。

have designs on sb.en: He has designs on my business partner, so we must stay vigilant.
have designs on sb.cn: 他觊觎我的商业伙伴，所以我们必须保持警惕。

have designs on sth.en: The thieves had clear designs on the museum's priceless artifacts.
have designs on sth.cn: 窃贼对博物馆的无价文物有明确的图谋。

have eyes in the back of your head.en: He has eyes in the back of his head, so he knows exactly what everyone is thinking.
have eyes in the back of your head.cn: 他后脑有眼，所以清楚每个人的心思。

have feet of clay.en: Critics argue that the new leader has feet of clay, making his political future uncertain.
have feet of clay.cn: 批评家认为，这位新领导人的根基不稳，其政治前景充满不确定性。

have got it bad.en: She has got it bad for him, spending all her time thinking about their relationship.
have got it bad.cn: 她对他情根深种，整日都在思念他们的感情。

have got sb under your skin.en: I have him completely under my skin; his charm is utterly irresistible.
have got sb under your skin.cn: 我完全掌控了他；他的魅力令人无法抗拒。

have had a few.en: He has had a few too many and is now completely drunk.
have had a few.cn: 他喝得太多了，现在完全醉了。

have had your day.en: You may have had your day, but the market has moved on without you.
have had your day.cn: 你或许曾风光一时，但市场早已在你缺席中前行。

have hysterics.en: The sudden insult made her lose control and have hysterics in the meeting.
have hysterics.cn: 突如其来的侮辱使她在会议上失控并歇斯底里起来。

have it in for sb.en: She has it in for her rival and won't stop until she wins.
have it in for sb.cn: 她视对手为敌，誓要将其击败为止。

have it in mind to do sth.en: I have it in mind to visit the museum next weekend.
have it in mind to do sth.cn: 我打算下周末去参观博物馆。

have legs.en: The scandal has legs, meaning the media will keep reporting on it for weeks.
have legs.cn: 此事有‘长尾效应’，意味着媒体将持续报道数周。

have money to burn.en: With so much money, he has nothing left to do but spend it all on luxury items.
have money to burn.cn: 钱多到让他别无他选，只能将全部积蓄挥霍在奢侈品上。

have nerves of steel.en: She has the nerve of steel, remaining calm even when the situation becomes completely chaotic.
have nerves of steel.cn: 她胆识如钢，即便局势完全混乱也能保持冷静。

have no business to do sth.en: You have no business criticizing the government's new policy.
have no business to do sth.cn: 你无权批评政府的新政策。

have sb in your pocket.en: He managed to have the corrupt official in his pocket by offering a large bribe.
have sb in your pocket.cn: 他通过送上一笔巨额贿赂，成功将那位腐败官员收买。

have sb's blood on your hands.en: You can't escape the fact that his death has your blood on your hands.
have sb's blood on your hands.cn: 你无法否认他死在你手上这一事实。

have sb's interests at heart.en: She always has her colleagues' interests at heart, ensuring everyone succeeds.
have sb's interests at heart.cn: 她始终将同事的利益放在心上，确保每个人都能成功。

have shot your bolt.en: He finally had shot his bolt, risking everything to win the championship.
have shot your bolt.cn: 他终于扣动了扳机，不惜一切代价赢得了冠军。

have sth at your fingertips.en: With all the latest market data right at her fingertips, she made an instant decision.
have sth at your fingertips.cn: 凭借最新的市场数据触手可及，她当即做出了决定。

have sth back.en: I finally managed to get my car keys back after the whole ordeal.
have sth back.cn: 经历这一切后，我终于拿回了车钥匙。

have sth coming out of your ears.en: You've got more books than you can possibly read in a lifetime.
have sth coming out of your ears.cn: 你拥有的书多到在一生中都不可能读完。

have sth in your pocket.en: With the evidence secured, we now have the truth firmly in our pocket.
have sth in your pocket.cn: 证据确凿，真相已牢牢掌握在我们手中。

have sth on good authority.en: The report is based on information obtained from a reliable source.
have sth on good authority.cn: 该报告依据可靠来源提供的信息编制。

have sth on the brain.en: She has too many new ideas on her brain, making it hard to focus on her current project.
have sth on the brain.cn: 她脑子里新点子太多，难以集中精力完成当前项目。

have sth on your side.en: You have the advantage of experience on your side in this negotiation.
have sth on your side.cn: 此次谈判你有经验作为优势。

have sth out.en: The surgeon decided to have the damaged tissue removed immediately.
have sth out.cn: 外科医生决定立即切除受损组织。

have sth to offer.en: The company has several innovative solutions to offer the market.
have sth to offer.cn: 该公司向市场提供多项创新解决方案。

have sth to your credit.en: She has her impressive research results to her credit.
have sth to your credit.cn: 她拥有令人印象深刻的研究成果作为资历。

have sth under your belt.en: He has already secured his promotion, so he now has it firmly under his belt.
have sth under your belt.cn: 他已确保晋升成功，如今这荣誉已牢牢在握。

have sticky fingers.en: He has sticky fingers, so he often steals small items from the office.
have sticky fingers.cn: 他手指沾油，常偷办公室小物件。

have ten left feet.en: He has ten left feet and stumbled awkwardly across the dance floor.
have ten left feet.cn: 他左腿无力，在舞池上蹒跚前行。

have the courtesy to do sth.en: Please have the courtesy to inform us of your arrival time at least two days in advance.
have the courtesy to do sth.cn: 烦请至少提前两天告知您的抵达时间。

have the ear of sb.en: She finally has the ear of the board, so her proposals are now being seriously considered.
have the ear of sb.cn: 她终于赢得了董事会的重视，因此她的提案正受到认真考虑。

have the last laugh.en: In the end, she will have the last laugh after all those setbacks.
have the last laugh.cn: 最终，她将在经历重重挫折后获得最后的胜利。

have the makings of sth.en: He has all the makings of a future leader, with his natural charisma and strategic vision.
have the makings of sth.cn: 他天生具备领袖气质与战略眼光，大有成为未来领导人的潜质。

have the munchies.en: After that spicy pizza, I suddenly had the munchies and couldn't stop eating chips.
have the munchies.cn: 吃完那口辣披萨后，我突然馋了，忍不住不停地吃薯片。

have the right idea.en: She finally had the right idea and launched her startup with remarkable success.
have the right idea.cn: 她终于找到了正确的方向，并成功推出了自己的创业公司。

have the world at your feet.en: Having achieved global success, he now has the world at his feet.
have the world at your feet.cn: 功成名就的他如今脚踏全球。

have time to kill.en: With nothing urgent on my plate, I have plenty of time to kill before the meeting.
have time to kill.cn: 我手头没什么急事，会前还有大把时间消磨。

have your eye on sth.en: She has her eye on that vintage watch and plans to buy it soon.
have your eye on sth.cn: 她正盯着那块古董表，打算很快买下它。

have your hands full.en: You have your hands full with the project, so I can't help you.
have your hands full.cn: 你手头的项目忙不过来，所以我帮不上忙。

have your hands tied.en: It's hard to make decisions when you have your hands tied by strict regulations.
have your hands tied.cn: 严格的规章制度让人难以做出决定。

have your heart set on sth.en: She has her heart set on becoming a doctor, so she studies hard every day.
have your heart set on sth.cn: 她立志当医生，因此每天刻苦学习。

have your nose in sth.en: She has her nose buried in that book, completely ignoring the party outside.
have your nose in sth.cn: 她埋头于那本书中，完全无视外面的派对。

having said that.en: Having said that, the project's budget remains strictly limited.
having said that.cn: 尽管如此，项目预算仍严格受限。

having the latest information.en: Having the latest information ensures you make informed decisions quickly.
having the latest information.cn: 掌握最新信息能帮助您快速做出明智决策。

he who pays the piper calls the tune.en: The company that funds the project ultimately dictates its strategic direction.
he who pays the piper calls the tune.cn: 项目资助方最终决定其战略方向。

head over heels in love.en: She is head over heels in love with him, unable to stop thinking about their future together.
head over heels in love.cn: 她深爱着他，无法停止思考他们的未来。

hear sb out.en: Let me hear you out before I make any judgment on your story.
hear sb out.cn: 在你讲完之前，我先听听你的说法，再做判断。

heart and soul.en: She devoted her heart and soul to curing the rare disease.
heart and soul.cn: 她倾尽心血救治这种罕见病。

heavy going.en: The complex regulations proved to be heavy going for the new team.
heavy going.cn: 复杂的规章对这支新队伍来说难以应付。

heavy hand.en: The government's heavy hand on the market has sparked widespread protests among small businesses.
heavy hand.cn: 政府对市场的严厉管控引发了小企业的广泛抗议。

hedge against sth.en: We must hedge against unexpected market fluctuations to protect our savings.
hedge against sth.cn: 我们必须对冲市场波动风险以保护储蓄。

hedge your bets.en: To hedge his bets, the investor diversified his portfolio across multiple sectors.
hedge your bets.cn: 为分散风险，该投资者将投资组合配置于多个行业。

hell for leather.en: We need to finish this report by tomorrow morning, hell for leather!
hell for leather.cn: 我们必须在明天早上前完成这份报告，真是急死人！

here and there.en: The litter was scattered here and there across the entire park.
here and there.cn: 整个公园到处散落着垃圾。

here goes.en: Here goes nothing as I leap into the freezing pool.
here goes.cn: 我纵身跳入冰冷的泳池，一切就此开始。

here we go.en: Here we go, and now the final presentation begins.
here we go.cn: 我们开始，现在进入最终演示环节。

here we go again.en: Here we go again with the same predictable drama.
here we go again.cn: 又是这出可预测的闹剧。

here you are.en: Here you are, the report I mentioned in our last meeting.
here you are.cn: 这是我在上次会议上提到的报告。

here you go.en: Here you go, this is the report you requested for your meeting.
here you go.cn: 这是您会议所需的报告。

high and mighty.en: He acted high and mighty, refusing to help anyone with his own problems.
high and mighty.cn: 他盛气凌人，拒绝帮助任何人解决自己的问题。

high as a kite.en: He was high as a kite after drinking too much alcohol at the party last night.
high as a kite.cn: 昨晚在聚会上喝得太醉，他简直像风筝一样飘忽不定。

high days and holidays.en: The festival season brings high days and holidays that fill the city with vibrant celebrations.
high days and holidays.cn: 节庆时节带来了诸多喜庆节日，使城市充满热闹欢庆的氛围。

hightail it.en: The thief managed to hightail it before the police arrived.
hightail it.cn: 小偷在警察到来前便溜走了。

his nibs.en: He is always acting superior, just like the self-important people we all call his nibs.
his nibs.cn: 他总是摆出一副高人一等的架势，就像我们大家都叫他‘小少爷’的那些自命不凡的人一样。

history repeats itself.en: History often repeats itself when leaders ignore the lessons of the past.
history repeats itself.cn: 当领导者忽视历史教训时，历史往往会重演。

hit it.en: Let's hit it and start playing the piano right now.
hit it.cn: 那就开始吧，现在立刻弹奏钢琴。

hit sb when they're down.en: Don't hit him when he's down; offer help instead of mockery.
hit sb when they're down.cn: 他跌倒时切勿殴打，而应给予帮助而非嘲笑。

hit sb where it hurts.en: The politician hit the voters where it hurts by ignoring their rising costs of living.
hit sb where it hurts.cn: 该政客无视民众日益上涨的生活成本，正中下怀。

hit the buffers.en: The startup hit the buffers after losing its sole investor.
hit the buffers.cn: 该公司在失去唯一投资人后资金耗尽。

hit the deck.en: The heavy box hit the deck with a loud thud, scattering debris everywhere.
hit the deck.cn: 沉重的箱子重重地砸在甲板上，发出巨大的声响，碎片四处飞溅。

hit the ground running.en: The team hit the ground running immediately after their victory.
hit the ground running.cn: 他们在获胜后立刻投入工作。

hit the jackpot.en: After years of struggling, she finally hit the jackpot when her startup secured massive funding.
hit the jackpot.cn: 历经多年挣扎，她的初创公司终于获得巨额投资，一举成功。

hit the nail on the head.en: His analysis hit the nail on the head regarding the company's financial decline.
hit the nail on the head.cn: 他对公司财务下滑的分析一针见血。

hit the spot.en: That spicy dish really hit the spot after our long hike.
hit the spot.cn: 长途跋涉后，这道辣菜真是解了我们的馋。

hither and yon.en: He wandered hither and yon, searching for his lost keys in the dense forest.
hither and yon.cn: 他在茂密的森林中四处游荡，寻找丢失的钥匙。

hold all the aces.en: The team held all the aces by securing every advantage before the final match.
hold all the aces.cn: 该队在决赛前牢牢掌握了所有主动权。

hold all the cards.en: She holds all the cards in this negotiation, leaving us with no choice but to accept her terms.
hold all the cards.cn: 她在这场谈判中占据绝对主动权，让我们别无选择，只能接受她的条件。

hold forth.en: He tends to hold forth on obscure topics, annoying everyone in the room.
hold forth.cn: 他喜欢就生僻的话题滔滔不绝，惹得在场众人厌烦。

hold good.en: The advice holds good until the policy changes next month.
hold good.cn: 此建议在下月政策变更前依然有效。

hold it.en: Please hold it while I retrieve the necessary documents for you.
hold it.cn: 请稍等，我去为您取所需文件。

hold out sth.en: The new policy aims to hold out hope for those struggling with unemployment.
hold out sth.cn: 新政策旨在为那些受失业困扰的人带来希望。

hold sb's hand.en: The government decided to hold the struggling families' hand during the economic crisis.
hold sb's hand.cn: 政府在经济危机期间决定扶持困难家庭。

hold sth against sb.en: She decided not to hold his rudeness against him, choosing instead to focus on their shared goals.
hold sth against sb.cn: 她决定不记他的无礼，转而专注于共同的目标。
