hold sth over sb.en: He tried to hold his grades over her head to force her into the scholarship.
hold sth over sb.cn: 他试图把成绩挂在她的头顶，迫使她获得奖学金。

hold the floor.en: She held the floor for twenty minutes, leaving no one else to speak.
hold the floor.cn: 她发言长达二十分钟，无人再开口。

hold up.en: The new bridge can hold up the heavy traffic loads during winter storms.
hold up.cn: 这座新桥能承受冬季风暴期间的重载交通。

hold up sth.en: The bank was held up by armed robbers who demanded all the cash.
hold up sth.cn: 该银行遭持枪劫匪挟持，劫匪要求交出全部现金。

hold up your head.en: He finally held up his head with pride after winning the competition.
hold up your head.cn: 他赢得比赛后，自豪地昂起了头。

hold your horses.en: Hold your horses before making such a rash decision in the meeting.
hold your horses.cn: 在会议上做如此草率的决定之前，请三思而后行。

home is where the heart is.en: Home is where the heart is, so she returned to her quiet cottage after a long year abroad.
home is where the heart is.cn: 家才是心灵的归宿，因此她在海外漂泊一年后回到了宁静的住所。

home sweet home.en: No matter where we wander, this humble abode remains our truly sweet home.
home sweet home.cn: 无论我们走到哪里，这简陋的小屋始终是我们真正甜蜜的家。

hop it.en: Hop it, you're blocking the exit path for everyone.
hop it.cn: 别闹了，你堵住了所有人的出口。

hope for the best.en: Despite the setbacks, we must hope for the best and keep moving forward.
hope for the best.cn: 尽管遭遇挫折，我们仍要抱最佳期望，继续前行。

horror of horrors.en: This outdated software is the absolute horror of horrors we've ever encountered.
horror of horrors.cn: 这是我们曾遭遇过的最令人绝望的软件。

hot under the collar.en: He was hot under the collar after receiving the harsh criticism from his boss.
hot under the collar.cn: 他因上司的严厉批评而恼火。

how do you do.en: When we first met, I politely asked him how do you do.
how do you do.cn: 初次见面时，我礼貌地问他：“您好？"

how the other half lives.en: It's easy to envy how the other half lives when you only see their highlight reel.
how the other half lives.cn: 若只看到他人生活的精彩集锦，便容易心生羡慕。

hue and cry.en: The public's hue and cry forced the government to address the corruption scandal immediately.
hue and cry.cn: 公众的强烈抗议迫使政府立即处理腐败丑闻。

husband and wife.en: The husband and wife decided to retire early after thirty years of marriage.
husband and wife.cn: 这对夫妻在结婚三十周年后决定提前退休。

if all else fails.en: If all else fails, I will simply try to find another way to solve the problem.
if all else fails.cn: 若其他方法均无效，我将尝试寻找另一种途径来解决问题。

if and when.en: We should prepare for both the success and failure, if and when it happens.
if and when.cn: 无论成功与否，都应做好相应准备。

if anything.en: If anything, the situation has worsened rather than improved.
if anything.cn: 实际情况反而恶化了，并未改善。

if in doubt.en: If you are unsure which path to take, it is better to wait until you have more information.
if in doubt.cn: 若不确定该走哪条路，最好等待更多信息后再做决定。

if it comes to that.en: If it comes to that, we might as well finish the project today.
if it comes to that.cn: 既然如此，我们今天就完成这个项目吧。

if only.en: If only we had acted sooner, the disaster could have been averted.
if only.cn: 倘若我们早点行动，这场灾难本可避免。

if you ask me.en: If you ask me, I believe this policy will significantly improve our community's safety.
if you ask me.cn: 依我看，该政策将显著提升我们社区的安全。

ignorance is bliss.en: His ignorance of the scandal was, indeed, a form of bliss for him.
ignorance is bliss.cn: 他对丑闻的无知，对他来说确实是一种幸福。

ill at ease.en: He felt ill at ease during the interview and struggled to answer the questions.
ill at ease.cn: 他在面试时感到不自在，难以作答。

in a brown study.en: He sat in a brown study, so lost in thought he didn't notice anyone approaching.
in a brown study.cn: 他独自沉思，以至于没注意到有人走近。

in a circle.en: The team kept circling the same point in a circle without making any progress.
in a circle.cn: 该团队在原地反复空转，毫无进展。

in a daze.en: She stood in a daze, unable to comprehend the sudden shift in her life.
in a daze.cn: 她呆若木鸡，无法理解生活的骤变。

in a flat spin.en: The crowd went into a flat spin when the unexpected announcement was made.
in a flat spin.cn: 当意外宣布时，人群陷入混乱。

in a heartbeat.en: The doctor rushed in a heartbeat to save the critically injured patient.
in a heartbeat.cn: 医生飞奔而来抢救那位重伤患者。

in a hole.en: The company is in a hole due to the sudden market crash.
in a hole.cn: 该公司因市场突然暴跌而陷入困境。

in a hurry to do sth.en: She was in a hurry to finish the report before her boss returned.
in a hurry to do sth.cn: 她急于在老板回来之前完成报告。

in a leading position or in control.en: The company has maintained a leading position by consistently innovating its products.
in a leading position or in control.cn: 该公司通过持续创新产品，始终保持在领先地位。

in a manner of speaking.en: In a manner of speaking, the project is complete, though minor details remain.
in a manner of speaking.cn: 话虽如此，项目已基本完成，仅余些许细节待完善。

in a pickle.en: The company is in a pickle after the sudden market crash.
in a pickle.cn: 公司因市场突然暴跌陷入困境。

in a state of grace.en: The priest declared that the penitent had returned to a state of grace after sincere repentance.
in a state of grace.cn: 神父宣布，该忏悔者在真诚悔过后已恢复恩宠状态。

in a trice.en: The situation changed in a trice, leaving us completely unprepared for the sudden shift.
in a trice.cn: 局势瞬息万变，让我们完全措手不及。

in a vacuum.en: Without considering real-world constraints, the theory fails in a vacuum.
in a vacuum.cn: 若不考虑现实约束，该理论在真空中无法成立。

in a word.en: In a word, the project's success hinged entirely on our team's unwavering dedication.
in a word.cn: 总之，项目的成功完全取决于我们团队坚定不移的奉献精神。

in abeyance.en: The decision regarding the merger remains in abeyance until further notice.
in abeyance.cn: 合并事宜暂且搁置，待另行通知。

in abundance.en: The market is flooded with fresh produce available in abundance.
in abundance.cn: 市场上供应充足的新鲜农产品琳琅满目。

in accordance with sth.en: The new policy was implemented in accordance with the guidelines issued last month.

in addition to sth.cn: 除预算外，还需考虑潜在的设备费用。

in all.cn: 该项目总花费超过两百万美元才完成。

in all honesty.cn: 老实说，我从未想过我们会一起完成这个项目。

in all seriousness.cn: 说真的，关于这件严肃的事情，我并非在开玩笑。

in any case.cn: 无论如何，我们必须在周五上午前提交报告。

in arrears.cn: 该公司目前拖欠供应商款项已达三个月。

in bad faith.cn: 他们以不诚信的态度进行谈判，向投资者隐瞒了真实的财务风险。

in bed.cn: 电影还没开始，她就已在床上睡着了。

in brief.cn: 简言之，项目的成功完全取决于能否获得额外资金。

in chorus.cn: 合唱团齐声高唱国歌以庆祝胜利。

in cold blood.en: The murderer killed his victims in cold blood without any remorse.
in cold blood.cn: 凶手冷血地杀害了受害者，毫无悔意。

in conformity with sth.en: The new policy was implemented in conformity with the established regulations.
in conformity with sth.cn: 新政策已按既定规定实施。

in conjunction with.en: The new policy will be implemented in conjunction with the upcoming budget adjustments.
in conjunction with.cn: 新政策将随即将进行的预算调整一并实施。

in consideration of sth.en: He received a bonus in consideration of his exceptional performance last year.
in consideration of sth.cn: 鉴于他去年表现优异，他获得了一笔奖金。

in contemplation.en: The proposal is currently in contemplation by the board of directors.
in contemplation.cn: 董事会正在审议该提议。

in control of a situation.en: She regained full control of the situation before the meeting ended.
in control of a situation.cn: 她在会议结束前重新掌控了局面。

in course of sth.en: In the course of the project, we encountered several unexpected technical challenges.
in course of sth.cn: 项目过程中，我们遇到了几个意想不到的技术难题。

in default of sth.en: In default of any evidence, the court will impose a heavy fine on him.
in default of sth.cn: 若无相反证据，法院将对其处以重罚。

in demand.en: The latest smartphone models are in high demand among tech enthusiasts.
in demand.cn: 最新智能手机在科技爱好者中备受追捧。

in depth.en: The report provides an in-depth analysis of the company's recent financial struggles.
in depth.cn: 该报告深入分析了公司近期的财务困境。

in embryo.cn: 该项目尚处萌芽阶段，我们仍有数月时间完成预算。

in full.en: The company will present its financial report in full during the quarterly meeting.
in full.cn: 该公司将在季度会议上全面公布其财务报告。

in full measure.en: The new policy will be implemented in full measure to boost economic growth.
in full measure.cn: 新政策将全面实施以推动经济增长。

in general but not in detail.cn: 总体而言，项目进展顺利，但细节尚不明确。

in good company.en: You don't have to worry about your mistake; everyone in good company has made it before.
in good company.cn: 不必担心你的失误；在良师益友中，每个人都曾犯过错。

in good faith.en: They signed the contract in good faith, believing all terms were fair.
in good faith.cn: 他们本着善意签署了合同，认为所有条款都公平合理。

in good time.en: We must finish the project in good time to avoid any last-minute delays.
in good time.cn: 我们必须按时完工，以免产生任何最后时刻的延误。

in high dudgeon.cn: 他怒气冲冲，盯着刚才发生的粗鲁打断。

in inverted commas.cn: 所谓的‘经济奇迹’不过是一个迅速破灭的幻象。

in itself.cn: 该项目本身已属成功，但仍需更多资金以图扩展。

in jeopardy.cn: 这片古老森林正面临非法采伐活动的威胁。

in jest.cn: 他说只是开玩笑要辞职，但我知道他认真考虑职业转变。

in large measure.en: In large measure, the project's success depended on the team's relentless dedication.
in large measure.cn: 该项目在很大程度上取决于团队的不懈奉献。

in line for sth.en: He is in line for the promotion if he can finish the project on time.
in line for sth.cn: 若能按时完成该项目，他将获晋升机会。

in line with sth.en: The new policy is in line with the company's long-term strategic goals.
in line with sth.cn: 新政策与公司长期战略目标一致。

in microcosm.en: The crisis in this small town reflects the global situation in microcosm.
in microcosm.cn: 这座小镇的危机折射出全球局势的缩影。

in miniature.en: The company launched a pilot project in miniature to test the new market strategy.
in miniature.cn: 该公司启动了一项微型试点项目，以测试新的市场战略。

in mint condition.en: The antique car is in mint condition, with a gleaming exterior and flawless engine.
in mint condition.cn: 这辆古董车状况极佳，车身光亮如新，引擎完美无缺。

in mistake for sth.en: I mistook the red car for a police vehicle in the dark.
in mistake for sth.cn: 在黑暗中，我把那辆红色汽车误认为是警车。

in mothballs.en: The project was put in mothballs due to lack of funding, so it remains dormant until next year.
in mothballs.cn: 该项目因资金不足被搁置，因此直到明年仍处于休眠状态。

in my book.en: In my book, that decision was completely wrong and needed immediate reversal.
in my book.cn: 在我看来，该决定完全错误，必须立即撤销。

in name only.en: The partnership exists in name only, as both parties have no intention of collaborating.
in name only.cn: 该合伙关系仅具名义，双方均无意合作。

in one.en: This all-in-one device combines a printer, scanner, and copier into a single unit.
in one.cn: 该一体化设备将打印机、扫描仪和复印机合二为一。

in operation.en: The new bridge is finally in operation after months of construction.
in operation.cn: 这座新桥历经数月施工，终于通车。

in or to many parts of sth.en: The new policy affects in or to many parts of the economy, causing widespread disruption.
in or to many parts of sth.cn: 新政策波及经济诸多领域，引发广泛动荡。

in or to many places in an area.en: We need to visit many locations throughout the entire region.
in or to many places in an area.cn: 我们需要走访该地区的许多地点。

in order that.en: We implemented strict safety protocols in order that no accidents could occur during the project.
in order that.cn: 为确保项目期间不发生任何事故，我们实施了严格的安全规程。

in order to do sth.en: In order to achieve sustainable growth, we must invest heavily in renewable energy technologies.
in order to do sth.cn: 为确保持续增长，我们必须大力投资可再生能源技术。

in order to help sb.en: In order to help her, he offered to drive her home safely.
in order to help sb.cn: 为助她一臂之力，他主动提出安全送她回家。

in over your head.cn: 他接了太多项目，如今已完全力不从心。

in pairs.en: Students worked in pairs to solve the complex math problems.
in pairs.cn: 学生两人一组解决复杂的数学题。

in part.en: The decision was made in part due to budget constraints and in part due to public pressure.
in part.cn: 该决定部分源于预算限制，部分源于公众压力。

in passing.en: He mentioned the project in passing, but it clearly held his interest.
in passing.cn: 他顺带提到了该项目，但这显然引起了他的兴趣。

in pawn.en: The company had to pledge its main assets in pawn to cover the sudden financial shortfall.
in pawn.cn: 公司不得不将其主要资产抵押以弥补突发的资金短缺。

in payment for sth.en: He received a bonus in payment for his exceptional performance last quarter.
in payment for sth.cn: 他因上个季度的杰出表现获得了奖金。

in perpetuity.en: The company granted the land to the village in perpetuity, ensuring their permanent ownership.
in perpetuity.cn: 该公司将该土地永久授予该村，确保其拥有永久产权。

in person.en: The CEO will attend the summit in person to discuss the merger details.
in person.cn: 首席执行官将亲自出席峰会，讨论合并细节。

in point of fact.en: In point of fact, the project was completed two weeks ahead of schedule.
in point of fact.cn: 事实上，该项目提前两周完工。

in practice.en: In practice, the new policy will significantly improve our operational efficiency.
in practice.cn: 实际上，新政策将显著提高我们的运营效率。

in private.cn: 夫妇决定私下商量他们的未来，避开旁人的窥探。

in progress.cn: 该项目目前仍在进行中，因此尚无法提供最终报告。

in rags.cn: 那个流浪汉衣衫褴褛地走在街上，显得极度贫困。

in reality.cn: 实际上，项目的预算远低于我们最初的计划。

in reserve.en: We must keep emergency funds in reserve for unforeseen economic crises.
in reserve.cn: 我们必须储备应急资金以应对突发的经济危机。

in residence.en: The artist is currently in residence at the university, creating new works for the gallery exhibition.
in residence.cn: 该艺术家目前驻校，为画廊展览创作新作。

in retrospect.cn: 回顾往事，他早期的失误实则是通往成功的基石。

in rude health.cn: 他精神抖擞地来到聚会，准备通宵跳舞。

in ruins.cn: 那座被风暴摧毁的古堡如今矗立着，成为昔日辉煌的令人不安的见证。

in sb's hands.cn: 该项目现已完全由新经理负责。

in sb's keeping.en: The elderly cat is in the new neighbor's keeping, so they feed it daily.
in sb's keeping.cn: 这只老猫由新邻居照看，因此每天都能得到喂养。

in sb's presence.en: He admitted the theft only in his boss's presence, fearing immediate termination.
in sb's presence.cn: 他仅在老板面前承认了盗窃，生怕立即被解雇。

in sb's train.cn: 我们决定紧随其后，一同探索隐蔽的洞穴。

in spades.cn: 当前就业形势大好，为所有人提供了无数机会。

in spirit.en: We should act in spirit, not just follow the rules blindly.
in spirit.cn: 我们应秉持精神去行动，而非盲目遵循规则。

in spite of sth.cn: 尽管雨下得很大，我们还是决定去公园散步。

in sum.cn: 总之，证据有力地支持了我们最初的假设。

in the ascendant.cn: 这项新技术正迅速普及，现已成为行业主流。

in the blink of an eye.en: The project was completed in the blink of an eye, surprising everyone involved.
in the blink of an eye.cn: 该项目转瞬即告完成，令所有参与者感到惊讶。

in the buff.cn: 该模特身着浴袍展示其新款泳装系列。

in the clear.cn: 服刑结束后，他终于重获自由，无畏地面对生活。

in the cold light of day.cn: 事实一经冷峻审视，他的不在场证明便完全崩塌。

in the course of time.en: In the course of time, she finally achieved her lifelong dream.
in the course of time.cn: 岁月流转，她终于实现了毕生的梦想。

in the event.cn: 如遇延误，我们将将会议改至明天举行。

in the event that sth happens.cn: 若发生严重洪水，必须立即启动所有撤离路线。

in the extreme.en: In the extreme, this policy could lead to severe economic instability.
in the extreme.cn: 极端情况下，该政策可能导致严重的经济不稳定。

in the fast lane.en: She decided to live in the fast lane, embracing a vibrant and exciting lifestyle.
in the fast lane.cn: 她决定生活在快节奏中，拥抱充满活力与刺激的生活方式。

in the flesh.cn: 我更希望能与您面对面相见，而不是通过视频通话。

in the fullness of time.cn: 在时光圆满之时，正义必将战胜一切不公。

in the grip of sth.cn: 该市仍受严重洪水侵袭，救援队难以抵达被隔离区域。

in the interim.cn: 在此期间，我们将采取临时措施确保安全。

in the land of the living.cn: 他在漫长的昏迷后终于回到了人间。

in the lap of luxury.en: Living in the lap of luxury, he never faced any real financial challenges.
in the lap of luxury.cn: 他生活优渥，从未面临过真正的财务挑战。

in the lap of the gods.en: The outcome lies entirely in the lap of the gods, making it impossible for us to control.
in the lap of the gods.cn: 结果全凭天意，我们无能为力。

in the last resort.en: In the last resort, we must accept that the project will fail.
in the last resort.cn: 最后，我们必须承认该项目将失败。

in the long run.en: In the long run, consistent effort yields far better results than sporadic bursts of energy.
in the long run.cn: 从长远来看，持之以恒的努力远胜于偶尔迸发的精力。

in the making.en: The relationship is still in the making, so patience is required from both sides.
in the making.cn: 双方关系尚在发展中，需要彼此耐心。

in the market for sth.en: She is currently in the market for a new laptop to upgrade her work setup.
in the market for sth.cn: 她目前正在寻找一台新笔记本电脑以升级工作设备。

in the meantime.cn: 在此期间，我会处理这些紧急任务，您准备报告。

in the meanwhile.cn: 与此同时，我将处理紧急报告，您准备演示文稿。

in the nature of sth.cn: 这项新政策在本质上是对立观点之间的妥协。

in the nature of things.en: In the nature of things, such delays are inevitable in complex projects.
in the nature of things.cn: 就项目本质而言，复杂项目的延误是不可避免的。

in the nude.en: The artist chose to paint a model in the nude to capture raw human emotion.
in the nude.cn: 这位艺术家选择裸体模特，以捕捉原始的人类情感。

in the offing.cn: 风暴即将来临，我们必须立即固定所有松散物品。

in the original.cn: 为全面领会其深层含义，应阅读原著。

in the person of sb.en: The new policy will be implemented in the person of our newly appointed CEO.
in the person of sb.cn: 新政策将由我们新任首席执行官亲自推行。

in the pipeline.en: Several new projects are currently in the pipeline for next year's budget.
in the pipeline.cn: 今年预算中已有数个项目正在规划中。

in the presence of sth.en: The incident occurred in the presence of several witnesses who later testified.
in the presence of sth.cn: 该事件发生在多名证人面前，他们随后出庭作证。

in the public eye.cn: 该丑闻使该政客一夜之间进入公众视野。

in the same breath.cn: 他自称天才，却又在同一口气中承认自己一无所知。

in the short run.en: In the short run, inflation may spike before stabilizing in the long term.
in the short run.cn: 短期内通胀率可能先飙升，随后在长期趋于稳定。

in the slow lane.en: The company fell into the slow lane, losing ground to its agile competitors.
in the slow lane.cn: 该公司陷入停滞，落后于其敏捷的竞争对手。

in the soup.en: The company is in deep trouble after losing that crucial contract.
in the soup.cn: 该公司在失去那份关键合同后陷入困境。

in the trust of sb.en: The documents are kept in the trust of the bank manager.
in the trust of sb.cn: 这些文件由银行经理保管。

in the way of sth.en: In the way of food, I prefer vegetables to meat.
in the way of sth.cn: 在饮食方面，我更喜欢蔬菜而非肉类。

in the wilderness.en: After years in the wilderness, he finally returned to lead his party.
in the wilderness.cn: 历经多年漂泊，他终于归来统领部众。

in the wind.en: The rumor about his resignation has been in the wind for weeks.
in the wind.cn: 关于他辞职的传闻已传开数周。

in the world.en: It is truly remarkable that she has achieved such success in the world within just a few years.
in the world.cn: 她仅用几年时间就在世界范围内取得了如此巨大的成功，这确实令人惊叹。

in theory.en: In theory, the system works perfectly, but in practice it often fails.
in theory.cn: 理论上系统运行完美，但实践中常会失效。

in this day and age.en: In this day and age, digital literacy is essential for everyone.
in this day and age.cn: 当今时代，数字素养对每个人而言都至关重要。

in time.en: The project will be completed in time, despite the initial delays.
in time.cn: 尽管初期延误，项目仍如期完成。

in truth.en: In truth, the project's success depends entirely on your immediate cooperation.
in truth.cn: 事实上，项目的成功完全取决于你立即的合作。

in two.en: The project was completed in two weeks, far ahead of schedule.
in two.cn: 该项目仅用两周便完工，远超前定计划。

in undertones.en: The actor conveyed the character's hidden fear in undertones throughout the scene.
in undertones.cn: 该演员通过潜台词在整场戏中传达了角色隐藏的恐惧。

in vain.en: His years of hard work were in vain because the company went bankrupt.
in vain.cn: 他多年的辛勤努力付诸东流，因为公司破产了。

in view of sth.en: In view of the severe weather, we decided to postpone the outdoor event.
in view of sth.cn: 鉴于天气恶劣，我们决定推迟户外活动。

in words of six syllable.en: He explained the complex theory in words of six syllable, making it easy for everyone to understand.
in words of six syllable.cn: 他用六个音节的话语阐述了复杂的理论，使人人都能听懂。

in writing.en: The official policy was announced in writing rather than verbally.
in writing.cn: 官方政策以书面形式而非口头形式宣布。

in your birthday suit.en: He arrived at the party in his birthday suit, shocking everyone with his nudity.
in your birthday suit.cn: 他光着身子出席聚会，裸体惊动了众人。

in your cups.en: Don't drive if you're in your cups, it's too dangerous for everyone.
in your cups.cn: 若你酒醉，切勿驾车，这对所有人来说都太危险了。

in your dreams.en: You think you'll get that promotion in your dreams? It's not happening.
in your dreams.cn: 你以为能在梦中得到晋升？别做梦了。

in your eighties.en: She has been living in her eighties for over a decade now.
in your eighties.cn: 她已在此居住三十余年，如今已是八十高龄。

in your element.en: She felt completely in her element when she finally returned to the bustling market.
in your element.cn: 当她终于回到熙攘的市场时，她感到如鱼得水。

in your fifties.en: Many people find that their energy levels drop significantly once they are in their fifties.
in your fifties.cn: 许多人发现，进入五十岁后精力会显著下降。

in your forties.en: By the time she was in her forties, her career had reached its peak.
in your forties.cn: 到她四十多岁时，事业已达巅峰。

in your own time.en: You can read this book in your own time whenever you like.
in your own time.cn: 您可以根据自己的时间安排，随时阅读这本书。

in your seventies.en: He has been working in the field for over thirty years, now in his seventies.
in your seventies.cn: 他从事该领域工作已超过三十年，如今已七十多岁。

in your sixties.en: Many of my colleagues are in their sixties and still very active.
in your sixties.cn: 我许多同事年过六旬，依然十分活跃。

in your thirties.en: Many people find their true passion for art when they are in their thirties.
in your thirties.cn: 许多人直到三十多岁才真正发现他们对艺术的热爱。

in your twenties.en: She is still in her twenties, though she looks much older than her actual age.
in your twenties.cn: 她仍处二十多岁，但看起来比实际年龄老得多。

inch by inch.en: We must rebuild the bridge inch by inch to ensure its safety.
inch by inch.cn: 我们必须一寸一寸地重建桥梁，以确保其安全。

inside out.en: The instructions explicitly stated to wear the coat inside out before washing.
inside out.cn: 说明书明确指出洗涤前应将外套翻面穿着。

into action.en: The new safety regulations have finally been put into action to protect all workers.
into action.cn: 新的安全规定已正式实施，以保护所有工人。

involving sth unpleasant.en: The promotion involves taking on extra responsibilities that are quite unpleasant.
involving sth unpleasant.cn: 该晋升要求承担一些令人不悦的额外职责。

it goes to show.en: It goes to show that consistency is the key to long-term success.
it goes to show.cn: 这足以说明，一致是长期成功的关键。

it isn't on.en: It isn't on, so we can't proceed with the project at all.
it isn't on.cn: 该项目尚未启动，因此无法推进任何工作。

it makes no odds.en: It makes no odds whether we leave now or wait until tomorrow.
it makes no odds.cn: 无论我们现在离开还是等到明天，结果都一样。

it takes ten to do sth.en: It takes two to tango, as both parties share equal responsibility for the conflict.
it takes ten to do sth.cn: 二人同心，冲突双方责任均等。

it takes two to tango.en: It takes two to tango when both parties contribute equally to the problem.
it takes two to tango.cn: 若双方对问题贡献均等，则需两人共舞。

it won't do.en: It won't do; we must find a better solution to this problem immediately.
it won't do.cn: 不行，我们必须立即找到更好的解决办法。

it's a fair cop.en: It's a fair cop if you admit to stealing from the office.
it's a fair cop.cn: 如果你承认从办公室偷东西，那就算你倒霉了。

it's a free country.en: It's a free country, so you have the right to say what you think.
it's a free country.cn: 这是一个自由的国家，因此你有权利说出你的想法。

it's not as if.en: It's not as if we've been waiting for years to see this.
it's not as if.cn: 并非我们等了数年才盼到这一幕。

it's not brain surgery.en: You don't need to be a genius to understand this simple concept.
it's not brain surgery.cn: 你无需成为天才才能理解这个简单的概念。

it's not rocket science.en: Don't let the complexity fool you; it's not rocket science.
it's not rocket science.cn: 不要被其复杂性误导；这并非高深莫测的科学。

it's not sb's day.en: It's not just a bad day; it's truly his worst day so far.
it's not sb's day.cn: 这不仅仅是一个糟糕的日子，而是迄今为止他最糟糕的一天。

it's your funeral.en: If you choose to ignore the warning, it's your funeral.
it's your funeral.cn: 若你选择无视警告，后果自负。

jobs for the boys.en: Critics argue that many government jobs were given to close friends rather than qualified candidates.
jobs for the boys.cn: 批评者认为，许多政府职位被授予了亲密朋友而非合格候选人。

jog sb's memory.en: The old photograph successfully jogged her memory about that distant summer.
jog sb's memory.cn: 那张旧照片唤起了她对那个遥远夏天的记忆。

join the club.en: Well, you can join the club; we all faced similar hardships.
join the club.cn: 没关系，你可以加入这个行列；我们都曾经历过类似的艰难困苦。

jolly well.en: He jolly well knows that the deadline is tomorrow.
jolly well.cn: 他清清楚楚知道截止日期是明天。

jump down sb's throat.en: She jumped down his throat immediately after he made a mistake.
jump down sb's throat.cn: 她在他犯错误后立刻对他破口大骂。

jump out at sb.en: The bright red sign jumped out at me as I walked down the street.
jump out at sb.cn: 我走在街上时，那块鲜红的招牌格外醒目。

jump out of your skin.en: The sudden noise made me jump out of my skin, nearly knocking over my chair.
jump out of your skin.cn: 突如其来的噪音吓得我跳了起来，差点撞翻椅子。

jump the gun.en: We shouldn't jump the gun by announcing results before the final vote.
jump the gun.cn: 在最终投票前公布结果是不恰当的。

jump through hoops.en: The team had to jump through numerous bureaucratic hoops just to secure the funding.
jump through hoops.cn: 该团队仅为了争取资金，便不得不跨越重重行政障碍。

jump to it.en: Don't just jump to it; analyze the data first before drawing any conclusions.
jump to it.cn: 切勿急于下结论，应先分析数据。

just like that.en: The phone rang just like that, catching me completely off guard.
just like that.cn: 电话就在这时响起，让我措手不及。

just so.en: The room is just so that every item has its designated place.
just so.cn: 房间里的每件物品都有固定的位置。

just then.en: Just then, the phone rang and interrupted our conversation.
just then.cn: 就在这时，电话响了，打断了我们的谈话。

just this once.en: I'll make an exception just this once, but don't expect it again.
just this once.cn: 这次我破个例，但别指望下次还有。

just what the doctor ordered.en: That new strategy is just what the doctor ordered for our struggling sales team.
just what the doctor ordered.cn: 这套新策略正是我们销售团队急需的良方。

keep abreast of sth.en: You should keep abreast of the latest developments in this rapidly changing industry.
keep abreast of sth.cn: 您应密切关注该行业最新的发展动态。

keep at sth.en: You should keep at your studies until you master the complex grammar rules.
keep at sth.cn: 你应该坚持学习，直到掌握复杂的语法规则。

keep body and soul together.en: They barely keep body and soul together on their meager income.
keep body and soul together.cn: 他们仅靠微薄的收入勉强维持生计。

keep down.en: The soldiers kept low to avoid detection by the enemy.
keep down.cn: 士兵们压低身体，以免被敌人发现。

keep house.en: She decided to keep house after her husband retired early last year.
keep house.cn: 她丈夫去年提前退休后，她决定操持家务。

keep it real.en: He insisted on keeping it real, refusing to use any fancy words or tricks.
keep it real.cn: 他坚持保持真实，拒绝使用任何花哨的词汇或技巧。

keep off.en: The heavy rain kept the snow from falling on the roof.
keep off.cn: 大雨挡住了屋顶上的积雪。

keep on.en: She decided to keep on working despite the overwhelming challenges she faced.
keep on.cn: 她决定继续工作，尽管面临重重挑战。

keep sb amused.en: The children kept themselves amused by playing with the new toys in the garden.
keep sb amused.cn: 孩子们玩弄花园里的新玩具自得其乐。

keep sb at a distance.en: She tried to keep him at a distance by never sharing her personal feelings.
keep sb at a distance.cn: 她从不流露个人情感，以此保持与他的距离。

keep sb at arm's length.en: She decided to keep him at arm's length after discovering his dishonesty.
keep sb at arm's length.cn: 她发现他不诚实后，决定与他保持距离。

keep sb at sth.en: The coach kept the team in practice until dawn to ensure they maintained peak performance.
keep sb at sth.cn: 教练坚持让球队训练至黎明，以确保他们保持最佳状态。

keep sb company.en: I'll keep you company while you wait for the bus.
keep sb company.cn: 等你等车时，我陪你一起。

keep sb from sth.en: The strict safety rules kept the workers from entering the construction site.
keep sb from sth.cn: 严格的安全规定阻止工人进入施工现场。

keep sb going.en: The small amount of money she saved was just enough to keep her going until the next paycheck.
keep sb going.cn: 她攒下的这点钱仅够维持到下一次发薪日。

keep sb guessing.en: The artist's subtle use of light keeps the audience guessing about the true nature of the scene.
keep sb guessing.cn: 艺术家对光影的微妙运用，令观众难以窥见场景的真实面貌。

keep sb in.en: The doctor ordered him to keep himself in bed until his fever subsided.
keep sb in.cn: 医生命令他卧床，直到退烧为止。

keep sb on their toes.en: The coach keeps the players on their toes by introducing unpredictable tactics during practice.
keep sb on their toes.cn: 教练通过在训练中引入不可预测的战术，让球员们时刻保持警惕。

keep sb sweet.en: She kept her boss sweet by always praising his work.
keep sb sweet.cn: 她总是称赞他的工作，以此让上司对她满意。

keep sb under.en: The government kept the protesters under strict control throughout the night.
keep sb under.cn: 政府彻夜严密控制示威者。

keep sb up.en: The endless work kept me up all night, but I finally fell asleep.
keep sb up.cn: 无休止的工作让我彻夜未眠，但我终于睡着了。

keep sb waiting.en: His constant lateness keeps the entire team waiting for crucial updates.
keep sb waiting.cn: 他屡次迟到，致使整个团队不得不等待关键更新。

keep sth from sb.en: She kept the secret from her parents to avoid unnecessary worry.
keep sth from sb.cn: 她瞒着父母，以免让他们多操心。

keep sth from sth.en: The doctor kept the patient away from other visitors to prevent infection.
keep sth from sth.cn: 医生将患者与其他访客隔离，以防感染。

keep sth in proportion.en: He managed to keep his emotions in proportion despite the shocking news.
keep sth in proportion.cn: 尽管消息令人震惊，他仍设法使自己的情绪保持适度。

keep sth on.en: They decided to keep the apartment on for another year.

keep sth quiet.en: Please keep the details of the merger quiet until the official announcement.
keep sth quiet.cn: 请在官方宣布前保持此次合并的详情保密。

keep sth to yourself.en: Please keep the details of our meeting to yourself until I tell you.
keep sth to yourself.cn: 请在我告知你之前，将我们会议的详情保密。

keep sth under your hat.en: She kept the company's merger secret under her hat until the official announcement.
keep sth under your hat.cn: 她一直将公司合并的秘密藏在帽子里，直到官方宣布。

keep the flag flying.en: He kept the national flag flying high to represent his country's enduring spirit.
keep the flag flying.cn: 他让国旗高高飘扬，以象征其国家永存的意志。

keep the wolf from the door.en: We can barely keep the wolf from the door with our current meager income.
keep the wolf from the door.cn: 我们目前的微薄收入勉强能维持生计。

keep up.en: The weather has been sunny all morning, and it seems to keep up this fine condition.
keep up.cn: 今晨天气晴朗，似乎将持续这良好的状况。

keep up with sb.en: It's hard to keep up with her rapid progress in the competition.
keep up with sb.cn: 很难跟上她在比赛中突飞猛进的速度。

keep wicket.en: The bowler kept the wicket tight, preventing any runs from scoring.
keep wicket.cn: 投球手将击球区握得紧实，阻止了任何得分。

keep your eye on the ball.en: You must keep your eye on the ball to ensure we meet our project deadlines.
keep your eye on the ball.cn: 务必紧盯项目进度，确保按期交付。

keep your hair on.en: Please keep your cool; you need to calm down before making that decision.
keep your hair on.cn: 请保持冷静；在做决定前你需要平复心情。

keep your hand in.en: You should keep your hand in with coding to maintain your proficiency.
keep your hand in.cn: 应持续参与编码以保持熟练程度。

keep your head above water.en: Many small businesses are struggling to keep their heads above water amid the recent economic downturn.
keep your head above water.cn: 许多小型企业在近期经济衰退中挣扎求生。

keep your mouth shut.en: You should keep your mouth shut until the police arrive to investigate the incident.
keep your mouth shut.cn: 在警方前来调查此事前，你应闭嘴。

keep your nose clean.en: You should keep your nose clean and avoid any illegal activities.
keep your nose clean.cn: 请保持清白，避免任何非法活动。

keep your nose out of sth.en: You should keep your nose out of other people's business and let them handle their own problems.
keep your nose out of sth.cn: 你应管好自己的事，别多管闲事，让他们自己处理问题。

keep your nose to the grindstone.en: He decided to keep his nose to the grindstone for months to master the complex coding skills.
keep your nose to the grindstone.cn: 他决定埋头苦干数月，以掌握复杂的编程技能。

keep your own counsel.en: He decided to keep his own counsel and wait for the right moment to speak.
keep your own counsel.cn: 他决定保守自己的意见，等待合适的时机再发言。

keep your powder dry.en: You should keep your powder dry by preparing a backup plan for any unexpected challenges.
keep your powder dry.cn: 请为任何突发挑战制定备用计划，以保持粉状物干燥。

keep your shirt on.en: Please keep your shirt on until we resolve this conflict together.
keep your shirt on.cn: 请保持冷静，让我们共同解决这一冲突。

keep yourself busy.en: She decided to keep herself busy by taking up painting and reading.
keep yourself busy.cn: 她决定通过绘画和阅读来打发时间。

kick against sth.en: Many people try to kick against the tide of rapid technological change.
kick against sth.cn: 许多人试图逆流而上，对抗快速的技术变革。

kick off sth.en: The CEO kicked off the quarterly review with a brief overview of our recent achievements.
kick off sth.cn: 首席执行官简要概述了公司近期的成就，并启动了季度审查。

kick over the traces.en: The students finally kicked over the traces and started disrupting the class.
kick over the traces.cn: 学生们终于翻过痕迹，开始扰乱课堂。

kick sb in the teeth.en: The harsh criticism truly kicked me in the teeth, leaving me devastated by his words.
kick sb in the teeth.cn: 严厉的批评确实让我如遭重击，令我为他的话语感到极度悲痛。

kick sb upstairs.en: The promotion was merely a pretext to kick him upstairs and replace him with a more compliant subordinate.
kick sb upstairs.cn: 这次晋升不过是把他踢到高位、换上一个更听话的下级罢了。

kick sb when they're down.en: Don't kick him when he's down; offer help instead of mockery.
kick sb when they're down.cn: 他跌倒时不要踢他，而应提供帮助而非嘲笑。

kick the bucket.en: After years of illness, he finally kicked the bucket and left his family.
kick the bucket.cn: 多年患病后，他终于离世，留下了家人。

kick up your heels.en: After the exhausting meeting, we decided to kick up our heels at the beach.
kick up your heels.cn: 散会后，我们决定去海滩放松一下。

kill or cure.en: The final exam is the only chance to pass or fail the course completely.
kill or cure.cn: 期末考试是这门课唯一决定能否通过的机会。

kill two birds with one stone.en: You can kill two birds with one stone by asking about the project and your vacation in a single call.
kill two birds with one stone.cn: 在一次通话中同时询问项目进展和度假安排，可谓一举两得。

kind of.en: It's kind of difficult to finish the project before tomorrow.
kind of.cn: 要在明天之前完成这个项目相当困难。

kiss and tell.en: The celebrity's scandal was leaked by her friend, a classic case of kiss and tell.
kiss and tell.cn: 这位名人的丑闻由其朋友曝光，这是典型的‘亲口供认’案例。

kiss goodbye to sth.en: We must kiss goodby to our old habits if we want real change.
kiss goodbye to sth.cn: 若欲实现真正的变革，我们必须与旧习惯告别。

kiss sth better.en: She kissed the wound better, hoping it would stop hurting immediately.
kiss sth better.cn: 她轻吻伤口，希望疼痛能立刻止住。

kith and kin.en: The storm destroyed the kith and kin's home, leaving them homeless.
kith and kin.cn: 风暴摧毁了亲友们的家园，使他们流离失所。

knee-high to a grasshopper.en: He is knee-high to a grasshopper, barely reaching his own shoulders.
knee-high to a grasshopper.cn: 他矮得像个蚂蚱，刚够不到自己的肩膀。

knock sb dead.en: The comedian's jokes were so funny that they knocked the audience dead with laughter.
knock sb dead.cn: 这位喜剧演员的段子实在太好笑了，引得观众捧腹大笑。

knock sb sideways.en: The shocking news knocked me sideways, leaving me speechless with disbelief.
knock sb sideways.cn: 这令人震惊的消息让我猝不及防，惊得说不出话来。

knock the stuffing out of sb.en: The harsh criticism really knocked the stuffing out of his confidence.
knock the stuffing out of sb.cn: 严厉的批评确实摧毁了他的自信。

know best.en: In matters of the heart, she knows best and deserves to make the final call.
know best.cn: 在感情问题上，她最了解情况，也应由她做最终决定。

know full well.en: She knows full well that her absence will cause significant disruption to the team's progress.
know full well.cn: 她深知自己的缺席会给团队进度带来重大干扰。

know sb by sight.en: I know him by sight, having seen his face countless times at the party.
know sb by sight.cn: 我认得他，曾在聚会上无数次见过他的脸。

know sb in the biblical sense.en: They claim to know her in the biblical sense, though no one has ever seen them together.
know sb in the biblical sense.cn: 他们声称在圣经意义上认识她，尽管从未见过他们二人在一起。

know what you're talking about.en: She knows what she's talking about after surviving that disaster alone.
know what you're talking about.cn: 她独自经历过那场灾难后，深知自己所说的话。

know which side your bread is buttered.en: You must know which side your bread is buttered before making any decision.
know which side your bread is buttered.cn: 在做出任何决定之前，你必须清楚自己的立场。

know your own mind.en: She knows her own mind and refuses to compromise on her career goals.
know your own mind.cn: 她清楚自己的立场，绝不向职业目标妥协。

know your stuff.en: You clearly know your stuff when it comes to analyzing complex market trends.
know your stuff.cn: 您在分析复杂市场趋势方面确实精通行内知识。

know your way around.en: She quickly learned to know her way around the complex software system.
know your way around.cn: 她很快熟悉了这套复杂的软件系统。

larger than life.en: His larger-than-life persona captivated the audience with his exaggerated charm and theatrical flair.
larger than life.cn: 他夸张的魅力与戏剧化的风采令观众为之倾倒。

later on.en: Later on, the company will expand its operations to include new markets globally.
later on.cn: 此后，该公司将把业务扩展至全球新市场。

laugh all the way to the bank.en: He laughed all the way to the bank after winning the lottery.
laugh all the way to the bank.cn: 他中了彩票后一路笑到了银行。

laugh in sb's face.en: She laughed right in his face when he failed the exam.
laugh in sb's face.cn: 他考试不及格时，她当面大笑。

laugh your head off.en: The comedian's jokes made the audience laugh their heads off until they cried with laughter.
laugh your head off.cn: 这位喜剧演员的笑话逗得观众捧腹大笑，甚至笑出了眼泪。

law and order.en: The government insists that law and order must be maintained above all else.
law and order.cn: 政府坚持首要任务是维护法治与秩序。

lay claim to sth.en: The company laid claim to exclusive rights over the new technology.
lay claim to sth.cn: 该公司宣称对该新技术拥有独家权利。

lay down the law.en: The manager decided to lay down the law regarding the new safety protocols immediately.
lay down the law.cn: 经理当即决定就新的安全规程制定严格规定。

lay down your arms.en: The rebels finally laid down their arms after the prolonged conflict ended.
lay down your arms.cn: 叛军在内战结束后终于放下武器。

lay it on the line.en: I'll lay it on the line: this project is far more challenging than we initially imagined.
lay it on the line.cn: 直说吧：这个项目比我们最初想象的困难得多。

lay it on with a trowel.en: He laid it on with a trowel, claiming the project would solve all global problems overnight.
lay it on with a trowel.cn: 他用抹刀将其抹平，声称该项目能一夜之间解决所有全球问题。

lay sb low.en: The flu laid her down so she couldn't attend the important meeting today.
lay sb low.cn: 流感使她卧床，无法出席今天的会议。

lay sb to rest.en: The police laid the suspect to rest by releasing his confession.
lay sb to rest.cn: 警方通过让其认罪而让嫌疑人得以休整。

lay sth at sb's door.en: Critics laid the project's failure squarely at the director's door.
lay sth at sb's door.cn: 批评家们将项目的失败完全归咎于导演。

lay sth bare.en: She finally laid her deepest fears bare to the group during the therapy session.
lay sth bare.cn: 她在治疗过程中终于向众人袒露了内心最深的恐惧。

lead from the front.en: The company leader decided to lead from the front during the crisis.
lead from the front.cn: 公司高层决定在危机中身先士卒。

lead sb by the nose.en: The manager led the team by the nose, forcing them to accept every single demand without question.
lead sb by the nose.cn: 经理对团队颐指气使，迫使他们在不假思索的情况下接受每一项要求。

lead up to sth.en: The recent policy changes have led up to a significant shift in the market.
lead up to sth.cn: 近期政策调整促使市场发生重大转变。

learn your lesson.en: You must learn your lesson, or you'll face serious consequences next time.
learn your lesson.cn: 你必须吸取教训，否则下次将面临严重后果。

leave it at that.en: Let's leave it at that; the debate has gone on long enough.
leave it at that.cn: 就此打住；争论已经持续太久了。

leave it out.en: Let's leave it out; the details are too complex for this brief discussion.
leave it out.cn: 暂不讨论；细节过于复杂，不适合在此简要论述中展开。

leave no stone unturned.en: They left no stone unturned to find the missing documents before the deadline.
leave no stone unturned.cn: 他们不遗余力，在截止日期前找到了缺失的文件。

leave sb cold.en: The movie was so boring that it completely left me cold.
leave sb cold.cn: 这部电影太无聊了，让我完全无动于衷。

leave sb holding the baby.en: The manager left me holding the baby by suddenly assigning the entire project to my team.
leave sb holding the baby.cn: 经理突然将整个项目交给我的团队，让我独自承担后果。

leave sb in possession of the field.en: The team's early victory left them in a commanding position to dominate the final match.
leave sb in possession of the field.cn: 球队早期获胜使其在决赛中占据绝对优势。

leave sb in the lurch.en: He left his team in the lurch when they desperately needed support during the final match.
leave sb in the lurch.cn: 他在决赛急需支援时抛弃了队友。

leave sb to their own devices.en: We decided to leave the children to their own devices while we were away on business.
leave sb to their own devices.cn: 我们外出办事时，让孩子们自己玩。

less and less.en: The number of visitors to the museum is becoming less and less every year.
less and less.cn: 参观该博物馆的游客数量逐年减少。

let alone.en: Let alone expecting a promotion, he barely finished his current project.
let alone.cn: 别说升职了，他连手头的项目都刚做完。

let fall sth.en: He accidentally let fall the secret during their casual conversation.
let fall sth.cn: 他们在闲聊时不慎泄露了秘密。

let it all hang out.en: He finally let it all hang out after years of suppressing his anger.
let it all hang out.cn: 多年压抑怒火后，他终于彻底爆发。

let loose sth.en: The crowd let loose a deafening roar that shook the entire stadium.
let loose sth.cn: 人群爆发出一阵震耳欲聋的欢呼声，整个体育场都为之震动。

let off steam.en: He went to the gym to let off steam after his frustrating workday.
let off steam.cn: 他去健身房发泄一下疲惫的工作情绪。

let sb have it.en: The coach decided to let the player have it after his careless error during the match.
let sb have it.cn: 教练决定在球员比赛期间犯下失误后让他继续上场。

let sb know.en: Please let me know if you need any further assistance with your application.
let sb know.cn: 如有申请方面的进一步需求，请告知。

let sb off the hook.en: The judge decided to let him off the hook due to his sudden illness.
let sb off the hook.cn: 法官因其突发疾病决定对其从轻发落。

let sb out.en: The judge decided to let the innocent man out of his long imprisonment.
let sb out.cn: 法官决定让那个无辜者出狱。

let sleeping dogs lie.en: Let sleeping dogs lie, for bringing up old grievances will only make things worse.
let sleeping dogs lie.cn: 宁可不提旧事，翻出陈年旧账只会让事情更糟。

let slip sth.en: He accidentally let slip the location of the meeting during his casual conversation.
let slip sth.cn: 他在闲聊中不慎透露了会议地点。

let sth go.en: We decided to let the old garden go and focus on our new project.
let sth go.cn: 我们决定放弃旧花园，专注于新项目。

let sth into sth.en: The architect let the intricate stone carving into the wall's surface.
let sth into sth.cn: 建筑师将繁复的石雕纹饰融入墙面。

let sth off.en: The artillery finally let the mine off, causing a massive explosion that shattered the entire bridge.
let sth off.cn: 火炮最终引爆了地雷，引发剧烈爆炸，将整座桥梁彻底摧毁。

let sth ride.en: The board decided to let the scandal ride rather than launch an immediate investigation.
let sth ride.cn: 董事会决定让丑闻自行发酵，而非立即展开调查。

let the cat out of the bag.en: He accidentally let the cat out of the bag by posting that secret on social media.
let the cat out of the bag.cn: 他在社交媒体上发布该秘密时，不慎泄露了底牌。

let us say.en: Let us say the project is delayed; how will we adjust our schedule?
let us say.cn: 假设项目延期，我们将如何调整进度？

let your hair down.en: After weeks of intense work, she finally let her hair down at the beach party.
let your hair down.cn: 经过数周的高强度工作，她终于在海滩派对上放松下来。

lick your wounds.en: After the project's failure, she needed time to lick her wounds before tackling new challenges.
lick your wounds.cn: 项目失败后，她需要时间疗伤，才能迎接新的挑战。

lie back.en: He decided to lie back and enjoy the quiet afternoon sun.
lie back.cn: 他决定躺下，享受宁静的午后阳光。

lie behind sth.en: The real reason for his failure lies behind the lack of preparation.
lie behind sth.cn: 他失败的真实原因在于准备不足。

lie down.en: After the exhausting meeting, she finally decided to lie down on the sofa for a brief rest.
lie down.cn: 会议结束后，她终于决定在沙发上稍作休息。

lie low.en: The suspect decided to lie low until the police investigation concluded.
lie low.cn: 嫌疑人决定在警方调查结束前暂避风头。

lie through your teeth.en: He lied through his teeth about the accident, claiming he had no idea what happened.
lie through your teeth.cn: 他关于事故的陈述含糊其辞，声称自己完全不知情。

life after death.en: Many people believe in the existence of life after death, though scientific evidence remains scarce.
life after death.cn: 许多人相信死后生命依然存在，尽管科学证据仍十分匮乏。

life is cheap.en: He treated life as cheap, wasting his potential on trivial matters.
life is cheap.cn: 他视生命如草芥，将宝贵潜能耗费于琐事之上。

life's too short.en: Life is too short to waste time on trivial matters that don't truly matter.
life's too short.cn: 人生苦短，莫为无关紧要之事虚度光阴。

light at the end of the tunnel.en: After months of struggle, we finally see light at the end of the tunnel.
light at the end of the tunnel.cn: 经过数月的挣扎，我们终于看到了隧道尽头的光明。

like a bat out of hell.en: She sprinted like a bat out of hell to catch the departing bus.
like a bat out of hell.cn: 她如脱缰野马般狂奔追赶即将离开的公交车。

like a dose of salts.en: The news came like a dose of salts, shocking everyone instantly.
like a dose of salts.cn: 这消息来得如盐入喉，令众人瞬间震惊。

like a knife through butter.en: He solved the complex puzzle like a knife through butter, showing his exceptional skill.
like a knife through butter.cn: 他如刀切黄油般轻松解开了那道复杂的谜题，展现了非凡的技艺。

like a shot.en: He finished the marathon like a shot, crossing the finish line in record time.
like a shot.cn: 他如飞般跑完马拉松，以打破纪录的成绩冲过终点线。

like a ton of bricks.en: The new textbooks feel like a ton of bricks in my heavy backpack.
like a ton of bricks.cn: 新教科书让我沉重的背包仿佛压着千斤砖头。

like fury.en: The storm swept across the valley like fury, toppling ancient trees in its path.
like fury.cn: 狂风如怒涛般席卷山谷，将沿途的古树连根拔起。

like it's going out of fashion.en: He likes to buy the latest gadgets, like it's going out of fashion.
like it's going out of fashion.cn: 他喜欢购买最新款电子产品，仿佛它们即将过时一样。

like new.en: The car looks like new, but the engine has been running for years.
like new.cn: 这辆车看起来崭新，但发动机已运行多年。

like one possessed.en: He worked like one possessed, finishing the project before dawn.
like one possessed.cn: 他如入魔般工作，在黎明前完成了项目。

like sheep.en: They blindly followed the crowd like sheep, ignoring all critical evidence.
like sheep.cn: 他们如羊群般盲目跟随大众，无视一切关键证据。

like shit.en: The service was absolutely like shit, leaving us furious.
like shit.cn: 服务极差，令我们愤怒不已。

like the devil.en: He worked like the devil to finish the project before the deadline.
like the devil.cn: 他竭尽全力赶在截止日期前完成了项目。

like the wind.en: He sprinted across the field like the wind, leaving everyone far behind.
like the wind.cn: 他如风般疾驰穿过田野，将众人远远甩在身后。

like water.en: He drank so much water that he felt like water.
like water.cn: 他喝了很多水，感觉浑身湿漉漉的。

live a lie.en: Many politicians live a lie to protect their own image and gain public trust.
live a lie.cn: 许多政客为保护自身形象、赢得公众信任而虚与委蛇。

live and breathe sth.en: She lives and breathes her passion for sustainable architecture.
live and breathe sth.cn: 她全身心致力于可持续建筑事业。

live and let live.en: We should practice the old adage: live and let live, to foster mutual understanding.
live and let live.cn: 我们应践行古训‘与人为善’，以增进相互理解。

live by doing sth.en: Many artists choose to live by doing freelance design work rather than holding a traditional job.
live by doing sth.cn: 许多艺术家选择从事自由设计工作，而非担任传统职业。

live by your wits.en: He managed to survive the economic crash by living strictly by his wits.
live by your wits.cn: 他凭借过人的智慧，在金融危机中得以幸存。

live in.en: She chooses to live in the office to save time on her daily commute.
live in.cn: 她选择住在公司附近，以节省通勤时间。

live in sin.en: They decided to live in sin rather than commit a crime.
live in sin.cn: 他们决定苟且偷生，以免犯罪。

live in the past.en: He still lives in the past, refusing to accept any new technology or modern ideas.
live in the past.cn: 他仍沉溺于过去，拒绝接受任何新技术或新观念。

live it up.en: They decided to live it up in Paris, partying until dawn every night.
live it up.cn: 他们决定在巴黎尽情享乐，每晚狂欢至天明。

live off sth.en: Many artists try to live off their creative work and public donations.
live off sth.cn: 许多艺术家依靠创作成果和公众捐赠维持生计。

live off the fat of the land.en: They decided to live off the fat of the land by renting a luxury villa in the countryside.
live off the fat of the land.cn: 他们决定租下乡村的一座豪华别墅，靠地里的收成生活。

live off the land.en: They decided to live off the land by hunting and gathering wild berries.
live off the land.cn: 他们决定靠狩猎和采集野生浆果自给自足。

live on.en: The rare species still lives on in the remote mountain forests.
live on.cn: 这种珍稀物种仍栖息于偏远的山林之中。

live out.en: He chose to live out in the countryside instead of working in the city.
live out.cn: 他选择住在乡下，而不是在城市工作。

live through sth.en: Many survivors live through the devastating earthquake with nothing but hope.
live through sth.cn: 许多幸存者仅凭希望度过那场毁灭性地震。

live to fight another day.en: Despite the recent failure, we must live to fight another day and try again tomorrow.
live to fight another day.cn: 尽管遭遇近期失败，我们仍需坚持生存，为明日再战、重振旗鼓积蓄力量。

live up to sth.en: She worked tirelessly to live up to the high expectations her family had placed on her.
live up to sth.cn: 她不懈努力，以不辜负家人对她的高期望。

live with sth.en: Many people try to live with the constant noise from their neighbors.
live with sth.cn: 许多人试图忍受邻居持续的噪音。

lo and behold.en: Lo and behold, the unexpected visitor arrived right at our doorstep.
lo and behold.cn: 看哪，不速之客竟径直来到了我们家门口。

long in the tooth.en: The old car is long in the tooth and needs a complete overhaul.
long in the tooth.cn: 这辆老车已年岁渐长，需彻底大修。

long on sth.en: He is long on theory but short on practical experience.
long on sth.cn: 他理论丰富，但实践经验不足。

long time no see.en: It's been ages since we last met, but long time no see!
long time no see.cn: 我们上次见面已许久未见了，好久不见！

look a fright.en: He looked like a fright when he walked into the room, causing everyone to gasp in surprise.
look a fright.cn: 他走进房间时面色惨白，吓得众人惊呼。

look before you leap.en: Before making any major decision, you should always look before you leap.
look before you leap.cn: 在做出重大决定之前，务必三思而后行。

look daggers at sb.en: She looked daggers at him when he lied about the meeting time.
look daggers at sb.cn: 他谎报会议时间时，她瞪了他一眼。

look for sth.en: We are all looking forward to the day when we can finally return home.
look for sth.cn: 我们都盼望着终于能回家的那一天。

look for trouble.en: He always looks for trouble, so he never has a quiet moment.
look for trouble.cn: 他总爱惹事，因此从未有过片刻安宁。

look forward to sth.en: I look forward to hearing from you soon regarding the project.
look forward to sth.cn: 期待您就该项目早日回复。

look good.en: The project is looking good, with all stakeholders optimistic about its successful completion.
look good.cn: 该项目进展良好，所有利益相关方对其顺利完工充满信心。

look here.en: Look here! I'm trying to explain this complex issue without getting sidetracked.
look here.cn: 看这里！我正在尝试在不偏离主题的情况下解释这个复杂问题。

look into sth.en: The committee decided to look into the matter thoroughly before making any recommendations.
look into sth.cn: 委员会决定在提出任何建议前彻底调查此事。

look on.en: He chose to look on quietly while the argument escalated into chaos.
look on.cn: 他选择在一旁静观，任由争吵演变为混乱。

look on the bright side.en: Instead of dwelling on the setbacks, try to look on the bright side and find hope.
look on the bright side.cn: 与其沉溺于挫折，不如换个角度寻找希望。

look out.en: Look out for the car coming around the bend!
look out.cn: 注意弯道处驶来的车辆！

look out for sb.en: You should look out for your elderly parents and ensure they receive proper care.
look out for sb.cn: 应照看年迈父母，确保他们得到妥善照料。

look sharp.en: You should look sharp and finish this report by tomorrow morning.
look sharp.cn: 你应精神饱满，并于明晨前完成这份报告。

look the other way.en: He chose to look the other way when his colleague made a serious mistake.
look the other way.cn: 当同事犯下严重错误时，他选择视而不见。

look to your laurels.en: He looked to his laurels, unwilling to risk losing the advantage he had just earned.
look to your laurels.cn: 他望着自己的战利品，不愿冒失去刚刚赢得的优势的风险。

look up to sb.en: She always looks up to her mentor for his wisdom and guidance.
look up to sb.cn: 她始终仰慕导师的智慧与指导。

look your age.en: She looks her age, which is impressive given her youth.
look your age.cn: 她看起来与她的年龄相符，考虑到她的年轻，这令人印象深刻。

loom large.en: The looming threat of climate change looms large over our future.
loom large.cn: 气候变化的威胁笼罩着我们未来。

loosen sb's tongue.en: The judge decided to loosen the suspect's tongue by allowing him to speak freely.
loosen sb's tongue.cn: 法官决定通过允许嫌疑人自由发言来让他开口说话。

loosen up.en: She finally loosened up and stopped worrying about the upcoming exam.
loosen up.cn: 她终于放松下来，不再为即将到来的考试担忧。

lose face.en: He felt he had lost face when his proposal was rejected by the board.
lose face.cn: 他的提议被董事会驳回后，感到丢脸。

lose heart.en: The team didn't lose heart despite the early defeat and kept fighting until victory.
lose heart.cn: 尽管早期失利，该队并未气馁，坚持战斗直至获胜。

lose it.en: The crowd finally lost it when the band played that unexpected song.
lose it.cn: 人群终于爆发时，乐队演奏了那首意想不到的歌曲。

lose your bearings.en: After the sudden storm, I completely lost my bearings and didn't know where we were.
lose your bearings.cn: 暴风雨过后，我完全迷失了方向，不知身在何处。

lose your head.en: When the crisis hit, he lost his head and made a terrible decision.
lose your head.cn: 危机爆发时，他头脑发昏，做出了可怕的决定。

lose your mind.en: The constant noise finally made her lose her mind, causing her to scream at the ceiling.
lose your mind.cn: 持续的噪音终于让她精神崩溃，对着天花板尖叫起来。

lose yourself in sth.en: He lost himself completely in the intricate details of the complex puzzle.
lose yourself in sth.cn: 他完全沉浸在复杂谜题的错综细节中。

loud and clear.en: The instructions were loud and clear, so I followed them without any confusion.
loud and clear.cn: 指示清晰明确，我毫无困惑地照做了。

louder than sth.en: The crowd shouted louder than the band could play.
louder than sth.cn: 人群喊叫的声音比乐队演奏的还要响。

love is blind.en: Love is blind, so he overlooked her glaring flaws and fell completely for her.
love is blind.cn: 爱使人盲目，因此他忽略了她的明显缺点而完全动心。

made of money.en: He is so made of money that he can afford a private island.
made of money.cn: 他富甲一方，足以买下一座私人岛屿。

make a bolt for it.en: The thief made a bolt for it the moment he saw the security guard.
make a bolt for it.cn: 小偷一见保安便夺路而逃。

make a clean breast of sth.en: He finally made a clean breast of his financial misdeeds to the board.
make a clean breast of sth.cn: 他终于向董事会坦白了自己的财务不当行为。

make a day of it.en: Instead of rushing home, we decided to make a day of it and explore the city together.
make a day of it.cn: 我们决定不赶回家，而是把这一天当作一次特别的旅程，一起探索这座城市。

make a drama out of sth.en: Don't make a drama out of such a minor incident.
make a drama out of sth.cn: 别把这么小的事情搞得像戏剧一样。

make a fool of sb.en: They tried to make a fool of him during the entire game.
make a fool of sb.cn: 整场比赛他们试图让他出丑。

make a fool of yourself.en: Don't make a fool of yourself by sharing such private details online.
make a fool of yourself.cn: 切勿在网上分享此类私密细节而让自己出丑。

make a hash of sth.en: The team made a hash of the presentation due to poor preparation.
make a hash of sth.cn: 因准备不足，该团队对演示进行了批判。

make a hole in sth.en: The new software development project is making a huge hole in our company's budget.
make a hole in sth.cn: 新软件开发项目使公司预算出现巨大缺口。

make a horlicks of sth.en: He made a mess of the presentation by forgetting all his notes.
make a horlicks of sth.cn: 他因忘记所有讲稿而把演示搞得一团糟。

make a joke of sth.en: He made a joke of her serious illness to lighten the tense atmosphere.
make a joke of sth.cn: 他拿她的重病开玩笑，以缓解紧张的气氛。

make a killing.en: The new tech startup is making a killing by dominating the global market.
make a killing.cn: 这家新兴科技公司凭借在全球市场的统治地位大发利市。

make a meal of sth.en: He made a huge fuss over the minor mistake, turning it into a full-blown crisis.
make a meal of sth.cn: 他对那个小错误大张旗鼓，将其演变成了一场全面危机。

make a mockery of sth.en: The comedian made the serious situation look ridiculous, turning it into pure mockery.
make a mockery of sth.cn: 这位喜剧演员让严肃的局面显得荒谬可笑，将其变成了纯粹的嘲讽。

make a pitch to sb.en: He made a pitch to the investors, promising them huge returns.
make a pitch to sb.cn: 他向投资者推销项目，承诺给予巨额回报。

make a point of doing sth.en: She made it a point to visit her grandmother every Sunday without fail.
make a point of doing sth.cn: 她坚持每逢周日都要去探望祖母，从未间断。

make a rod for your own back.en: He made a rod for his own back by ignoring the warning signs.
make a rod for your own back.cn: 他无视警告信号，却为自己招致祸患。

make a spectacle of yourself.en: Don't make a spectacle of yourself by arguing with the manager in public.
make a spectacle of yourself.cn: 不要在公共场合与经理争辩，以免让你自己成为笑柄。

make an example of sb.en: They made him an example of others to deter future offenders.
make an example of sb.cn: 他们将他作为反面教材，以警示未来的违法者。

make an exception.en: I usually don't accept late submissions, but I'll make an exception for you today.
make an exception.cn: 我通常不接受迟交，但今天对你破例。

make an exhibition of yourself.en: Don't make an exhibition of yourself by answering that question so loudly in front of everyone.
make an exhibition of yourself.cn: 不要在众人面前大声回答这个问题，以免招摇过市。

make an honest woman of sb.en: He finally made an honest woman of her by marrying the man she had slept with.
make an honest woman of sb.cn: 他娶了那个他曾与之同床共枕的女子，最终让她成了老实人。

make as if to do sth.en: He made as if he knew nothing about the secret plan.
make as if to do sth.cn: 他装作对那个秘密计划一无所知。

make common cause with sb.en: The two rivals decided to make common cause with each other to secure the championship.
make common cause with sb.cn: 这两名对手决定联手争夺冠军。

make good.en: After years of hard work, he finally made good in the tech industry.
make good.cn: 经过多年的努力，他终于在科技界取得了成功。

make hard work of sth.en: Don't make this simple task a hard work by overthinking every detail.
make hard work of sth.cn: 切勿因过度纠结细节而使这项简单任务变得劳心费力。

make hay while the sun shines.en: We should seize this opportunity to launch our project before competitors catch up.
make hay while the sun shines.cn: 我们应把握此次机会，在竞争对手赶上来之前启动项目。

make headway.en: The team finally made headway in resolving the complex dispute after months of negotiation.
make headway.cn: 经过数月谈判，该团队最终在解决复杂纠纷上取得进展。

make heavy weather of sth.en: Don't make heavy weather of a simple task; it's just routine work.
make heavy weather of sth.cn: 不要把简单的事情搞得复杂；这不过是日常琐事罢了。

make it snappy.en: We need to make it snappy before the deadline arrives tomorrow.
make it snappy.cn: 我们必须在明天截止前将其处理得迅速利落。

make merry.en: The family gathered to make merry with a grand feast and lively music.
make merry.cn: 全家欢聚一堂，享用丰盛的宴席和欢快的音乐。

make mincemeat of sb.en: The team managed to make mincemeat of their rivals in the final match.
make mincemeat of sb.cn: 该队在决赛中彻底击溃了对手。

make mischief.en: The children were caught making mischief by hiding the teacher's glasses in the closet.
make mischief.cn: 孩子们因把老师的眼镜藏进衣柜而被抓住捣乱。

make money.en: The startup aims to make money quickly by targeting young consumers with affordable gadgets.
make money.cn: 该公司旨在通过向年轻消费者提供廉价电子产品来快速盈利。

make no claim.en: He made no claim to being a leader, simply stating he was just an ordinary worker.
make no claim.cn: 他并未声称自己是领导者，只是说自己只是个普通工人。

make off.en: They made off quickly when the police arrived at their doorstep.
make off.cn: 警察一到门口，他们就迅速溜走了。

make off with sth.en: The thieves managed to make off with the jewelry before the police arrived.
make off with sth.cn: 小偷在警察到达前便溜走了。

make or break sth.en: The final exam will make or break his chances of getting into the top university.
make or break sth.cn: 期末考试将决定他能否进入顶尖大学。

make sb out.en: It took her a while to make sense of the complex situation.
make sb out.cn: 她花了些时间才弄懂这复杂的局面。

make sb sick.en: The constant noise from the construction site made everyone in the office feel sick and unable to concentrate.
make sb sick.cn: 施工现场的持续噪音让办公室里的每个人都感到恶心，无法集中注意力。

make sb's blood boil.en: The politician's lies made the journalist's blood boil with rage.
make sb's blood boil.cn: 政客们的谎言令记者怒火中烧。

make sb's blood run cold.en: The gruesome tale made her blood run cold, freezing her very soul.
make sb's blood run cold.cn: 这骇人听闻的故事令她血液冻结，连灵魂都为之冰冷。

make sb's day.en: The unexpected gift truly made her day, filling the room with laughter and joy.
make sb's day.cn: 这份意外的礼物让她的一天变得格外美好，房间里充满了欢声笑语。

make sb's hair stand on end.en: The sudden scream made my hair stand on end with pure terror.
make sb's hair stand on end.cn: 那突如其来的尖叫声令我毛骨悚然，恐惧至极。

make sb's life a misery.en: His constant complaining truly makes my life a misery.
make sb's life a misery.cn: 他不停地抱怨，真让我的生活苦不堪言。

make sb's toes curl.en: His awkward silence made her toes curl with embarrassment.
make sb's toes curl.cn: 他尴尬的沉默让她脚趾都蜷缩起来。

make sense of sth.en: It took me weeks to make sense of the complex legal documents.
make sense of sth.cn: 我花了数周时间才弄懂这些复杂的法律文件。

make something of yourself.en: She worked tirelessly to make something of herself in the competitive tech industry.
make something of yourself.cn: 她在竞争激烈的科技行业中不遗余力地谋求发展。

make the acquaintance of sb.en: I would like to make the acquaintance of your colleague during our visit.
make the acquaintance of sb.cn: 我们来访期间，希望能与您同事认识一下。

make the grade.en: She finally made the grade by acing her final exam.
make the grade.cn: 她最终凭借期末考满分而及格。

make towards sth.en: The hikers made towards the summit as dawn broke over the misty peaks.
make towards sth.cn: 随着破晓时分雾气笼罩的山峰逐渐显露，徒步者们向山顶进发。

make tracks.en: After the party, they decided to make tracks and head home before dawn.
make tracks.cn: 聚会结束后，他们决定赶在天亮前回家。

make up for lost time.en: We must work overtime to make up for the time we wasted last week.
make up for lost time.cn: 我们必须加班以弥补上周浪费的时间。

make up for sth.en: We must make up for the lost time by working harder tomorrow.
make up for sth.cn: 我们必须通过明天加倍努力来弥补失去的时间。

make waves.en: He made waves by publicly criticizing the company's new policy.
make waves.cn: 他公开批评公司新政策，引起轩然大波。

make whoopee.en: The whole team made whoopee to celebrate their unexpected victory in the final match.
make whoopee.cn: 全队欢呼庆祝他们在决赛中意外获胜。

make your blood freeze.en: The ghost story made my blood freeze, causing me to tremble uncontrollably in the dark room.
make your blood freeze.cn: 那个鬼故事让我血液冻结，在黑暗的房间中不由自主地颤抖。

make your flesh creep.en: The chilling story made my flesh creep with genuine horror.
make your flesh creep.cn: 这骇人的故事令我毛骨悚然，心生真切的恐惧。

make your mind up.en: You should make your mind up soon so we can finalize the project plan.
make your mind up.cn: 请尽快下定决心，以便我们最终确定项目计划。

make your presence felt.en: She made her presence felt by addressing the entire room with a powerful speech.
make your presence felt.cn: 她通过发表一场有力的演讲，让在场众人感受到她的存在。

make your skin crawl.en: The horror movie made my skin crawl with its terrifying special effects.
make your skin crawl.cn: 这部恐怖电影因其令人毛骨悚然的特效而让人不寒而栗。

make your voice heard.en: It is crucial that we make our voices heard to address the urgent environmental crisis.
make your voice heard.cn: 我们必须发出声音，以应对紧迫的环境危机。

make yourself known to sb.en: You should make yourself known to the new team members during the first meeting.
make yourself known to sb.cn: 初次见面时，你应该向新团队成员介绍自己。

make yourself scarce.en: He decided to make himself scarce after the awkward argument with his boss.
make yourself scarce.cn: 他与老板发生不愉快的争吵后，决定躲起来。

make yourself understood.en: You must speak slowly and clearly to make yourself understood by the foreign audience.
make yourself understood.cn: 您必须用缓慢而清晰的语速说话，以便让外国听众听懂。

man and boy.en: From the moment he was a man until his death, he remained an inseparable companion to his son.
man and boy.cn: 自他成年直至离世，始终与子相伴不离。

man to man.en: We need to have a frank, man-to-man discussion about the budget.
man to man.cn: 我们需要就预算进行坦诚的一对一讨论。

man's best friend.en: Often called man's best friend, dogs provide loyal companionship and unconditional love to their owners.
man's best friend.cn: 狗常被称为人类最好的朋友，它们为主人提供忠诚的陪伴和无条件的爱。

many hands make light work.en: Many hands make light work, so the team finished the project quickly together.
many hands make light work.cn: 众人拾柴火焰高，因此团队很快便完成了项目。

many moons ago.en: It was many moons ago when we first met under the silver moonlight.
many moons ago.cn: 那是许多个夜晚之前，我们在银色的月光下初次相遇。

march on.en: The protesters decided to march on the city hall to demand immediate action.
march on.cn: 抗议者决定前往市政厅游行，要求立即采取行动。

mark you.en: Mark you, the deadline is non-negotiable regardless of your excuses.
mark you.cn: 记住，无论你有什么理由，截止日期都是不可更改的。

marry into sth.en: She married into a wealthy family and gained access to their social circle.
marry into sth.cn: 她嫁入豪门，得以进入其社交圈。

marry money.en: She decided to marry money rather than a man who truly loved her.
marry money.cn: 她决定嫁给钱，而不是一个真正爱她的男人。

me and my big mouth.en: I shouldn't have said that; it was me and my big mouth.
me and my big mouth.cn: 我不该说那些话；是我那张大嘴惹的祸。

mean business.en: He finally meant business when he threatened to quit the project.
mean business.cn: 他威胁要退出该项目时，终于动真格了。

mean to say.en: What do you mean to say when you look at me like that?
mean to say.cn: 你这样看着我时，想表达什么？

mean well.en: He meant well, but his advice was so blunt that it hurt my feelings.
mean well.cn: 他本意是好的，但建议过于直率，伤了我的感情。

meat and drink to sb.en: The concert was the real meat and drink for him, filling his soul with pure joy.
meat and drink to sb.cn: 这场音乐会是他真正的精神食粮，让他内心充满纯粹的喜悦。

meet sb halfway.en: We should meet our clients halfway to ensure a mutually beneficial agreement.
meet sb halfway.cn: 我们应折中考虑客户需求，以确保达成互利协议。

meet sth with sth.en: The government met the rising costs with a series of tax cuts.
meet sth with sth.cn: 政府通过一系列减税措施应对了不断上升的成本。

melt into sth.en: The crowd slowly melted into the sea of people at the concert.
melt into sth.cn: 人群缓缓融入演唱会的人海。

mend your ways.en: He finally decided to mend his ways and return to a life of honesty.
mend your ways.cn: 他终于决定改过自新，回归诚实的生活。

miles from anywhere.en: The remote village is miles from anywhere, making it hard to reach.
miles from anywhere.cn: 这个偏远村庄距任何地方都有数英里之遥，难以到达。

mind over matter.en: She refused to let her fear of failure dictate her decision, choosing instead to act with determination.
mind over matter.cn: 她拒绝让对失败的恐惧左右决定，而是选择坚定地行动。

miss the boat.en: You should have acted sooner to avoid missing the boat on this opportunity.
miss the boat.cn: 你本应早些行动，以免错失这次机会。

mission accomplished.en: The team finally secured the contract, making their mission accomplished.
mission accomplished.cn: 团队最终赢得了合同，使命圆满完成。

mix and match.en: You can mix and match these components to create a unique design that perfectly suits your needs.
mix and match.cn: 您可灵活组合这些组件，打造完美契合您需求的独特设计。

mix sth into sth.en: She mixed the spices into the sauce to enhance its flavor.
mix sth into sth.cn: 她往酱汁中掺入香料以增味。

money is no object.en: We can afford the latest model because money is no object for us.
money is no object.cn: 我们负担得起最新款，因为对我们来说金钱不是问题。

money talks.en: In this city, money talks louder than any other form of power or influence.
money talks.cn: 在这座城市里，金钱的影响力胜过任何其他形式的权力或权威。

more and more.en: More and more people are choosing remote work to improve their work-life balance.
more and more.cn: 越来越多的人选择远程工作以改善工作与生活的平衡。

more power to sb's elbow.en: More power to you; I truly believe in your ability to achieve this goal.
more power to sb's elbow.cn: 加油；我坚信你一定能实现这一目标。

more precisely.en: More precisely, the study focused exclusively on urban populations rather than rural areas.
more precisely.cn: 更准确地说，本研究仅关注城市人口，而未涉及农村地区。

more to the point.en: It is more to the point that we address this issue immediately.
more to the point.cn: 更切题的是我们立即解决这一问题。

move heaven and earth.en: He moved heaven and earth to secure the funding for his ambitious research project.
move heaven and earth.cn: 他不遗余力地筹措资金，以支持其雄心勃勃的研究项目。

move in sth.en: She decided to move in the tech industry after years of observing it from afar.
move in sth.cn: 她在多年旁观科技行业后，决定投身其中。

move in with sb.en: After saving enough, they decided to move in with their parents to save on rent.
move in with sb.cn: 积蓄充足后，他们决定搬去父母家以节省房租。

move out.en: After the renovation, we decided to move out and find a new apartment.
move out.cn: 装修完成后，我们决定搬离并寻找新公寓。

move with the times.en: The company must move with the times to survive in today's competitive market.
move with the times.cn: 公司必须与时俱进，才能在当今竞争激烈的市场中生存。

move your ass.en: Stop moving so slowly and get your ass out of that chair immediately.
move your ass.cn: 别动得那么慢，立刻从椅子上起来。

movers and shakers.en: The movers and shakers of the industry are planning a major merger.
movers and shakers.cn: 该行业的领军企业正计划进行重大合并。

much of a muchness.en: The two proposals are so similar that they are much of a muchness.
much of a muchness.cn: 这两个提议如此相似，可谓大同小异。

mud sticks.en: Once you get involved in such mud-sticking scandals, it's impossible to wash the stain off your reputation.
mud sticks.cn: 一旦卷入此类丑闻，便无法洗清声誉上的污点。

music to your ears.en: The news of her promotion was absolutely music to my ears.
music to your ears.cn: 她升职的消息简直如天籁之音。

mutton dressed as lamb.en: She looks like mutton dressed as lamb, surprisingly youthful for her age.
mutton dressed as lamb.cn: 她看起来像披着羊皮的绵羊，年纪虽大却显得出奇地年轻。

my hat.en: My hat! I never thought you'd be the one to solve this puzzle.
my hat.cn: 我的帽子！我从未想过竟是你解开了这个谜题。

my lips are sealed.en: My lips are sealed; I will never reveal the secret to anyone.
my lips are sealed.cn: 我守口如瓶，绝不会对任何人透露这个秘密。

my pleasure.en: It was my pleasure to assist you with your research project.
my pleasure.cn: 协助您的研究项目是我的荣幸。

my way or the highway.en: You can either follow my lead or leave this situation entirely.
my way or the highway.cn: 你可以跟随我的行动，或者彻底离开这个局面。

neck of the woods.en: The old oak tree stands proudly at the very neck of the woods.
neck of the woods.cn: 那棵古老的橡树傲然挺立于林缘尽头。

needless to say.en: Needless to say, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
needless to say.cn: 不言而喻，该项目已提前完成。

neither here nor there.en: It doesn't matter if you are late, as neither here nor there.

never darken my door again.en: I hope you never darken my door again, as your behavior has been unacceptable.
never darken my door again.cn: 希望你再也不要踏进我的家门，因为你的行为已无法接受。

never say die.en: Never say die, for every setback is merely a stepping stone to your ultimate success.
never say die.cn: 永不言败，因为每一次挫折都是通往最终成功的基石。

never tire of doing sth.en: She never tires of explaining complex concepts to her students every single day.
never tire of doing sth.cn: 她每天不厌其烦地向学生解释复杂的概念。

nice work if you can get it.en: It's a nice job if you can actually get it.
nice work if you can get it.cn: 如果能做到，那真是件好事。

night night.en: Goodnight, sweetie; I'll see you again tomorrow.

nine times out of ten.en: Nine times out of ten, the team will secure victory in this crucial match.
nine times out of ten.cn: 十次中有九次，该队将在这场关键比赛中获胜。

nine to five.en: The job demands nine-to-five hours, leaving little time for personal life.
nine to five.cn: 该工作需朝九晚五上班，几乎无暇顾及个人生活。

nip sth in the bud.en: We must nip the conflict in the bud before it escalates into a full-scale war.
nip sth in the bud.cn: 我们必须将冲突扼杀在萌芽状态，防止其演变为全面战争。

no amount of sth.en: No amount of money can buy back the time we've lost together.
no amount of sth.cn: 再多的钱也无法买回我们共同失去的时光。

no big deal.en: Don't worry about it; it's absolutely no big deal.
no big deal.cn: 别担心；这根本不算什么大事。

no can do.en: The task is simply impossible for me; I truly say no can do.
no can do.cn: 这项任务对我来说简直不可能；我确实无法做到。

no chance.en: There is absolutely no chance we will finish the project by Friday.
no chance.cn: 周五前绝无可能完成该项目。

no dice.en: I'd love to help you out, but unfortunately, I have no dice.
no dice.cn: 我很乐意帮您，但很遗憾，我无能为力。

no end.en: It is absolutely no end of a challenge to complete this project on such tight deadlines.
no end.cn: 在如此紧迫的期限内完成该项目，挑战之大难以想象。

no end of sth.en: There is no end of problems that need solving right now.
no end of sth.cn: 眼下亟待解决的问题不胜枚举。

no fear.en: I have no fear of facing the consequences of my own actions.
no fear.cn: 我毫不畏惧承担自己行为的后果。

no go.en: The proposed merger is no go due to the board's strict compliance requirements.
no go.cn: 该合并计划因董事会严格的合规要求而取消。

no hard feelings.en: Let's not let this disagreement create any hard feelings between us.
no hard feelings.cn: 别让这种分歧在我们之间产生隔阂。

no harm done.en: Don't worry, no harm done; we'll fix it before anyone notices.
no harm done.cn: 别担心，没造成损害；我们会在任何人注意到之前修好。

no less.en: No less impressive was his ability to solve such a complex problem under pressure.
no less.cn: 他在压力下解决如此复杂问题的能力同样令人印象深刻。

no matter.en: No matter how difficult the task is, we will finish it together.
no matter.cn: 无论任务多么艰巨，我们都能共同完成。

no messing.en: It was no messing; she solved the complex puzzle in minutes.
no messing.cn: 毫不含糊；她几分钟就解开了那道复杂的谜题。

no news is good news.en: The silence from the hospital confirms that no news is good news.
no news is good news.cn: 医院的沉默证实了‘无消息即为好消息’。

no offence.en: I'm sorry to say that, but no offence is intended.
no offence.cn: 抱歉这么说，但并无冒犯之意。

no probs.en: No problems, I'll handle the situation immediately.

no room to swing a cat.en: There is no room to swing a cat in this cramped office space.
no room to swing a cat.cn: 这间拥挤的办公室里连挥动猫爪的地方都没有。

no sooner said than done.en: He no sooner said it than immediately started working on the project.
no sooner said than done.cn: 他话音未落，便立即着手处理该项目。

no such luck.en: Unfortunately, no such luck; the meeting was rescheduled to tomorrow.
no such luck.cn: 很遗憾，没有这样的运气；会议改期至明天。

no sweat.en: Don't worry about it; I'll handle the rest with no sweat.
no sweat.cn: 别担心，剩下的我来处理，毫无压力。

no you don't.en: No, you won't get away with that deceitful behavior.
no you don't.cn: 不，你无法用这种欺骗行为脱身。

none but.en: None but the brave would dare to climb that treacherous peak.

none other than.en: None other than the former president himself came to support us.
none other than.cn: 正是前总统本人前来支持我们。

none too pleased.en: The team was none too pleased with the unexpected delay in their match.
none too pleased.cn: 球队对比赛的不期而遇的延误感到十分不满。

not a dry eye in the house.en: Not a dry eye was in the house as they heard the tragic news.
not a dry eye in the house.cn: 家家泪如雨下，听闻这噩耗。

not a penny.en: He insisted on paying nothing, claiming he had not a penny to his name.
not a penny.cn: 他坚持分文不付，声称身无分文。

not a sausage.en: There is not a sausage in the fridge, so we can't have dinner tonight.
not a sausage.cn: 冰箱里没有香肠，所以今晚没法吃晚饭。

not all there.en: He isn't all there; his constant confusion suggests he might be slightly off.
not all there.cn: 他神志不清；持续的混乱表明他可能有些不对劲。

not anything like.en: It is not anything like the quality you were expecting.
not anything like.cn: 质量与您预期的相去甚远。

not arranged correctly or neatly.en: The files were not arranged correctly, making it hard to find specific documents quickly.
not arranged correctly or neatly.cn: 文件未正确排序，难以快速查找特定文档。

not at all.en: Not at all! It was a pleasure helping you with your project.
not at all.cn: 不客气！能协助您完成项目是我的荣幸。

not at any price.en: She refused to sell her house not at any price, no matter how much the buyer offered.
not at any price.cn: 她无论买家出价多少都拒绝出售房屋。

not bad.en: The new restaurant is not bad, offering surprisingly delicious food.
not bad.cn: 这家新餐厅不错，食物出乎意料地美味。

not be born yesterday.en: I'm not born yesterday; I know exactly what you're trying to trick me into.
not be born yesterday.cn: 我并非生来愚钝；我清楚你正试图将我引向何处。

not be getting any younger.en: It's not that I don't want to, but I'm simply not getting any younger.
not be getting any younger.cn: 并非我不想，只是我确实不再年轻了。

not be in the business of doing sth.en: We are not in the business of making decisions based on incomplete data.
not be in the business of doing sth.cn: 我们不做基于不完整数据做决策的事。

not be supposed to do sth.en: You are not supposed to enter the restricted area without a permit.
not be supposed to do sth.cn: 未经许可不得进入限制区域。

not be wearing a stitch.en: He was not wearing a stitch, standing completely naked in the freezing wind.
not be wearing a stitch.cn: 他浑身未着片缕，赤裸地站在刺骨的寒风中。

not come to anything.en: The elaborate plan they spent weeks on ultimately did not come to anything.
not come to anything.cn: 他们耗费数周精心策划的方案最终毫无结果。

not come to much.en: The whole project didn't come to much, so we decided to scrap it.
not come to much.cn: 该项目进展甚微，我们决定取消。

not cricket.en: It's not cricket for the team to win by cheating during the match.
not cricket.cn: 比赛期间作弊获胜，这对球队来说是不光彩的。

not do a hand's turn.en: He has been doing nothing but sitting in his room all day.
not do a hand's turn.cn: 他整天除了待在房间里什么也没做。

not feel yourself.en: I don't feel myself today; my head is pounding and I can barely focus on work.
not feel yourself.cn: 我今天状态不佳，头痛难忍，几乎无法集中精力工作。

not feeling or showing any emotion.en: He remained completely unmoved, not feeling or showing any emotion despite the tragedy.
not feeling or showing any emotion.cn: 他完全不动声色，面对悲剧毫无情绪波动。

not feeling well.en: I'm not feeling well and I need to take some medicine immediately.
not feeling well.cn: 我身体不舒服，需要立刻服药。

not for anything.en: It is not for anything, so do not bother trying to convince me.
not for anything.cn: 这毫无意义，所以不必费心说服我。

not for nothing.en: He didn't leave the team not for nothing, given his repeated misconduct.
not for nothing.cn: 鉴于他屡次违规，他并非无故离开球队。

not go any further.en: Let's not go any further with this discussion until we have all the facts.
not go any further.cn: 在掌握全部事实之前，我们暂不就此讨论深入。

not have a dog's chance.en: You don't even have a dog's chance of winning that competition.
not have a dog's chance.cn: 你在那项比赛中连狗都不如。

not have all day.en: We don't have all day to finish this project, so we must work faster.
not have all day.cn: 我们没时间一天内完成这个项目，必须加快进度。

not having any.en: She refused to admit she was not having any idea what he meant.
not having any.cn: 她拒绝承认自己完全不明白他的意思。

not having enough time to do sth.en: She rushed out without having enough time to pack her bags properly.
not having enough time to do sth.cn: 她匆忙出门，来不及好好收拾行李。

not hear of sth.en: I can't hear of you accepting such a low salary for this job.
not hear of sth.cn: 我无法相信你会接受这么低的薪水做这份工作。

not hold water.en: His excuse for missing the meeting simply does not hold water.
not hold water.cn: 他缺席会议的借口经不起推敲。

not in prison.en: He was released early, so he is not in prison anymore.
not in prison.cn: 他获提前释放，因此已不在狱中。

not in the least.en: I am not in the least interested in attending that boring meeting today.
not in the least.cn: 我对今天参加那场无聊的会议毫无兴趣。

not in the slightest.en: I am not in the slightest bit interested in attending that boring meeting.
not in the slightest.cn: 我对参加那场无聊的会议毫无兴趣。

not inconsiderable.en: The cost of living is not inconsiderable, making it hard for many families to save money.
not inconsiderable.cn: 生活成本不菲，令许多家庭难以存钱。

not just yet.en: It's not just yet, but the situation might improve very soon.
not just yet.cn: 尚未明朗，但局势可能很快好转。

not know any better.en: He didn't know any better when he insulted her, but his rudeness was unacceptable.
not know any better.cn: 他当时并不知好歹地侮辱了她，但他的粗鲁行为是不可接受的。

not know what hit you.en: I didn't expect him to win so easily; I still don't know what hit me.
not know what hit you.cn: 我没想到他会这么轻易地获胜；我至今仍不知何故。

not know where to look.en: He was so embarrassed he didn't know where to look.
not know where to look.cn: 他尴尬得不知往哪里看。

not know whether you're coming or going.en: I'm not sure if I should come or go right now.
not know whether you're coming or going.cn: 我不确定现在是否应该去还是留下。

not leave sb's side.en: She decided not to leave her elderly father's side, caring for him daily.
not leave sb's side.cn: 她决定不离年迈的父亲左右，每日悉心照料他。

not let the grass grow under your feet.en: You must not let the grass grow under your feet by working efficiently today.
not let the grass grow under your feet.cn: 今日高效工作，切勿让杂草丛生。

not look good.en: It would not look good if he arrived late without an apology.
not look good.cn: 如果他迟到却不道歉，那会显得很不体面。

not much in it.en: The new model isn't much in it compared to the previous version.
not much in it.cn: 与上一版本相比，新模型表现平平。

not much to look at.en: He's not much to look at, but he has a brilliant mind.
not much to look at.cn: 他相貌平平，但头脑非常聪明。

not nearly.en: The results are not nearly as impressive as we had hoped.
not nearly.cn: 结果并不如我们所期望的那样令人印象深刻。

not necessarily.en: Just because he failed once doesn't mean he will fail again.
not necessarily.cn: 一次失败并不意味着下次也会失败。

not on your life.en: I absolutely will not do that, not on your life.
not on your life.cn: 我绝对不做那件事，听清楚了。

not put your finger on sth.en: It's frustrating that I can't quite put my finger on what exactly is wrong with the system.
not put your finger on sth.cn: 很难受的是，我说不清系统具体出了什么问题。

not sb's cup of tea.en: This complex architectural style is simply not my cup of tea.
not sb's cup of tea.cn: 这种复杂的建筑风格完全不是我的菜。

not sb's scene.en: That chaotic party is definitely not my scene, so I prefer quiet evenings at home.
not sb's scene.cn: 那混乱的派对完全不合我意，所以我更喜欢在家享受宁静的夜晚。

not six whit.en: He claimed he knew nothing about it, not six whit.
not six whit.cn: 他声称对此一无所知，分文不晓。

not sleep a wink.en: He was so exhausted that he could not sleep a wink all night long.
not sleep a wink.cn: 他累得整夜都无法合眼。

not suffer fools gladly.en: He never suffers fools gladly, often pointing out their errors immediately.
not suffer fools gladly.cn: 他从不轻易饶恕愚者，常立即指出他们的错误。

not suitable for a particular situation.en: This formal attire is not suitable for a particular situation like a casual beach party.
not suitable for a particular situation.cn: 这种正装不适合海滩派对等特定场合。

not take no for an answer.en: He refused to accept the apology and demanded a full explanation instead.
not take no for an answer.cn: 他拒绝接受道歉，反而要求给予全面解释。

not that.en: Not that I'm complaining, but the schedule is quite tight for us.
not that.cn: 并非抱怨，只是我们的日程确实很紧凑。

not the end of the world.en: Don't panic, it's not the end of the world; we'll solve it together.
not the end of the world.cn: 别慌，这并非世界末日；我们会一起解决的。

not the sharpest tool in the box.en: He is not the sharpest tool in the box, but his kindness makes him invaluable to our team.
not the sharpest tool in the box.cn: 他并非最聪明的人，但他的善良使他对我们的团队至关重要。

not to be sneezed at.en: This issue is not to be sneezed at, as it could severely impact our future.
not to be sneezed at.cn: 此问题不容忽视，因其可能严重影响我们的未来。

not to be sniffed at.en: This proposal is not to be sniffed at; it demands serious consideration from everyone.
