not to be sniffed at.cn: 此提议不容轻视，需引起大家严肃重视。

not to mention.en: Not to mention the heavy traffic, we missed our flight.
not to mention.cn: 不说交通拥堵，我们错过了航班。

not to put too fine a point on it.en: Not to put too fine a point on it, his performance was truly dreadful.
not to put too fine a point on it.cn: 不必过分强调，他的表演确实糟糕透顶。

not to say.en: Not to say that he's a genius, but he is remarkably talented.
not to say.cn: 虽不能说他天才，但确实才华出众。

not to worry.en: Don't worry, I will handle the situation for you.

not turn a hair.en: He didn't even turn a hair when confronted with the shocking news.
not turn a hair.cn: 面对这惊人的消息，他连眉毛都没皱一下。

not wanting or not willing to do sth.en: She refused to participate in the project, clearly showing she wasn't willing to take on any additional risks.
not wanting or not willing to do sth.cn: 她拒绝参与该项目，明确表示不愿承担任何额外风险。

not working or behaving in the normal wa.en: The system is not working or behaving in the normal way, causing data corruption.
not working or behaving in the normal wa.cn: 系统运行异常或未按正常方式运作，导致数据损坏。

nothing but.en: The project requires nothing but your full dedication and hard work.
nothing but.cn: 本项目只需您全心投入与辛勤付出。

nothing doing.en: I'm afraid nothing can be done about the delayed flight.
nothing doing.cn: 恐怕无法对航班延误做任何补救。

nothing if not.en: It is nothing if not a masterpiece of modern engineering.
nothing if not.cn: 这堪称现代工程的杰作。

nothing less than.en: The performance was nothing less than a masterpiece that captivated the entire audience.
nothing less than.cn: 这场演出堪称杰作，深深吸引了全场观众。

nothing much.en: There isn't anything much to discuss regarding the project's current status.
nothing much.cn: 目前项目进展无需过多讨论。

nothing succeeds like success.en: Nothing succeeds like success; once you achieve a goal, everything else becomes easier.
nothing succeeds like success.cn: 成功是成功的最好助推剂；一旦达成目标，其余一切便变得更容易。

now you're talking.en: Now you're talking! That is exactly the solution we have been waiting for.
now you're talking.cn: 正是如此！这正是我们苦苦等待的解决方案。

nowhere in sight.en: The missing documents are now nowhere in sight, leaving us completely helpless.
nowhere in sight.cn: 这些缺失的文件已无影无踪，让我们完全束手无策。

numbers game.en: The debate is just a numbers game where the count matters more than the truth.
numbers game.cn: 这场辩论不过是一场数字游戏，计票比真相更重要。

of a certain age.en: He is of a certain age, so he understands the importance of planning for retirement.
of a certain age.cn: 他已年过不惑，因此懂得为退休做规划的重要性。

of all.en: Of all the candidates she was the one who surprised everyone.
of all.cn: 她是所有候选人中令众人意外的那一位。

of all people.en: It is truly of all people that he would forget our anniversary.
of all people.cn: 他竟忘了我们的纪念日，真是人世间少有的事。

of all time.en: This is the most incredible performance I have ever witnessed in my life.
of all time.cn: 这是我一生中所见过的最令人难以置信的表演。

of course not.en: Of course not, I have absolutely no intention of doing that.
of course not.cn: 当然不是，我完全没有那样的打算。

of easy virtue.en: Her reputation for easy virtue ruined her chances in the business world.
of easy virtue.cn: 她因善行过度而毁坏了在商界的发展机会。

of moment.en: The proposed policy is of moment to our nation's long-term prosperity.
of moment.cn: 该政策关乎我国长远繁荣。

of note.en: It is of note that the company announced a significant merger yesterday.
of note.cn: 值得注意的是，该公司昨日宣布了一项重大合并。

of old.en: It was of old a bustling market, now it is quiet.
of old.cn: 昔日此处集市喧嚣，如今却十分寂静。

of sb's day.en: He is a man of his own day, not bound by our modern standards.
of sb's day.cn: 他是属于他那个时代的人，不受我们现代标准的束缚。

of sorts.en: The food was of sorts, but it lacked the genuine flavor we expected.
of sorts.cn: 食物尚可，但缺乏我们预期的地道风味。

of steel.en: Her resolve was of steel, unshaken by any external pressure or doubt.
of steel.cn: 她的意志如钢铁般坚定，不受任何外界压力或怀疑动摇。

of the day.en: The restaurant offers a special menu of the day featuring fresh local ingredients.
of the day.cn: 该餐厅提供每日特餐，选用新鲜本地食材。

of the essence.en: It is of the essence that we address this issue immediately.
of the essence.cn: 立即解决这一问题至关重要。

of yore.en: The bustling streets of yore have been replaced by modern skyscrapers.
of yore.cn: 昔日的喧嚣街道已被现代摩天大楼取代。

of your acquaintance.en: I have no idea of your acquaintance with these complex legal regulations.
of your acquaintance.cn: 我对您熟悉这些复杂的法律规定一无所知。

of your choice.en: You can pick any restaurant of your choice for our anniversary dinner.
of your choice.cn: 您可为我们的周年晚宴挑选任何心仪的餐厅。

of your own accord.en: She decided to quit her job of her own accord, seeking a new challenge.
of your own accord.cn: 她主动辞职，寻求新的挑战。

of your own free will.en: You must sign this form voluntarily, not under any pressure or coercion.
of your own free will.cn: 您必须自愿签署此表，不得受任何压力或胁迫。

off beam.en: The candidate's answer was completely off beam, missing the core requirement entirely.
off beam.cn: 该候选人的回答完全偏离轨道，完全未触及核心要求。

off the hook.en: She kept her phone off the hook to avoid missing any urgent calls from colleagues.
off the hook.cn: 她不让电话挂机，以免错过同事的任何紧急来电。

off the record.en: The source refused to speak off the record, citing strict confidentiality protocols.
off the record.cn: 该消息来源拒绝透露细节，并援引了严格的保密规定。

off the shelf.en: We can provide you with off-the-shelf software that meets your needs immediately.
off the shelf.cn: 我们可立即为您提供符合您需求的现成软件。

off the wall.en: The comedian's latest routine was absolutely off the wall, leaving everyone in stitches.
off the wall.cn: 这位喜剧演员的最新表演荒诞不经，引得全场捧腹大笑。

off your hands.en: Once the project is handed off, you will no longer be responsible for it.
off your hands.cn: 项目移交后，您将不再负责。

offer your hand.en: He immediately offered his hand to help her lift the heavy box.
offer your hand.cn: 他立刻伸出手帮她搬起那个沉重的箱子。

old enough to know better.en: He is old enough to know better and should have learned from his mistakes.
old enough to know better.cn: 他年纪已大，理应知晓更好的做法，并应从自己的错误中吸取教训。

on a shoestring.en: They managed to renovate the entire building on a shoestring budget.
on a shoestring.cn: 他们仅用微薄的预算就翻新了整个大楼。

on a silver platter.en: The perfect job was handed to her on a silver platter, requiring no effort at all.
on a silver platter.cn: 一份完美的工作被轻易地递到了她面前，无需任何努力。

on account.en: The hotel will put your bill on account for the first night's stay.
on account.cn: 酒店将为您挂账第一晚的费用。

on and on.en: The rain poured on and on, making it impossible to leave the house.
on and on.cn: 雨下个不停，让人无法离开屋子。

on balance.en: On balance, the evidence suggests that remote work significantly boosts productivity.
on balance.cn: 总体而言，证据表明远程办公能显著提高生产力。

on board.en: Please get on board the plane immediately as our flight is about to take off.
on board.cn: 请立刻登机，我们的航班即将起飞。

on camera.en: The actor admitted his mistake on camera, causing a major scandal.
on camera.cn: 该演员在镜头前承认错误，引发重大丑闻。

on cloud nine.en: She was on cloud nine after receiving the job offer.
on cloud nine.cn: 她收到工作录用通知后欣喜若狂。

on demand.en: The software provides instant access to files on demand whenever needed.
on demand.cn: 该软件可随时按需即时访问文件。

on display.en: The new exhibits are currently on display in the main hall.
on display.cn: 新展品目前正在主厅展出。

on earth.en: I have no idea on earth how he managed to solve such a complex problem.
on earth.cn: 我简直无法想象他是如何解决如此复杂问题的。

on easy street.en: They've finally settled on easy street after years of financial struggle.
on easy street.cn: 历经多年财务困境，他们终于搬到了易安居。

on everyone's lips.en: The latest scandal is on everyone's lips, dominating the headlines.
on everyone's lips.cn: 最新的丑闻人人皆知，占据头条。

on fire.en: The entire building was on fire when the firefighters finally arrived.
on fire.cn: 消防员到达时，整座大楼已燃起大火。

on first acquaintance.en: On first acquaintance, they found their shared passion for astronomy immediately fascinating.
on first acquaintance.cn: 初次相识时，他们便发现彼此对天文学的共同爱好令人着迷。

on hand.en: We need to keep enough supplies on hand in case of an emergency.
on hand.cn: 我们需储备充足物资以应对紧急情况。

on horseback.en: The explorer rode on horseback across the vast, untamed wilderness.
on horseback.cn: 探险家骑马穿越了广袤未驯的荒野。

on manual.en: The car is currently on manual, so you must operate the gears yourself.
on manual.cn: 车辆目前处于手动模式，需您自行操作换挡。

on payment of sth.en: The goods will be released immediately upon payment of the full amount.
on payment of sth.cn: 货物将在付清全款后立即放行。

on production of sth.en: Upon production of the required documents, he was immediately granted access to the secure facility.
on production of sth.cn: 提交所需文件后，他立即获准进入该安全设施。

on purpose.en: He broke the vase on purpose to prove his point during the argument.
on purpose.cn: 他在争吵中故意打碎花瓶以证明自己的观点。

on sb's account.en: He was fired on his boss's account for missing the critical deadline.
on sb's account.cn: 他因错过关键截止日期而被解雇。

on sb's coat-tails.en: He launched his career by riding on the famous actor's coat-tails.
on sb's coat-tails.cn: 他凭借搭乘那位著名演员的光环起步。

on sb's say-so.en: He agreed to the plan solely on his say-so, despite our warnings.
on sb's say-so.cn: 尽管我们一再警告，他仍仅凭个人意愿同意该计划。

on sb's shoulders.en: The burden of proving his innocence now rests entirely on his shoulders.
on sb's shoulders.cn: 如今，证明他无罪的责任完全压在他肩上。

on sb's tail.en: The detective was on the suspect's tail in his car all night.
on sb's tail.cn: 侦探整晚都在车里跟踪嫌疑人。

on sb's terms.en: He refused to settle on her terms, insisting on his own conditions.
on sb's terms.cn: 他拒绝按她的条件妥协，坚持提出自己的要求。

on second thoughts.en: On second thoughts, I think we should postpone the meeting until tomorrow.
on second thoughts.cn: 再考虑一下，我认为会议应推迟到明天举行。

on song.en: The engine is running on song, delivering smooth power without any vibration.
on song.cn: 引擎运转平稳，动力充沛且无振动。

on sufferance.en: The committee approved the budget on sufferance, despite initial objections.
on sufferance.cn: 委员会尽管起初有异议，仍勉强通过了预算。

on the back of sth.en: We achieved this breakthrough on the back of years of relentless research and development.
on the back of sth.cn: 这一突破建立在多年不懈的研发基础之上。

on the blink.en: The car's engine suddenly went on the blink, leaving us stranded in the middle of nowhere.
on the blink.cn: 汽车引擎突然故障，让我们被困在荒无人烟的地方。

on the cheap.en: They decided to buy the car on the cheap to save money for their trip.
on the cheap.cn: 他们决定低价买车，以便为旅行攒钱。

on the contrary.en: On the contrary, the data actually supports our initial hypothesis completely.
on the contrary.cn: 相反，数据完全支持我们最初的假设。

on the credit side.en: On the credit side, his dedication to the project is truly commendable.
on the credit side.cn: 在信贷方面，他对项目的奉献精神确实值得嘉奖。

on the distaff side.en: On the distaff side, her family's wealth significantly influenced his business decisions.
on the distaff side.cn: 在母系方面，她家族的财富显著影响了他的商业决策。

on the dot.en: The train arrived on the dot, exactly when it was scheduled to depart.
on the dot.cn: 火车准时到达，恰好在预定发车时刻。

on the downlow.en: They kept their deal on the downlow to avoid any public scrutiny.
on the downlow.cn: 他们私下达成交易，以避免受到公众审视。

on the drawing board.en: The new bridge design is still on the drawing board, awaiting final approval.
on the drawing board.cn: 新桥设计方案仍在绘图板上，等待最终批准。

on the edge of your seat.en: The thriller kept me on the edge of my seat until the very last page.
on the edge of your seat.cn: 这部惊悚小说让我坐立不安，直到最后一页。

on the face of it.en: On the face of it, the project looks promising, but details remain unclear.
on the face of it.cn: 乍看之下该项目颇具前景，但细节尚不明确。

on the far or opposite side of sth.en: The lighthouse stands on the far side of the island, overlooking the vast ocean.
on the far or opposite side of sth.cn: 灯塔矗立于岛屿远端，俯瞰着浩瀚的海洋。

on the ground.en: The team was on the ground to collect first-hand data for their research report.
on the ground.cn: 该团队亲临现场，为研究报告收集了一手数据。

on the home front.en: While soldiers fought abroad, families remained steadfast on the home front.
on the home front.cn: 士兵们在海外作战，而家庭则坚守在后方。

on the horizon.en: The signs of economic recovery are finally on the horizon.
on the horizon.cn: 经济复苏的迹象终于出现在地平线上。

on the horns of a dilemma.en: The company is now on the horns of a dilemma, unable to choose between closing factories or losing its main investor.
on the horns of a dilemma.cn: 该公司正陷入两难境地，无法在关闭工厂与失去主要投资者之间做出选择。

on the house.en: The restaurant decided to offer a complimentary dinner for everyone on the house.
on the house.cn: 餐厅决定为所有顾客提供免费晚餐。

on the inside.en: The inner lining of his jacket was surprisingly soft on the inside.
on the inside.cn: 他夹克内衬意外地很柔软。

on the market.en: The new smartphone is currently on the market and available for immediate purchase.
on the market.cn: 这款新智能手机现已上市，可立即购买。

on the money.en: The forecast proved on the money, predicting a record-breaking heatwave with perfect accuracy.
on the money.cn: 该预测精准无误，准确预言了破纪录的热浪。

on the nose.en: The critic's review was on the nose, pinpointing every flaw in the film.
on the nose.cn: 该评论一针见血，指出了影片中所有的缺陷。

on the open market.en: The company decided to sell its assets on the open market rather than liquidating them privately.
on the open market.cn: 该公司决定在公开市场出售资产，而非私下清算。

on the other side of the fence.en: We must consider the other side of the fence before making our final decision.
on the other side of the fence.cn: 在做出最终决定前，我们必须考虑另一方的立场。

on the qui vive.en: She kept on the qui vive, watching for any sign of trouble in the dark alley.
on the qui vive.cn: 她时刻警惕，在黑暗的巷子里留意任何麻烦的迹象。

on the rack.en: The candidate is on the rack, terrified of answering any question about his past.
on the rack.cn: 该候选人被审问，害怕回答任何关于他过去的问题。

on the rebound.en: After their breakup, they tried to reconnect on the rebound, hoping to fill the void.
on the rebound.cn: 分手后，他们试图趁热打铁重新联系，希望能填补内心的空缺。

on the ropes.en: The team is on the ropes, facing a severe deficit in the final minutes of the match.
on the ropes.cn: 球队处境艰难，比赛最后几分钟处于巨大劣势。

on the safe side.en: To be on the safe side, I've booked a hotel room just in case.
on the safe side.cn: 以防万一，我订了酒店房间。

on the same page.en: We must stay on the same page to ensure our project succeeds.
on the same page.cn: 我们必须保持步调一致，以确保项目成功。

on the scrap heap.en: Many outdated technologies are now just sitting on the scrap heap, useless and forgotten by everyone.
on the scrap heap.cn: 许多过时的技术如今仅堆积在废料堆上，毫无用处且被众人遗忘。

on the sly.en: He was trying to sell his car on the sly without telling anyone.
on the sly.cn: 他正试图暗中出售汽车，不让任何人知道。

on the stocks.en: The new bridge is still on the stocks, so traffic remains disrupted.
on the stocks.cn: 这座新桥仍在施工中，交通因此受阻。

on the strength of sth.en: We secured the contract on the strength of our impressive track record.
on the strength of sth.cn: 我们凭借出色的业绩赢得了这份合同。

on the surface.en: On the surface, everything seemed perfect, but hidden problems were lurking beneath.
on the surface.cn: 表面上看似完美，但隐患暗藏其中。

on the tip of your tongue.en: The name is on the tip of my tongue, but I can't recall it right now.
on the tip of your tongue.cn: 这个名字我一时想不起来，但感觉就在嘴边。

on the wing.en: The migratory birds were spotted flying on the wing over the ocean.
on the wing.cn: 人们在海上看到一群候鸟正展翅飞翔。

on view.en: The ancient artifacts are currently on view in the museum's main hall.
on view.cn: 这些古代文物目前陈列在博物馆的主厅。

on your conscience.en: You cannot escape the guilt that will forever rest on your conscience.
on your conscience.cn: 你无法逃脱那将永远萦绕在你良心的愧疚感。

on your feet.en: After weeks of illness, she finally regained her strength and was back on her feet.
on your feet.cn: 病了几周后，她终于恢复了体力，重新站了起来。

on your hands.en: You must take full responsibility for the project on your hands.
on your hands.cn: 你必须对你经手的项目负全责。

on your hunkers.en: He sat on his hunkers to watch the sunset over the quiet lake.
on your hunkers.cn: 他盘腿坐在草地上，观赏着宁静的湖面夕阳。

on your mettle.en: You must show on your mettle if you want to lead this team to victory.
on your mettle.cn: 若想带领这支队伍取得胜利，你必须展现出你的真才实学。

on your mind.en: She has been worrying about the project on her mind all week.
on your mind.cn: 她这周一直在为这个项目操心。

on your tod.en: You should practice on your own to improve your skills.
on your tod.cn: 应自行练习以提升技能。

once and for all.en: Let's settle this dispute once and for all so we can move forward.
once and for all.cn: 让我们彻底解决这一争端，以便继续前进。

once in a blue moon.en: He only visits his hometown once in a blue moon, so we rarely see him.
once in a blue moon.cn: 他一年难得回一次故乡，所以我们很少见到他。

once in a lifetime.en: This rare opportunity appears only once in a lifetime, so we must seize it immediately.
once in a lifetime.cn: 此良机一生仅现一次，故须即刻把握。

once more.en: She stood once more at the podium, her voice trembling with emotion.
once more.cn: 她再次站在讲台上，声音因激动而颤抖。

once or twice.en: I've only seen that movie once or twice, so I'm not an expert on it.
once or twice.cn: 我只看过那部电影一两次，所以算不上专家。

once too often.en: He was once too often lucky to escape the danger, but that won't happen again.
once too often.cn: 他曾经多次幸运地逃脱了危险，但不会再发生第二次。

once upon a time.en: Once upon a time, a brave knight set out to save the kingdom from dark forces.
once upon a time.cn: 从前，一位勇敢的骑士出发去拯救王国免受黑暗势力的侵害。

one and all.en: The new policy will benefit one and all, from the CEO to the janitor.
one and all.cn: 新政策将惠及所有人，从首席执行官到清洁工。

one and only.en: She is the one and only person who can truly understand my complex artistic vision.
one and only.cn: 她是唯一能真正理解我复杂艺术构思的人。

one and the same.en: It is one and the same person who signed both documents.
one and the same.cn: 签署这两份文件的是同一人。

one by one.en: The teacher called on students to answer questions one by one.
one by one.cn: 老师请学生逐一回答问题。

one day.en: One day, she will become the most influential leader in history.
one day.cn: 有一天，她将成历史上最具影响力的领袖。

one for the road.en: Before heading home, he ordered one for the road to celebrate their success.
one for the road.cn: 回家前，他特意点了一份路上吃的，以庆祝他们的成功。

one of a kind.en: This handcrafted watch is truly one of a kind, unlike any other in the world.
one of a kind.cn: 这款手工腕表独一无二，世间再无第二件。

one of these days.en: One of these days, he'll finally admit he's wrong about everything.
one of these days.cn: 总有一天，他会承认自己全错了。

one or two.en: One or two more days and the project will be completed.
one or two.cn: 再过一两天，项目即可完工。

one thing leads to another.en: One thing leads to another, and soon we'll be facing a crisis.
one thing leads to another.cn: 一事引发另一事，很快我们将面临危机。

one way or the other.en: You must decide one way or the other, regardless of which option you choose.
one way or the other.cn: 无论选择何种方案，都必须做出决定。

only a short time ago.en: It was only a short time ago that we still believed in magic.
only a short time ago.cn: 不久前，我们仍相信魔法。

only have yourself to blame.en: You made a critical error, so you are the only one who must take responsibility.
only have yourself to blame.cn: 你犯了一个关键错误，因此你必须独自承担责任。

only if.en: You will succeed only if you commit yourself to the task every single day.
only if.cn: 唯有每日全力以赴，方能成功。

only time will tell.en: Only time will tell if this bold strategy truly transforms the struggling company.
only time will tell.cn: 唯有时间能证明，这一大胆举措是否真能让这家困境中的公司起死回生。

or anything.en: I don't want to discuss politics or anything else that might cause an argument.
or anything.cn: 我不想讨论政治或其他可能引发争执的话题。

or otherwise.en: The applicant must submit proof of income, or otherwise the visa application will be rejected.
or otherwise.cn: 申请人须提交收入证明，否则签证申请将被拒签。

or so.en: The meeting is scheduled for around three o'clock, or so.
or so.cn: 会议定于下午三点左右举行。

or whatever.en: He mentioned the project, or whatever else was on his mind that day.
or whatever.cn: 他提到了那个项目，或是当天让他挂心的其他事情。

or wherever.en: You can submit your application online or wherever you prefer.
or wherever.cn: 您可在线提交申请，或选择您偏好的其他方式。

out loud.en: Please read the instructions out loud so everyone can hear them clearly.
out loud.cn: 请大声读出这些说明，以便大家都能听清。

out of action.en: The server went out of action due to a sudden power surge.
out of action.cn: 服务器因突发的电源浪涌而停止运行。

out of breath.en: After sprinting up the steep hill, she was completely out of breath and struggling to catch her breath.
out of breath.cn: 跑完陡峭的山坡后，她气喘吁吁，努力平复呼吸。

out of business.en: The local bakery has been out of business for over a year due to rising costs.
out of business.cn: 这家本地面包店因成本上涨已停业一年多了。

out of character.en: His sudden anger was completely out of character for the usually calm man.
out of character.cn: 这位向来沉着的人突然发怒，完全不合常理。

out of doors.en: We decided to have our barbecue out of doors instead of indoors.
out of doors.cn: 我们决定把烧烤搬到室外进行，而不是在室内。

out of harm's way.en: The children were taken out of harm's way before the storm hit.
out of harm's way.cn: 风暴来临前，孩子们已被转移到安全地带。

out of hearing.en: The signal was lost because the car drove too far out of hearing range.
out of hearing.cn: 信号因汽车驶出听觉范围而过远而丢失。

out of here.en: The security guard ordered the intruder to get out of here immediately.
out of here.cn: 保安命令入侵者立即离开。

out of the frying pan into the fire.en: She left her stressful job only to find herself in an even worse one.
out of the frying pan into the fire.cn: 她辞去了那份令人压力巨大的工作，结果却陷入了一份更糟糕的工作。

out of the goodness of your heart.en: He donated his entire savings out of the goodness of his heart to help the flood victims.
out of the goodness of your heart.cn: 他出于好心，倾尽积蓄帮助了洪水灾民。

out of the loop.en: He is out of the loop regarding the company's latest strategic initiatives.
out of the loop.cn: 他对公司最新的战略举措一无所知。

out of the ordinary.en: The way she handled that crisis was truly out of the ordinary.
out of the ordinary.cn: 她处理那场危机的方式真是不寻常。

out of the question.en: It is completely out of the question to discuss such a controversial topic.
out of the question.cn: 讨论这样一个有争议的话题是完全不可能的。

out of thin air.en: The company suddenly announced a merger, seemingly out of thin air.
out of thin air.cn: 该公司突然宣布合并，仿佛凭空而来。

out of this world.en: The view from the mountain top was absolutely out of this world.
out of this world.cn: 从山顶望去，景色简直妙不可言。

out of your element.en: He felt completely out of his element when he had to give a presentation in front of the entire board.
out of your element.cn: 他在整个董事会面前做报告时，感到完全不自在。

out of your hands.en: Once the situation spiraled out of our control, we had to wait for the authorities.
out of your hands.cn: 局势一旦失控，我们只能等待当局介入。

out of your way.en: You can easily park out of your way without blocking the emergency lane.
out of your way.cn: 您可在不妨碍应急车道通行的情况下轻松绕行停车。

out on a limb.en: By admitting the mistake, she put herself out on a limb with no one to support her.
out on a limb.cn: 她承认错误后，孤立无援，处境艰难。

out to lunch.en: He was so out to lunch that he forgot his own name at the party.
out to lunch.cn: 他神志不清，以至于在聚会上忘了自己的名字。

out to sea.en: The fishing boat headed out to sea, leaving the harbor behind.
out to sea.cn: 渔船驶向大海，抛下港口。

over against sth.en: When placed over against the new policy, the old one appears outdated and ineffective.
over against sth.cn: 与新政相比，旧政显得过时且无效。

over and above.en: The project cost $50,000, over and above the initial budget estimates.
over and above.cn: 该项目花费五万美元，超过了最初的预算估算。

over the counter.en: You can buy this medicine over the counter without needing a doctor's prescription.
over the counter.cn: 此药无需医生处方即可在药店直接购买。

over the hill.en: The company's once-mighty CEO is now over the hill and struggling to keep up with modern trends.
over the hill.cn: 该公司昔日显赫的首席执行官如今已过时，正努力跟上现代潮流。

over the moon.en: She was over the moon when she received the acceptance letter from her dream university.
over the moon.cn: 收到梦想大学的录取通知书时，她欣喜若狂。

over to you.en: Now it's over to you; the final decision rests entirely in your hands.
over to you.cn: 现在轮到你了；最终决定权完全在你手中。

over-egg the pudding.en: He over-egged the pudding by adding too many spices to the cake.
over-egg the pudding.cn: 他在蛋糕里加了太多香料，反而弄坏了布丁。

overplay your hand.en: He overplayed his hand by assuming he could easily win the negotiation without preparation.
overplay your hand.cn: 他因未做充分准备就认为能轻松赢得谈判而弄巧成拙。

pack into sth.en: The stadium was packed into seats by the end of the match.
pack into sth.cn: 比赛结束时，看台已座无虚席。

pack your bags.en: After the heated argument, she finally packed her bags and left town forever.
pack your bags.cn: 争吵过后，她终于收拾好行李，永远离开了这座城市。

paint over sth.en: Don't just paint over the cracks; fix them properly first.
paint over sth.cn: 切勿仅用油漆覆盖裂缝，应先妥善修复。

paint the town red.en: The band decided to paint the town red after their record-breaking concert.
paint the town red.cn: 乐队在创下纪录的演出后决定全城狂欢。

pale into insignificance.en: When compared to his groundbreaking work, his recent output quickly paled into insignificance.
pale into insignificance.cn: 与其开创性作品相比，他近期的产出显得微不足道。

part and parcel of sth.en: It is now part and parcel of modern life to have instant access to the internet.
part and parcel of sth.cn: 如今，即时访问互联网已成为现代生活不可或缺的一部分。

part of the furniture.en: He has become just another part of the furniture in our family life.
part of the furniture.cn: 他已成为我们家庭生活的一部分。

pass into sth.en: The new regulations will soon pass into law, changing how we handle data privacy.
pass into sth.cn: 新法规即将生效，将改变我们处理数据隐私的方式。

pass muster.en: The new safety protocols must pass muster before the board approves them.
pass muster.cn: 新安全规程必须通过审查，董事会才会批准。

pass out.en: She suddenly passed out from the extreme heat and dehydration.
pass out.cn: 她因酷热和脱水突然晕倒。

pass over sth.en: The report deliberately passes over the recent financial scandal to focus on future projections.
pass over sth.cn: 该报告刻意略去近期的财务丑闻，转而关注未来预测。

pass water.en: He suddenly had to pass water during the important meeting.
pass water.cn: 他在重要会议上突然需要上厕所。

pay court to sb.en: He tried to pay court to the new manager by bringing her coffee every morning.
pay court to sb.cn: 他每天早晨给她送咖啡，以此讨好新经理。

pay dividends.en: The company's recent investment strategy has begun to pay significant dividends.
pay dividends.cn: 该公司近期的投资策略已开始带来显著回报。

pay good money for sth.en: He paid good money for that used car, only to find it was a total scam.
pay good money for sth.cn: 他花高价买了那辆二手车，结果发现是个彻头彻尾的骗局。

pay up.en: Finally, he managed to pay up the entire outstanding balance.
pay up.cn: 最后，他终于还清了全部欠款。

pay your way.en: She decided to pay her own way by taking a part-time job during the summer.
pay your way.cn: 她决定利用暑假打一份兼职来支付自己的开销。

peck at sth.en: He pecked at the sandwich, though he wasn't really hungry.
peck at sth.cn: 他咬了一口三明治，尽管并不饿。

perish the thought.en: I'd rather perish the thought than consider such a ridiculous proposal.
perish the thought.cn: 与其想这荒谬的提议，不如让它消失。

pick a lock.en: The thief tried to pick a lock on the safe but failed due to his lack of skill.
pick a lock.cn: 小偷试图撬开保险箱的锁，但因技术生疏而失败。

pick and choose.en: You can pick and choose the best features from this software package.
pick and choose.cn: 您可以从该软件包中挑选最佳功能。

pick holes in sth.en: Critics often pick holes in the new policy, highlighting minor flaws that undermine its overall effectiveness.
pick holes in sth.cn: 批评者常在新政策中找茬，强调那些削弱其整体效能的微小缺陷。

pick sb up on sth.en: Don't pick me up on my mistakes, we've already discussed them.
pick sb up on sth.cn: 别在我犯错时找我麻烦，我们已讨论过了。

pick sb's brains.en: She decided to pick the professor's brains about her upcoming research project.
pick sb's brains.cn: 她决定向教授请教关于即将开展的研究项目的问题。

pick sb's pocket.en: The thief managed to pick the victim's pocket while she was distracted by her phone.
pick sb's pocket.cn: 小偷趁她看手机分心时偷了她的钱包。

pick up speed.en: The project is picking up speed as we approach the final deadline.
pick up speed.cn: 随着临近最终截止日期，该项目进展加快。

pick up the pieces.en: After the storm, it took us weeks to pick up the pieces and rebuild our lives.
pick up the pieces.cn: 风暴过后，我们花了数周时间收拾残局，重建生活。

pick up the threads.en: After the chaotic meeting, she managed to pick up the threads and organize the discussion.
pick up the threads.cn: 会议结束后，她理清思路并组织了讨论。

pick yourself up.en: After the setback, she decided to pick herself up and keep moving forward.
pick yourself up.cn: 受挫后，她决定振作起来继续前行。

pie in the sky.en: It is like a pie in the sky, an impossible dream that will never be realized.
pie in the sky.cn: 这无异于空中楼阁，一个永远无法实现的梦想。

pigs might fly.en: It is as impossible for pigs to fly, given the current economic crisis.
pigs might fly.cn: 在当前经济危机下，猪飞上天无异于痴人说梦。

pinch pennies.en: He refuses to pinch pennies, always investing in his company's future growth.
pinch pennies.cn: 他不愿斤斤计较，总是致力于公司的未来发展。

play by the rules.en: The team insisted on playing by the rules to ensure fair competition.
play by the rules.cn: 该队坚持按规则比赛，以确保公平竞争。

play catch-up.en: The team played catch-up to regain the lead in the final minutes.
play catch-up.cn: 球队在最后几分钟追平比分反超领先。

play chicken.en: They decided to play chicken by driving towards each other on the narrow road.
play chicken.cn: 他们决定在狭窄的道路上相向行驶来玩‘斗鸡’游戏。

play footsie with sb.en: He kept playing footsie with his date under the table to show affection.
play footsie with sb.cn: 他在桌下与约会对象玩捉迷藏以示亲昵。

play happy families.en: They decided to play happy families by organizing a surprise birthday party for their daughter.
play happy families.cn: 他们决定通过为女儿举办惊喜生日派对来庆祝幸福家庭。

play hard to get.en: She plays hard to get, but her genuine kindness eventually won him over.
play hard to get.cn: 她故作矜持，但她的真诚善良最终打动了他的心。

play into sb's hands.en: The team made a strategic error that played directly into the rival's hands.
play into sb's hands.cn: 该队犯了一个战略错误，直接助长了对手的气焰。

play it by ear.en: We'll play it by ear and decide on the itinerary once we arrive in London.
play it by ear.cn: 到时再定行程，抵达伦敦后作决定。

play it cool.en: When the crisis hit, he managed to play it cool and keep everyone calm.
play it cool.cn: 危机爆发时，他镇定自若，使众人保持冷静。

play it straight.en: We must play it straight and never compromise our integrity in any business deal.
play it straight.cn: 我们必须堂堂正正行事，在任何商业交易中绝不妥协我们的诚信。

play possum.en: He decided to play possum and pretended not to understand the complex instructions.
play possum.cn: 他装死，假装听不懂那些复杂的指令。

play sb's game.en: By chance, he played the politician's game and secured his unexpected victory.
play sb's game.cn: 他偶然涉足政治博弈，赢得了意想不到的胜利。

play the field.en: He decided to play the field before settling down with a serious partner.
play the field.cn: 他决定先四处寻觅，再与一位认真的伴侣共度余生。

play the game.en: He insists on playing the game fairly, refusing any unfair advantage.
play the game.cn: 他坚持公平比赛，拒绝任何不公平的优势。

play the market.en: They decided to play the market by buying stocks at a low point and selling them when prices rose.
play the market.cn: 他们决定趁股价低迷时买入，待价格上涨时卖出。

play the race card.en: He tried to play the race card by claiming his background made him unfairly targeted.

play to the gallery.en: The politician played to the gallery by making controversial promises during the election.
play to the gallery.cn: 该政客在选举期间做出争议性承诺以博取公众关注。

play with fire.en: He keeps playing with fire by investing in such risky startups.
play with fire.cn: 他通过投资这类高风险初创企业玩火自焚。

play with yourself.en: Stop playing with yourself; the evidence clearly points to your guilt.
play with yourself.cn: 别再自欺欺人了；证据确凿地指向你的有罪。

play your ace.en: He finally played his ace card to secure the victory in the final match.
play your ace.cn: 他最终打出王牌，确保了决赛的胜利。

play your cards right.en: He played his cards right to secure the contract without any conflict.
play your cards right.cn: 他行事得当，顺利签下了合同且未生任何冲突。

please the eye.en: The vibrant colors in her garden design truly please the eye.
please the eye.cn: 她花园设计中的鲜艳色彩令人赏心悦目。

please yourself.en: Please yourself if you wish to leave; I'll handle the rest without your interference.
please yourself.cn: 若您想离去，请自便；其余事宜我会自行处理，无需您插手。

pleased with yourself.en: He seemed pleased with himself after winning the competition without any effort.
pleased with yourself.cn: 他赢得比赛后似乎颇为自得，仿佛毫无费力一般。

pluck at sth.en: She plucked at the loose thread, trying to fix the torn fabric.
pluck at sth.cn: 她扯松了线头，试图修补破损的布料。

pluck sth out of the air.en: He plucked an answer out of the air when asked about his future plans.
pluck sth out of the air.cn: 谈及未来计划时，他随口编造了一个答案。

plumb the depths of sth.en: We must plumb the depths of his despair to find a way out.
plumb the depths of sth.cn: 我们必须深入探究他的绝望深渊，以寻找出路。

plus or minus.en: The meeting is scheduled for two o'clock, plus or minus fifteen minutes.
plus or minus.cn: 会议定于两点举行，误差十五分钟。

ply your trade.en: He decided to ply his trade in the city rather than stay at home.
ply your trade.cn: 他决定进城谋生，而不是待在家里。

point of contact.en: We need to establish a clear point of contact for all future project updates.
point of contact.cn: 我们需要为所有未来的项目更新指定明确的联系人。

point taken.en: You're absolutely right; I concede that point is well-taken.
point taken.cn: 您完全正确；我承认这一点很有道理。

poke at sth.en: He kept poking at the old wound until it bled again.
poke at sth.cn: 他反复揭开那道旧伤疤，直到它再次流血。

pomp and circumstance.en: The ceremony was filled with pomp and circumstance, impressing all the guests.
pomp and circumstance.cn: 典礼隆重盛大，令所有宾客印象深刻。

possession is four tenths of the law.en: In legal disputes, the person in possession often wins because possession is nine-tenths of the law.
possession is four tenths of the law.cn: 在法律诉讼中，占有人往往胜诉，因为占有是法律十分之九。

pot luck.en: It's all pot luck whether we'll make it in time for the meeting.
pot luck.cn: 能否赶上会议全看运气了。

pour out.en: Tears poured out of her eyes as she heard the tragic news.
pour out.cn: 听到这悲痛的消息，她不禁泪如雨下。

practice makes perfect.en: Consistent practice is the only reliable path to mastering complex skills.
practice makes perfect.cn: 持之以恒是掌握复杂技能唯一可靠途径。

practise what you preach.en: You must practise what you preach, not just talk about it.
practise what you preach.cn: 你必须言行一致，而不仅仅是空谈。

preach to the converted.en: The lecture was preach to the converted, offering no new insights for those already convinced.
preach to the converted.cn: 此次讲座旨在向已信者传教，对那些已然信服的人毫无新意。

present company excepted.en: Present company excepted, I'd like to propose a toast to our new manager.
present company excepted.cn: 除本公司外，我提议为我们的新经理举杯祝酒。

press for sth.en: The government is pressing for immediate action on climate change.
press for sth.cn: 政府正敦促立即采取行动应对气候变化。

press sth home.en: The lawyer pressed his client's innocence home until the jury acquitted him.
press sth home.cn: 律师极力向陪审团证明其客户无罪，直至陪审团宣判其无罪。

press sth on sb.en: The government tried to press the unpopular tax on the public.
press sth on sb.cn: 政府试图向公众推行这项不受欢迎的税收。

pride of place.en: The company's sustainable initiatives hold a pride of place in its corporate strategy.
pride of place.cn: 该公司的可持续发展举措在公司战略中占据重要地位。

prime the pump.en: The government invested heavily to prime the pump and stimulate the struggling tech sector.
prime the pump.cn: 政府大力投入以启动引擎，提振挣扎中的科技产业。

propose sb's health.en: He proposed his colleague's health with a glass of champagne.

pull out all the stops.en: The team pulled out all the stops to ensure victory in the final match.
pull out all the stops.cn: 该队在决赛中以尽全力确保获胜。

pull sb's leg.en: Don't pull my leg, I'm serious about this job offer.
pull sb's leg.cn: 别拿我开玩笑，我是认真的，这份工作机会我很看重。

pull sth apart.en: The mechanic carefully pulled the engine apart to replace the worn-out piston.
pull sth apart.cn: 技师将发动机拆开，更换了磨损的活塞。

pull the strings.en: The politician is accused of pulling the strings behind the scenes to manipulate public opinion.
pull the strings.cn: 该政客被指控幕后操纵舆论。

pull the wool over sb's eyes.en: The company pulled the wool over our eyes with their misleading financial reports.
pull the wool over sb's eyes.cn: 该公司用误导性的财务报告蒙蔽了我们的双眼。

pull together.en: The team pulled together to overcome the unexpected challenges during the project.
pull together.cn: 团队齐心协力克服了项目中的意外挑战。

pull your punches.en: Instead of criticizing her harshly, he chose to pull his punches and offer gentle advice.
pull your punches.cn: 他没有严厉地批评她，而是选择委婉劝诫。

pull your weight.en: It's time you stopped making excuses and started pulling your weight in the team.
pull your weight.cn: 是时候停止找借口，在团队中切实出力了。

pull yourself together.en: You need to pull yourself together before the meeting starts.
pull yourself together.cn: 会议开始前你要振作起来。

pure and simple.en: The results are pure and simple: the project failed completely.
pure and simple.cn: 结果纯粹且简单：项目彻底失败。

push forward.en: We must push forward despite the heavy rain to reach our destination on time.
push forward.cn: 尽管大雨倾盆，我们仍须奋力前行，确保准时抵达目的地。

push on.en: We must push on despite the heavy rain to reach our destination in time.
push on.cn: 尽管大雨倾盆，我们必须继续前行，准时抵达目的地。

push sth back.en: We must push the project deadline back to next month due to unforeseen delays.
push sth back.cn: 因不可预见的延误，我们必须将项目截止日期推迟至下月。

push sth to the back of your mind.en: You should push those painful memories to the back of your mind and focus on the future.
push sth to the back of your mind.cn: 应将那些痛苦的回忆置于脑后，专注于未来。

push the envelope.en: The team decided to push the envelope by developing a new, ultra-efficient battery technology.
push the envelope.cn: 该团队决定通过研发一种新型超高效电池技术来突破极限。

put a brave face on sth.en: He tried to put a brave face on his failure, but his trembling hands betrayed his fear.
put a brave face on sth.cn: 他试图掩饰失败的窘态，但颤抖的双手暴露了他的恐惧。

put a figure on sth.en: The company put a figure on the project's cost before signing the contract.
put a figure on sth.cn: 签约前，该公司已估算了项目成本。

put a price on sth.en: The bank put a price on the gold bar to ensure its value was accurately reflected in the market.
put a price on sth.cn: 银行对金条定价，以确保其价值在市场中得到准确反映。

put a sock in it.en: Stop talking and put a sock in it before I lose my patience.
put a sock in it.cn: 别说了，在我失去耐心之前把袜子穿上。

put all your eggs in one basket.en: Don't put all your eggs in one basket; diversify your investments to reduce risk.
put all your eggs in one basket.cn: 不要把鸡蛋放在同一个篮子里；分散投资以降低风险。

put an end to it all.en: He decided to put an end to it all by jumping from the bridge.

put ideas into sb's head.en: Don't put wild ideas into his head about winning the lottery tomorrow.
put ideas into sb's head.cn: 别让他明天中彩票这种荒诞的念头进脑子。

put money into sth.en: We decided to put more money into the new project this quarter.
put money into sth.cn: 我们决定在本季度增加对新项目的投入。

put out feelers.en: Before making a final offer, the company put out feelers to gauge the market's reaction.
put out feelers.cn: 在做出最终报价前，该公司试探市场反应。

put paid to sth.en: The unexpected rain finally put paid to our outdoor wedding plans.
put paid to sth.cn: 突如其来的雨最终使我们室外的婚礼计划泡汤了。

put pen to paper.en: She decided to put pen to paper and draft a formal proposal for the new project.
put pen to paper.cn: 她决定动笔起草新项目的正式建议书。

put sb down as sth.en: He put her down as a mere secretary, ignoring her true potential.
put sb down as sth.cn: 他视她仅为秘书，无视她的真正潜力。

put sb down for sth.en: The immigration officer put my passport down for registration at the counter.
put sb down for sth.cn: 移民官员将我的护照放在柜台办理登记。

put sb in their place.en: The senior manager put the arrogant intern in his place by calmly outlining his duties.
put sb in their place.cn: 这位经理通过平静地阐明其职责，让傲慢的实习生知难而退。

put sb off their stride.en: The sudden noise put her completely off her stride during the race.
put sb off their stride.cn: 突如其来的噪音使她在比赛中完全乱了方寸。

put sb on.en: She put him on the phone to discuss the urgent project details.
put sb on.cn: 她让他打电话讨论紧急项目细节。

put sb on the spot.en: The interviewer put her on the spot by asking a tricky question about her past mistakes.
put sb on the spot.cn: 面试官通过询问她过去的错误这一棘手问题，让她陷入了被动。

put sb out of their misery.en: The manager informed the staff that layoffs were final, putting them out of their misery.
put sb out of their misery.cn: 经理告知员工裁员已成定局，让他们摆脱困境。

put sb out to grass.en: The company decided to put the veteran manager out to grass due to budget cuts.
put sb out to grass.cn: 公司因预算削减决定让这位资深经理离职。

put sb over your knee.en: He put the naughty toddler over his knee to give him a firm spanking.
put sb over your knee.cn: 他让那个顽皮的幼儿跨在自己的膝盖上，狠狠地打了一巴掌。

put sb through it.en: The harsh criticism really put him through it, leaving him speechless in front of everyone.
put sb through it.cn: 严厉的批评让他备受煎熬，令他在众人面前无言以对。

put sb through the mill.en: The new boss decided to put his underlings through the mill before they could relax.
put sb through the mill.cn: 新老板决定在下属放松之前先让他们经历一番考验。

put sb to death.en: The court finally put the notorious criminal to death after a lengthy trial.
put sb to death.cn: 法院在漫长的审判后，最终将这名臭名昭著的罪犯处以死刑。

put sb to flight.en: The sudden noise put the birds to flight, scattering them across the garden.
put sb to flight.cn: 突如其来的噪音惊起鸟儿，将它们驱散在花园各处。

put sb to rout.en: The new strategy put our competitors to rout, securing a decisive victory in the market.
put sb to rout.cn: 新策略使竞争对手溃败，确立了我们在市场的决定性胜利。

put sb to sth.en: Don't put me to the trouble of explaining it again.
put sb to sth.cn: 别再让我费心重复解释了。

put sb to the sword.en: The government decided to put the corrupt officials to the sword for their crimes.
put sb to the sword.cn: 政府决定对腐败官员处以极刑以抵偿其罪行。

put sb's nose out of joint.en: The manager put the junior staff's nose out of joint by ignoring their proposals.
put sb's nose out of joint.cn: 经理无视他们的建议，使初级员工大失所望。

put six over on sb.en: He managed to put six over on the investors by hiding critical data.
put six over on sb.cn: 他通过隐瞒关键数据，成功向投资者隐瞒了六项信息。

put sth behind you.en: You must put your past failures behind you to move forward.
put sth behind you.cn: 你必须将过去的失败抛在身后，才能继续前行。

put sth down to experience.en: He put his recent failures down to a lack of practical experience.
put sth down to experience.cn: 他将最近的失败归咎于缺乏实践经验。

put sth into operation.en: The government has finally put the new infrastructure project into operation.
put sth into operation.cn: 政府终于启动了新基建项目。

put sth to the torch.en: The company decided to put its old factory to the torch to make way for a new, more efficient plant.
put sth to the torch.cn: 该公司决定将旧工厂拆除，以便建设一座更高效的新厂房。

put sth towards sth.en: They decided to put every spare dollar towards buying a new car.
put sth towards sth.cn: 他们决定将每一笔积蓄都用于购买新车。

put the kibosh on sth.en: The sudden rain put a complete kibosh on our outdoor wedding plans.
put the kibosh on sth.cn: 突如其来的雨彻底取消了我们的户外婚礼计划。

put together.en: The team managed to put together a comprehensive report within the tight deadline.
put together.cn: 团队在紧迫期限内完成了综合报告。

put up or shut up.en: Either put up a concrete plan to solve this issue, or just shut up.
put up or shut up.cn: 要么拿出一个切实可行的解决方案来解决这个问题，要么就闭嘴。

put words into sb's mouth.en: The media often put words into politicians' mouths to create a false narrative.
put words into sb's mouth.cn: 媒体常替政客添油加醋，制造虚假叙事。

put years on sb.en: The constant stress has put years on her face, making her look decades older.
put years on sb.cn: 长期的压力使她面容苍老，看起来比实际年龄大得多。

put your back into sth.en: She put her entire heart and energy into winning the competition.
put your back into sth.cn: 她倾尽全部心血与精力去赢得比赛。

put your best foot forward.en: She decided to put her best foot forward during the crucial job interview.
put your best foot forward.cn: 她在关键的求职面试中决定表现最佳。

put your face on.en: She put her face on before the important interview to look more professional.
put your face on.cn: 她在重要面试前敷上面霜，以显得更专业。

put your feet up.en: After the exhausting meeting, she finally put her feet up on the sofa to rest.
put your feet up.cn: 会议结束后，她终于把脚搁在沙发上休息。

put your money where your mouth is.en: He finally put his money where his mouth was by launching the startup.
put your money where your mouth is.cn: 他终于通过创办初创企业兑现了自己的承诺。

put your shoulder to the wheel.en: We must put our shoulders to the wheel to finish this project on time.
put your shoulder to the wheel.cn: 我们必须全力以赴，确保项目按时完成。

put your thinking cap on.en: Before making that critical decision, please put your thinking cap on and analyze the data carefully.
put your thinking cap on.cn: 在做出这一关键决定之前，请戴上思考帽，仔细分析数据。

put yourself in sb's shoes.en: You should try to put yourself in her shoes before making that decision.
put yourself in sb's shoes.cn: 在做决定前，你应试着站在她的角度思考。

quick and dirty.en: We adopted a quick and dirty solution to fix the server crash immediately.
quick and dirty.cn: 我们采用了一种快速简便的方案来立即修复服务器崩溃问题。

quids in.en: The company made a fortune from the deal, earning thousands of quids in.
quids in.cn: 该公司从该交易中获利丰厚，赚取了数千英镑。

quite the contrary.en: That is quite the contrary, as my recent research proves.
quite the contrary.cn: 恰恰相反，正如我近期的研究证明的那样。

raise hell.en: The students raised hell when they discovered the exam had been cancelled.
raise hell.cn: 学生们发现考试取消后大闹一场。

raise sb's hackles.en: The politician's inflammatory speech immediately raised the crowd's hackles.
raise sb's hackles.cn: 该政治家的煽动性言论立刻激起了人群的愤怒。

raise sb's spirits.en: The team captain raised everyone's spirits with an inspiring speech.
raise sb's spirits.cn: 队长发表鼓舞人心的讲话，振奋了全队士气。

raise the roof.en: The kids raised the roof in the living room, making it impossible for anyone to hear us.
raise the roof.cn: 孩子们把客厅闹得沸反盈天，让我们无法说话。

rant and rave.en: The protesters began to rant and rave against the government's new policies.
rant and rave.cn: 抗议者开始猛烈抨击政府的新政策。

rather than.en: We should prioritize health rather than chasing material wealth.
rather than.cn: 我们应优先关注健康，而非追逐物质财富。

rattle sb's cage.en: The persistent noise from the construction crew finally rattled the manager's cage.
rattle sb's cage.cn: 施工队持续的噪音终于惊动了经理。

reach for the stars.en: She reached for the stars, determined to conquer her lifelong dream.
reach for the stars.cn: 她伸手摘星，决心实现毕生梦想。

read between the lines.en: You must read between the lines to understand his true feelings.
read between the lines.cn: 要读懂他真正的想法，必须透过字里行间去体会。

read my lips.en: Please read my lips carefully before you make any decision.
read my lips.cn: 在做出任何决定前，请仔细听我说话。

read on.en: Please read on to discover the fascinating details hidden within these pages.
read on.cn: 继续阅读，即可发现这些页面中隐藏的迷人细节。

read sb like a book.en: I can read her like a book; she never hides her true feelings.
read sb like a book.cn: 我读她就像读书，她从不掩饰真情实感。

read sth into sth.en: Don't read too much meaning into his silence, as he might just be quiet.
read sth into sth.cn: 不要过度解读他的沉默，他可能只是安静。

ready to roll.en: The team is ready to roll and will launch the project immediately.
ready to roll.cn: 团队已整装待发，将立即启动项目。

recharge your batteries.en: You should take a short vacation to recharge your batteries before the next project.
recharge your batteries.cn: 在下一个项目开始前，你应该去度个短假以恢复精力。

redress the balance.en: We must redress the balance to ensure fair treatment for all stakeholders.
redress the balance.cn: 我们必须平衡各方利益，确保对所有相关方公平对待。

reduce sth to sth.en: The complex theory was reduced to a simple formula that everyone could understand.
reduce sth to sth.cn: 该复杂理论被简化为人人都能理解的公式。

reinvent the wheel.en: We shouldn't reinvent the wheel when better solutions already exist.
reinvent the wheel.cn: 既然已有更优方案，我们就不必重复造轮子。

relatively speaking.en: Relatively speaking, this is a minor issue compared to the others.
relatively speaking.cn: 相对而言，这与其他问题相比是个小问题。

ride the crest of sth.en: The company is currently riding the crest of its rapid expansion.
ride the crest of sth.cn: 该公司目前正乘其快速扩张之势。

riding a horse.en: She enjoys riding a horse in the countryside every weekend.
riding a horse.cn: 她每逢周末都在乡间骑马。

right enough.en: It is right enough that the team finally secured the championship after years of struggle.
right enough.cn: 经过多年挣扎，球队终于夺得冠军，实至名归。

right on.en: That analysis is absolutely right on, and it perfectly captures the core issue.
right on.cn: 该分析完全正确，精准地揭示了核心问题。

ring a bell.en: That phrase didn't ring a bell for me at all.

ring in sth.en: We will ring in the New Year with a grand celebration at midnight.
ring in sth.cn: 午夜我们将举行盛大的庆祝活动迎接新年。

ring out.en: The bell rang out clearly, signaling the start of our morning assembly.
ring out.cn: 钟声清晰响起，标志着我们早会的开始。

roaring drunk.en: He started roaring drunk, shouting insults at everyone in the bar.
roaring drunk.cn: 他醉得开始咆哮，在酒吧里向众人辱骂。

rob sb blind.en: The con artist managed to rob the elderly couple blind by exploiting their trust.
rob sb blind.cn: 骗子利用这对老夫妇的信任，使其蒙受损失。

root and branch.en: We must address the problem root and branch to ensure lasting success.
root and branch.cn: 必须从根本上解决问题，以确保持久的成功。

rooted to the spot.en: He was rooted to the spot, staring in disbelief at the sudden change.
rooted to the spot.cn: 他呆立在原地，难以置信地凝视着那突如其来的变化。

rough edges.en: The house has some rough edges, but it's still a lovely place to live.
rough edges.cn: 这房子虽有些瑕疵，但仍是宜居之所。

round here.en: Have you seen the new exhibition round here in the city centre?
round here.cn: 市中心新开的展览你看过吗？

rub salt into sb's wounds.en: The new data only rubs salt into the wound of our previous failures.
rub salt into sb's wounds.cn: 新数据只是往我们之前的失败上又撒了一把盐。

rub sb's nose in it.en: He kept rubbing her nose in her past mistakes to hurt her feelings.
rub sb's nose in it.cn: 他不断提醒她过去的错误，以此伤害她的感情。

ruined or badly damaged.en: The storm left the coastal village completely ruined, with many houses badly damaged by the high winds.
ruined or badly damaged.cn: 风暴使沿海村庄完全毁于一旦，许多房屋遭强风严重损毁。

run a tight ship.en: The CEO runs the company like a well-oiled machine, keeping every department under strict control.
run a tight ship.cn: 首席执行官将公司运作得像一台精密运转的机器，对各部门实施严格管控。

run afoul of sth.en: The new policy runs afoul of the existing regulations and needs revision.
run afoul of sth.cn: 该新政策与现行规定相抵触，需修订。

run amok.en: The crowd began to run amok when the security guard tried to stop them.
run amok.cn: 当保安试图阻止他们时，人群开始乱跑。

run away from sth.en: He tried to run away from the responsibility of leading the team.
run away from sth.cn: 他试图逃避领导团队的责任。

run away with you.en: The situation ran away with me, leaving me completely out of control.
run away with you.cn: 局势失控，令我完全无法掌控。

run back over sth.en: I need to run back over the proposal before we finalize it.
run back over sth.cn: 在最终定稿前，我需要再仔细审阅一遍这份提案。

run before you can walk.en: He tried to run before he could even walk properly.
run before you can walk.cn: 他试图在学会正常走路之前奔跑。

run dry.en: The well finally ran dry after the prolonged drought.
run dry.cn: 久旱之后，水井终于干涸了。

run in the family.en: It runs in the family, as my father and uncle both became doctors.
run in the family.cn: 这在我们家很常见，因为我父亲和叔叔都成了医生。

run into sb.en: I unexpectedly ran into my former colleague at the airport yesterday.
run into sb.cn: 昨天我在机场意外遇到了前同事。

run off with sth.en: He tried to run off with the company's funds during the audit.
run off with sth.cn: 他在审计期间试图携公司公款潜逃。

run on.en: The project has been running on for months without any sign of completion.
run on.cn: 该项目已运行数月，毫无完工迹象。

run out of steam.en: After the marathon, he ran out of steam and could barely walk.
run out of steam.cn: 马拉松结束后，他筋疲力尽，几乎无法行走。

run over.en: The sudden rain caused the river to run over its banks, flooding the nearby fields.
run over.cn: 突降暴雨致河水漫堤，淹没附近农田。

run over sth.en: I'll run over the key points from our meeting to ensure everyone understands.
run over sth.cn: 我将概述会议要点，以确保大家理解无误。

run risks.en: The company decided to run risks by launching a new product in an untested market.
run risks.cn: 该公司决定在未经验证的市场推出新产品以冒风险。

run round in circles.en: The team kept running round in circles, yet no real progress was made on the project.
run round in circles.cn: 团队仍在原地打转，项目却毫无进展。

run sb ragged.en: The relentless schedule has run me ragged, leaving me exhausted.
run sb ragged.cn: 繁重的日程安排让我精疲力竭。

run the gauntlet.en: The controversial policy faced a run the gauntlet from critics across the political spectrum.
run the gauntlet.cn: 这项有争议的政策遭到来自政治光谱各方的批评者严厉抨击。

run up against sth.en: The startup ran up against unexpected regulatory hurdles last quarter.
run up against sth.cn: 该公司上季度遭遇突发的监管障碍。

run with sth.en: The team decided to run with the new strategy despite initial doubts.
run with sth.cn: 尽管起初存疑，团队仍决定采用新策略推进。

safe in the knowledge that.en: She felt safe in the knowledge that her team would win.
safe in the knowledge that.cn: 她确信团队会获胜而感到安心。

safety first.en: In the event of a fire, we must strictly adhere to the principle that safety comes first.
safety first.cn: 发生火灾时，我们必须坚持安全第一的原则。

sail close to the wind.en: He decided to sail close to the wind by selling his house at a steep discount.
sail close to the wind.cn: 他决定以大幅折扣出售房屋，以此逆风航行。

same difference.en: The two approaches yield the same difference in results, making them practically equivalent.
same difference.cn: 这两种方法产生的结果差异相同，因此在实践中是等价的。

same here.en: I have to admit that I feel exactly the same way.
same here.cn: 我不得不承认，我的感受完全一样。

save your breath.en: It's pointless to save your breath arguing with someone who won't listen.
save your breath.cn: 与不愿倾听的人争辩是徒劳的，何必白费口舌？

say cheese.en: Before taking the photo, he asked everyone to say cheese and smile.
say cheese.cn: 拍照前，他让大家说“茄子”并微笑。

say no more.en: I already knew that; you really don't need to say no more.
say no more.cn: 我早已知晓；你无需再多言。

say when.en: Please say when you're full so we can stop serving the food immediately.
say when.cn: 请告诉我们您已吃饱，以便我们立即停止上菜。

say your piece.en: He finally said his piece and left the room without a second thought.
say your piece.cn: 他终于说完话，便不再多想地离开了房间。

sb can not help but do sth.en: He could not help but laugh when he saw his own silly mistake.
sb can not help but do sth.cn: 看到自己那愚蠢的错误，他忍不住笑了。

sb had a good innings.en: It's truly fitting that he lived long enough to have a good innings before passing away.
sb had a good innings.cn: 他得以长寿，在离世前拥有了一个圆满的职业生涯，这真是再合适不过了。

sb has a face like thunder.en: He walked into the room with a face like thunder, glaring at everyone.
sb has a face like thunder.cn: 他满面怒容地走进房间，瞪着众人。

sb has arrived.en: The project has finally arrived, marking a major success for the team.
sb has arrived.cn: 项目终于完成，标志着团队取得重大成功。

sb will not do sth again in a hurry.en: He said he would never do that again in a hurry.
sb will not do sth again in a hurry.cn: 他说再也不急匆匆那样做了。

sb won't thank you for sth.en: He won't thank you for telling him that he made a mistake.
sb won't thank you for sth.cn: 他不会感谢你指出他的错误。

sb's advanced age.en: His advanced age made it difficult for him to keep up with the fast-paced work environment.
sb's advanced age.cn: 他年事已高，难以跟上快节奏的工作环境。

sb's bark is worse than their bite.en: His angry words are just as loud as his bark, yet his heart remains soft and kind.
sb's bark is worse than their bite.cn: 他愤怒的话语虽如吠声般响亮，内心却依旧温柔善良。

sb's creature.en: The dictator treated his ministers merely as his puppets, manipulating them without regard for their own will.
sb's creature.cn: 独裁者将大臣视为傀儡，完全不顾他们的意愿加以操纵。

sb's declining years.en: His declining years were marked by a gradual loss of memory and mobility.
sb's declining years.cn: 他晚年记忆力与行动能力逐渐衰退。

sb's ears are burning.en: She felt her ears burning as she heard colleagues whispering about her behind her back.
sb's ears are burning.cn: 她听到同事们在背后议论自己时，感到耳朵发烫。

sb's eyes are bigger than their stomach.en: His appetite is far greater than his ability to digest the food he eats.
sb's eyes are bigger than their stomach.cn: 他的胃口远大于消化所食食物的能力。

sb's face doesn't fit.en: His face simply does not fit the role he is expected to play in this high-stakes negotiation.
sb's face doesn't fit.cn: 他的面容完全不适合他在这场高风险谈判中扮演的角色。

sb's gorge rises.en: Seeing the corruption, her gorge rose with disgust at his actions.
sb's gorge rises.cn: 目睹他的所作所为，她感到恶心，胃中翻腾。

sb's hackles rise.en: When the manager heard the bad news, his hackles rose instantly.
sb's hackles rise.cn: 经理听到这个坏消息时，顿时勃然大怒。

sb's heart is in the right place.en: He might have made a mistake, but his heart is truly in the right place.
sb's heart is in the right place.cn: 他或许犯了错，但他的心意是好的。

sb's heart is in their mouth.en: Her heart was pounding so hard she felt like it might jump out of her mouth.
sb's heart is in their mouth.cn: 她的心跳得如此剧烈，仿佛要从嘴里跳出来。

sb's heart leaps.en: When she saw the invitation, her heart leaped with pure joy.
sb's heart leaps.cn: 她看到请柬时，心中涌起纯粹的喜悦。

sb's heart misses a beat.en: When she heard the shocking news, her heart missed a beat with sudden fear.
sb's heart misses a beat.cn: 当她听到这个惊人的消息时，心中突然涌起一阵恐惧，心跳漏了一拍。

sb's heart sinks.en: When the bad news arrived, his heart sank instantly.
sb's heart sinks.cn: 噩耗传来，他顿时心如死灰。

sb's name is mud.en: His reputation as a corrupt official has made his name synonymous with scandal.
sb's name is mud.cn: 他作为腐败官员的声誉，使其名字与丑闻成为同义词。

sb's pride and joy.en: The young couple's first child has become their absolute pride and joy.
sb's pride and joy.cn: 这对年轻夫妇的第一个孩子成了他们最大的骄傲和快乐。

sb's waters break.en: Her waters broke suddenly, signaling that her labor was about to begin.
sb's waters break.cn: 她突然感到羊水破裂，预示分娩即将开始。

sb's word is their bond.en: Her word remains the strongest bond, proving she keeps every promise without fail.
sb's word is their bond.cn: 她的话语仍是维系关系的纽带，证明她言出必行。

scare sb into doing sth.en: The news scared him into confessing his crimes immediately.
scare sb into doing sth.cn: 这消息吓得他立即供认了罪行。

scare sb shitless.en: The sudden thunderstorm scared the children shitless, causing them to hide under their blankets.
scare sb shitless.cn: 突如其来的雷暴吓得孩子们魂飞魄散，躲进了被窝里。

seal sth in sth.en: The government sealed the treaty in a historic ceremony.
seal sth in sth.cn: 政府在一个具有历史意义的仪式上签署了该条约。

search me.en: I cannot search me; I have absolutely no idea what the answer is.
search me.cn: 我无法自我审视；我完全不知道答案是什么。

season's greetings.en: The card arrived just in time for our Christmas season's greetings exchange.
season's greetings.cn: 卡片恰好在我们的圣诞问候交换时送达。

secretly or illegally.en: He secretly stole the company's funds and sold them illegally to cover his debts.
secretly or illegally.cn: 他秘密窃取公司资金并非法变卖以偿还债务。

see about sth.en: I'll see about arranging a meeting with the client for next week.
see about sth.cn: 我将安排下周与客户会面。

see for yourself.en: You should see the data for yourself to verify the results.
see for yourself.cn: 请自行查看数据以验证结果。

see sense.en: After years of confusion, he finally saw sense in his own mistakes.
see sense.cn: 历经多年困惑，他终于看清了自己错误的本质。

see stars.en: After the car crash, he hit his head and immediately saw stars.
see stars.cn: 车祸后他撞到了头，眼前顿时一片漆黑。

see sth coming.en: You can see the storm coming if you notice the dark clouds gathering.
see sth coming.cn: 若留意到乌云聚集，便可预见风暴将至。

see sth out of the corner of your eye.en: I saw her leaving from the corner of my eye, but I wasn't sure if she had actually gone.
see sth out of the corner of your eye.cn: 我从余光中看见她走了，但不确定她是否真的离开了。

see the colour of sb's money.en: Before signing the contract, we need to see the colour of his money.
see the colour of sb's money.cn: 签约前，我们需要了解他的资金来源。

see the world.en: Having seen the world, she now understands diverse cultures better.
see the world.cn: 阅尽世事后，她更懂得包容多元文化。

see to sth.en: You should see to the paperwork before the meeting starts.
see to sth.cn: 会议开始前务必处理完文书工作。

see which way the wind is blowing.en: We need to see which way the wind is blowing before making any final decisions.
see which way the wind is blowing.cn: 在做出任何最终决定之前，我们需要看清风向。

see you later.en: I'll see you later at the conference tomorrow morning.
see you later.cn: 明天上午会议结束后我再联系你。

seeing is believing.en: You can't truly understand the damage until you actually see it yourself.
seeing is believing.cn: 唯有亲眼目睹，方能真正了解其造成的破坏。

seek your fortune.en: After years of studying abroad, she finally decided to seek her fortune in the bustling tech industry.
seek your fortune.cn: 多年留学后，她终于决定投身于繁忙的科技产业寻求发展。

sell sb down the river.en: He sold his friend down the river by betraying his trust during their crisis.
sell sb down the river.cn: 他在危机中背叛朋友的信任，将其出卖。

sell your body.en: She decided to sell her body for money, which shocked everyone.
sell your body.cn: 她决定出卖身体换取钱财，此举令众人震惊。

send for sb.en: The police sent for an expert to investigate the suspicious incident.
send for sb.cn: 警方请来专家调查这起可疑事件。

send for sth.en: The manager sent for a specialist to fix the complex machinery immediately.
send for sth.cn: 经理立即派人修理那台复杂的机器。

send out for sth.en: I'll send out for dinner so we can enjoy a meal at home tonight.
send out for sth.cn: 今晚我出去买些食材，以便在家享用晚餐。

send sb packing.en: The manager decided to send the disruptive employee packing immediately.
send sb packing.cn: 经理决定立即让这名扰乱秩序的雇员收拾东西离开。

set off.en: The family set off early in the morning to reach the destination before noon.
set off.cn: 家人清晨出发，中午前抵达目的地。

set sb against sb.en: Don't set your brother against me by spreading those rumors.
set sb against sb.cn: 别散布谣言让我与兄弟反目。

set sth in train.en: The committee has set the new policy in train to ensure better service.
set sth in train.cn: 委员会已着手实施新政策，以确保服务更优。

set the stage for sth.en: The new policy set the stage for a significant economic recovery next year.
set the stage for sth.cn: 新政策为明年的显著经济复苏奠定了基础。

set tongues wagging.en: His controversial remarks immediately set tongues wagging across the city.
set tongues wagging.cn: 他那些争议性的言论立刻让全城人议论纷纷。

set up house.en: After graduating, they decided to set up house in a quiet suburb near the city.
set up house.cn: 毕业后，他们决定在城郊一个安静的地方安家。

set up shop.en: After years of planning, the startup finally set up shop in a bustling downtown district.
set up shop.cn: 经过多年筹备，这家初创公司终于在繁华的市中心开设了店铺。

set your mind on sth.en: She finally set her mind on becoming a top surgeon despite the challenges.
set your mind on sth.cn: 尽管面临诸多挑战，她最终下定决心成为一名顶尖外科医生。

settle an old score.en: They decided to settle an old score by exposing his secret.
settle an old score.cn: 他们决定通过揭露他的秘密来报复旧怨。

settle for sth.en: He decided to settle for a smaller apartment rather than wait indefinitely.
settle for sth.cn: 他决定租一套较小的公寓，而不是无限期等待。

settle on sth.en: After weeks of debate, the committee finally settled on a new policy.
settle on sth.cn: 经过数周的辩论，委员会最终确定了一项新政策。

shake a leg.en: Come on, let's shake a leg before the meeting starts late.
shake a leg.cn: 快点，会议快迟到了，我们动身吧。

shake in your shoes.en: The thought of failing the exam made her shake in her shoes with sheer terror.
shake in your shoes.cn: 想到考试不及格，她吓得浑身发抖。

shake on sth.en: Before signing the contract, we decided to shake on it to ensure mutual trust and commitment.
shake on sth.cn: 签约前，我们握手言和，以确保互信与承诺。

share and share alike.en: The bill must be shared and shared alike among all four of us.
share and share alike.cn: 账单必须由我们四人平均分担。

she'll be right.en: Don't worry, she'll be right and everything will turn out fine soon.
she'll be right.cn: 别担心，她会好起来的，一切很快就会好转。

shift your ground.en: During the heated debate, she decided to shift her ground and support the opposing view.
shift your ground.cn: 在激烈的辩论中，她改变立场，转而支持对方面对的观点。

shit happens.en: Sometimes shit happens, so we must remain calm and adapt quickly to unexpected challenges.
shit happens.cn: 世事无常，我们务必保持冷静，迅速适应突如其来的挑战。

shock horror.en: He pretended to be shocked by the news, but it was just a shock horror act.
shock horror.cn: 他对这消息装作震惊，不过那只是吓人的表演。

shoot from the hip.en: Don't shoot from the hip; we need to verify the facts first before making any public statements.
shoot from the hip.cn: 切勿信口开河；在核实事实之前，我们不应发表任何公开声明。

shoot the messenger.en: Instead of addressing the root cause, they chose to shoot the messenger by blaming the intern.
shoot the messenger.cn: 他们未究其根本原因，反而通过指责实习生来推卸责任。

shoot the rapids.en: The rafters careened violently as they shot the rapids, splashing water everywhere.
shoot the rapids.cn: 船舱剧烈颠簸，随着船只冲过激流，水花四溅。

shoot yourself in the foot.en: He accidentally signed the contract with his own name, effectively shooting himself in the foot.
shoot yourself in the foot.cn: 他用自己的名字签署了合同，无异于自掘坟墓。

short and sweet.en: Let's keep the conversation short and sweet, focusing on the main points.
short and sweet.cn: 让我们简明扼要地讨论重点。

shove it.en: He just shoved it when I asked him to help with the project.
shove it.cn: 当我请他帮忙时，他只是把这事推脱了。

show sb the door.en: The manager showed the client out, effectively ending their meeting.
show sb the door.cn: 经理将客户送出，会议随之结束。

show sb who's boss.en: She finally showed him who's boss by refusing to apologize for his rude behavior.
show sb who's boss.cn: 她通过拒绝为他的粗鲁行为道歉，让他见识到了自己的地位。

show the way.en: The teacher showed us the way to solve this complex problem step by step.
show the way.cn: 老师向我们展示了分步解决这个复杂问题的方法。

show your face.en: He finally decided to show his face at the conference after years of silence.
show your face.cn: 他在多年沉默后，终于决定在会议上露面。

show your paces.en: You should show your paces by delivering a flawless performance in the competition.
show your paces.cn: 你应在比赛中以完美表现展示你的实力。

shrink from sth.en: He always shrinks from facing the difficult questions in class.
shrink from sth.cn: 他总回避在课堂上回答难题。

shut sb up.en: The teacher immediately shut the noisy student up to restore order in the classroom.
shut sb up.cn: 老师立刻制止了那个吵闹的学生以恢复课堂秩序。

shut sth in sth.en: The door shut the handle in its frame, making it impossible to open.
shut sth in sth.cn: 门把手被关在门框内，无法打开。

shut yourself away.en: She shut herself away in her room to avoid the noisy crowd.
shut yourself away.cn: 她把自己关在房间里，以避免嘈杂的人群。

sick at heart.en: I am sick at heart to see my hard work wasted on such a trivial project.
sick at heart.cn: 见我的心血付诸如此琐碎的项目，心中深感悲恸。

sight unseen.en: The company approved the project sight unseen, despite the lack of prior inspection.
sight unseen.cn: 尽管此前未进行检验，该公司仍批准了该项目。

silence is golden.en: Sometimes silence is golden, as speaking up might only escalate the conflict further.
silence is golden.cn: 有时沉默是金，因为开口说话只会使冲突进一步升级。

sing a different tune.en: He suddenly changed his mind and started singing a completely different tune.
sing a different tune.cn: 他突然改变了主意，开始唱起完全不同的曲子。

sing out.en: She finally sang out her name to the entire crowd.
sing out.cn: 她终于向全场喊出了自己的名字。

sink into sth.en: He sank into a deep depression after losing his job.
sink into sth.cn: 他失业后陷入深深的抑郁。

sink or swim.en: You must either sink or swim if you want to survive in this fiercely competitive industry.
sink or swim.cn: 若想在竞争激烈的行业中生存，你必须要么沉下去，要么游起来。

sink sth into sth.en: The company decided to sink its capital into the new technology project.
sink sth into sth.cn: 公司决定将资本投入新技术项目。

sink to sth.en: The team sank to the bottom of the league after losing all their final matches.
sink to sth.cn: 该队在输掉所有决赛后跌至联赛垫底。

sink your differences.en: Let's sink our differences and focus on the shared goals ahead.
sink your differences.cn: 让我们搁置分歧，共同致力于未来的目标。

sit at sb's feet.en: She finally sat at his feet, completely captivated by his wisdom and leadership.
sit at sb's feet.cn: 她终于坐在他脚边，完全被他智慧与领导力所折服。

sit by.en: They sat by and watched the fire spread without taking any action.
sit by.cn: 他们坐在一旁看着火势蔓延，却未采取任何行动。

sit down and do sth.en: Sit down and focus on finishing this challenging report before dinner.
sit down and do sth.cn: 坐下，在晚餐前集中精力完成这份有挑战性的报告。

sit in for sb.en: She sat in for her brother during his unexpected hospitalization.
sit in for sb.cn: 她代兄在突发住院期间照料。

sit in on sth.en: She sat in on the board meeting to better understand the company's strategic direction.
sit in on sth.cn: 她列席董事会会议，以便更好地了解公司的战略方向。

sit on the fence.en: He kept sitting on the fence until he received a clear offer from both companies.
sit on the fence.cn: 他迟迟未做决定，直到两家公司都给出了明确的报价。

sit sb up.en: The doctor sat the patient up to help him breathe more easily.
sit sb up.cn: 医生让病人坐起来以便他呼吸更顺畅。

sit through sth.en: She managed to sit through the entire three-hour lecture without falling asleep.
sit through sth.cn: 她坚持听完整个三小时的讲座，没有睡着。

six of the old school.en: He is still six of the old school, refusing to accept any new technology.
six of the old school.cn: 他仍固守旧派，拒绝接受任何新技术。

six of those days.en: It's been six of those days, with nothing going right.

skate over sth.en: He tried to skate over the issue of his financial mismanagement.
skate over sth.cn: 他试图回避其财务不善的问题。

skip it.en: Let's just skip it; the whole topic is too sensitive to discuss right now.
skip it.cn: 暂且跳过吧；这个话题眼下太过敏感，不宜讨论。

slap and tickle.en: They spent the evening just slapping and tickling each other in a playful embrace.
slap and tickle.cn: 他们相拥嬉戏，互相拍打逗弄，度过了一整晚。

sleep in.en: He decided to sleep in today because he had a very early meeting tomorrow.
sleep in.cn: 他决定今天补觉，因为明天有个很早的会议。

sleep over.en: We decided to sleep over at her place because the movie marathon was so exhausting.
sleep over.cn: 因电影马拉松太过累人，我们决定去她家过夜。

sleep tight.en: I hope you sleep tight and have a restful night's rest.
sleep tight.cn: 愿你夜夜好眠，安享宁静之夜。

slip one over on sb.en: He tried to slip a secret deal over on his partner, but she saw through it immediately.
slip one over on sb.cn: 他试图向合伙人隐瞒秘密交易，但她立刻识破了。

slip out.en: He accidentally slipped out that he was planning to resign.
slip out.cn: 他不小心透露了自己打算辞职的计划。

slip through the net.en: Some evidence slipped through the net, leaving investigators puzzled.
slip through the net.cn: 部分证据未被察觉，令调查人员感到困惑。

slip your mind.en: Don't let the details slip your mind before the meeting.
slip your mind.cn: 别让细节在会议前从你脑海中溜走。

slowly but surely.en: The project will be completed slowly but surely by the end of the year.
slowly but surely.cn: 该项目将于年底前缓慢而肯定地完成。

slug it out.en: Let's slug it out in the final match to see who truly takes the lead.
slug it out.cn: 让我们通过最后一场比赛决出胜负，看谁真正领先。

slum it.en: We decided to slum it in this tiny apartment until we saved enough for a proper home.
slum it.cn: 我们决定在这间小公寓将就着住下去，直到攒够钱买下真正的家。

smell a rat.en: The deal seemed perfect until I started to smell a rat.
smell a rat.cn: 这桩交易看似完美，直到我开始察觉不对劲。

snap to it.en: You should snap to it and finish the report before noon.
snap to it.cn: 请立刻着手完成报告，务必在中午前交稿。

snap your fingers.en: She snapped her fingers to signal the band to start playing immediately.
snap your fingers.cn: 她打了个响指示意乐队立即演奏。

sniff at sth.en: He only sniffs at the proposal, showing no real interest in its potential benefits.
sniff at sth.cn: 他对该提议只是略加闻问，并未表现出对其潜在利益的任何真实兴趣。

so as to do sth.en: He studied hard so as to achieve his goal in the upcoming competition.
so as to do sth.cn: 他刻苦学习，以期在即将到来的比赛中实现目标。

so be it.en: So be it, for I have accepted his decision without any further protest.
so be it.cn: 如此吧，我已接受他的决定，不再有任何抗议。

so far.en: So far, the project has exceeded all our initial expectations.
so far.cn: 迄今为止，该项目已超出我们最初的预期。

so the story goes.en: So the story goes, he vanished into thin air without leaving a trace.
so the story goes.cn: 于是人们传言，他凭空消失，未留任何踪迹。

so to speak.en: He is, so to speak, a walking encyclopedia of local history.
so to speak.cn: 可以说，他是一位活着的本地历史百科全书。

sob your heart out.en: She sobbed her heart out after hearing the tragic news about her lost pet.
sob your heart out.cn: 听到她丢失的爱宠遭遇不幸的消息后，她哭得肝肠寸断。

sometimes good and sometimes bad.en: The weather is sometimes good and sometimes bad, making travel plans difficult.
sometimes good and sometimes bad.cn: 天气时而晴朗时而恶劣，使出行计划难以安排。

sooner or later.en: Sooner or later, the truth will come out and everyone will know.
sooner or later.cn: 迟早真相大白，人人都知道。

sooner rather than later.en: It is always better to act sooner rather than later when facing a critical decision.
sooner rather than later.cn: 面对重大抉择时，尽早行动总比拖延要好。

sour grapes.en: He dismissed the job offer as worthless, though he clearly envied his colleague's success.
sour grapes.cn: 他视这份工作为毫无价值，尽管显然嫉妒同事的成功。

sow the seeds of sth.en: The scandal sowed the seeds of distrust among the public, leading to a loss of faith in the institution.
sow the seeds of sth.cn: 该丑闻在公众中播下了不信任的种子，导致对该机构失去信心。

speak for yourself.en: You can't speak for yourself; your opinion doesn't represent everyone else's views.
speak for yourself.cn: 你不能代表自己说话；你的观点不能代表其他人的看法。

speak out of turn.en: He spoke out of turn by criticizing the proposal before the meeting concluded.
speak out of turn.cn: 他在会议结束前就提议提出批评，属于越俎代庖。

speak up.en: Could you please speak up? I can't quite hear you over the noise.
speak up.cn: 请您提高音量，我受噪音干扰听不清您的话。

speak your mind.en: It is time we spoke our minds and stopped hiding behind polite excuses.
speak your mind.cn: 是时候直言不讳，不再以礼貌为借口掩饰真相了。

speaking as sth.en: Speaking as a long-time customer, I must admit the service was exceptional.
speaking as sth.cn: 作为一名老顾客，我必须承认服务非常卓越。

special or specific.en: The hospital requires special equipment for this specific surgical procedure.
special or specific.cn: 该手术需配备专用设备。

spend a penny.en: He decided to spend a penny before heading out for the long drive.
spend a penny.cn: 出发前他决定先花一块钱。

spill the beans.en: The candidate accidentally spilled the beans about his secret plan during the interview.
spill the beans.cn: 该候选人在面试中不慎泄露了他的秘密计划。

spit it out.en: Don't hold back; just spit it out if you have any concerns about the project.
spit it out.cn: 如有项目方面的顾虑，请直言不讳。

split an infinitive.en: Critics often advise avoiding split infinitives, yet many writers use them for better rhythm.
split an infinitive.cn: 批评家常建议避免分裂不定式，但许多作家却为追求更好的节奏而使用它们。

split hairs.en: We shouldn't split hairs over such trivial details when we need to focus on the main issue.
split hairs.cn: 当我们需要关注主要问题时，不应纠缠于这些无关紧要的细节。

split sb up.en: The couple's relationship was split up by their parents' constant interference.
split sb up.cn: 这对情侣的关系因父母不断的干涉而破裂。

split the difference.en: They decided to split the difference between their conflicting proposals.
split the difference.cn: 他们决定折中处理彼此的意见分歧。

spread the word.en: She decided to spread the word about her new job opening.
spread the word.cn: 她决定宣传她的新职位空缺。

spread your net.en: You should spread your net to catch all possible candidates for the job.
spread your net.cn: 应扩大招聘范围，以吸纳所有可能的求职者。

spread your wings.en: You should spread your wings and try new challenges with confidence.
spread your wings.cn: 请展翅翱翔，自信地迎接新的挑战。

spread yourself too thin.en: Don't spread yourself too thin by trying to manage every project simultaneously.
spread yourself too thin.cn: 切勿试图同时管理所有项目而让自己精力分散。

spy out the land.en: Before launching their campaign, they decided to spy out the land to assess potential risks.
spy out the land.cn: 在发动运动之前，他们决定勘察地形以评估潜在风险。

squeeze sb dry.en: The interviewer squeezed the candidate dry, extracting every detail about his past experience.
squeeze sb dry.cn: 面试官对候选人穷追不舍，榨干了他关于过往经历的所有细节。

stab sb in the back.en: He stabbed his loyal colleague in the back by stealing her project credit.
stab sb in the back.cn: 他通过窃取她的项目功劳，从背后伤害了这位忠诚的同事。

stand by sb.en: The government must stand by its people during this crisis.
stand by sb.cn: 政府必须在此危机中支持人民。

stand by sth.en: Despite the delay, he decided to stand by his promise and deliver the project on time.
stand by sth.cn: 尽管延误，他仍坚持履行承诺，如期交付项目。

stand on your dignity.en: She demanded that the officials stand on her dignity by respecting her age.
stand on your dignity.cn: 她要求官员们尊重她的年龄，维护她的尊严。

stand over sb.en: The security guard stood over the suspect to ensure he remained under strict surveillance.
stand over sb.cn: 保安站在嫌疑人身旁，确保其处于严密监视之下。

stand sb in good stead.en: Having a backup plan will stand you in good stead if the project fails.
stand sb in good stead.cn: 若项目失败，有备选方案将大有裨益。

stand the test of time.en: This classic design has successfully stood the test of time.
stand the test of time.cn: 这款经典设计历经时间考验。

stand up.en: The students stood up when the teacher asked them to answer.
stand up.cn: 老师提问时，学生们站了起来。

stand up and be counted.en: We must stand up and be counted, supporting every policy that protects our community.
stand up and be counted.cn: 我们必须挺身而出，支持所有保护我们社区的政策。

stand up to sb.en: The team stood up to the bully and refused to accept his unfair treatment.
stand up to sb.cn: 该团队挺身而出对抗欺凌者，拒绝接受其不公平对待。

stars in your eyes.en: She still has the stars in her eyes, dreaming of becoming a famous actress.
stars in your eyes.cn: 她眼中仍闪烁着星光，梦想着成为一名著名演员。

start something.en: He started a scandal by spreading rumors about his colleague's private life.
start something.cn: 他通过散布关于同事私生活的谣言制造了丑闻。

stay in.en: The doctor advised me to stay in and rest until my fever subsides.
stay in.cn: 医生建议我留在家中休息，直到退烧。

stay on.en: We decided to stay on and finish the remaining project before leaving.
stay on.cn: 我们决定留下来，在离开前完成剩余的项目。

stay over.en: We decided to stay over at her place because the hotel was too far.
stay over.cn: 我们决定在她家过夜，因为酒店太远。

stay put.en: The storm is too severe, so we must all stay put until it passes.
stay put.cn: 风暴太猛烈了，我们必须原地待命，直到它过去。

stay the course.en: Despite the setbacks, she decided to stay the course and finish her marathon.
stay the course.cn: 尽管遭遇挫折，她仍坚持完成马拉松比赛。

stay up.en: She decided to stay up late to finish her research paper before morning.
stay up.cn: 她决定熬夜，在清晨前完成研究论文。

stay your hand.en: He finally stayed his hand and didn't interrupt the speaker's passionate argument.
stay your hand.cn: 他终于忍住了，没有打断那位演讲者激情的论述。

steal sb's heart.en: She stole his heart with her gentle smile and kind words.
steal sb's heart.cn: 她以温柔的微笑和善意的话语俘获了他的心。

steal sb's thunder.en: He tried to steal his brother's thunder by announcing the news first.
steal sb's thunder.cn: 他抢先宣布消息，试图抢走哥哥的风头。

steep sth in sth.en: She steeped the herbs in hot water for twenty minutes to extract their flavor.
steep sth in sth.cn: 她将草药在热水中浸泡二十分钟以提取其风味。

steering a boat or ship.en: She is steering a small boat across the choppy sea at dawn.
steering a boat or ship.cn: 黎明时分，她正驾驶着小船在波涛汹涌的海面上航行。

stick at sth.en: She decided to stick at her research until she finally solved the complex problem.
stick at sth.cn: 她坚持进行研究，直至最终解决了那个复杂的问题。

stick out.en: The red flag stood out vividly against the dark, stormy sky.
stick out.cn: 红旗在阴沉的暴风雨天空中格外醒目。

stick to your guns.en: Despite the team's warnings, he decided to stick to his guns and take the risky investment.
stick to your guns.cn: 尽管团队发出警告，他仍坚持己见，决定进行这项高风险投资。

stick up.en: The tall flagpole sticks up above the surrounding rooftops.
stick up.cn: 高高的旗杆耸立在周围屋顶之上。

stick your neck out.en: He decided to stick his neck out by investing in that risky startup.
stick your neck out.cn: 他决定冒风险投资那家初创公司。

stir the blood.en: The thrilling story truly stirred his blood, making him eager to act immediately.
stir the blood.cn: 这扣人心弦的故事确实激起了他的热血，使他迫不及待想要立刻行动。

stir your stumps.en: Stop dawdling and stir your stumps to get moving right now.
stir your stumps.cn: 别再磨蹭了，赶紧动起来。

stone-cold sober.en: He remained stone-cold sober despite the party's wild atmosphere.
stone-cold sober.cn: 尽管派对气氛热烈，他却始终清醒如常。

stoop to sth.en: He was forced to stoop to lying just to secure the contract.
stoop to sth.cn: 他不得不撒谎来保住这份合同。

stop at nothing.en: They stopped at nothing to secure the contract, even resorting to bribery.
stop at nothing.cn: 他们不惜贿赂以拿下该合同。

stop sb short.en: The sudden car alarm stopped us in our tracks, forcing everyone to halt immediately.
stop sb short.cn: 突如其来的汽车警报声让我们瞬间停下脚步，迫使所有人立即停止。

stop the clock.en: The referee stopped the clock to let the injured player receive medical attention.
stop the clock.cn: 裁判停表让受伤球员接受医疗处理。

straight away.en: I'll straight away begin the project once you give me the details.
straight away.cn: 您提供细节后，我将立即着手该项目。

straight from the shoulder.en: He spoke straight from the shoulder, revealing his true feelings without any filter.
straight from the shoulder.cn: 他直抒胸臆，毫无保留地袒露真情。

straight up.en: I promise you, straight up, I have absolutely no intention of lying to you.
straight up.cn: 我向你保证，直说，我绝无欺骗你的意图。

strain at the leash.en: The eager puppy strained at the leash, refusing to wait for the walk.
strain at the leash.cn: 那只渴望的小狗拼命拽着牵引绳，拒绝等待散步。

stretch a point.en: He stretched a point about the deadline to get an extension on his project.
stretch a point.cn: 他拖延截止日期以争取项目延期。

stretch your legs.en: After sitting for hours at the desk, I decided to stretch my legs in the garden.
stretch your legs.cn: 在书桌前坐了许久后，我决定去花园伸展一下双腿。

strictly speaking.en: Strictly speaking, the project was completed two weeks ahead of schedule.
strictly speaking.cn: 严格来说，该项目提前两周完成。

strike gold.en: The team finally struck gold when they secured the championship trophy.
strike gold.cn: 这支队伍终于捧起了冠军奖杯。

strike it rich.en: He finally struck it rich after discovering the rare mineral deposit.
strike it rich.cn: 他最终在发现稀有矿藏后发了大财。

strike while the iron is hot.en: You should strike while the iron is hot before it cools down completely.
strike while the iron is hot.cn: 趁铁未完全冷却时锻打。

strut your stuff.en: He strutted his stuff on stage, showing off his impressive dance moves to the crowd.
strut your stuff.cn: 他在舞台上大摇大摆地展示自己，向观众炫耀令人印象深刻的舞蹈动作。

suck it and see.en: We'll suck it and see how the new marketing strategy performs in the market.
suck it and see.cn: 我们试试看新营销策略在市场上的表现。

sure of yourself.en: She is absolutely sure of herself, though her confidence borders on arrogance.
sure of yourself.cn: 她对自己深信不疑，自信甚至近乎自负。

sure thing.en: That's a sure thing; I'll handle it immediately without any hesitation.
sure thing.cn: 没问题，我会立即处理，绝不犹豫。
