swear blind.en: He swore blind that he had never seen the document.
swear blind.cn: 他发誓说从未见过那份文件。

swear like a trooper.en: He swore like a trooper, cursing loudly whenever he encountered any minor inconvenience.
swear like a trooper.cn: 他骂起人来像军人一样，遇到任何小麻烦就大声咒骂。

sweep sb off their feet.en: The actor swept the audience off their feet with his incredible performance last night.
sweep sb off their feet.cn: 这位演员昨晚的表演令观众如痴如狂。

sweep the board.en: The team swept the board by winning every single match in the tournament.
sweep the board.cn: 该队在比赛中全胜夺冠。

sweep to victory.en: The team swept to victory by defeating all opponents in the tournament without losing a single match.
sweep to victory.cn: 该队在比赛中未失一役便横扫所有对手，一举夺冠。

sweet nothings.en: She whispered sweet nothings that made his heart flutter with excitement.
sweet nothings.cn: 她低语着甜言蜜语，令他的心因兴奋而悸动。

swing both ways.en: The situation swings both ways, as he enjoys dating both men and women equally.
swing both ways.cn: 情况因人而异，因为他对男女交往同样感到愉悦。

swing into action.en: The committee swung into action immediately after receiving the urgent report.
swing into action.cn: 委员会在收到紧急报告后立即采取行动。

swing the lead.en: He tried to swing the lead by feigning illness and refusing to attend the meeting.
swing the lead.cn: 他假装生病并拒绝参加会议，试图操纵投票结果。

take a back seat.en: I decided to take a back seat in the project so my colleague could lead the team.
take a back seat.cn: 我决定在项目中退居二线，以便同事能带领团队。

take a dive.en: The stock market took a dive after the unexpected economic data was released.
take a dive.cn: 经济数据意外发布后，股市暴跌。

take a hike.en: He told me to take a hike, so I left the room immediately.
take a hike.cn: 他让我滚蛋，于是我立刻离开了房间。

take a joke.en: He can take a joke, which is rare for someone with such short temper.
take a joke.cn: 他偶尔能开得起玩笑，这对于脾气如此暴躁的人来说实属罕见。

take a lot of doing.en: It takes a lot of doing to fix this complex system without any prior knowledge.
take a lot of doing.cn: 修复这个复杂的系统需要大量工作，且无需任何先验知识。

take care.en: Take care, and I hope you have a wonderful journey ahead.

take evasive action.en: The diplomat took evasive action to avoid offending the sensitive audience.
take evasive action.cn: 该外交官采取了回避行动，以免冒犯敏感的听众。

take exception to sth.en: The committee took exception to the proposal regarding budget cuts.
take exception to sth.cn: 委员会对削减预算的建议提出异议。

take flight.en: The birds took flight as soon as the intruder appeared in the garden.
take flight.cn: 鸟儿一见入侵者出现在花园中便飞走了。

take form.en: The new policy is slowly taking form as officials finalize the details.
take form.cn: 新政策正随着官员完善细节而逐渐成型。

take it into your head to do sth.en: Don't take it into your head to quit just because one project failed.
take it into your head to do sth.cn: 不要因为一个项目失败就萌生退意。

take place.en: The conference will take place next Monday at the city center.
take place.cn: 会议将于下周一在市中心举行。

take risks.en: She decided to take risks and launch her own startup despite the uncertainty.
take risks.cn: 她决定冒风险创办自己的公司，尽管前景不明。

take sb as they come.en: He decided to take his life as it came, accepting whatever challenges arose without resistance.
take sb as they come.cn: 他决定顺其自然地度过余生，对任何出现的挑战都坦然接受，绝不抗拒。

take sb as you find them.en: You should take your partner as they are, not expecting them to change overnight.
take sb as you find them.cn: 应接纳伴侣原本的样子，而非期待他们一夜之间发生改变。

take sb at their word.en: I completely take her at her word when she promises to finish the project today.
take sb at their word.cn: 她答应今天完成项目时，我完全相信她。

take sb by surprise.en: The sudden announcement truly took us all by surprise.
take sb by surprise.cn: 这一突如其来的宣布确实让我们所有人感到意外。

take sb in hand.en: It took the principal several months to take the unruly student in hand.
take sb in hand.cn: 校长花了数月才将这名不守规矩的学生管教好。

take sb into your confidence.en: I can't take him into my confidence about the surprise party.
take sb into your confidence.cn: 我不能让他知道惊喜派对的事。

take sb through sth.en: The tutor took me through the complex grammar rules step by step.
take sb through sth.cn: 导师循序渐进地为我讲解复杂的语法规则。

take sb under your wing.en: She decided to take the struggling artist under her wing and help him succeed.
take sb under your wing.cn: 她决定提携这位挣扎中的艺术家，助他成功。

take sb's breath away.en: The breathtaking view of the mountains took my breath away.

take sb's life.en: The police finally took the suspect's life after he refused to surrender.
take sb's life.cn: 警方最终在嫌疑人拒绝投降后将其击毙。

take sb's name in vain.en: We must not take his hard work in vain by making excuses.
take sb's name in vain.cn: 我们不能以找借口为由让他多年的辛勤付出付诸东流。

take shape.en: The project is finally taking shape after months of intense collaboration.
take shape.cn: 经过数月的紧密合作，该项目终于成形。

take sides.en: The debate ended with everyone finally taking sides on the controversial issue.
take sides.cn: 辩论最终以各方就这一争议性问题表明立场而结束。

take some beating.en: His performance was so exceptional that it took some beating to surpass.
take some beating.cn: 他的表演如此出色，非经一番努力难以超越。

take sth at face value.en: We shouldn't take his excuses at face value, given his history of lying.
take sth at face value.cn: 鉴于他撒谎的历史，我们不能轻信他的借口。

take sth from the top.en: They decided to take the story from the top and rewrite it entirely.
take sth from the top.cn: 他们决定从头开始重写整个故事。

take sth further.en: We should take these new findings further to our senior management.
take sth further.cn: 应将这些新发现进一步呈报给高级管理层。

take sth into account.en: We must take all these factors into account before making our final decision.
take sth into account.cn: 在做出最终决定前，我们必须考虑所有这些因素。

take sth into consideration.en: We must take all these factors into consideration before making our final decision.
take sth into consideration.cn: 在做出最终决定前，我们必须综合考虑所有这些因素。

take sth into your own hands.en: You should take matters into your own hands rather than waiting for others.
take sth into your own hands.cn: 你应该亲自动手，而不是等待他人。

take sth lying down.en: He decided not to take the company's unfair treatment lying down.
take sth lying down.cn: 他决定不再忍受公司的不公平待遇。

take sth on board.en: The committee finally took the new proposal on board after weeks of debate.
take sth on board.cn: 委员会经过数周的辩论，最终采纳了这项新提案。

take sth on the chin.en: He took the harsh criticism on the chin and kept working hard.
take sth on the chin.cn: 他坦然接受严厉的批评，继续努力工作。

take sth on trust.en: He took her story on trust, despite his own doubts about its authenticity.
take sth on trust.cn: 尽管自己对其真实性存疑，他还是相信了她的故事。

take sth out of sth.en: The company took the initial deposit out of their total budget allocation.
take sth out of sth.cn: 公司从总预算中划拨了首期定金。

take sth personally.en: Don't take his criticism of your presentation style personally, as he is only focused on improving the project.
take sth personally.cn: 不要把他对你演讲风格的批评当作针对个人，因为他只是专注于改进项目。

take sth the wrong way.en: Don't take her kindness the wrong way, as she always means well.
take sth the wrong way.cn: 别误解她的善意，她总是出于好心。

take sth to extremes.en: The debate quickly took the issue to extremes, polarizing public opinion.
take sth to extremes.cn: 辩论迅速将问题推向极端，使公众意见两极分化。

take sth to heart.en: She couldn't take his constant criticism to heart, so she ignored it.
take sth to heart.cn: 她无法将他的不断批评放在心上，因此选择了无视。

take sth under advisement.en: We will take your proposal under advisement and get back to you soon.
take sth under advisement.cn: 我们将认真考虑您的建议，并尽快与您联系。

take sth up with sb.en: I decided to take the matter up with my manager immediately.
take sth up with sb.cn: 我当即决定向经理反映此事。

take the bread out of sb's mouth.en: The company's decision to lay off staff has taken the bread out of many families' mouths.
take the bread out of sb's mouth.cn: 公司裁员的决定让许多家庭失去了口粮。

take the bull by the horns.en: We must take the bull by the horns and confront this crisis head-on immediately.
take the bull by the horns.cn: 我们必须直面危机，立即采取果断行动。

take the easy way out.en: Instead of tackling the complex problem, he chose to take the easy way out.
take the easy way out.cn: 他未解决难题，而是选择了简便方法。

take the edge off sth.en: The long meeting took the edge off his usual enthusiasm for the project.
take the edge off sth.cn: 漫长的会议消磨了他对项目的热情。

take the law into your own hands.en: Instead of waiting for legal intervention, he decided to take the law into his own hands.
take the law into your own hands.cn: 他决定自行执法，而不是等待法律介入。

take the offensive.en: The company decided to take the offensive by launching a surprise marketing campaign.
take the offensive.cn: 该公司决定采取攻势，发起了一场突袭营销活动。

take the plunge.en: After months of hesitation, she finally took the plunge and applied for the job.
take the plunge.cn: 犹豫数月后，她终于鼓起勇气申请了这份工作。

take the trouble to do sth.en: Please take the trouble to explain this complex issue in simpler terms.
take the trouble to do sth.cn: 请费心用更简单的术语解释这一复杂问题。

take the veil.en: After years of contemplation, she finally decided to take the veil and join the convent.
take the veil.cn: 经过多年深思熟虑，她终于决定戴上面纱，加入修道院。

take the weight off your feet.en: After running for hours, she finally took the weight off her feet by sitting down.
take the weight off your feet.cn: 跑了几小时后，她终于坐下，减轻了脚部的负担。

take the wind out of sb's sails.en: The unexpected news took the wind out of her sails, leaving her speechless.
take the wind out of sb's sails.cn: 这突如其来的消息让她大失所望，竟无言以对。

take the words right out of sb's mouth.en: She took his words right out of his own mouth when she repeated them.
take the words right out of sb's mouth.cn: 她复述他的话时，仿佛是从他自己口中说出的一样。

take time out.en: We should take time out to enjoy the sunset together.
take time out.cn: 我们应抽出时间一同欣赏夕阳。

take to your bed.en: He was so severely ill that he had to take to his bed immediately.
take to your bed.cn: 他病得十分严重，不得不立即卧床。

take to your heels.en: Before the police arrived, he quickly took to his heels and vanished into the crowd.
take to your heels.cn: 警察到达前，他迅速逃入人群消失不见。

take up.en: After the lunch break, we will take up where we left off with our project.
take up.cn: 午餐休息后，我们将继续项目的工作。

take up sth.en: The new sofa takes up too much space in our small living room.
take up sth.cn: 新沙发占了我们小客厅太多空间。

take up the gauntlet.en: He took up the gauntlet, ready to defend his honor against any challenge.
take up the gauntlet.cn: 他举起护手，准备捍卫自己的荣誉，应对任何挑战。

take wing.en: The birds took wing and soared high above the valley.
take wing.cn: 鸟儿振翅高飞，翱翔于山谷之上。

take years off sb.en: The new makeup products made her feel ten years younger instantly.
take years off sb.cn: 这款新化妆品让她瞬间年轻了十岁。

take your chances.en: You should take your chances and apply for that job immediately.
take your chances.cn: 你应该抓住机会，立即申请那份工作。

take your eye off the ball.en: He failed to take his eye off the ball, missing the crucial opportunity.
take your eye off the ball.cn: 他未能紧盯足球，错失了关键机会。

take your life in your hands.en: He took his life in his hands to save the child from the burning building.
take your life in your hands.cn: 他冒生命危险从火场中救出了孩子。

take your mind off sth.en: You can listen to music to take your mind off the stress of work.
take your mind off sth.cn: 你可以听音乐来转移工作的压力。

talk at sb.en: He talked at her for twenty minutes without acknowledging her questions.
talk at sb.cn: 他跟她谈了二十分钟，却未回应她的提问。

talk dirty.en: He decided to talk dirty about his rival during the board meeting.
talk dirty.cn: 他在董事会上决定对竞争对手进行人身攻击。

talk down to sb.en: The teacher talked down to the students, which made them feel undervalued.
talk down to sb.cn: 老师对学生居高临下，使他们感到不被重视。

talk sb through sth.en: The teacher talked the confused student through the complex math problem step by step.
talk sb through sth.cn: 老师一步步引导困惑的学生解开了那道复杂的数学题。

talk shop.en: Don't talk shop with me; I'm not interested in your technical jargon.
talk shop.cn: 别跟我谈那些技术术语，我不感兴趣。

talk the hind leg off a donkey.en: She kept talking the hind leg off a donkey about her plans until I finally agreed.
talk the hind leg off a donkey.cn: 她喋喋不休地谈论她的计划，直到我最终同意。

talk the talk.en: He can talk the talk but fails to walk the walk in real life.
talk the talk.cn: 他能言善辩，却难以付诸实践。

talk through your hat.en: He talked through his hat about the project's sudden failure.
talk through your hat.cn: 他随口谈论起了该项目的突然失败。

talk turkey.en: We need to talk turkey about the budget before making any final decisions.
talk turkey.cn: 在做出任何最终决定之前，我们需要就预算进行坦诚的讨论。

tear at sth.en: The strong wind tore at the old tent, ripping it apart completely.
tear at sth.cn: 狂风撕扯着旧帐篷，将其彻底撕裂。

tear your heart out.en: The news of his failure truly tore my heart apart, leaving me in agony.
tear your heart out.cn: 他失败的噩耗令我心如刀割，痛苦难忍。

tell me.en: Tell me the truth about what happened last night.
tell me.cn: 告诉我昨晚到底发生了什么。

tell me about it.en: You're absolutely right; I can't argue with that assessment.
tell me about it.cn: 您完全正确；我无法反驳这一评估。

tell sb what they can do with sth.en: Stop telling me what I can and cannot do.
tell sb what they can do with sth.cn: 别再告诉我能做什么不能做什么了。

ten to one.en: It is ten to one that the company will merge with its rival next quarter.
ten to one.cn: 该公司下个季度与竞争对手合并的可能性很大。

thank your lucky stars.en: Thank your lucky stars that the meeting didn't end up being cancelled at the last minute.
thank your lucky stars.cn: 幸好会议没有在最后一刻取消。

that does it.en: I'm done with this endless argument; that does it.
that does it.cn: 我受够了这场无休止的争论；就这样吧。

that is to say.en: That is to say, the project's success depends entirely on our collective effort.
that is to say.cn: 也就是说，项目的成功完全取决于我们集体的努力。

that makes two of us.en: That makes two of us, both stubbornly refusing to admit we're wrong.
that makes two of us.cn: 这下我们俩都成了，谁也不肯承认自己错了。

that said.en: That said, the project's budget remains insufficient for the proposed expansion.
that said.cn: 尽管如此，项目预算仍不足以支持拟议的扩建。

that will do.en: That will do; please stop talking so loudly in the library.
that will do.cn: 够了；请在图书馆小声点。

that'll be the day.en: That'll be the day when we finally admit our mistakes to everyone.
that'll be the day.cn: 那将是我们要向所有人承认错误的日子。

that's about it.en: That's about it, and I think we've covered all the essential points for today.
that's about it.cn: 就这些，我想我们今天已经涵盖了所有要点。

that's about the size of it.en: That's roughly the scale of the project we discussed yesterday.
that's about the size of it.cn: 这正是我们昨天讨论的项目规模。

that's all she wrote.en: That's all she wrote; the committee has already finalized the report without further discussion.
that's all she wrote.cn: 画蛇添足；委员会已定稿报告，无需再议。

that's done it.en: That's done it; now the situation is truly out of our control.
that's done it.cn: 至此，局势已完全脱离我们的控制。

that's life.en: That's life; we can't control everything and must accept the inevitable.
that's life.cn: 人生如此，我们无法掌控一切，只能接受必然发生的事。

that's not saying much.en: That's not saying much, but his performance was indeed impressive.
that's not saying much.cn: 话虽不多，但他的表现确实令人印象深刻。

that's that.en: That's that; we have reached a final agreement on the project budget.
that's that.cn: 就这样了；我们已就项目预算达成最终协议。

that's the ticket.en: That's exactly what I needed, so that's the ticket.
that's the ticket.cn: 这正是我所需要的，所以这就是我要找的。

that's the way the cookie crumbles.en: That's just how life works; there is no other solution available.
that's the way the cookie crumbles.cn: 生活本就是这样；别无他法可解。

that's torn it.en: That's torn it; our entire project plan has now completely collapsed.
that's torn it.cn: 这下全完了；我们整个项目计划已彻底崩溃。

the armpit of sth.en: We must not let the armpit of our city become a breeding ground for crime.
the armpit of sth.cn: 绝不能让我们的城市成为犯罪的温床。

the battle lines are drawn.en: The battle lines are drawn, with most voters clearly choosing the left-wing candidate.
the battle lines are drawn.cn: 选战已打响，多数选民明显倾向于左翼候选人。

the beginning of the end.en: The first sign of the end appeared when the factory shut down for good.
the beginning of the end.cn: 工厂彻底关闭，标志着终结的迹象初现。

the best medicine.en: The best medicine for his anxiety was a long walk in the park.
the best medicine.cn: 缓解他焦虑的最佳良药是在公园散步。

the best thing since sliced bread.en: It's the best thing since sliced bread, truly revolutionary for our industry.
the best thing since sliced bread.cn: 这是自切片面包以来最好的东西，对我们行业而言具有革命性意义。

the big picture.en: We need to see the big picture before making any final decisions.
the big picture.cn: 在做出任何最终决定之前，我们需要看清大局。

the big stick.en: The US employed the big stick policy to force Mexico to withdraw its troops.
the big stick.cn: 美国运用“金棒”政策迫使墨西哥撤军。

the bird has flown.en: The bird has flown, so the person we were trying to catch has escaped.
the bird has flown.cn: 鸟儿已飞走，我们试图抓捕的那人也趁机逃脱了。

the birds and the bees.en: Parents finally broke the silence to explain the birds and the bees to their teenage daughter.
the birds and the bees.cn: 父母终于打破沉默，向女儿解释恋爱常识。

the blind leading the blind.en: It is futile for a novice to guide another who lacks the same expertise.
the blind leading the blind.cn: 让缺乏同样专长的人指导新手是徒劳的。

the boot is on the other foot.en: The situation has shifted so that the client now holds all the negotiating power.
the boot is on the other foot.cn: 局势已变，客户如今掌握了全部谈判主动权。

the boys in blue.en: The police arrived to arrest the suspects in the blue uniforms.
the boys in blue.cn: 警察身穿蓝色制服前来逮捕嫌疑人。

the bright lights.en: The city's vibrant energy is captured in its bright lights at night.
the bright lights.cn: 城市的活力在夜晚明亮的灯火中得以展现。

the bubble bursts.en: The bubble burst when the market crashed, leaving investors with nothing.
the bubble bursts.cn: 市场崩盘时泡沫破裂，投资者一无所获。

the calm before the storm.en: The eerie silence was merely the calm before the storm that would soon engulf our city.
the calm before the storm.cn: 这诡异的寂静不过是风暴来临前的宁静，那风暴即将吞噬我们的城市。

the company sb keeps.en: The company one keeps often reflects the person's true character and values.
the company sb keeps.cn: 一个人常与谁交往，往往反映其真实的品格与价值观。

the corridors of power.en: The corridors of power often remain shrouded in secrecy.
the corridors of power.cn: 权力走廊往往笼罩在秘密之中。

the dead hand of sth.en: The dead hand of outdated regulations continues to hinder our company's growth.
the dead hand of sth.cn: 过时的法规仍阻碍着公司的发展。

the devil.en: The task proved to be the devil of a puzzle, leaving us utterly frustrated.
the devil.cn: 这项任务证明是个极其棘手的难题，让我们彻底感到沮丧。

the devil makes work for idle hands.en: The devil makes work for idle hands, so I must finish this report today.
the devil makes work for idle hands.cn: 闲人无事生非，所以我必须今天完成这份报告。

the eight year itch.en: After seven years of marriage, she finally succumbed to the eight-year itch and sought a new romance.
the eight year itch.cn: 结婚七年后，她终于屈服于八年之痒，寻求新的恋情。

the end justifies the means.en: He argued that achieving the goal justified any method used to reach it.
the end justifies the means.cn: 他认为，实现目标可以正当使用任何手段。

the exception that proves the rule.en: That rare accident is merely the exception that proves the general safety rule.
the exception that proves the rule.cn: 这起罕见的事故恰恰证明了普遍的安全规则。

the facts speak for themselves.en: The evidence against him is so overwhelming that the facts speak for themselves.
the facts speak for themselves.cn: 针对他的证据确凿无疑，事实自会说明一切。

the flower of sth.en: The flower of our research team led the project to success.
the flower of sth.cn: 我研究团队的努力使项目取得了成功。

the forces of nature.en: The relentless forces of nature eventually destroyed the ancient coastal village.
the forces of nature.cn: 无情的自然力量最终摧毁了这座古老的沿海村庄。

the freedom of the city.en: The mayor awarded him the freedom of the city for his outstanding contributions to local charity.
the freedom of the city.cn: 市长因其对当地慈善事业的杰出贡献授予其市民荣誉。

the frosting on the cake.en: The unexpected bonus was truly the icing on the cake for our project.
the frosting on the cake.cn: 这笔意外的奖金真是锦上添花。

the game is up.en: Now that the truth has come out, the game is up and your cover is blown.
the game is up.cn: 真相大白，游戏结束，你的伪装已败露。

the gloves are off.en: Now that the gloves are off, we can finally argue about this issue.
the gloves are off.cn: 如今障眼法已去，我们终于可以就此问题展开辩论了。

the greasy pole.en: Climbing the greasy pole means navigating a treacherous career path to reach professional excellence.
the greasy pole.cn: 爬上滑油杆意味着在充满险阻的职业道路上攀登，以臻专业卓越。

the half of it.en: It's not just the surface; the other half is far worse than we imagined.
the half of it.cn: 这不仅仅是表面现象；另一半的情况远比我们想象的糟糕。

the hard way.en: He finally learned to code the hard way after repeatedly breaking his own programs.
the hard way.cn: 他最终通过反复破坏自己的程序，艰难地学会了编程。

the heavens opened.en: Suddenly, the heavens opened and a torrential downpour began to fall.
the heavens opened.cn: 忽然间，天空裂开，倾盆大雨倾泻而下。

the history books.en: The history books meticulously record humanity's greatest achievements.
the history books.cn: 史书详尽记载了人类最伟大的成就。

the honours are even.en: The competition remains fiercely competitive, as the honours are evenly matched.
the honours are even.cn: 比赛依然激烈，双方实力相当。

the jewel in the crown.en: The new research project is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of our department's achievements.
the jewel in the crown.cn: 这项新研究项目无疑是本系成就中的瑰宝。

the joke's on sb.en: The joke's on us when we realize our own mistakes are causing the problem.
the joke's on sb.cn: 当我们意识到正是我们自己的错误导致了问题时，讽刺的是，这恰恰是我们自己。

the light of sb's life.en: She is the very light of his life, and he cannot imagine living without her.
the light of sb's life.cn: 她是他的掌上明珠，他无法想象没有她的生活。

the lights are on but nobody's home.en: The lights are on, yet no one is home.

the lion's den.en: She decided to confront the corrupt official in his very own lion's den.
the lion's den.cn: 她决定直面那位腐败官员在自己狮子洞般的据点。

the livelong day.en: It has been the livelong day, and I still haven't finished my report.
the livelong day.cn: 这一天已过去大半，我的报告仍未写完。

the long arm of sth.en: The long arm of the law finally reached him after years of evasion.
the long arm of sth.cn: 经过多年逃避，法律的长臂终于伸到了他头上。

the luck of the draw.en: The winner was decided by pure chance, a classic case of the luck of the draw.
the luck of the draw.cn: 胜者纯属偶然，是抽签运气的典型例子。

the middle of nowhere.en: We drove for hours to reach the middle of nowhere, where no one lives.
the middle of nowhere.cn: 我们驱车数小时才抵达人迹罕至的中途之地。

the milk of human kindness.en: His unexpected generosity was truly the milk of human kindness.
the milk of human kindness.cn: 他出乎意料的慷慨真是人间至善。

the naked eye.en: The telescope revealed details invisible to the naked eye.
the naked eye.cn: 望远镜揭示了肉眼无法看见的细节。

the name of the game.en: The real challenge isn't just winning; it's understanding the name of the game.
the name of the game.cn: 真正的挑战不仅在于获胜，更在于理解这场游戏的本质。

the only game in town.en: It remains the only game in town for securing funding this quarter.
the only game in town.cn: 本季度争取资金，它仍是唯一的选择。

the operative word.en: The operative word here is 'responsibility', not 'permission'.
the operative word.cn: 此处的关键词是‘责任’而非‘许可’。

the opposite situation.en: The opposite situation emerged when the market crashed unexpectedly.
the opposite situation.cn: 当市场意外崩盘时，情况却截然相反。

the other side of the coin.en: We must consider the other side of the coin before making any final decision.
the other side of the coin.cn: 在做出最终决定之前，我们必须考虑硬币的另一面。

the penny drops.en: Suddenly, the penny dropped when she realized the truth behind his lies.
the penny drops.cn: 突然，当她意识到他谎言背后的真相时，她恍然大悟。

the plot thickens.en: As new evidence emerges, the plot thickens and our investigation grows more complicated.
the plot thickens.cn: 随着新证据浮现，案情愈发扑朔迷离，调查也变得更加复杂。

the pot calling the kettle black.en: It's unfair to criticize others for faults you yourself possess.
the pot calling the kettle black.cn: 指责他人自身的缺陷是不公平的。

the primrose path.en: She chose the primrose path, seeking pleasure that ultimately led to disastrous consequences.
the primrose path.cn: 她选择了康庄大道，追求享乐，最终却导致了灾难性的后果。

the rest is history.en: The rest is history, as the outcome became universally known to everyone.
the rest is history.cn: 其余皆为史实，因结果早已广为人知。

the rule of law.en: The rule of law ensures that everyone is accountable under the law.
the rule of law.cn: 法治确保人人依法负责。

the rules of the game.en: We must strictly follow the rules of the game to ensure fair competition.
the rules of the game.cn: 我们必须严格遵守游戏规则，以确保公平竞争。

the salt of the earth.en: He is truly the salt of the earth, a kind and honest person who brings light to everyone.
the salt of the earth.cn: 他确实是大地之盐，一位善良诚实、能照亮众人的好人。

the sky's the limit.en: With your boundless creativity, there is truly no limit to what you can achieve.
the sky's the limit.cn: 凭借您无限的创造力，您的成就可谓无所不至。

the sweet smell of success.en: The sweet smell of success finally filled the room after months of hard work.
the sweet smell of success.cn: 经过数月的辛勤努力，成功的甜美气息终于充满了房间。

the tip of the iceberg.en: This is merely the tip of the iceberg; far more serious issues remain hidden beneath the surface.
the tip of the iceberg.cn: 这不过是冰山一角；更严重的问题仍隐藏在水面之下。

the university of life.en: We should value the university of life more than formal degrees.
the university of life.cn: 我们应更看重人生的大学，而非正式的学位。

the villain of the piece.en: The corrupt official remains the villain of the piece in this scandal.
the villain of the piece.cn: 在此丑闻中，腐败官员仍是罪魁祸首。

the way to sb's heart.en: The charming smile was the very thing that struck a chord in her heart.
the way to sb's heart.cn: 那迷人的微笑正是触动她心弦的那件事。

the whole enchilada.en: Don't just give me half the story; I need the whole enchilada.
the whole enchilada.cn: 别只给我一半的故事；我要的是全部。

the whole number or amount.en: The whole number of attendees exceeded our initial expectations.
the whole number or amount.cn: 出席人数远超我们的预期。

the whole shebang.en: Don't you think the whole shebang is a bit excessive for such a minor occasion?
the whole shebang.cn: 这种盛大的排场对于如此微小的场合来说，难道不显得过于铺张了吗？

there are plenty more fish in the sea.en: There are plenty more fish in the sea, so don't give up looking for someone better.
there are plenty more fish in the sea.cn: 海里有更多的鱼，所以不要放弃寻找更好的人。

there is no holding sb.en: There is no holding him back from pursuing his dream.
there is no holding sb.cn: 没有任何人能阻止他追求梦想。

there it is.en: There it is, the very moment I've been searching for all day.
there it is.cn: 就是它，我整天都在寻找的那个时刻。

there or thereabouts.en: The meeting is scheduled for three o'clock, though it might be there or thereabouts.
there or thereabouts.cn: 会议定于三点举行，但可能略有变动。

there you go again.en: There you go again, always making the same mistake.
there you go again.cn: 又是这样，你总是犯同样的错误。

there's a first time for everything.en: There's always a first time for everything, so don't be discouraged by this initial mistake.
there's a first time for everything.cn: 凡事皆有第一次，因此不要因为初次犯错而气馁。

there's no comparison.en: There is absolutely no comparison between his early work and this masterpiece.
there's no comparison.cn: 他的早期作品与此杰作毫无可比性。

there's no knowing.en: There's no knowing if the project will succeed before we finish it.
there's no knowing.cn: 项目能否成功，在完工前无法得知。

there's no law against sth.en: There's no law against him criticizing our project, so we should just ignore his complaints.
there's no law against sth.cn: 法律并未禁止他批评我们的项目，因此我们应无视他的抱怨。

there's no saying.en: There's no saying whether the new policy will succeed in the long run.
there's no saying.cn: 新政策能否长期成功尚难预料。

there's no telling.en: There's no telling how long it will take to finish the project.
there's no telling.cn: 项目何时能完工难以预料。

there's nothing like sth.en: There's nothing like the genuine warmth of a real fireplace on a cold night.
there's nothing like sth.cn: 寒夜之中，唯有真火壁炉散发出的温暖最为真切。

there's six born every minute.en: There are always some foolish people who make terrible mistakes every single minute.
there's six born every minute.cn: 总有一些愚蠢的人每分钟都会犯下可怕的错误。

there's sth for you.en: There's nothing like this for you, truly.
there's sth for you.cn: 这世间再无如此之物，确然无疑。

these days.en: These days, people rely heavily on smartphones for almost everything they do.
these days.cn: 如今，人们几乎依赖智能手机完成所有事务。

these five walls.en: Let's stop here, for these five walls must remain our secret.
these five walls.cn: 到此为止吧，因为这五面墙必须永远是我们的秘密。

these things happen.en: Don't worry; these things happen in life, and we all make mistakes.
these things happen.cn: 别担心，生活中难免发生这样的事，我们也会犯错。

thin on top.en: His hair is thin on top, making him look older than he actually is.
thin on top.cn: 他头顶发量稀疏，显得比实际年龄更老。

think again.en: After weeks of deliberation, she decided to think again and change her mind.
think again.cn: 经过数周的深思熟虑，她决定重新考虑并改变主意。

think for yourself.en: You should think for yourself rather than blindly following others' opinions.
think for yourself.cn: 应独立思考，切勿盲目追随他人意见。

think nothing of it.en: You don't need to worry about it at all; I think nothing of it.
think nothing of it.cn: 完全不必担心；这对我来说不算什么。

think of sth.en: I can't think of a suitable name for the new project yet.
think of sth.cn: 目前我还想不出一个合适的新项目名称。

think on your feet.en: The coach praised the player for his ability to think on his feet during the match.
think on your feet.cn: 教练称赞该球员在比赛中临场应变的能力。

think out of the box.en: We need to think outside the box to solve this complex problem.
think out of the box.cn: 我们需要跳出固有思维模式来解决这个复杂问题。

think straight.en: You need to think straight before making such a critical decision.
think straight.cn: 在做如此重大的决定前，你必须冷静思考。

third time lucky.en: I've failed twice, but I'll try again because the third time is usually lucky.
third time lucky.cn: 我已失败两次，但我会再试一次，因为第三次通常会有好运。

this is the main point.en: This is the main point: we must act now to prevent further damage.
this is the main point.cn: 核心在于：我们必须立即行动，防止损害进一步扩大。

this minute.en: We must finish the report this minute before the meeting starts.
this minute.cn: 会议开始前我们必须立刻完成报告。

this much.en: I'll take this much, please, as it's exactly what I need for the project.
this much.cn: 请给我这么多，正好是我项目所需的数量。

those were the days.en: Those were the days when we could afford to travel anywhere in the world.
those were the days.cn: 那时我们还能负担去世界各地旅行的费用。

through and through.en: The new policy has been implemented through and through, affecting every department.
through and through.cn: 新政策已全面实施，波及所有部门。

through sb's good offices.en: They resolved the dispute through the mediator's good offices.
through sb's good offices.cn: 他们通过调解人的斡旋解决了争端。

through the agency of.en: The policy was implemented through the agency of local community leaders.
through the agency of.cn: 该政策由当地社区领袖代为实施。

throw down the gauntlet.en: He threw down the gauntlet, challenging her to a fierce debate on the topic.
throw down the gauntlet.cn: 他扔出护手，向她发起关于该议题的激烈辩论挑战。

throw good money after bad.en: He kept throwing good money after bad, ignoring the initial losses.
throw good money after bad.cn: 他继续追加投资，无视最初的亏损。

throw in the towel.en: After losing three consecutive matches, he finally threw in the towel and admitted defeat.
throw in the towel.cn: 连输三场后，他终于认输了。

throw in your lot with sb.en: He decided to throw in his lot with the team despite their recent failures.
throw in your lot with sb.cn: 尽管球队近期屡遭失败，他仍决定与全队共进退。

throw money at sth.en: Don't just throw money at this problem without a real plan.
throw money at sth.cn: 若无切实可行的计划，切勿仅凭资金投入此问题。

throw sb a bone.en: The company threw the employees a small bonus to keep them from striking.
throw sb a bone.cn: 公司发了一笔小额奖金，以阻止员工罢工。

throw sb to the wolves.en: They decided to throw their injured colleague to the wolves instead of seeking help.
throw sb to the wolves.cn: 他们决定将受伤的同事置之不理，而不是寻求帮助。

throw sth back at sb.en: The memory of that incident keeps throwing unpleasant thoughts back at me.
throw sth back at sb.cn: 那段事件的记忆总让我想起令人不快的事。

throw the baby out with the bathwater.en: We shouldn't throw the baby out with the bathwater by cancelling all safety protocols.
throw the baby out with the bathwater.cn: 取消所有安全规程无异于因噎废食。

throw the book at sb.en: The court decided to throw the book at him for his heinous crimes.
throw the book at sb.cn: 法院决定对他犯下的骇人罪行施以极刑。

throw up.en: The sudden smell of rotting fish made her immediately throw up.
throw up.cn: 一股腐烂鱼类的恶臭让她立刻呕吐起来。

throw your hand in.en: Don't throw your hand in just because the first attempt failed.
throw your hand in.cn: 不要因为第一次尝试失败就放弃。

throw your hat into the ring.en: She decided to throw her hat into the ring and run for mayor.

throw yourself on sb's mercy.en: He threw himself on his boss's mercy after the project failed.
throw yourself on sb's mercy.cn: 项目失败后，他向老板乞求宽恕。

thus far.en: Thus far, the project has exceeded all initial budget projections.
thus far.cn: 迄今为止，该项目已超出所有初始预算预测。

tickle sb's fancy.en: The new gadget tickled my fancy, so I decided to buy it immediately.
tickle sb's fancy.cn: 这件新玩意儿令我心动，于是我决定立即购买。

tie six on.en: He was so drunk he couldn't even tie six on a piece of paper.
tie six on.cn: 他醉得连在纸上写个六都做不到。

tie the knot.en: After years of planning, they finally decided to tie the knot this autumn.
tie the knot.cn: 经过多年筹划，他们终于决定在今年秋天结婚。

tighten your belt.en: We must tighten our belts to survive the upcoming economic recession.
tighten your belt.cn: 我们必须勒紧裤腰带以度过即将到来的经济衰退。

till doomsday.en: We must finish the project before it's too late, even if we have to work till doomsday.
till doomsday.cn: 我们必须赶在时间耗尽前完成项目，哪怕要工作到末日。

till the cows come home.en: It's been a long time, but I'll wait till the cows come home.
till the cows come home.cn: 时间虽久，但我仍会等到牛群归家。

tilt at windmills.en: He keeps tilting at windmills, wasting energy on imaginary enemies instead of real problems.
tilt at windmills.cn: 他空想风车，将精力耗费在虚幻的敌人上，而非现实的问题。

time and a half.en: The company pays our staff time and a half during weekends to encourage overtime work.
time and a half.cn: 公司为鼓励加班，规定周末员工工作时间按双倍计薪。

time flies.en: Time flies when you are having fun, making the days pass so quickly that it feels like just yesterday.
time flies.cn: 乐在其中时，时光飞逝，日子过得飞快，仿佛只是昨天。

time is money.en: Time is money, so we must maximize our productivity during every single work hour.
time is money.cn: 时间就是金钱，因此我们必须充分利用每一工作小时来提高生产力。

time is on your side.en: Time is on your side, so you can take a moment to consider the proposal carefully.
time is on your side.cn: 时机已到，您可以仔细考虑这一提议。

to a fault.en: Her dedication to work is admirable, yet it sometimes goes to a fault.
to a fault.cn: 她对工作极为投入，令人钦佩，但有时却过犹不及。

to a higher position of authority than s.en: He was promoted to a higher position of authority than his former boss.
to a higher position of authority than s.cn: 他被提拔到一个高于前任上司的职位。

to accept sth that is offered or availab.en: She decided to accept the job offer, even though it required relocating immediately.
to accept sth that is offered or availab.cn: 她决定接受这份工作邀请，尽管需要立即搬迁。

to add a remark to a conversation.en: She decided to add a remark to the conversation about the project's future.

to and fro.en: The boat moved to and fro across the calm lake, reflecting the morning light.
to and fro.cn: 小船在平静的湖面上来回荡漾，倒映着晨光。

to arrange for sth to happen.en: She arranged for the team to arrive early and prepare thoroughly.
to arrange for sth to happen.cn: 她安排团队提前到达并充分准备。

to arrange or organize sth.en: She arranged the conference schedule to ensure all speakers arrived on time.
to arrange or organize sth.cn: 她安排会议日程，确保所有演讲者准时到场。

to ask or demand that sb do sth.en: The manager insisted that all staff submit their reports by Friday.
to ask or demand that sb do sth.cn: 经理坚持要求所有员工于本周五前提交报告。

to ask sb a question.en: She politely asked the professor a question about his latest research paper.
to ask sb a question.cn: 她礼貌地向教授请教了关于他最新研究论文的一个问题。

to attack a place suddenly and capture i.en: The army decided to attack the fortress suddenly and capture it before dawn.
to attack a place suddenly and capture i.cn: 军队决定突袭这座要塞，并在黎明前将其攻占。

to attack sb suddenly.en: The predator attacked the deer suddenly, causing it to flee in terror.
to attack sb suddenly.cn: 捕食者突然袭击了鹿，使其惊恐逃窜。

to avoid mentioning a particular subject.en: She kept avoiding mentioning the sensitive topic to prevent further arguments.
to avoid mentioning a particular subject.cn: 她刻意回避提及那个敏感话题，以免引发进一步的争吵。

to avoid sth.en: She took a different route to avoid the heavy traffic during rush hour.
to avoid sth.cn: 她另辟蹊径以避开高峰时段的拥堵交通。

to be a disadvantage to sb.en: It is clearly a disadvantage to the team if they lack experienced players.
to be a disadvantage to sb.cn: 若球队缺乏经验丰富的球员，对整体而言显然是不利的。

to be a sensible thing to do.en: It is indeed a sensible thing to do when you need to save money.
to be a sensible thing to do.cn: 确实，当你需要省钱时，这样做是明智的。

to be able to be present at a place.en: I regret that I am unable to be present at the ceremony due to an unexpected emergency.
to be able to be present at a place.cn: 因突发紧急情况，我遗憾无法出席典礼。

to be about sth.en: The debate was mainly about the future of renewable energy sources.
to be about sth.cn: 辩论主要围绕可再生能源的未来展开。

to be acceptable.en: The proposal is acceptable, but we need to address the budget concerns first.
to be acceptable.cn: 该提议可行，但需先解决预算问题。

to be careful of sth.en: You should always be careful of the slippery floor in the morning.
to be careful of sth.cn: 清晨务必小心地滑的地面。

to be certain to happen.en: It is absolutely certain that the project will be completed by next Friday.
to be certain to happen.cn: 该项目绝对定于下周五完工。

to be controlled or influenced by sth.en: The market remains largely uncontrolled by any single political faction.
to be controlled or influenced by sth.cn: 市场仍主要由单一政治派别无法控制。

to be dealt with by a court.en: The case will be dealt with by a court of law in the coming weeks.
to be dealt with by a court.cn: 此案将在数周内由法院审理。

to be dealt with later.en: The complex issue must be dealt with later, as it requires more time and resources.
to be dealt with later.cn: 该复杂问题需稍后处理，因其耗时耗力。

to be destroyed by fire or an explosion.en: The ancient library was completely destroyed by fire or an explosion during the war.
to be destroyed by fire or an explosion.cn: 这座古图书馆在战争期间被大火或爆炸彻底摧毁。

to be dirty or untidy.en: The messy room made it hard for me to find my keys.
to be dirty or untidy.cn: 凌乱的房间让我很难找到钥匙。

to be easy to understand or explain.en: The concept is so clear that it becomes remarkably easy to understand for everyone.
to be easy to understand or explain.cn: 这一概念清晰明了，使任何人都能轻易理解。

to be excited in a sexual way.en: He was so aroused that he couldn't focus on his work or sleep at all.
to be excited in a sexual way.cn: 他情绪激动得无法专心工作或入睡。

to be extremely tired.en: After hiking the entire mountain trail, I was absolutely exhausted and could barely stand.
to be extremely tired.cn: 走完整座山后，我累得几乎站不起来。

to be going to experience sth unpleasant.en: You're going to experience a terrible headache if you don't stop now.
to be going to experience sth unpleasant.cn: 如果你不停止，你将遭受剧烈的头痛。

to be harmed in an accident.en: The driver was severely harmed in the sudden car accident on the highway.
to be harmed in an accident.cn: 司机在高速公路上遭遇突发车祸时受重伤。

to be important in a particular situatio.en: It is crucial to prioritize safety measures during this critical emergency phase.
to be important in a particular situatio.cn: 在此关键紧急阶段，优先采取安全措施至关重要。

to be likely to hurt or damage sth.en: The sharp object is likely to hurt or damage your fingers if you aren't careful.
to be likely to hurt or damage sth.cn: 若不慎，尖锐物可能会划伤或损伤您的手指。

to be located away from sth.en: The research facility is strategically located away from the city center to ensure privacy.
to be located away from sth.cn: 该研究机构位于远离市中心的战略位置，以确保隐私。

to be mentioned or discussed.en: It is worth mentioning that the project's success depends on collective effort.
to be mentioned or discussed.cn: 值得一提的是，该项目的成功取决于众人的共同努力。

to be not near other objects or building.en: The old lighthouse stands alone, not near any other structures.
to be not near other objects or building.cn: 那座旧灯塔孤零零地矗立着，附近没有其他建筑物。

to be produced or published.en: The latest research findings were finally produced and published in a prestigious journal.
to be produced or published.cn: 最新的研究成果最终发表于一家权威期刊。

to be ready for action.en: The rescue team was fully prepared to act immediately upon receiving the distress signal.
to be ready for action.cn: 救援队已做好充分准备，一旦收到求救信号即可立即行动。

to be replaced by sth.en: The traditional paper currency is gradually being replaced by digital payment systems.
to be replaced by sth.cn: 传统纸质货币正逐渐被数字支付系统取代。

to be shown clearly.en: The data must be presented in a way that is shown clearly to everyone.
to be shown clearly.cn: 数据必须以清晰的方式呈现给所有人。

to be sure.en: To be sure, the data supports this conclusion without any doubt.

to be sure or expect that sth will happe.en: To be sure, the project will succeed if we work together.

to be trusted to do sth.en: He was entrusted with the critical task of leading the new project.

to become separated from sth.en: The two teams became separated from each other during the chaotic race.

to begin to believe in a religion.en: It took him years to begin to believe in the religion he had once despised.

to begin to discuss or deal with sth.en: We must begin to discuss the budget before the meeting ends.
to begin to discuss or deal with sth.cn: 我们必须在会议结束前开始讨论预算。

to begin to do sth as a habit.en: He began to spend his evenings alone, turning solitude into a comforting habit.
to begin to do sth as a habit.cn: 他开始独自度过傍晚时光，将孤独化为一种令人安适的习惯。

to begin to return somewhere.en: He decided to begin to return somewhere after his long journey.

to behave in a careful and sensible way.en: He decided to behave in a careful and sensible way during the critical negotiations.

to bet money on sth.en: He decided to bet his life savings on the outcome of that high-stakes poker game.

to boot.en: The project is already behind schedule, and it's going to be late by the hour.
to boot.cn: 项目已严重滞后，预计将每拖延一小时。

to build sth or place sth somewhere.en: The engineers spent months to build a new bridge across the river.

to collect sth from a place.en: She decided to collect the documents from the office before leaving.

to come to an end.en: The long debate finally came to an end, leaving everyone exhausted.

to complain about sth.en: The residents keep complaining about the constant noise from the construction site.

to create an idea in your imagination.en: She managed to create a vivid idea in her imagination about the future.

to create sth or start it.en: The company decided to create a new department to boost innovation.

to criticize sb severely.en: The committee decided to criticize the manager severely for his negligence.

to depend on sth.en: We cannot succeed unless we completely depend on each other's support.

to distraction.en: The constant noise drove everyone to distraction, making it impossible to concentrate on work.

to divide into parts to be analysed.en: We divided the complex data set into smaller parts to be analysed systematically.

to do and complete a task.en: He managed to do and complete the complex project ahead of schedule.

to do sth that you really enjoy.en: You should pursue a career in something you truly love and enjoy every single day.
