to make a note of sth.cn: 会议开始前，请记下关键日期。

to make a particular impression.en: The candidate's confident demeanor made a lasting impression on the interview panel.
to make a particular impression.cn: 该候选人的自信举止给面试小组留下了深刻印象。

to make a photograph bigger.en: To make a photograph bigger, you can use software to enlarge the image.
to make a photograph bigger.cn: 若要将照片放大，可使用软件将图像放大。

to make a short visit somewhere.en: I'll just drop by to make a short visit and pick up some mail.
to make a short visit somewhere.cn: 我顺道过来拜访一下，顺便取些信件。

to make an aircraft fall out of the sky.en: The pilot managed to make the aircraft fall out of the sky just before impact.
to make an aircraft fall out of the sky.cn: 飞行员设法让飞机在撞击前坠出天空。

to make an alarm start ringing.en: She managed to make the fire alarm start ringing loudly.
to make an alarm start ringing.cn: 她设法让火警报警器发出刺耳的响声。

to make an attempt to get or win sth.en: She made a determined attempt to secure the championship title.

to make an engine start running.en: The mechanic had to make the old engine start running again after it seized.
to make an engine start running.cn: 技师必须让卡死的旧发动机重新运转起来。

to make contact with sb by telephone.en: It took us a while to make contact with the manager by telephone.
to make contact with sb by telephone.cn: 我们花了些时间才通过电话与经理取得联系。

to make less effort.en: He decided to make less effort on the project and relax his pace.
to make less effort.cn: 他决定减少在该项目上的投入，放慢进度。

to make sb feel better.en: The warm drink helped me feel better after the long and exhausting meeting.
to make sb feel better.cn: 那杯热饮让我在漫长而疲惫的会议后感觉好多了。

to make sb feel very unhappy or worried.en: The constant criticism made her feel extremely anxious and upset about her future.
to make sb feel very unhappy or worried.cn: 不断的批评让她对未来感到极度焦虑和不安。

to make sb go away by frightening them.en: The loud noise made the intruders flee in terror.
to make sb go away by frightening them.cn: 巨大的噪音吓得闯入者仓皇逃窜。

to make sb remember a time in the past.en: The old photograph made me remember those happy days in my childhood.
to make sb remember a time in the past.cn: 这张旧照片让我想起了童年的快乐时光。

to make sb surprised and no longer calm.en: The sudden announcement left the team completely surprised and no longer calm.
to make sb surprised and no longer calm.cn: 突如其来的宣布让团队完全出乎意料，不再平静。

to make sb unconscious.en: The severe shock made him completely unconscious, requiring immediate medical attention.
to make sb unconscious.cn: 剧烈冲击使他完全昏迷，需立即就医。

to make sth appear on a computer screen.en: The manager clicked the button to make the report appear on the computer screen immediately.
to make sth appear on a computer screen.cn: 经理按下按钮，报告即刻出现在电脑屏幕上。

to make sth easy to see or hear.en: The committee decided to make the new policy easy to see for all stakeholders.
to make sth easy to see or hear.cn: 委员会决定使新政策对所有利益相关者一目了然。

to make sth easy to see or understand.en: The diagram makes the complex process easy to see and understand for everyone.
to make sth easy to see or understand.cn: 该图表使复杂流程一目了然。

to make sth move around in water or air.en: The strong wind made the leaves move around in the air.
to make sth move around in water or air.cn: 狂风使树叶在风中翻飞。

to make sth point away from the centre.en: The architect designed the windows to make them point away from the building's centre.
to make sth point away from the centre.cn: 建筑师设计窗户使其朝向背离建筑中心的方向。

to make sth remain at a high level.en: The government implemented policies to ensure economic growth remains at a high level.
to make sth remain at a high level.cn: 政府实施政策，确保经济保持高速增长。

to manage to do or complete sth.en: She managed to finish the report before the deadline.
to manage to do or complete sth.cn: 她设法在截止日期前完成了报告。

to manage to do or say sth.en: She managed to explain the complex theory clearly to everyone.
to manage to do or say sth.cn: 她向众人清晰地解释了复杂的理论。

to move into a particular position.en: The company moved into a dominant position in the global market within two years.
to move into a particular position.cn: 该公司两年内便在全球市场占据主导地位。

to move sth to a later time or date.en: We decided to move the meeting to a later date due to the unexpected rain.
to move sth to a later time or date.cn: 因突降大雨，我们将会议改期至后日。

to my mind.en: To my mind, this proposal is the most effective solution we could possibly find.
to my mind.cn: 在我看来，这是我们能找到的最有效的解决方案。

to my way of thinking.en: To my way of thinking, the project needs more time and budget.
to my way of thinking.cn: 依我看，该项目需要更多的时间和预算。

to no effect.en: The new medication had no effect on his chronic pain, leaving him in constant agony.
to no effect.cn: 新药对他的慢性疼痛毫无作用，使他长期处于剧烈痛苦之中。

to not consider sth.en: The committee decided to not consider the proposal due to insufficient funding.
to not consider sth.cn: 委员会因资金不足决定不予考虑该提议。

to not do sth immediately.en: He decided to not do the task immediately, choosing instead to postpone it until tomorrow.
to not do sth immediately.cn: 他决定不立即完成任务，而是推迟到明天再做。

to not get involved in sth.en: She decided to not get involved in the dispute, preferring to stay completely neutral.
to not get involved in sth.cn: 她决定不参与争执，坚持完全中立。

to not go to bed until later than usual.en: She decided not to go to bed until later than usual due to her late work hours.
to not go to bed until later than usual.cn: 她因工作较晚，决定比平时更晚才去睡觉。

to not leave somewhere.en: He decided to not leave the meeting until everyone had finished speaking.
to not leave somewhere.cn: 他决定等所有人说完话才离开会议。

to obtain an official document or servic.en: She applied online to obtain an official document for her visa.
to obtain an official document or servic.cn: 她在线申请了一份用于签证的官方文件。

to obtain sth again after having lost it.en: She managed to retrieve her lost passport before the flight departed.
to obtain sth again after having lost it.cn: 她在航班起飞前设法找回了丢失的护照。

to pass very slowly.en: The project is being completed to pass very slowly, delaying our launch date.
to pass very slowly.cn: 该项目进展缓慢，严重推迟了我们的上线日期。

to pay part of the cost of sth.en: You should consider paying part of the cost upfront to secure your booking.
to pay part of the cost of sth.cn: 建议预付部分费用以锁定预订。

to prepare a dead body to be buried.en: They began preparing the deceased's body for burial immediately after death.
to prepare a dead body to be buried.cn: 死者刚断气，他们便立即开始准备遗体下葬。

to prepare yourself mentally for sth.en: You must prepare yourself mentally for the inevitable challenges ahead.
to prepare yourself mentally for sth.cn: 你必须为即将到来的不可避免的挑战做好心理准备。

to present sth.en: The mayor will officially present the award to the outstanding student.
to present sth.cn: 市长将正式向杰出学生颁发奖项。

to produce sth very quickly.en: The factory had to rush production to meet the urgent deadline.
to produce sth very quickly.cn: 工厂不得不加快生产以赶上紧急期限。

to provide a large amount of money for s.en: The government decided to provide a large amount of money for the new infrastructure project.
to provide a large amount of money for s.cn: 政府决定为这项新基础设施项目提供大量资金。

to provide or lend money.en: The bank agreed to provide the loan funds immediately.
to provide or lend money.cn: 银行同意立即提供贷款资金。

to publicly ask for sth to happen.en: The community decided to publicly ask for immediate action on climate change.
to publicly ask for sth to happen.cn: 该社区决定公开呼吁立即采取行动应对气候变化。

to publish or broadcast sth.en: The government decided to publish or broadcast the sensitive data immediately.
to publish or broadcast sth.cn: 政府决定立即公布或广播敏感数据。

to pull or touch sth several times.en: She kept pulling the fabric repeatedly to test its durability before sewing it.
to pull or touch sth several times.cn: 她在缝纫前反复拉扯布料以测试其耐用性。

to push a bone out of its normal positio.en: The fall pushed his shoulder bone out of its normal position, causing severe pain.
to push a bone out of its normal positio.cn: 坠落导致他的肩骨脱位，引发剧烈疼痛。

to push or press sth into sth else.en: He tried to push the stubborn idea into his mind until it took root.
to push or press sth into sth else.cn: 他试图将那个顽固的念头植入脑海，直至生根发芽。

to push sth into sth else.en: He tried to push the old data into the new system without proper formatting.
to push sth into sth else.cn: 他试图将未正确格式化的旧数据录入新系统。

to put a fire out by beating.en: He tried to put the fire out by beating it with a wet blanket.
to put a fire out by beating.cn: 他用湿毯子拍打试图扑灭大火。

to put it mildly.en: To put it mildly, the project was a complete disaster from start to finish.
to put it mildly.cn: 轻描淡写地说，该项目从头到尾都是一场彻底的灾难。

to reach a particular level or amount.en: The company aims to reach a specific profit level by the end of this fiscal year.
to reach a particular level or amount.cn: 该公司旨在本财年年底前达到特定的盈利水平。

to reach an acceptable level or standard.en: The new policy aims to reach an acceptable level of safety for all residents.
to reach an acceptable level or standard.cn: 新政策旨在确保所有居民的安全达到可接受水平。

to reach as far down as a particular poi.en: The curtain reached as far down as the floor, creating a dramatic effect.
to reach as far down as a particular poi.cn: 窗帘垂至地面，营造出戏剧性的效果。

to read or watch only parts of sth.en: I prefer to skim the latest reports rather than read every single detail.
to read or watch only parts of sth.cn: 我更喜欢浏览最新报告的大意，而不是阅读每一个细节。

to receive a relatively light punishment.en: The court decided to give him a relatively light punishment due to his remorse.
to receive a relatively light punishment.cn: 鉴于其悔罪表现，法院决定对其从轻处罚。

to receive sth.en: The company will receive the payment within three business days.
to receive sth.cn: 该公司将于三个工作日内收到付款。

to reduce or destroy sth gradually.en: The relentless erosion of the cliff has gradually destroyed its original structure.
to reduce or destroy sth gradually.cn: 悬崖受侵蚀不断破坏其原有结构。

to reduce your costs.en: To reduce your costs, the company implemented a strict budgeting system.
to reduce your costs.cn: 为降低成本，公司实施了严格的预算制度。

to remove a substance from sth by washin.en: The detergent effectively removes oil stains from the fabric by washing.
to remove a substance from sth by washin.cn: 洗涤剂通过洗涤可有效去除织物上的油渍。

to remove sth from the ground by digging.en: They dug up the ancient ruins to remove them from the ground.
to remove sth from the ground by digging.cn: 他们挖掘古遗址以将其从地面清除。

to reply to attacks or criticism.en: She decided to reply to the critics' harsh attacks with a witty counter-argument.
to reply to attacks or criticism.cn: 她决定用机智的反驳来回应批评家的严厉攻击。

to return money that you borrowed from s.en: He finally returned the money he had borrowed from his friend last month.
to return money that you borrowed from s.cn: 他终于归还了上个月向朋友借的钱。

to rise suddenly by a large amount.en: The stock prices rose suddenly by a large amount, causing panic among investors.
to rise suddenly by a large amount.cn: 股价突然大幅上涨，引发投资者恐慌。

to save money to spend later.en: We need to save money now so we can afford a new car later.
to save money to spend later.cn: 我们现在需要存钱，以便将来能买得起新车。

to say nothing of sth.en: To say nothing of the extra cost, it would also take too long to complete.
to say nothing of sth.cn: 不说额外的费用，仅工期也会过长。

to say sth in a sharp unpleasant way.en: She spoke to the rude customer in a sharp, unpleasant tone that made him cry.
to say sth in a sharp unpleasant way.cn: 她以尖刻难听的语气对那位粗鲁的顾客说话，使他哭了起来。

to say sth with difficulty.en: He struggled to say the word with difficulty due to his severe stutter.
to say sth with difficulty.cn: 他因口吃严重而艰难地试图说出这个词。

to say that sth is true when it may not.en: He claimed the deal was final, even though evidence suggested otherwise.
to say that sth is true when it may not.cn: 他声称该交易已成定局，尽管证据表明并非如此。

to say what you mean in a clear way.en: He explained his position clearly, ensuring everyone understood exactly what he meant.
to say what you mean in a clear way.cn: 他清楚地阐述了自己的立场，确保每个人都确切理解了他的意思。

to sb's credit.en: It is to his credit that he never gave up despite the difficulties.
to sb's credit.cn: 他虽历经困难却从未放弃，实乃值得称道之举。

to sb's door.en: The police went straight to the suspect's door without any delay.
to sb's door.cn: 警方未作任何耽搁便径直前往嫌疑人住所。

to sb's face.en: He lied to her face, which made her feel deeply embarrassed.
to sb's face.cn: 他当面撒谎，让她深感尴尬。

to sb's liking.en: The new design didn't quite meet to everyone's liking.
to sb's liking.cn: 新设计并未完全符合所有人的喜好。

to serve food onto plates for a meal.en: The waiter skillfully served the fresh pasta onto individual plates before the guests began their meal.
to serve food onto plates for a meal.cn: 侍者熟练地将新鲜意面盛入餐盘，供客人们享用。

to settle and live in one place.en: They decided to settle and live in one place after years of traveling.
to settle and live in one place.cn: 他们决定定居下来，不再四处漂泊。

to shout at or speak angrily to sb.en: He shouted at the waiter for bringing the wrong order.
to shout at or speak angrily to sb.cn: 他因侍者上错菜而大声斥责。

to spend time doing nothing very useful.en: He spent the entire afternoon sitting in his room, doing absolutely nothing useful.
to spend time doing nothing very useful.cn: 他整个下午都待在房间里，什么有用的事也没做。

to start a process or a series of events.en: The scandal started a chain reaction that toppled the entire government.
to start a process or a series of events.cn: 丑闻引发连锁反应，导致整个政府垮台。

to start a process or series of events.en: The scandal started a chain reaction that toppled the government.
to start a process or series of events.cn: 丑闻引发连锁反应，导致政府倒台。

to start at a place and go away from it.en: The hikers started at the valley floor and moved steadily upward.
to start at a place and go away from it.cn: 徒步者从谷底出发，稳步向上攀登。

to start doing sth with a lot of energy.en: He began the project with great enthusiasm, pouring all his energy into every task.
to start doing sth with a lot of energy.cn: 他满怀热情地开始了这个项目，将全部精力投入到每一项任务中。

to start laughing a lot.en: He couldn't help but start laughing a lot at her silly jokes.
to start laughing a lot.cn: 他忍不住经常笑她那些愚蠢的笑话。

to start or begin sth such as a job.en: He decided to start a new career in software engineering last month.
to start or begin sth such as a job.cn: 他上个月决定开始新的软件工程师职业生涯。

to start suddenly and with force.en: The crowd erupted into cheers when the team scored a sudden, forceful goal.
to start suddenly and with force.cn: 球队突然攻入一球后，人群欢呼雀跃。

to start to act or move as if alive.en: The statue seemed to start to act or move as if alive when the wind blew.
to start to act or move as if alive.cn: 风一吹，雕像仿佛活了过来，似乎要动起来。

to stop at a place for a short time.en: The train stopped at the station briefly before continuing its journey.
to stop at a place for a short time.cn: 火车在车站稍作停留后继续前行。

to stop doing a job so sb else can do it.en: She decided to step aside from the project so her colleague could take the lead.
to stop doing a job so sb else can do it.cn: 她决定退出项目，以便同事能牵头负责。

to stop existing.en: The ancient civilization faded away until it completely stopped existing in history.
to stop existing.cn: 古代文明逐渐消亡，直至彻底消失在历史中。

to stop having a relationship with sb.en: She decided to stop having a relationship with him after he lied repeatedly.
to stop having a relationship with sb.cn: 他屡次撒谎后，她决定与他断绝关系。

to stop or get rid of sth.en: The government launched a campaign to stop and get rid of illegal drug trafficking.
to stop or get rid of sth.cn: 政府发起运动以打击并取缔非法毒品贩运。

to stop sth by force.en: The government decided to stop the violent riots by force.
to stop sth by force.cn: 政府决定动用武力平息暴乱。

to stop sth from burning or shining.en: We must act quickly to stop the fire from spreading and burning further.
to stop sth from burning or shining.cn: 我们必须迅速采取行动，阻止火势蔓延并继续燃烧。

to stop working.en: The server crashed and we had to stop working immediately.
to stop working.cn: 服务器崩溃，我们不得不立即停止工作。

to succeed in doing sth very difficult.en: She managed to succeed in solving the most complex equation ever.
to succeed in doing sth very difficult.cn: 她成功解出了有史以来最复杂的方程。

to succeed in getting a job very easily.en: It is incredibly easy to secure employment without any prior experience.
to succeed in getting a job very easily.cn: 无需任何经验即可轻松获得工作。

to suddenly become angry or violent.en: He was so easily provoked that he would suddenly become angry or violent at the slightest provocation.
to suddenly become angry or violent.cn: 他极易被激怒，稍受刺激便会突然发怒或暴怒。

to suddenly become very angry.en: She was so easily provoked that she would suddenly become very angry at the slightest provocation.
to suddenly become very angry.cn: 她极易被激怒，稍受刺激便会勃然大怒。

to suddenly start burning very strongly.en: The fire suddenly started burning very strongly, casting long shadows across the room.
to suddenly start burning very strongly.cn: 火突然猛烈燃烧起来，在房间里投下长长的影子。

to suggest sth for discussion.en: The committee suggested a new policy for discussion at the upcoming meeting.
to suggest sth for discussion.cn: 委员会建议了一项新政策，供下次会议讨论。

to support sth.en: The government must support the new policy to boost economic growth.
to support sth.cn: 政府必须支持新政策以促进经济增长。

to switch on a piece of equipment.en: We need to switch on the generator before the power fails completely.
to switch on a piece of equipment.cn: 必须在电力完全中断前启动发电机。

to take an active part in sth.en: She decided to take an active part in the community project.
to take an active part in sth.cn: 她决定积极参与社区项目。

to take notice of sth with your eyes.en: You must take notice of the subtle signs with your eyes.
to take notice of sth with your eyes.cn: 你必须用眼睛留意细微的迹象。

to take part in a discussion.en: She decided to take part in the debate to share her unique perspective on the issue.
to take part in a discussion.cn: 她决定参加辩论，分享自己对这一问题的独特见解。

to taste.en: The chef added a pinch of salt to taste before serving the dish.
to taste.cn: 上菜前，厨师尝了一口，加了一小撮盐调味。

to the bone.en: The cold penetrated to the bone, making it impossible for anyone to move.

to the contrary.en: To the contrary, the data clearly indicates that remote work significantly boosts productivity.
to the contrary.cn: 相反，数据明确表明远程办公能显著提升生产力。

to the core.en: The scandal reached to the core of his reputation, destroying everything he had built.
to the core.cn: 丑闻触及了他声誉的核心，毁掉了他一切建树。

to the day.en: The project was completed to the day, exactly as we had planned.
to the day.cn: 该项目如期完成，完全按计划进行。

to the death.en: They fought to the death, refusing to surrender until their final breath.
to the death.cn: 他们战至最后一人，直至生命终结也拒不投降。

to the gills.en: The restaurant was packed to the gills with hungry customers.
to the gills.cn: 餐厅里挤满了饥肠辘辘的顾客。

to the last man.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision, to the last man.
to the last man.cn: 委员会全体一致通过决议。

to the letter.en: She copied the instructions to the letter, ensuring every detail was followed precisely.
to the letter.cn: 她一字不差地抄下说明，确保每一个细节都得到精确执行。

to the max.en: The company aims to maximize its profits to the max this quarter.
to the max.cn: 该公司本季度力求实现利润最大化。

to the memory of sb.en: In memory of her late father, this garden was dedicated to his loving spirit.
to the memory of sb.cn: 为纪念她已故的父亲，这座花园被献给了他的慈爱精神。

to the minute.en: The meeting must start to the minute, or we will miss the crucial deadline.
to the minute.cn: 会议必须准时开始，否则我们将错过关键截止日期。

to the nth degree.en: The situation has deteriorated to the nth degree, leaving us with no viable options.
to the nth degree.cn: 局势已恶化到极点，让我们别无选择。

to the point.en: The manager's feedback was direct and to the point, saving us hours of confusion.
to the point.cn: 经理的反馈直截了当，帮我们省去了数小时的困惑。

to the tune of sth.en: The project cost to the tune of $5 million, far exceeding our initial budget.
to the tune of sth.cn: 该项目耗资 500 万美元，远超我们的初始预算。

to think about sth carefully.en: Before making such a critical decision, you need to think about it very carefully.
to think about sth carefully.cn: 做出如此重大的决定前，你必须仔细思考。

to this day.en: To this day, he has never forgotten the kindness shown to him by his mentor.
to this day.cn: 至今，他从未忘记导师对他的恩惠。

to travel and live in various places.en: She prefers to travel and live in various places rather than staying in one city forever.
to travel and live in various places.cn: 她更喜欢四处旅行和居住，而不是永远定居在一个城市。

to try to cause arguments or problems.en: He tried to stir up trouble by spreading rumors about the company's financial health.
to try to cause arguments or problems.cn: 他通过散布关于公司财务状况的谣言来制造麻烦。

to try to take an opportunity.en: He tried to take an opportunity to present his new research findings to the committee.
to try to take an opportunity.cn: 他试图借机向委员会展示他的最新研究成果。

to try to take hold of sth in your hands.en: He tried desperately to take hold of the slippery rope with his hands.
to try to take hold of sth in your hands.cn: 他拼命用手抓住那根滑溜溜的绳索。

to use energy by doing exercise.en: You can burn off excess energy simply by engaging in regular physical exercise.
to use energy by doing exercise.cn: 只需进行规律的身体锻炼即可消耗多余的能量。

to use up or finish sth completely.en: We must stop wasting electricity to avoid using up our limited resources completely.
to use up or finish sth completely.cn: 我们必须停止浪费电力，以免耗尽有限的资源。

to use up or spend money carelessly.en: He spent his savings on luxury items, effectively squandering all his hard-earned money.
to use up or spend money carelessly.cn: 他将积蓄挥霍在奢侈品上，实际上耗尽了他辛苦赚来的所有钱财。

to wait for sth to happen.en: We must wait for the storm to pass before we can leave the house.
to wait for sth to happen.cn: 我们必须等风暴过去后才能离开房子。

to win an election.en: The candidate managed to win an election by appealing directly to voters' concerns.
to win an election.cn: 该候选人通过直接回应选民关切成功当选。

to wit.en: The project faced delays, to wit, a lack of funding and skilled personnel.
to wit.cn: 该项目面临延误，原因在于资金短缺和缺乏熟练人员。

to work together in doing sth.en: The researchers decided to work together in developing a new vaccine.
to work together in doing sth.cn: 研究人员决定共同研制一种新疫苗。

to worry sb over a period of time.en: The constant noise worried him over a long period of time.
to worry sb over a period of time.cn: 长期的噪音令他深感忧虑。

to write sth down.en: She insisted on writing down every detail to ensure nothing was forgotten.
to write sth down.cn: 她坚持将每一个细节都记录下来，以确保无一遗漏。

to your heart's content.en: You can eat as much cake to your heart's content without worrying about the calories.
to your heart's content.cn: 您可以尽情享用蛋糕，无需担心热量问题。

to your knowledge.en: To your knowledge, the project has been completed ahead of schedule.
to your knowledge.cn: 据你所知，该项目已提前完成。

too much like hard work.en: The task is too much like hard work for me to complete quickly.
too much like hard work.cn: 这项任务对我来说太像苦差事了，无法快速完成。

too much of a good thing.en: Sometimes, too much of a good thing can actually ruin the overall experience.
too much of a good thing.cn: 有时，过多的好事反而会毁掉整体体验。

too right.en: That assessment is too right; the data clearly confirms our hypothesis.
too right.cn: 这一评估过于准确；数据确实证实了我们的假设。

touch wood.en: Before starting the new project, I always touch wood to wish for success.
touch wood.cn: 在新项目开始前，我总会摸一下木头以求成功。

towards the place where a river starts.en: We hiked towards the place where the river starts, following the trail upstream.
towards the place where a river starts.cn: 我们沿着小径向河流源头徒步走去。

travel light.en: To travel light means packing only essential items to ensure effortless movement and reduced luggage weight.
travel light.cn: 轻装出行是指仅携带必需品，以确保行动自如并减轻行李重量。

travelling around a place.en: We spent our summer travelling around the countryside, visiting remote villages.
travelling around a place.cn: 我们夏天在乡下四处旅行，走访偏远村庄。

tread on sb's heels.en: Critics often tread on the heels of established artists, copying their style without adding anything new.
tread on sb's heels.cn: 批评家往往跟在已确立的艺术家的脚步后面，模仿其风格却未增添新意。

treat sb like dirt.en: He treated her like dirt, ignoring her every request and insult.
treat sb like dirt.cn: 他视她如粪土，无视她的每一句请求与辱骂。

treat sb to sth.en: The company will treat all employees to a lavish dinner tonight.
treat sb to sth.cn: 公司今晚将宴请全体员工。

trial and error.en: We solved the complex puzzle only through relentless trial and error.
trial and error.cn: 我们仅凭坚持不懈的试错才解开了这个复杂的谜题。

trick or treat.en: Children knock on doors and ask for trick or treat to get candy.
trick or treat.cn: 孩子们敲门索要糖果，以换取节日礼物。

true to form.en: He was true to form, arriving at the meeting exactly on time as usual.

truth is stranger than fiction.en: The reality of the situation proved far stranger than any fictional tale could ever imagine.
truth is stranger than fiction.cn: 局势之诡异，远超任何虚构故事所能想象。

try sb's patience.en: His constant complaining truly tried my patience to the limit.
try sb's patience.cn: 他无休止的抱怨真让我忍无可忍。

turn in on yourself.en: She turned in on herself after the breakup, preferring solitude to social interaction.
turn in on yourself.cn: 分手后她把自己封闭起来，宁愿独处也不愿与人交往。

turn on sb.en: He suddenly turned on his rival during the heated debate.
turn on sb.cn: 他在激烈的辩论中突然攻击对手。

turn on the waterworks.en: She turned on the waterworks to get sympathy from her boss.
turn on the waterworks.cn: 她装可怜以博得上司的同情。

turn over a new leaf.en: He decided to turn over a new leaf after his serious mistakes.
turn over a new leaf.cn: 他在犯下严重错误后决定改过自新。

turn over sth.en: The company turned over $5 million in sales last year.
turn over sth.cn: 该公司去年销售额达 500 万美元。

turn sth to your advantage.en: You can turn this unexpected delay into a significant advantage for your project.
turn sth to your advantage.cn: 您可借此意外延误为项目争取显著优势。

turn swords into ploughshares.en: We must turn swords into ploughshares to build a peaceful future for all.
turn swords into ploughshares.cn: 我们必须将剑化为犁，为所有人建设和平的未来。

turn tail.en: When the storm threatened their lives, they had no choice but to turn tail and flee.
turn tail.cn: 风暴危及他们的生命时，他们别无选择，只能转身逃跑。

turn the corner.en: After months of treatment, his health finally turned the corner and he is back to work.
turn the corner.cn: 经过数月治疗，他的健康终于好转，现已重返工作岗位。

turn the other cheek.en: Instead of retaliating, she chose to turn the other cheek when he insulted her.
turn the other cheek.cn: 面对他的侮辱，她选择宽恕而非报复。

turn the page.en: After enduring those hardships, we must turn the page and embrace a fresh beginning.
turn the page.cn: 历经磨难后，我们必须翻过这一页，拥抱新的开始。

turn the tide.en: The team's unexpected victory finally managed to turn the tide against their rivals.
turn the tide.cn: 球队意外获胜，最终扭转了对阵对手的局势。

turn up like a bad penny.en: It's ironic that he keeps turning up like a bad penny at our reunion.
turn up like a bad penny.cn: 他总像枚倒霉的硬币一样在我们重逢时出现，真是讽刺。

turn your back.en: He turned his back on the departing crowd and walked away alone.
turn your back.cn: 他背过身去，独自走向离去的人群。

turn your hand to sth.en: Once you turn your hand to this task, you'll find it surprisingly easy to complete.
turn your hand to sth.cn: 一旦你着手这项任务，就会发现完成它出乎意料地容易。

turn your nose up at sth.en: She turned her nose up at the proposal, refusing to consider it even briefly.
turn your nose up at sth.cn: 她对该提议嗤之以鼻，甚至不愿稍作考虑。

turn your stomach.en: The sight of the rotting food immediately turned my stomach.
turn your stomach.cn: 看到腐烂的食物让我立刻感到恶心。

twice over.en: The evidence is twice over, proving his guilt beyond any reasonable doubt.
twice over.cn: 证据确凿，足以排除一切合理怀疑，证明其有罪。

twist sb's arm.en: The recruiter tried to twist the candidate's arm into accepting the job offer.
twist sb's arm.cn: 招聘人员试图说服候选人接受工作邀请。

two can play at that game.en: He tried to trick me, but I know two can play at that game.
two can play at that game.cn: 他试图骗我，但我知道两个人都能玩这招。

two heads are better than one.en: Two heads are better than one, so we should consult each other before making any major decision.
two heads are better than one.cn: 三个臭皮匠，顶个诸葛亮，因此我们在做重大决定前应互相商议。

under a cloud.en: He was under a cloud after the scandal damaged his reputation.
under a cloud.cn: 丑闻损害了他的声誉，使他备受非议。

under age.en: The minor was denied entry because he was under age.
under age.cn: 该未成年人因未满法定年龄被拒绝入境。

under canvas.en: We spent the entire night under canvas, huddled together for warmth.
under canvas.cn: 我们整晚在帐篷下蜷缩取暖。

under protest.en: He signed the contract under protest, refusing to accept the unfair terms.
under protest.cn: 他在抗议下签署了合同，拒绝接受不公正条款。

under the care of sb.en: The patient is under the care of a renowned specialist in this field.
under the care of sb.cn: 该患者由本领域知名专家诊治。

under the counter.en: He was caught selling illegal drugs under the counter.
under the counter.cn: 他在柜台后被发现贩卖毒品。

under the heel of sb.en: The company is completely under the heel of its ruthless owner.
under the heel of sb.cn: 该公司完全受制于其冷酷无情的老板。

under the influence.en: He drove under the influence of alcohol, which nearly caused a fatal accident.
under the influence.cn: 他酒后驾车，险些酿成致命事故。

under the knife.en: After weeks of preparation, he finally went under the knife for his life-saving surgery.
under the knife.cn: 经过数周的准备，他终于接受了挽救生命的手术。

under the same roof.en: Living under the same roof with my parents often leads to frequent arguments.
under the same roof.cn: 与父母同住常引发频繁争吵。

under the sun.en: There are countless stars under the sun that shine brighter than any we have ever seen.
under the sun.cn: 在太阳之下，有无数星辰比我们所见任何一颗都要明亮。

under the weather.en: He seemed under the weather, looking pale and unusually tired.
under the weather.cn: 他似乎身体不适，面色苍白且异常疲倦。

under your feet.en: The clutter under his feet was severely hindering his ability to move quickly through the office.
under your feet.cn: 他脚下的杂物严重阻碍了他在办公室快速移动的能力。

under your roof.en: You can always rely on us to be under your roof whenever you need help.
under your roof.cn: 无论您需要帮助，我们随时乐意在您家中为您提供服务。

unknown to sb.en: It was completely unknown to him that the project had already been approved.
unknown to sb.cn: 他完全不知道该项目早已获批。

up against sth.en: The team is up against a formidable opponent in the final match.
up against sth.cn: 这支队伍在决赛中将面对强大的对手。

up and down sth.en: The ship rocked violently up and down the rough sea waves.
up and down sth.cn: 船在波涛汹涌的海面上剧烈颠簸。

up and running.en: The new software is now up and running, delivering accurate data instantly.
up and running.cn: 新软件现已运行，可即时提供准确数据。

up in the air.en: The future of this project remains completely up in the air until we receive final approval.
up in the air.cn: 该项目的前景在获得最终批准前仍完全不明朗。

up north.en: We decided to drive up north for a weekend getaway.
up north.cn: 我们决定驱车北上，去度一个周末假期。

up the pole.en: The crowd went up the pole when they heard the band play.
up the pole.cn: 乐队奏响时，人群涌向高杆。

up the wall.en: The constant noise finally drove him up the wall, making it impossible for him to concentrate on his work.
up the wall.cn: 持续的噪音终于让他烦躁不堪，无法集中精力工作。

up to par.en: The team's recent performance has finally returned up to par with their usual standards.
up to par.cn: 该队近期表现终于恢复到其一贯水准。

up top.en: He has an excellent head for logic and can solve complex problems up top.
up top.cn: 他逻辑天赋极佳，能迅速解决复杂问题。

upset the apple cart.en: The sudden change in our travel plans truly upset the apple cart.
upset the apple cart.cn: 我们旅行计划的突然变更彻底打乱了原有的安排。

use your head.en: You should use your head and think before you make such a rash decision.
use your head.cn: 做这种鲁莽的决定前，你应该三思而后行。

used for introducing bad news.en: I regret to inform you that the project has been cancelled due to budget cuts.
used for introducing bad news.cn: 很抱歉通知您，该项目因预算削减而取消。

used in negative sentences to mean unusu.en: This rare phenomenon is seldom used in negative sentences to mean unusual.
used in negative sentences to mean unusu.cn: 此罕见现象极少用于否定句中表示‘不寻常’之意。

used to avoid repeating a full verb.en: She used to avoid repeating a full verb by saying 'it' instead.
used to avoid repeating a full verb.cn: 她过去习惯用‘它’来代替完整的动词。

used to disagree politely with sb.en: She used to disagree politely with her boss by saying sorry and asking for reconsideration.
used to disagree politely with sb.cn: 她曾礼貌地不同意老板的意见，通过道歉并请求重新考虑来表达。

used to emphasize sth that you are sayin.en: I used to emphasize the point that you must know this.
used to emphasize sth that you are sayin.cn: 我曾强调过，你必须了解这一点。

used to express surprise or anger.en: "What?" He used to express his shock at the unexpected news.
used to express surprise or anger.cn: 什么？他过去常用来表达听到意外消息时的震惊。

used to introduce a new idea or suggesti.en: I'd like to introduce a new approach to solving this complex problem.
used to introduce a new idea or suggesti.cn: 我想介绍一种解决这一复杂问题的新方法。

used to introduce the next part of a sto.en: He used to introduce the next part of the story with a dramatic pause.
used to introduce the next part of a sto.cn: 他习惯用戏剧性的停顿来引出故事的下文。

used to make a suggestion.en: I suggest we take the bus; what do you think?
used to make a suggestion.cn: 我建议我们坐公交车，你觉得呢？

used to say that sth has been removed.en: He used to say that the old furniture had been removed from the living room.
used to say that sth has been removed.cn: 他常说，旧家具已从客厅搬走。

used to say that sth seems unlikely.en: He used to say that such a sudden change of plans seemed entirely unlikely.
used to say that sth seems unlikely.cn: 他过去常说，如此突然的计划变更似乎完全不可能。

used to talk about the reason for sth.en: It's simply that we used to talk about the reason for this specific problem.
used to talk about the reason for sth.cn: 我们过去只是讨论过这个特定问题的原因。

used when asking sb's opinion of sth.en: What do you think of the new policy? It seems quite controversial to many.
used when asking sb's opinion of sth.cn: 您觉得这项新政策怎么样？许多人认为它颇具争议。

used when explaining or showing sth to s.en: That's it; I've just explained the concept clearly enough for you to understand.
used when explaining or showing sth to s.cn: 就是这样；我已经把概念解释得足够清楚，让你能够理解了。

used when giving sb a surprise.en: I can't believe it; I never expected such an unexpected surprise from you.
used when giving sb a surprise.cn: 我不敢相信；我从未料到你会有如此意想不到的惊喜。

used when you are not sure about sth.en: I'm not entirely sure, but it could be something else.
used when you are not sure about sth.cn: 我不太确定，但可能是别的原因。

variety is the spice of life.en: A variety of experiences is truly the spice that makes life so delightful.
variety is the spice of life.cn: 多样的经历才是让生活如此美妙的调味剂。

very similar.en: The two proposals are very similar, differing only in minor details.
very similar.cn: 这两项提议非常相似，仅在细微之处有所不同。

virtue is its own reward.en: The true virtue is that the act itself becomes its own reward.
virtue is its own reward.cn: 真正的德行在于行为本身即是其回报。

vote with your feet.en: Consumers can vote with their feet by choosing to buy from competitors instead.
vote with your feet.cn: 消费者可以通过选择购买竞争对手的产品来投票。

wait and see.en: We'll wait and see how the new policy affects the local economy before making any further decisions.
wait and see.cn: 我们将观察新政策对当地经济的影响，再作进一步决定。

wait at table.en: Waiters will wait at the table to serve your meal promptly.
wait at table.cn: 服务员将守在桌旁，确保您的餐点及时上桌。

wait for the dust to settle.en: We must wait for the dust to settle before making any final decisions on the case.
wait for the dust to settle.cn: 在尘埃落定之前，我们不得不对此案做出任何最终决定。

wait on sb.en: The waiter will wait on you to serve your meal immediately.
wait on sb.cn: 服务员会立即为您上菜。

wait on sb hand and foot.en: The staff waited on the VIP hand and foot throughout the entire event.
wait on sb hand and foot.cn: 工作人员全程为贵宾提供无微不至的服务。

wake up.en: The new project has finally woken up our team's enthusiasm and energy.
wake up.cn: 新项目终于唤起了团队的激情与活力。

wake up to sth.en: He finally woke up to the reality that his career was in serious decline.
wake up to sth.cn: 他终于意识到自己的事业已陷入严重衰退。

walk free.en: After the retrial, he was finally acquitted and walked free into the sunlight.
walk free.cn: 重审后，他最终获无罪判决，自由地步入阳光之中。

walk off.en: She stormed out of the meeting, refusing to walk off until her concerns were addressed.
walk off.cn: 她愤然离开会议，坚持直到她的关切得到回应才肯离去。

walk sb off their feet.en: The lively party made her walk everyone off their feet by the end of the night.
walk sb off their feet.cn: 热闹的聚会让她在当晚走遍了大街小巷。

walk sb through sth.en: The tutor walked me through the complex physics problem step by step.
walk sb through sth.cn: 导师一步步带我解决了这个复杂的物理问题。

walk tall.en: He walked tall down the street, radiating an air of supreme confidence and arrogance.
walk tall.cn: 他昂首阔步走在街上，散发着至高无上的自信与傲慢。

walk the plank.en: They decided to walk the plank as a cruel punishment for his betrayal.
walk the plank.cn: 他们决定让他走木板作为背叛的残酷惩罚。

walk the streets.en: He decided to walk the streets alone, seeking answers in the bustling city.
walk the streets.cn: 他决定独自漫步街头，在熙攘的城市中寻找答案。

walk the walk.en: He always walks the walk by keeping his promises without any excuses.
walk the walk.cn: 他从不找借口，始终言行一致，信守承诺。

walls have ears.en: Don't whisper secrets, because walls have ears.
walls have ears.cn: 切勿窃窃私语，因为墙上有耳。

warts and all.en: We must accept the company warts and all, despite its recent scandals.
warts and all.cn: 尽管公司近期丑闻不断，我们仍须全盘接受。

wash off.en: The heavy rain finally washed the mud off his muddy boots.
wash off.cn: 大雨终于洗去了他靴子上的泥污。

waste your breath.en: It is pointless to waste your breath arguing with someone who refuses to listen.
waste your breath.cn: 与拒绝倾听的人争辩是徒劳的。

watch it.en: You should watch it when driving in heavy traffic at night.
watch it.cn: 夜间在交通拥堵路段行驶时，应开启该功能。

watch the clock.en: He kept watching the clock, hoping to leave work before his boss returned.
watch the clock.cn: 他不停地看表，希望能在他老板回来之前离开办公室。

watch the time.en: You must watch the time to catch that last train before it departs.
watch the time.cn: 你必须抓紧时间，在火车出发前赶上最后一班。

watch the world go by.en: He sat quietly, watching the world go by as life rushed around him.
watch the world go by.cn: 他静坐不动，看着世界在他身边匆匆流逝。

watch this space.en: Watch this space for the announcement that will change everything.
watch this space.cn: 留意此处，即将发布改变一切的公告。

ways and means.en: The company secured the necessary ways and means to launch its new product line successfully.
ways and means.cn: 该公司成功筹措了所需资源，推出了新产品线。

weak at the knees.en: The shocking news made her weak at the knees, causing her to faint immediately.
weak at the knees.cn: 这惊人的消息让她双腿发软，当场晕了过去。

wear off.en: The pain finally wore off after taking the prescribed medication.
wear off.cn: 服下处方药后，疼痛终于消退了。

wear thin.en: The novelty of his jokes has worn thin, and the audience is losing interest.
wear thin.cn: 他的笑话已显陈旧，观众兴趣渐失。

week after week.en: The project has been delayed week after week, causing significant frustration for the entire team.
week after week.cn: 该项目已周周延宕，致使整个团队深感沮丧。

week by week.en: The project's progress will be tracked week by week until completion.
week by week.cn: 项目将逐周跟踪直至完工。

weigh your words.en: Before speaking, she always weighs her words to ensure they are both accurate and tactful.
weigh your words.cn: 她说话前总是斟酌词句，力求准确得体。

weight of numbers.en: The weight of numbers ensures that our proposal will pass in the final vote.
weight of numbers.cn: 票数优势确保我们的提案能在最终表决中通过。

well and truly.en: The scandal destroyed the company well and truly, leaving no hope of recovery.
well and truly.cn: 丑闻彻底摧毁了公司，使其毫无复苏希望。

what have you.en: What have you, a complete stranger asking for directions?
what have you.cn: 你个完全陌生的路人，竟来问路？

what makes sb tick.en: What really makes her tick is the chance to lead a team.
what makes sb tick.cn: 真正让她充满活力的，是带领团队的机会。

what sb is driving at.en: You should ask what she is driving at regarding the sudden budget cuts.
what sb is driving at.cn: 你应该问问她突然削减预算是什么意思。

what sb is made of.en: What he was made of showed his incredible courage during the crisis.
what sb is made of.cn: 他的所作所为彰显了他在危机中的非凡勇气。

what with sth.en: What with the rain and the traffic, we're late again.
what with sth.cn: 雨大又堵车，我们又一次迟到了。

what's what.en: Let's cut through the noise and focus on what's really important.
what's what.cn: 让我们拨开喧嚣，聚焦真正重要的内容。

whatever you do.en: Whatever you do, never forget that your dreams are worth fighting for.
whatever you do.cn: 无论做什么，永远不要忘记你的梦想值得为之奋斗。

whatever you say.en: Whatever you say, I'll agree to avoid any further argument.
whatever you say.cn: 无论你怎么说，我都同意，以免再发生争执。

wheels within wheels.en: The conspiracy was so intricate that it seemed to have wheels within wheels.
wheels within wheels.cn: 该阴谋错综复杂，仿佛车轮中有车轮。

when sb was young.en: When she was young, she dreamed of becoming a famous artist.
when sb was young.cn: 她年轻时曾梦想成为一名著名艺术家。

when the cat's away the mice will play.en: When the manager leaves, the team members will take full advantage of their newfound freedom.
when the cat's away the mice will play.cn: 经理离开后，团队成员将充分利用这份新获得的自由。

when the chips are down.en: When the chips are down, we must stand together to face our challenges.
when the chips are down.cn: 危机时刻，我们必须携手共克时艰。

where it's at.en: The party was held where it's at, with a live band and dancing.
where it's at.cn: 聚会就在原处举行，配有现场乐队和舞蹈。

where sb is coming from.en: We need to understand where the speaker is coming from before judging their claims.
where sb is coming from.cn: 在评判其主张前，需了解说话者的立场。

which is which.en: It's hard to tell who is which when everyone looks so similar.
which is which.cn: 众人长相如此相似，很难分辨谁是谁。

while sth else is happening.en: While other students were sleeping, he was diligently studying for his exams.
while sth else is happening.cn: 当其他学生还在睡觉时，他正勤奋地备考。

who's who.en: The list of delegates attending read like a who's who of the business world.
who's who.cn: 与会代表名单读起来像个商界名人录。

why ever.en: Why ever did you leave your umbrella at home again?
why ever.cn: 你怎么又把伞落在家里了？

wide of the mark.en: His estimate was wide of the mark, completely missing the actual figures.
wide of the mark.cn: 他的估计偏离了实际数据，完全未触及真实情况。

win or lose.en: Whether we win or lose, the team will remain united and motivated.
win or lose.cn: 无论胜负，球队都将团结一致、士气高昂。

win sb's heart.en: He finally won her heart by writing a heartfelt letter on the day of their anniversary.
win sb's heart.cn: 他在纪念日那天写了一封深情信，终于赢得了她的心。

wipe sth off sth.en: The detective tried to wipe the evidence off his memory.
wipe sth off sth.cn: 侦探试图抹去记忆中的证据。

wipe sth off the map.en: The scandal was so severe that it completely wiped the company off the map.
wipe sth off the map.cn: 该丑闻性质极其恶劣，致使该公司彻底销声匿迹。

wipe the slate clean.en: The new manager promised to wipe the slate clean and treat everyone equally.
wipe the slate clean.cn: 新经理承诺推倒重来，公平对待所有人。

wish sth away.en: I desperately wished the pain away, but it lingered for hours.
wish sth away.cn: 我痛不欲生地渴望疼痛消失，但它却持续了数小时。

with a difference.en: Her approach to the problem is entirely different, with a real difference from what we expected.
with a difference.cn: 她解决问题的方法截然不同，与我们预期的大相径庭。

with a flea in your ear.en: He tried to talk sense into her with a flea in his ear.
with a flea in your ear.cn: 他试图用耳语劝她讲道理。

with a human face.en: The government must act with a human face to address the people's urgent needs.
with a human face.cn: 政府必须以有人情味的方式应对民众的迫切需求。

with a vengeance.en: The team performed with a vengeance, scoring five goals in the final ten minutes.
with a vengeance.cn: 球队势如破竹，在最后十分钟连进五球。

with a will.en: She approached the challenge with a will, determined to succeed.
with a will.cn: 她满怀斗志迎接挑战，决心成功。

with all due respect.en: With all due respect, I must disagree with your assessment of the project's viability.
with all due respect.cn: 尽管我保留意见，但我必须指出您对项目可行性的评估有误。

with bated breath.en: He listened with bated breath, his heart pounding as he waited for the verdict.
with bated breath.cn: 他屏息凝神，心跳如鼓，等待着判决结果。

with dispatch.en: The company promised to process all your complaints with dispatch.
with dispatch.cn: 该公司承诺迅速处理您的所有投诉。

with gay abandon.en: He threw the ball with gay abandon, ignoring any chance of injury.
with gay abandon.cn: 他嬉笑玩弄地扔出球来，全然不顾受伤的可能。

with half an ear.en: He listened with half an ear, distracted by the constant notifications on his phone.
with half an ear.cn: 他心不在焉地听着，手机不断弹出的通知让他分神。

with knobs on.en: The new model is not only better but, with knobs on, completely transforms the experience.
with knobs on.cn: 新模型不仅更出色，而且通过旋钮调节彻底改变了体验。

with pleasure.en: I'd be delighted to help you with that project.
with pleasure.cn: 我很乐意协助您完成该项目。

with respect to sth.en: With respect to the budget, we must prioritize essential services over luxury items.
with respect to sth.cn: 关于预算，我们必须优先保障基本服务，而非奢侈物品。

with spaces between.en: The trees are planted with spaces between them to ensure proper growth.
with spaces between.cn: 树木之间留有间距，以确保其正常生长。

with that.en: With that, the team immediately launched into their final strategy.
with that.cn: 随后，团队立即投入最后的战略部署。

with the exception of.en: With the exception of a few minor errors, the report is comprehensive and accurate.
with the exception of.cn: 除少数小错外，该报告内容详实且准确。

with the sun.en: The birds began their morning chorus with the sun rising over the hills.
with the sun.cn: 鸟儿随着太阳从山丘升起而开始晨唱。

with tongue in cheek.en: He joked with tongue in cheek about the company's recent financial struggles.
with tongue in cheek.cn: 他半开玩笑地提及公司近期的财务困境。

with your bare hands.en: He managed to dismantle the complex machine with his bare hands, showing remarkable dexterity.
with your bare hands.cn: 他仅凭双手便拆解了这台复杂的机器，手法极为灵巧。

with your eyes open.en: You should invest with your eyes open, knowing the risks clearly.
with your eyes open.cn: 投资时务必明察秋毫，清楚知晓风险。

with your nose in the air.en: He walked into the room with his nose in the air, completely ignoring everyone else.
with your nose in the air.cn: 他鼻孔朝天走进房间，完全无视他人。

with your tail between your legs.en: He walked out with his tail between his legs after the harsh criticism.
with your tail between your legs.cn: 受到严厉批评后，他垂头丧气地走了出去。

within limits.en: The results are valid only within limits, not universally applicable.
within limits.cn: 结果仅在特定范围内有效，不具有普遍适用性。

without a second thought.en: She agreed to the proposal without a second thought, despite her reservations.
without a second thought.cn: 尽管心存疑虑，她仍毫不犹豫地同意了该提议。

without ceremony.en: They handed over the documents without ceremony, ignoring all formal protocols.
without ceremony.cn: 他们毫无仪式地递交了文件，无视所有正式程序。

without exception.en: Without exception, every student in the class passed the final exam.
without exception.cn: 全班无一学生未通过期末考试。

without fear or favour.en: The judge ruled without fear or favour, ensuring justice for all parties involved.
without fear or favour.cn: 法官公正无私地裁决，确保所有当事方获得正义。

without help.en: She managed to complete the complex project without help from anyone.
without help.cn: 她独自完成了这项复杂的项目。

without hurrying.en: He handled the crisis without hurrying, ensuring every detail was thoroughly addressed.
without hurrying.cn: 他从容应对危机，确保每一个细节都得到妥善处理。

woe to sb.en: Woe to you if you ever cross the path of that vengeful judge again.
woe to sb.cn: 若你再次遇上那位复仇的法官，灾祸便临头了。

wonders will never cease.en: It's astonishing that such bizarre occurrences keep happening without end.
wonders will never cease.cn: 令人难以置信的是，如此离奇的怪事竟一再发生，永无休止。

word for word.en: The translator rendered the ancient text word for word to preserve its original rhythm.
word for word.cn: 译者逐字翻译了古文字，以保留其原有的韵律。

words to that effect.en: He claimed he had no idea what she meant by those words to that effect.
words to that effect.cn: 他声称自己不知她以那些话所指为何意。

work at sth.en: She decided to work at improving her public speaking skills before the big presentation.
work at sth.cn: 她在大型演讲前决定先提升公开演讲能力。

work like a charm.en: The new study method works like a charm, helping me ace the exam.
work like a charm.cn: 这种新方法效果极佳，助我顺利通过考试。

work on sb.en: The lawyer worked hard on the client to secure a favorable settlement.
work on sb.cn: 律师为当事人争取有利和解方案付出了巨大努力。

work on sth.en: She decided to work on her presentation until the final minute.
work on sth.cn: 她决定一直工作到最后一分钟才结束演示。

work sth up into sth.en: The carpenter worked the rough timber up into a sturdy, polished table.
work sth up into sth.cn: 木匠将粗糙的原木加工成一张结实光亮的桌子。

work to rule.en: The union demanded workers work to rule, strictly adhering to every safety regulation.
work to rule.cn: 工会要求工人实行以工护厂，严格遵守各项安全规定。

work to sth.en: The team worked to the schedule, finishing the project two days ahead of time.
work to sth.cn: 该团队按进度工作，提前两天完成了项目。

work towards sth.en: We must work towards achieving sustainable energy solutions for the future.
work towards sth.cn: 我们必须致力于实现未来的可持续能源方案。

work up to sth.en: The project gradually worked up to a level where we could no longer ignore the risks.
work up to sth.cn: 该项目逐渐发展到我们再也无法忽视风险的程度。

work wonders.en: The new teaching method works wonders on the students' confidence and grades.
work wonders.cn: 这种新的教学方法极大地提高了学生的自信心和成绩。

work your arse off.en: He worked his arse off to catch up with the team's progress.
work your arse off.cn: 他拼尽全力追赶队伍的进度。

work your fingers to the bone.en: She worked her fingers to the bone to finish the project before the deadline.
work your fingers to the bone.cn: 她拼尽全力赶在截止日期前完成了项目。

work your way through sth.en: She worked her way through the thick book chapter by chapter.
work your way through sth.cn: 她逐章读完这本厚厚的书。

work your way up.en: She worked her way up from junior to senior manager over five years.
work your way up.cn: 她用了五年时间从初级经理晋升为高级经理。

working or ready to work.en: The server is fully operational and ready to handle incoming requests immediately.
working or ready to work.cn: 服务器已完全运行就绪，可立即处理请求。

worth sb's while.en: It is worth your while to invest in this promising startup today.
worth sb's while.cn: 今日投资这家有前景的初创企业值得您一试。

wring sb's hand.en: He wrung her hand tightly, showing his deep concern for her well-being.
wring sb's hand.cn: 他紧紧握住她的手，流露出对她安危的深切关怀。

wring sb's neck.en: I can't stand him anymore; I want to wring his neck for what he did.
wring sb's neck.cn: 我再也无法忍受他了；我要拧断他的脖子为他所做的事报仇。

wring your hands.en: She wrung her hands nervously while waiting for the exam results.
wring your hands.cn: 她焦急地搓着双手等待考试结果。

write sth into sth.en: We must write the penalty clause into the contract immediately.
write sth into sth.cn: 我们必须立即将惩罚条款写入合同。

year after year.en: Year after year, the same challenges have plagued our community.
year after year.cn: 年年如此，同样的挑战一直困扰着我们的社区。

year by year.en: The company's profits have grown steadily, year by year.
year by year.cn: 该公司利润逐年稳步增长。

yes and no.en: He gave a yes-and-no answer, leaving us completely uncertain about his true intentions.
yes and no.cn: 他给出了模棱两可的回答，让我们完全无法揣测他的真实意图。

you can say that again.en: You can say that again, as the data perfectly confirms our initial hypothesis.
you can say that again.cn: 您说得完全正确，数据完美证实了我们最初的假设。

you can't be too careful.en: You can't be too careful when handling such a volatile chemical substance.
you can't be too careful.cn: 处理这种易变化学试剂时，不可过于粗心。

you can't get away from sth.en: You can't get away from the fact that he lied to us.
you can't get away from sth.cn: 你无法否认他对我们撒谎的事实。

you can't keep a good man down.en: You can't keep a good man down, so his ambition will surely lead him to success.
you can't keep a good man down.cn: 英雄志在四方，他的雄心必将助他成功。

you could hear a pin drop.en: You could hear a pin drop as the entire audience waited for his verdict.
you could hear a pin drop.cn: 鸦雀无声，全场都在等待他的裁决。

you had me worried.en: You had me worried until I saw the text message from you.
you had me worried.cn: 看到你发的消息，我才放心下来。

you haven't lived.en: You haven't lived until you've experienced the thrill of winning the lottery.
you haven't lived.cn: 未曾体验过中彩票的快感，便不算真正生活过。

you live and learn.en: I never realized how complex the legal system is until I lived through that trial.
you live and learn.cn: 直到我亲身经历那场审判，我才意识到法律体系是多么复杂。

you never can tell.en: You never can tell what unexpected opportunities might arise in your life.
you never can tell.cn: 你永远无法预料生活中会出现哪些意想不到的机遇。

you never know.en: You never know, the next big opportunity might just appear right now.
you never know.cn: 说不定，下一个重大机遇此刻就会出现。

you see.en: You see, the data clearly indicates that our initial hypothesis was entirely incorrect.
you see.cn: 由此可见，数据清楚地表明我们最初的假设完全错误。

you win.en: I'll concede that your argument holds significant merit.
you win.cn: 我承认你的论点很有道理。

you'll be lucky.en: You'll be lucky if you manage to secure that rare opportunity before the deadline.
you'll be lucky.cn: 若能在截止日期前争取到这一难得的机会，你才算幸运。

you're a fine one to talk.en: You're a fine one to talk when you've never faced such challenges yourself.
you're a fine one to talk.cn: 你从未经历过这样的挑战，却还有资格来评判吗？

you're on.en: You're on, I'll take that bet right now.

you're welcome.en: You're welcome, and I'd be delighted to assist you further with your inquiries.
you're welcome.cn: 不客气，我很乐意进一步协助您解答疑问。

young at heart.en: Despite his advanced age, he remains young at heart and loves exploring new places.
young at heart.cn: 尽管年事已高，他依然童心未泯，热衷于探索新地方。

your all.en: You have my undying gratitude for everything you've done for us.
your all.cn: 感谢您为我们所做的一切，我们感激不尽。

your best bib and tucker.en: She arrived at the gala wearing her very best bib and tucker, looking absolutely radiant.
your best bib and tucker.cn: 她盛装出席舞会，光彩照人。

your conscience pricks you.en: The thought of lying made his conscience prick him deeply at night.
your conscience pricks you.cn: 夜晚想到说谎，他的良心便深感刺痛。

your daily bread.en: After years of struggle, his hard work finally provided his daily bread.
your daily bread.cn: 历经多年奋斗，他的辛勤劳作终于让他有了口饭吃。

your good deed for the day.en: You've done a wonderful thing today; it truly is your good deed for the day.
your good deed for the day.cn: 你今天做了一件了不起的事，这确实是你今日行善之举。

your heart goes out to sb.en: Your heart goes out to the victims of the recent earthquake.
your heart goes out to sb.cn: 对近期地震的遇难者深表同情。

your heart is not in sth.en: You clearly aren't enthusiastic about this project because your heart isn't in it.
your heart is not in sth.cn: 你显然对这个项目不感兴趣，因为你并不真心投入。

your mind's eye.en: You can visualize the entire project in your mind's eye before it begins.
your mind's eye.cn: 项目开始前，你已在脑海中构想出整个项目的全貌。

your number is up.en: His fate was sealed when his number finally came up in the lottery.
your number is up.cn: 他的命运在他终于抽中彩票号码时注定。

your obedient servant.en: I remain your most obedient servant, ready to assist whenever you require my services.
your obedient servant.cn: 我仍是最忠诚的仆人，随时准备为您提供协助。

your salad days.en: He is still in his salad days, unaware of the harsh realities he will soon face.
your salad days.cn: 他仍处于草创阶段，尚未意识到即将面临的严峻现实。

your thick head.en: I can't believe you still don't understand the instructions; your thick head is truly frustrating.
your thick head.cn: 我无法相信你还是不明白说明书；你那笨头笨脑的脑袋真是让人抓狂。

your true colours.en: When the storm broke, her true colours finally revealed themselves to everyone.
your true colours.cn: 风暴骤起，她真实的本性终于暴露于众人面前。
